标题: Analisis Teknologi Cryptocurrency Bitcoin Dalam Transaksi Bisnis: Perspektif Hukum Islam Dan Peraturan Mata Uang Di Indonesia
作者: laili nur fadila; Dovi Iwan Musthofa Habibillah
摘要: Abstrak. Penelitian ini menganalisis penggunaan Bitcoin dalam transaksi bisnis berdasarkan hukum Islam dan ketentuan mata uang di Indonesia. Fokus kajian meliputi karakteristik teknologi cryptocurrency, praktik transaksi, unsur yang dapat menyebabkan transaksi dibenarkan atau dilarang menurut fikih muamalah, serta kedudukan Bitcoin berdasarkan Undang-Undang Nomor 7 Tahun 2011 tentang Mata Uang dan Peraturan Bank Indonesia Nomor 18/40/PBI/2016. Penelitian menggunakan metode penelitian hukum normatif dengan pendekatan kepustakaan. Data dikumpulkan melalui penelaahan buku, artikel ilmiah, penelitian terdahulu, dan peraturan yang dibahas dalam naskah, kemudian dianalisis secara kualitatif. Hasil kajian menunjukkan bahwa teknologi blockchain memungkinkan pencatatan transaksi secara terdistribusi dan transaksi antarpengguna, tetapi karakteristik tersebut tidak dengan sendirinya menjadikan Bitcoin sebagai alat pembayaran yang sah di Indonesia. Dari perspektif hukum Islam, penilaian transaksi perlu mempertimbangkan objek dan tujuan transaksi, kejelasan akad, unsur kerelaan para pihak, serta ada tidaknya gharar, maysir, riba, dan penipuan. Penggunaan yang dominan spekulatif berisiko menimbulkan ketidakpastian dan kerugian. Kajian ini merekomendasikan agar pengguna memahami risiko dan status hukum yang berlaku, sedangkan penelitian selanjutnya perlu menelaah perkembangan regulasi dan praktik perdagangan aset kripto secara lebih mutakhir.

标题: Airdrop Sybil Attack detection framework supported by machine learning
摘要: A skilled hunter may earn thousands of dollars in tokens from a single airdrop, making airdrop Sybil assaults a profitable endeavor. In this situation, Sybil assaults are not always wanted by projects and are often seen as improper behavior by honest individuals, which may negatively impact a project's image. It is thus to be anticipated that detection methods for Sybil assaults would be continuously enhanced. This study presents a multistep structure. Its concept is to sort blockchain addresses and give each one a score that indicates whether it belongs to the Sybil or regular class. Topologies were classified using a graph isomorphism network, whose parameters were adjusted using a dataset that the authors labeled. In subsequent phases, the account clustering operation was performed using a DBSCAN. Each stage in the framework may be given arbitrary weights by users, which will decide how essential a step is to them and provide a different score for a particular address. A grid search strategy and a threshold after which the address is deemed Sybil were used to find the optimal weights. This article examined a collection of EOAs from the ZK sync rollup. Ultimately, 76% of the examined accounts were classified as Sybils. Compared to the official ZK sync eligibility list, we found 342 addresses that received airdrop tokens but were marked as Sybil by our solution.

标题: Cambium: Participant-Built Commitment Roots for Shared Digital Infrastructure
作者: Mansoor "Manny" Ahmed; Dann Toliver; Ekaterina Pavlova
摘要: Commitment services, such as timestamping, transparency logs and provenance registries, let a party prove that it bound itself to a record without publishing the record. Today an operator runs them, or a blockchain replaces the operator at the cost of network-wide agreement on every write. We present Cambium, a permissioned peer-to-peer service in which participants build each cycle's commitment root together, so that no single party decides which inputs the root includes. Fixed-size committees certify inputs and use a recursive-doubling merge, in which disjoint groups recompute every intermediate value, to spread root construction across all participants. A successful cycle costs each node $O(c\log(n/c))$ messages for committee size $c$, and each node stores its own $O(\log(n/c))$ proof per cycle, along with the $O(n)$ membership roster. A Go prototype on AWS with $c=4$, 8-256 nodes and simulated stragglers completes cycles in 12-148 ms and verifies proofs in under 1.5 ms, and demonstrates logarithmic growth. We show that conflicting certificates identify their signers, that a proof binds a signed input to its root, and that two conflicting roots both become final only if at least a third of the nodes are Byzantine, except with probability exponentially small in the number of committees. We also set out the membership, proof-availability and exclusion questions a community deploying Cambium must answer.

标题: IUBI: Mass Economic Policy Mechanism
摘要: Abstract This paper introduces the Incentivized Universal Basic Income (IUBI) framework, a blockchain-enabled and AI-governed economic model designed to provide a guaranteed income floor while rewarding constructive participation through a Merit-Based Dividend (MBD). The system leverages decentralized credit reputation, smart contracts, and adaptive AI feedback loops to create a fairer distribution of economic opportunity. The model is evaluated through comparative analysis with existing UBI trials, a formal mathematical scoring architecture, an XGBoost-based empirical validation on 10,000 synthetic participants, and a dual-layer governance design that separates domestic calibration from international oversight. Results indicate that IUBI's merit-aligned incentive structure addresses core failures of both unconditional redistribution and unregulated market compounding, achieving R2 = 0.80 on benefit-score regression and 63.9% accuracy on tier classification. The framework develops a mechanism for mass-population incentive in a world where machines and AI can produce whatever is required, so that the governing question shifts from scarcity to motivation.

标题: Market Dynamics and Risk in Digital Assets
摘要: This thesis examines key sources of risk and interconnectedness in digital asset markets through three empirical studies. Together, we analyse how operational vulnerabilities and intermarket connections influence return and volatility dynamics across evolving digital currency markets. In Chapter 2, we investigate how deviations of Tether from its US dollar peg affect the returns of ten major digital assets. Positive and negative depegging events are identified through both constant-threshold and time-varying frameworks. Return models are then estimated to evaluate how cryptocurrencies behave around these dates, both with and without pricing factors. The results show that downward depegging leads to immediate and statistically significant declines in returns, particularly at more severe thresholds. Upward depegging generally displays weak and inconsistent effects, while lagged responses point to limited reversal following large downward deviations. In Chapter 3, we analyse information transmission between cryptocurrencies, stablecoins, and traditional financial markets through a Granger-causality network spanning six sectors and 108 time series. The network maps predictive linkages across equities, commodities, corporate bonds, government bonds and macro indicators, non-stable cryptocurrencies, and stablecoins. The full-sample results reveal meaningful interconnectedness, with commodities and corporate bonds acting as central transmitters of causality, while macro variables and stablecoins are found to be fragile to external influences. Subsample analysis shows that interconnectedness peaked during the COVID-19 period and declined as markets moved toward post-pandemic normalisation, suggesting a gradual shift towards a more segmented and resilient financial structure. In Chapter 4, we evaluate operational risks faced by cryptocurrency exchanges, examining the effects of both cyber breaches on digital exchanges and exchange closures on Bitcoin returns and volatility. The results show that cyberattacks produce significant negative return shocks but do not affect volatility, whereas exchange closures primarily trigger volatility spikes. A further decomposition of exchange closure into four different types (operational failure, security breach, scam or fraud, and unknown) reveals that only failures related to business operations generate significant negative return effects. These findings emphasise the importance of distinguishing among types of operational shocks when assessing risk in digital asset markets.

标题: Reproduction artifact: Measuring the quantum-exposed supply of Bitcoin from a UTXO snapshot (T1 at height 935,000)
摘要: Reproduction artifact for the paper Measuring the quantum-exposed supply of Bitcoin from a UTXO snapshot. Every number in the paper is reproduced from a single public file: the Bitcoin mainnet assumeutxo snapshot at height 935,000 (base block time 2026-02-04 14:25 UTC). No node, no database; the full scan is 14 minutes single-threaded Python over a memory-mapped 9.4 GB file. Contents. Seven scripts (downloader, single-pass parser and classifier, era×type×coinbase targeted scan, share-derivation arithmetic, report and figure generators, synthetic-snapshot generator) and the published scan outputs (scan_result.json, p2pk_detail.json, by_type.csv, figure). The 9.4 GB snapshot itself is not included; it is fetched from the mirror Bitcoin Core v31.0 hardcodes for assumeutxo bootstrapping at this height, and its sha256 (e572ddbe456d254f05fb004cebe225bdb3656074b66f0e9b1c7fa83e1301d486) must be verified before parsing. Headline results (exact, not estimated). T1 — outputs whose scriptPubKey contains an elliptic-curve point (P2PK, bare multisig, P2TR key path) — comprises 57,362,046 outputs worth 1,912,247.31 BTC, i.e. 9.5688% of the 19,984,148.03 BTC in the set. By count T1 is 95.3% Taproot dust created after November 2021; by value it is 89.8% P2PK, 99.31% of which is unmoved coinbase revenue, 99.75% of it created before the first halving (December 2012). At 10 sat/vB at least 96.5% of T1 outputs are worth less than the cost of migrating them under a key-in-output post-quantum design (they hold at most 0.033% of V1); the actionable set is 1,244,270 outputs (2.17%) carrying 99.967% of the value at risk. Verification chain. (1) synthetic 309-coin sample over all eight script classes; (2) regtest snapshot generated by bitcoind itself (116 coins / 5,550 BTC); (3) production invariants: parsed count equals the header-declared 164,241,311, exact end-of-file termination, total within 0.1% of issued supply; (4) external anchors: base block hash matches the public block at height 935,000, earliest P2PK output at height 1, 33,648 outputs of exactly 50 BTC, and every script class first appears in the era containing its protocol activation (BIP-16/141/341). The known gap — the hash_serialized_3 commitment is not recomputed — is documented in the README with the mirror-published value for cross-checking. Requirements. Python 3.10+ (standard library for scan; matplotlib for the figure), ~10 GB disk. MIT license; author contact fengrongjun@163.com.

标题: The Crypto Prediction Divergence: When Accuracy Doesn't Equal Profit
摘要: This research explores the economic potential of integrating machine learning with technical analysis by analyzing major cryptocurrencies—Bitcoin, Ethereum, Litecoin, and Ripple -using long-term historical data from 2018 to 2024. While earlier studies have predominantly focused on short-term forecasts utilizing standard technical indicators, the broader performance of machine learning-assisted technical strategies across varying timeframes and market conditions remains underexplored. To bridge this research gap, XGBoost classification models are employed with a notably large feature set of 771 technical indicators, a scope rarely seen in prior literature. These models are used to evaluate predictive accuracy over forecast horizons ranging from 5 to 120 trading days. The most consistent and accurate predictions are observed for selected cryptocurrencies, especially over the 120-day period. Unexpectedly, the highest annualized returns emerge from shorter forecast horizons, such as 5 days. Elevated market volatility further enhances both predictive accuracy and trading profitability. This divergence likely stems from the models being tuned for classification accuracy rather than return optimization. Additionally, the study finds that despite strong predictive performance, technical analysis may not be universally applicable or effective across all cryptocurrencies.

标题: The Implication of Cryptocurrency Volatility on the Financial System Stability of the Five Largest MENA Financial Markets: Evidence from Diagonal BEKK-GARCH and DCC-GARCH Models
作者: Hicham Es-Saadi; Zakariae Bel Mkaddem; Mohammed Amine; Imane Tesse
摘要: The rapid integration of cryptocurrencies into the East and North Africa (MENA) financial landscape has raised concerns about domestic financial systems’ exposure to crypto-market turbulence. This paper investigates the implications of cryptocurrency volatility for the financial system stability of the five largest MENA financial markets: Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, Qatar, Egypt and Morocco. Using daily data on Bitcoin, Ethereum and the benchmark stock indices of the five markets (TASI, DFMGI, QE General, EGX 30 and MASI) from January 2018 to December 2025, we estimate bivariate diagonal and full BEKK-GARCH(1,1) models for each cryptocurrency–stock-index pair, complemented by DCC-GARCH(1,1) models that trace time-varying conditional correlations. Own-volatility persistence is high in all markets (0.88–1.00). Volatility spillovers are bidirectional but asymmetric: transmission from MENA equity markets to cryptocurrencies is significant in all ten pairs, whereas crypto-to-equity spillovers are significant for Saudi Arabia, the UAE and Qatar, marginal for Egypt, and absent for Morocco. Dynamic conditional correlations are low on average (0.04–0.13) but increase significantly during crisis episodes, notably for the Gulf markets, indicating contagion rather than pure interdependence. MENA financial systems’ exposure to crypto-induced instability therefore remains moderate but is rising, and is highest in the more open Gulf markets. These findings call for the integration of crypto-market indicators into the macroprudential surveillance frameworks of MENA central banks and for differentiated, risk-based regulatory responses.

标题: An adaptive spatio-temporal framework for carbon-aware and privacy-preserving DNN partitioning
摘要: Introduction Choosing where to split a deep neural network (DNN) between device and cloud requires balancing latency, carbon emissions, privacy and device thermal state, which existing partitioning methods rarely address jointly. Methods We propose GreenSplit, an adaptive spatio-temporal framework that selects the split layer and cloud region by minimising a normalised four-term cost under a hard privacy exclusion zone, with an Adaptive Weight Controller (AWC), current and forecast carbon intensity, Laplace noise on transmitted activations, a thermal-battery model, and a dynamic voltage and frequency scaling (DVFS) safeguard. We evaluated it in simulation on MobileNetV2 across three cloud regions (200 sustained-load trials), extended the decision model to ResNet-50, ViT-Base and the CLIP ViT-B/32 image encoder, and tested the noise mechanism on a pretrained ImageNet MobileNetV2 with 1,000 real images. Results Under our assumed energy constants, offloading a lightweight CNN is carbon-costly (5.8–6.7 × on-device carbon), so the framework keeps MobileNetV2 local; it then behaves as local execution with DVFS, emitting 66.0% of the carbon of unmanaged local execution with no privacy-zone violations (4% for baselines without the zone). Its 32.5% throttle rate at nominal thermal parameters is not robust (0–100% over plausible parameters), although DVFS lowers throttling in every draw. Laplace noise at operating budgets (ϵ r ≤ 10 leaves the cloud classifying at chance, while accuracy-preserving budgets ( ϵ r ≈ 3 × 1 0 4 –3 × 10 5 ) allow perfect re-identification among 1,000 images and give a vacuous differential-privacy bound. The AWC's benefit in its original scenario does not transfer to unseen disturbances in its original min–max form; a fixed-scale variant is stable but gives only a modest gain and no thermal benefit. Discussion The hard exclusion zone, not the noise, provides utility-preserving protection. All results are simulated; validation on physical devices is required.

标题: Temporal Graph Neural Networks for Risk Detection Under Distribution Shift
摘要: This independent historical empirical benchmark has not been peer-reviewed. The research software evaluates Logistic Regression, LightGBM, GraphSAGE, graph attention networks, and GraphSAGE with historical GRU context on the original Elliptic Bitcoin dataset using chronological splits and matched 18-, 93-, and 165-feature inputs. LightGBM achieves pooled test average precision of 0.5993, 0.7639, and 0.7866, exceeding each matched neural mean. At its frozen F1 threshold, the 165-feature model detects 4 of 169 known illicit transactions in steps 43–49 (2.37% recall). The package includes five notebooks, aggregate results, figures, and the frozen evaluation protocol. Evaluation covers known labels. Released successor features may include information beyond snapshot end. The 18-feature set reduces exposure to documented leakage mechanisms, and its point-in-time safety remains unverified. On November 15, 2026, a local CPU audit replayed all 33 frozen models using verified original Elliptic data and retained checkpoints. The maximum absolute pooled AP difference was 0.00000221 and all frozen F1 decisions matched. External independent inference reproduction remains unverified. Raw data, checkpoints, and per-transaction predictions are excluded. MIT applies to original software and accompanying software documentation. CC BY 4.0 applies to the original manuscript and eligible original artwork. The underlying Elliptic data and other third-party material retain their own terms.

标题: Enigma Root of Trust: A Third-Party Notary for National and Corporate Ledgers
摘要: Many records must be trusted by parties who share no owner: an export certificate issued in one country and checked on arrival in another, a mining licence checked by a buyer, a supplier's declaration checked by a regulator. Enigma Root of Trust is a ledger operated by a neutral third party into which registered members (ministries, agencies and companies) write cryptographic fingerprints of their own records. A member's records never leave the member: it writes a Merkle root of a period's records, signed with its own keys, so the operator can order and preserve commitments but cannot create or alter them. The root is the Enigma Blockchain of IAIC-TR-2026-01, with no coin, no token and no fees, anchored in the Bitcoin blockchain through OpenTimestamps. The report specifies the roles of operator, member, witness and verifier, the commitment format and acceptance rules, daily anchoring and a fallback against censorship by the operator, the verification algorithm, corridors between members under which a certificate can be received only once, contract interfaces, rules enforced by smart contracts and checked for all inputs, AI-assisted monitoring that flags but never decides, the threat model and the implementation status. It applies the design to a verified gold corridor between Ghana and the United Arab Emirates, built on top of whichever traceability system Ghana selects, and closes with a six-week proof-of-concept plan.

标题: MediVault: A Decentralized RAG-Driven Framework for Secure and Interoperable Healthcare Data Management
作者: Aiman Gulzar; Boomika Shetty; Deepashree N; Janaki K.B; Lavanya N.L
摘要: The increasing digitization of healthcare has created significant challenges in securely storing, managing, and sharing sensitive medical records.Centralized healthcare systems may expose patient information to unauthorized access and provide limited control over medical data.To address these challenges, this paper presents MediVault, a decentralized framework for secure healthcare data management using blockchain, InterPlanetary File System (IPFS), encryption, smart contracts, and a locally deployed Large Language Model (LLM).The proposed system enables patients to manage their medical records and control access granted to authorized healthcare providers.Medical records are encrypted before being stored in IPFS, while blockchain-based smart contracts support access authorization, revocation, and audit-related operations.A break-glass mechanism is incorporated to facilitate controlled emergency access.In addition, a local AI assistant using Ollama and Phi-3 Mini enables users to interact with available medical-record information without relying on external cloud-based AI services.The system is implemented using Streamlit and SQLite, providing a patient-centric approach to secure and privacy-aware healthcare data management.

标题: The science of OX212: how we measure, forecast and stop the behavior that costs a trader the most money
作者: Proxima Creative Co. LLC OX212 team
摘要: Between 74% and 89% of retail CFD accounts in Europe lose money. Among all day traders in Taiwan over fifteen years, fewer than 1% earn reliable profits after fees. Thirty years of research point to a recurring cause: the trader's behavior at their worst moments, more than their reading of the market. OX212 measures that behavior, session by session, using each trader's real trades. Before each session it writes a forecast of what the trader is likely to do. During the session it sends alerts and, only if the trader has authorized it in advance, pauses their account. Every forecast is sealed in the Bitcoin blockchain before anyone knows whether it is correct. It is then checked against what happened, the same principle science uses to register a hypothesis before the experiment. Anyone can verify the record independently. This white paper sets out the published research the approach stands on (38 references), what OX212 measures, how its forecasts are proven, and what it is not. It is published in English and Spanish.

标题: Graph-Based Financial Fraud Detection: A Property-Centric Survey of Static, Temporal, Cycle-Aware, and Generative Methods and Their Evaluation
作者: Daniel T. Ale; E. O. Ogunti; S. A. Oyetunji; A. A. Ponnle; K. B. Adedeji
摘要: Financial fraud is increasingly coordinated across multiple accounts and transactions, meaning that its evidence often lies in relationships between accounts, the sequence of events, and, in schemes such as money laundering and wash trading, closed loops of transfers rather than in individual records. This review examines graph-based methods for detecting such fraud, covering static and temporal graph neural networks, graph anomaly detection, cycle- and motif-aware methods, generative models, and the evaluation practices used to assess them. The review draws on 147 sources identified through a documented literature search protocol. Four findings emerge. First, no single method family performs best under all conditions: tree-based models remain highly competitive on feature-rich datasets, whereas graph-based and temporal models offer greater advantages when discriminative signals reside in relational structures or transaction sequences. Second, detecting cyclic laundering is fundamentally a representational problem: standard message-passing architectures have limited ability to capture cycle structures, while recent performance gains have been associated with representations that preserve the directed multigraph structure of transactions rather than simply increasing model complexity. Third, evaluation practices, including temporal leakage and threshold selection using test data, can inflate reported performance and undermine the reliability of comparisons. Fourth, a taxonomy of eight method families evaluated against four properties required for coordinated, temporal, and partially observed fraud detection—temporal awareness, probabilistic generation, cycle awareness, and intrinsic explainability—reveals that none of the reviewed families provides all four properties. This identifies a central research gap in the current literature. Building on these findings, the review proposes cyclic fraud as a structural stress test for future detection methods and provides an evaluation checklist to address the methodological weaknesses identified.

标题: Dynamic graph anomaly detection via temporal-structural attention and variational graph autoencoder
作者: Jiayu Sun; Zhiliang Shang; Zhigang Sun; Xiang Min Zhao; Guoyong Cai; Ruiheng Ling; Chuang Lei
摘要: Abstract With the increasing application of dynamic graph data in social networks, financial services and cybersecurity, dynamic graph anomaly detection has attracted growing attention. Due to the dynamicity and complexity arising from the continuous evolution of dynamic graph topology, existing methods face challenges in effectively modeling complex temporal features and capturing the intricate dependencies between temporal and structural information. These challenges hinder the comprehensive capture of spatiotemporal features in dynamic graphs, thereby limiting anomaly detection performance. To address these issues, we propose a novel dynamic graph anomaly detection method that integrates Temporal-Structural Attention graph embedding with Variational Graph Autoencoder (TSAVGA). Our approach innovatively employs a hierarchical temporal-structural attention mechanism to capture short-term spatiotemporal features, while leveraging a GCN-GRU enhanced variational graph autoencoder to model deeper long-term dependencies. In addition, we design a spectral clustering-based anomaly injection strategy to augment the diversity of anomalies in the training data. Experimental results on six real-world datasets demonstrate that TSAVGA outperforms state-of-the-art methods by 1% to 5% in AUC, and maintains robust performance across varying anomaly ratios, confirming both the effectiveness and stability of our method.

标题: A wind power prediction method based on CEEMDAN- LightGBM-Transformer
作者: Jingsong ZHANG; Yukai Zhou; Chu Xiao-rui; Yuanyuan Yang; Yangdi Xu
摘要: In the development of green energy, wind power, as the core clean energy, has the inherent intermittency, volatility and randomness of its output, which is very easy to cause the power imbalance of the energy system and the surge of grid accommodation pressure, seriously restricting the safe and stable operation of the energy system. This study proposes the CEEMDAN-LightGBM-Transformer model. First, Complete ensemble empirical mode decomposition with adaptive noise(CEEMDAN) decomposes the data into multiple intrinsic mode function(IMF), and uses the "drop_k" strategy to select IMF components with prominent feature information and low redundancy, effectively stripping the noise and invalid fluctuations in wind power output data, and consolidating the foundation for accurate analysis of energy data. Then, Light gradient boosting machine(LightGBM) is used to construct nonlinear features, which are combined with strong correlation linear features to rank the importance of features, and accurately explore the correlation between wind power output and multidimensional factors. Finally, the multi-dimensional features are fused using a Transformer with an Encoder-Decoder architecture to generate a low-error power prediction sequence. The experimental results show that compared with multiple classical baseline models such as random forest, the mean value of Root Mean Squared Error (mRMSE) and mean value of Mean Absolute Error(mMAE) of this model are reduced by 61%, and the R² value is more than 98%, which has significant advantages in prediction performance. In addition, CEEMDAN, LightGBM and Transformer have shown good synergy in enhancing the performance of the model, which can effectively cope with the complex dynamic operating characteristics of wind power systems. The accurate prediction model can effectively stabilize the fluctuation risk of energy system caused by wind power integration, and provide reliable technical support for the grid dispatching of new power system.

标题: Uma política econômica da ignorância: A representação do Estado e de grandes bancos como males por ‘influencers’ de investimentos
摘要: O objetivo deste artigo é analisar como o discurso de convencimento de influencers de investimentos mobiliza a negativização moral do Estado e dos chamados “grandes bancos”, afirmando-os como produtores de ignorância financeira – uma incompetência que seus ensinamentos viriam a corrigir. Metodologicamente, realizamos uma análise semiótica e situacional de vídeos publicados no YouTube e de um corpus de autoajuda financeira. A análise mostra que a crítica ao Estado é operada por meio de denúncia de espoliação e de promessas ilusórias, mobilizando a urgência e a projeção dos piores mundos possíveis, enquanto a crítica aos bancos se concentra na figura do gerente interesseiro, inscrita na disputa entre corretoras/fintechs e bancos tradicionais. Propomos, a partir disso, uma matriz de elementos da crítica à política econômica empreendida por essa parcela do mercado financeiro.

标题: Game Changers or Coincidences? Analyzing Bitcoin's and FBToken's Influence on Fenerbahce Assets
摘要: Today's financial markets are shaped by the interaction of traditional instruments and digital assets such as cryptocurrencies. This study examines the short- and long-term relationships between the financial assets of Fenerbahçe Sports Club—specifically its stock price (FBS) and fan token (FBT)—Google Trends search interest (FBG), and Bitcoin (BTC). The analysis is based on weekly data covering the period from November 22, 2022, to November 30, 2023. The Autoregressive Distributed Lag (ARDL) model was employed to investigate both short- and long-term dynamics. The empirical results reveal no significant long-term relationship between Bitcoin and the other variables. However, Fenerbahçe’s stock price and fan token value have a statistically significant and positive impact on search interest, indicating that the club’s financial performance influences public attention and fan engagement. In the short run, lagged Bitcoin prices negatively affect Fenerbahçe-related financial assets, suggesting delayed investor reactions to cryptocurrency market movements. Additionally, lagged values of Google Trends have a positive and significant effect, underlining the role of digital attention in shaping asset fluctuations. The findings contribute to the growing literature on sports finance and behavioral economics, demonstrating that sports-related assets are influenced by both market fundamentals and public sentiment indicators such as search trends.

标题: Transport revolutions and urban development: Historical trajectories and possible futures
作者: Ennio Cascetta; Marilisa Botte; Anna Limmatola
摘要: The configuration of cities has experienced profound changes over time, and one of the lenses through which these shifts can be interpreted is the emergence of successive transport technologies and systems, giving rise to major transport revolutions. Most of the first six of such revolutions have historically contributed to shaping urban morphology. This paper addresses this via the “one-hour city” hypothesis that combines the Travel Time Budget (TTB) assumption with the average travel distance and the speed allowed by the prevailing transport technology. Today, a seventh transport revolution is potentially unfolding, propelled by decarbonization, autonomous driving, and the introduction of digital mobility services. This ongoing transition holds the potential to reshape both the spatial and functional dimensions of cities, although overall effects are still unpredictable. These changes have been widely researched in recent years but often with reference to specific features. This paper presents research results in a holistic view, proposing two extreme, opposing scenarios. The first is based on a model of car ownership similar to the present, only based on autonomous cars. This scenario will be labelled as the “autonomous-car city.” Research results suggest an increase in car demand and congestion, as well as a decrease in public transport ridership. Conversely, the “post-car city” scenario shifts from ownership to a “car-as-a-service” paradigm using shared, electric autonomous fleets. This transition drastically reduces parking footprint, enabling urban space reclamation and better separation between motorized and active transport modes. In both scenarios, public transit and individual mobility blur into Demand-Responsive Mobility Services. As for city dimensions, the analytical model would suggest that, given that the commercial speed of future services is arguably comparable to the present, spatial dimensions will depend on the value of average TTB. This paper concludes with some policy recommendations to steer future cities toward more sustainable trajectories.

标题: A Bilinear Neural Network Framework for the Fourth-Order Ablowitz-Kaup-Newell-Segur Equation and Physics-Informed Wireless MCS Prediction
作者: Nguyen Minh Tuan; Chaiyod Kamthorncharoen; Surattana Sungnul; Sekson Sirisubtawee; Chukiat Saksurakan
摘要: This paper presents a novel hybrid analytical–computational framework based on the bilinear neural network method (BNNM) for solving the fourth-order Ablowitz–Kaup–Newell–Segur (4AKNS) water wave equation with perturbation. By employing Hirota's bilinear transformation, the original nonlinear partial differential equation is systematically converted into a bilinear form, providing the construction of a test function representation. Instead of directly approximating the physical solution, the proposed approach learns the test function using a feedforward neural network combined with automatic differentiation. To enhance training stability and convergence, a softmax-based adaptive weighting strategy is incorporated into the loss function, allowing the model to focus on low-residual regions. Several analytical solution structures, including kink waves, soliton–periodic interactions, and periodic waves, are constructed and validated through multiple case studies. Numerical experiments demonstrate that the proposed method achieves stable convergence, high accuracy, and strong robustness across diverse solution types. The results confirm that the bilinear neural network framework is an effective and flexible tool for solving nonlinear integrable systems, providing both accurate approximations and the ability to maintain complex wave dynamics.

标题: Does Conditional Covariance Outperform Empirical Covariance? A Study of Portfolio Optimization Techniques
作者: Akshay Damani; Anish Nair; Urmi Mangal; Radhika Bhutra
摘要: This study analyses two academically utilised approaches of dynamic conditional correlation GARCH (DCC-GARCH) and historical/empirical covariance for covariance matrix estimation and their impact on portfolio optimization is studied during crisis periods. The researchers have collected data for a period of 9 months (i.e. the crisis period) of a multi-asset portfolio that is diversified across countries. This paper also compares different optimisation techniques to not only have a more robust comparison between results from the estimation of covariance matrix, but also to study which optimisation technique benefits the most from the change in covariance matrix estimation method and performs the best during the studied crisis period. It evaluates four strategies: mean-variance optimization (MVO), cluster risk parity (CRP), naïve risk parity (NRP), and equal weighting. The results indicate that DCC-GARCH based covariance matrix estimation provides a much better result for portfolio optimisation during the crisis period studied, and that max Sharpe portfolio optimisation technique benefits the most from said estimation method while CRP and NRP witness no benefit from the same. These results add to the existing literature showing the outperformance of DCC-GARCH in covariance estimation and highlights an additional nuance of variance in results based on which optimisation technique is used.

标题: A HERANÇA DE CRIPTOMOEDAS E OS DESAFIOS DE ACESSO PELOS HERDEIROS
作者: Vinícius Angelo Lessa Holanda; Carina Gassen Martins Clemes
摘要: O avanço das tecnologias digitais e a crescente utilização de criptomoedas transformaram as relações patrimoniais e trouxeram novos desafios ao Direito das Sucessões. Este trabalho analisa a transmissão sucessória de criptoativos e as dificuldades de acesso enfrentadas pelos herdeiros, distinguindo carteiras sob custódia de prestadoras de serviços de ativos virtuais daquelas mantidas em autoguarda. O problema consiste em compreender como assegurar a transmissão desses bens diante da ausência de disciplina sucessória específica, embora já exista marco normativo geral para os ativos virtuais. A pesquisa é bibliográfica e documental, de abordagem qualitativa e finalidade descritivo-analítica, com consulta a doutrina, legislação e decisões judiciais. Os resultados indicam que os criptoativos dotados de valor econômico podem integrar o acervo hereditário, mas a identificação dos ativos, a comprovação da titularidade e o acesso às chaves privadas constituem obstáculos relevantes. Conclui-se que a efetividade sucessória exige planejamento preventivo e disciplina normativa que compatibilize o direito à herança, a segurança dos ativos e a privacidade.

标题: Measurement Sensitivity of Apparent Volatility Roughness in Perpetual Futures
摘要: The association between perpetual-futures funding and measured volatility roughness changes with both the statistic and the path used to construct it. Using Binance Bitcoin and Ether perpetual futures from January 2020 through July 2026, I compare increment-variance slopes, pre-averaged slopes, and normalized p-variation on common six-hour windows. Both slope measures yield negative funding coefficients in level and month-fixed-effects specifications. A paired decomposition identifies two sources of disagreement. On the same log-realized-variance path, switching from the increment-variance slope to p-variation attenuates Bitcoin’s level coefficient by 0.00609 per funding standard deviation. Holding p-variation fixed and switching from log variance to realized volatility attenuates Ether’s month-fixed-effects coefficient by 0.00191. Both contrasts have Holm-adjusted p-values of 0.0123. The results show why empirical comparisons of roughness across funding conditions need to account for both the statistic and the input path.

标题: Towards verifiable accountability for autonomous AI agents via cryptographic decision anchoring
摘要: As robots increasingly operate under the control of autonomous AI agents in safety-critical and socially sensitive environments, the ability to audit and verify past decisions becomes essential for trust, liability, and post-incident analysis. However, conventional logging mechanisms do not provide guarantees against post hoc manipulation of recorded agent behavior. This paper proposes a lightweight, reproducible framework for tamper-evident logging of autonomous multi-agent decisions, based on cryptographic commitments and blockchain anchoring, as an integrity building block for AI accountability. In the proposed approach, agents record selected decision events off-chain, aggregate them using Merkle trees, and periodically anchor resulting root hashes to an immutable ledger. This design enables efficient storage while ensuring that any modification of committed decision logs after anchoring becomes cryptographically detectable. We implement the framework in an open-source multi-agent robotic simulation and evaluate it under honest and adversarial logging scenarios. Across twelve attack types with 1,000 trials each, every modification of committed decision records was detected against the on-chain commitment, with no false positives in 1,000 honest runs, whereas a local check without the anchor missed every attack once the attacker also rewrote the local commitments. Verification took about 7 µs per recorded decision, a single decision could be verified in about 20 µs with a proof below 1 kB, and each run required one anchoring transaction of 188 virtual bytes, regardless of the number of agents and decisions. The framework guarantees the integrity of what has been committed while keeping the underlying decision records off-chain until an audit requires them. The main contribution is a practical architecture for verifiable decision records of AI agents. It combines selective logging, efficient cryptographic verification, and reproducible experimentation, and lays a foundation for post hoc auditing of autonomous robotic systems.

A Study of Blockchain Based Solutions towards Fraudulent Practices in Bangladesh
摘要: The objective of this study is to investigate how blockchain’s unique technological properties –immutability, cryptographic verification and decentralization- could be utilized to mitigate fraudulent practices in Bangladesh, with a particular emphasis on financial reporting fraud, LC fraud, payment fraud and tax evasion (especially VAT). This study employs an exploratory and qualitative methodology, obtaining secondary data from scholarly articles, handbooks and professional reports. Through critical analysis, this study evaluates blockchain’s potential in deterring fraud and identifies some major challenges associated with its implementation in Bangladesh. The findings highlight blockchain’s immense potential to mitigate fraudulent practices based on its distributed ledgers across multiple stakeholders, immutable audit trails and smart contract-based verification. In financial reporting, blockchain’s triple-entry accounting considerably reduces scope for financial statements manipulation; it has the potential to minimize LCrelated fraud by strengthening the authenticity of trade documents; it increases transaction security and integrity in both local and cross-border digital payment system; and in the field of taxation, it improves the traceability of documents and tax compliance. However, data privacy concerns, technological readiness and adoption costs are some challenges that remain as critical obstacles in Bangladesh context. This research has importance as it attempts to fill in a notable gap in Bangladesh context, where perpetrators are rampant but blockchain implementation is very limited. By integrating global best practices with national realities, this study offers significant insights for academia, regulators and policymakers for designing effective strategies to counter fraudulent activities by harnessing the power of blockchain technology.

标题: Real-Time Bitcoin Price Prediction Through Streaming Data and Machine Learning
作者: N. Madhuri; R. Tamilkodi; S. Jyothi; K. Rohini; B. Sai SriKanth; P. Pramod Kumar
摘要: The first-ever cryptocurrency, Bitcoin (BTC), has revolutionized the financial systems of the world with its decentralized blockchain technology that makes paying without third parties possible with the needed security in peer-to-peer transactions. While Bitcoin is fast becoming popular, it is highly volatile in terms of pricing that makes it extremely dangerous and difficult for traders and investors. In order to overcome this problem, the current paper presents the construction of a data collection and prediction model using Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks to forecast the price trends of Bitcoin. The Bitcoin prices are collected through the Binance API and normalized, segmented, and reshaped before modeling to recognize the trends in time series financial data. Based on the general analysis of the forecasted results against the actual market data and comparative analysis, it is clear that the developed model can be used for both short-term price changes and long-term price predictions. Based on the results, the use of deep learning models for predictions can provide reliable information in terms of optimizing trading strategies and reducing financial risks, which can be used to make more informed decisions in cryptocurrency trading.

标题: Timing the Window: A gated regime engine for issuance and rotation in crypto-asset markets — architecture, calibration from operator heuristics, and conditional derivations for cascade rotation and treasury-levered equity exposure
作者: Marcos Elias-Eliashberg Elias; Marcos Eduardo Elias Eliashberg Elias
摘要: Capital markets open and close windows capriciously, and an issuer who must act once, irreversibly, has a different problem from a trader who may act continuously. This paper formalises an instrument built to decide the first problem: an admission clock that states, at any date, whether the window for placing a new instrument is open, how far open, and what dose that grade permits. The instrument is a conjunction of three gates — internal readiness, market regime, and a veto list — and not a weighted index, a design choice we defend on the ground that averaging allows an open gate to compensate a closed one, which is precisely the error an irreversible act cannot absorb. The regime gate is driven by a latent-factor engine whose identification rests on a point we believe has been underweighted in practice: an index assembled exclusively from indicators endogenous to the crypto market measures a single factor that is itself a transformation of the price level, and therefore carries no information about the future willingness of capital to finance an unseasoned instrument. We show that the primary equity issuance market supplies an exogenous and leading measurement of that same latent variable, and that the relevant measurement is the count and receptivity of small deals rather than aggregate proceeds — a distinction the 2026 data make vivid, with record United States proceeds accompanied by a thirty-four per cent fall in the number of deals priced. The paper's technical core converts the tacit knowledge of a daily operator into testable propositions. We obtain three results worth isolating. First, under a margin buffer set proportionally to the prevailing volatility level, the probability that a carry position breaches its buffer is exactly invariant to the level of volatility and depends, to second order, only on the volatility of volatility; the dependence is strictly increasing when the buffer exceeds √2 standard deviations and reverses below it. This gives the lockability gate a defensible threshold variable and explains why a carry bid withdraws in unstable markets without any change in the mean level of risk. Second, the rotation cascade that carries capital from bitcoin outward to the market's tail is asymmetric in its lag structure, not merely in sign: in expansion it propagates head-to-tail with a positive and tier-increasing lag, which is what makes it exploitable and what gives an issuer warning; in contraction it propagates at lag zero with amplification greater than one, which gives no warning and dries the tail first. Third, the equity of a company holding a leveraged bitcoin treasury is not a levered claim on bitcoin but a levered claim on the regime factor, with elasticity β = λ(1 + ε_m) decomposing into a balance-sheet channel and a premium-elasticity channel, both of which reverse sign together; the accretion identity Δq/q = (ΔV/SN)(1 − 1/m) shows the issuance loop inverting exactly at a multiple of one, which the 2025–2026 compression of these multiples and the observable conversion of such companies from net buyers into net sellers appear to bear out. A fourth result was added in this version and is negative. The whole architecture presupposes that the admission window is exogenous — that assent must be obtained from a party the issuer does not control. Where the issuer can operate its own venue, the predicate degenerates into a preference, and three identities follow: in a constant-product pool the marginal price is the ratio of seeded reserves, so the opening price is declared rather than discovered; slippage depends on the fraction of the pool reserve transacted and not on circulating float, so depth decouples from the float arithmetic; and the liquidity position is concave in price, so the issuer who seeds his own pool writes a continuous strip of options on his own instrument — the precise arrangement the dose parameters were designed to avoid. We then state the derivations the instrument supports, including the conditions under which a directional view is better expressed down the cascade than at its head, and the conditions under which treasury-levered equity amplifies a view rather than merely levering a loss. Each derivation is stated with what it forbids as well as what it permits. Finally, we apply the instrument to the dated state of the market on 15 November 2026 and report that the window reads closed, with one gate — the breadth of institutional access — at its most open in the instrument's history while every other reading is adverse. That configuration is the paper's best argument for conjunction over averaging, and the call is published in advance so that it can fail in public.

标题: THE CONVERGENCE OF FORENSIC SCIENCE AND DIGITAL TECHNOLOGY IN ENHANCING CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION EFFICACY: A TECHNO-LEGAL AND EMPIRICAL SYNTHESIS
摘要: Purpose: Modern criminal investigations operate at the intersection of molecular forensic science and pervasive digital technology. This study evaluates how advancements in biological, chemical, and cyber-digital methodologies synergize to elevate investigation efficacy-defined across four metrics: triage velocity, probative objectivity, scientific reproducibility, and judicial resilience. Design/Methodology/Approach: Employing a qualitative-empirical, doctrinal, and comparative techno-legal methodology, this paper synthesizes peer-reviewed forensic literature (2003–2026), statutory frameworks (including the U.S. Federal Rules of Evidence, European ISO/IEC 17025 standards, and India’s Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 and Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023), and landmark judicial precedents. Findings: Cross-domain corroboration—fusing physical trace evidence (Rapid DNA, Massively Parallel Sequencing, non-invasive virtopsy, and laser-ablation spectrometry) with digital telemetry (mobile physical extractions, Internet of Things sensors, artificial intelligence triage, and blockchain-secured chains of custody)-significantly compresses suspect identification timelines, increases pre-trial resolution rates, and mitigates wrongful convictions. However, operational efficacy remains constrained by laboratory backlogs, proprietary “black-box” algorithmic opacity, end-to-end encryption (“going dark”), cross-border cloud jurisdiction delays, and Fourth Amendment/constitutional privacy tensions. Originality/Value: Unlike studies that examine physical forensics and cyber investigation in isolation, this manuscript presents an integrated cyber-physical evidentiary model alongside actionable policy reforms for judicial gatekeeping, algorithmic auditing, and decentralized forensic triage.

标题: BITCOIN COMO ATIVO FINANCEIRO: UMA ANÁLISE BIBLIOMÉTRICA DA PRODUÇÃO CIENTÍFICA ENTRE 2020 E 2024
作者: João Victor Jansen; Dayana Carla de Macedo; Flávia Mariane Mores
摘要: Este artigo tem como finalidade examinar a literatura científica recente sobre o Bitcoin, considerando seu papel como ativo de investimento no contexto financeiro contemporâneo. Para isso, foi realizada uma investigação bibliométrica com base na plataforma Scopus, adotando-se o método Methodi Ordinatio como critério de seleção e classificação dos estudos, além da utilização do software VOSviewer para o mapeamento de autores, palavras-chave e conexões temáticas. Os resultados revelam uma literatura ainda em consolidação, marcada por abordagens diversas e dispersão entre autores, mas com crescente interesse por parte da comunidade acadêmica. Identificaram-se tópicos centrais como volatilidade de preços, diversificação de portfólios, riscos regulatórios e uso estratégico do Bitcoin em contextos de instabilidade econômica. Também se verificou que a produção científica está distribuída entre países com perfis econômicos variados, indicando que o interesse pelo ativo não se restringe a mercados desenvolvidos. A análise das palavras-chave mostra a presença de temas emergentes como inteligência artificial, sustentabilidade e eventos geopolíticos, sinalizando a expansão do campo de pesquisa.

标题: RSI Threshold Configurations and Signal Behaviour in Cryptocurrency and Traditional Markets: An Empirical Analysis on Weekly Data
作者: Hatem Mabrouk; Federico Trigos; Francisco Valderrey
摘要: Decision-making in financial markets increasingly relies on technical indicators embedded in digital trading platforms; however, the empirical basis for their standard parameterisations is rarely systematically examined. This has a financial impact on three stakeholder groups: retail investors, institutional portfolio managers, and decision-support designers. Widely used momentum indicators, such as the Relative Strength Index (RSI), which ranges from 0 to 100, often produce unstable or inconsistent signals across assets and time horizons, limiting their reliability for medium- and long-horizon decisions. RSI is a price-based oscillator that signals overbought and oversold conditions through fixed threshold levels. Its conventional 30/70 (buy when RSI≤30 and sell when RSI≥70) configuration has been adopted as the de facto standard across platforms and research, even though supporting research remains limited. This paper addresses that gap from a transdisciplinary perspective, combining investment theory with engineering methods (statistical sampling, response surface methodology, and lexicographic multi-criteria selection) to evaluate RSI threshold configurations as decision rules that guide agent financial behaviour in a systematic manner. This study examines ten threshold combinations on weekly data for nine major crypto assets—Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH), XRP (XRP), Binance Coin (BNB), Solana (SOL), Dogecoin (DOGE), Cardano (ADA), TRON (TRX), and Avalanche (AVAX)—and the S&P 500 market index. The findings indicate that no single configuration consistently dominates; in most cryptocurrency markets, alternatives to the standard 30/70 configuration yield competitive or superior outcomes, providing valuable insights for investors, system designers, and society as a whole.

作者: Muhamad Arianto; R. Hadapiningradja Kusumodestoni; Nur Aeni Widiastuti
摘要: Abstrak. Penelitian ini bertujuan membangun model prediksi harga terendah harian Bitcoin dengan memanfaatkan data historis dan sentimen berita pasar. Harga terendah dipilih sebagai target karena dapat menggambarkan tekanan penurunan harga dalam satu periode. Data penelitian terdiri atas data historis harian Bitcoin dari 1 Januari 2020 sampai 30 Desember 2025 dan data berita pasar. Data historis berjumlah 2.191 baris, sedangkan data berita berjumlah 196 artikel. Data berita diolah menggunakan metode Valence Aware Dictionary and sEntiment Reasoner untuk memperoleh nilai sentimen, kemudian diintegrasikan berdasarkan tanggal dengan data harga. Tahapan penelitian meliputi preprocessing, analisis sentimen, integrasi data, pembentukan fitur teknikal dan fitur keterlambatan waktu, pembagian data secara kronologis, pelatihan model Extreme Gradient Boosting, prediksi, dan evaluasi. Dataset akhir berjumlah 2.184 baris, terdiri atas 1.747 data pelatihan dan 437 data pengujian. Fitur yang digunakan adalah Moving Average, Relative Strength Index, Moving Average Convergence Divergence, Lag_1, Lag_3, Lag_7, dan Sentiment_Score. Hasil evaluasi menghasilkan mean absolute error sebesar 31.270,09, mean squared error sebesar 1.136.040.507,95, root mean squared error sebesar 33.705,20, dan koefisien determinasi sebesar -5,80. Lag_1 menjadi fitur paling dominan dengan kontribusi 75,40%, sedangkan Sentiment_Score hanya sebesar 0,04%. Hasil tersebut menunjukkan bahwa model lebih banyak memanfaatkan informasi historis harga dibandingkan informasi sentimen pada dataset penelitian. Kinerja model pada data pengujian belum optimal sehingga diperlukan pengembangan fitur dan pengujian model pembanding pada penelitian selanjutnya.

标题: Bitcoin in Euro 2013 bis 2026: Vier-Jahres-Takt, Haltedauer, Kursrückgänge und Sparplan aus 688 Wochenkursen
摘要: Die Arbeit wertet 688 Wochenschlusskurse von Bitcoin in Euro an der Börse Kraken aus, von der Woche ab dem 5. September 2013 bis zur Woche ab dem 5. November 2026. Die vier Höchststände der Reihe liegen 211, 203 und 204 Wochen auseinander, und vom Höchststand bis zum Tief vergingen dreimal 58 bis 59 Wochen. Im Juni 2026 fiel der Kurs zum ersten Mal unter den Höchststand des vorletzten Zyklus. Der gesamte Anstieg auf das 689-Fache hängt an 24 von 687 Wochen. Wer von 2014 bis 2025 jedes Jahr in der teuersten Woche kaufte, hat sein Geld trotzdem auf das 29,5-Fache gebracht. Nach vier Jahren Haltedauer gab es keine Kaufwoche mit Verlust, und ein Sparplan mit einer Rate je Monat lag nach vier Jahren Laufzeit bei allen 111 Startmonaten im Plus. Der Bericht liegt als PDF bei, dazu zehn Tabellen als CSV: die Wochenkurse, die Zyklen mit ihren Abständen, die Rechnung ohne die besten Wochen, die Kaufzeitpunkte je Jahr, das Ergebnis jeder Kaufwoche nach einem bis zehn Jahren, alle Rückgänge um mindestens 50 Prozent mit Dauer, die Sparplan-Ergebnisse je Laufzeit und je Startmonat sowie die Jahreswerte. Eigene Beträge und Zeiträume lassen sich mit dem Bitcoin-Sparplan-Rechner und dem Bitcoin-Rechner durchrechnen. Hintergrund zur Kursbildung: Wer bestimmt den Bitcoin-Preis. Zum Kauf: Bitcoin kaufen. English summary: This report analyses 688 weekly closing prices of bitcoin in euro on the Kraken exchange (XBT/EUR), from the week of 2013-09-05 to the week of 2026-11-05. The four cycle highs are 211, 203 and 204 weeks apart, and each completed decline took 58 to 59 weeks from high to low. In June 2026 the weekly close fell below the high of the cycle before the previous one for the first time. The entire 689-fold rise depends on 24 of 687 weeks. Buying once a year at the highest weekly close from 2014 to 2025 still multiplied the money 29.5-fold. For every purchase week it computes the result of a single purchase after one to ten years. After one year 67.6 percent of purchase weeks were in profit, after 3 years 530 of 532, and after 4 years no purchase week showed a loss. The weekly close fell by at least half 4 times; the completed drawdowns took 120 to 160 weeks to regain the previous high. A monthly savings plan was in profit for all 111 start months after 4 years. All tables are included as CSV files. Calculators: gunnarschuster.com. Datengrundlage: Kraken, Handelspaar XBT/EUR, Wochenkerzen. Auswertung: gunnarschuster.com.

标题: TIDE: code and data for a coverage-aware risk indicator for Bitcoin transactions
摘要: This record contains the code and the data used in the article "TIDE: A Coverage-Aware Risk Indicator for Bitcoin Transactions, from Evidence Fusion to a Working Platform". TIDE scores one Bitcoin transaction from the evidence available before it. It places the transaction in a coverage stratum (S1, S2, S3) that sets its prior, scores it with a history facet and a behavior facet, fuses them on the log-odds scale, and returns a level defined by a review budget, a confidence and an explanation per facet. Contents- tide_code.zip: the scoring core (tide_core.py), the fitting and evaluation scripts (steps 0 to 4 and the export script), the command-line scoring scripts, and the interface (app_tide.py).- dataset_v21_full.csv: the BitFraud transactions (six chronological snapshots of 100 blocks each, 1,687,072 transactions) with their features and labels.- scam_addresses_v21_frozen.csv: the reported Bitcoin addresses used to label the transactions, with the creation time of each report.- step1_facets.csv.gz, step1_priors.csv, step2_beta.csv: intermediate outputs (facet scores, stratum priors, fitted fusion parameters).- tide_bundle.joblib: the fitted system loaded by the interface.- README.md: run order, software versions and the list of columns used by the behavior facet. ReproductionThe scripts run in Google Colab with the Drive mounted. The order is: step 0 (strata check), step 1 (facets), step 2 (fusion and tests T1 to T4 and T6), step 3b (levels, T5), step 4 (explanations), step 6 (export), then "streamlit run app_tide.py". Software versions: scikit-learn 1.6.1, LightGBM 4.6.0. Bootstrap resamples: 200 in step 2 and 300 in steps 3b and 4. AccessThe files are under restricted access during the review. A private link is provided to the editor and the reviewers, and the record will be made open on publication of the article.

标题: Clean-Account Banking, Zero Hidden Money, and Multi-Tier Protection Against Corrupt Agencies: Reclaiming Cryptographic Ledgers From Speculative Coin Schemas

标题: Big Data Analytics Capabilities, Blockchain Technology Adoption, and Sustainable Supply Chain Performance: The Mediating Role of Circular Economy
作者: Moh’d Anwer AL-Shboul; Nouf Nayel Almajali
摘要: ABSTRACT The aim of this research is to formulate a theoretical framework to explore the relationship between big data analytics capabilities (BDACs), Blockchain technology adoption (BCTA), and sustainable supply chain performance (SSCP), with a particular focus on the mediating effect of the circular economy (CE). The theoretical framework was established following an extensive review of existing literature. Following that a model was developed consisting of four key dimensions. Big data analytics capabilities, blockchain technology adoption, sustainable supply chain performance and Circular economy practices. Consequently, a quantitative research method was implemented via a structured online survey, which was filled out by 130 IT managers within logistics firms in Jordan. The analysis of the data was conducted using SPSS software and SmartPLS, employing descriptive analysis and structural equation modeling (SEM). This study found that there is a significant positive impact of BDACs and BCTA on SSCP, with circular economy practices playing a partial mediating role in this effect. The findings conclude with guidance for policymakers and logistics businesses, highlighting the importance of embracing advanced technologies and circular practices to optimize the sustainability and performance of supply chains in Jordan.

标题: Unforgeable Electronic Mail and Sovereign .omenc Vaults: Eliminating SMTP Spoofing, Automated-Generator Impersonation, and Untrusted Client Leakage on Self-Verifying Virtual File Graphs
摘要: Replacing Hop-by-Hop Mail Relays, Server-Side DKIM Milters, and Plaintext IMAP Caches With End-to-End Plain-Sight Author Signatures, Human-vs-Generator Signer Separation, Legacy Quarantine Boundaries, and Native Cross-Platform Clients (OMVFS-MAIL-V1) Electronic mail remains the backbone of business contracts, legal notices, and financial instructions, yet forty years of bolted-on patches (SPF, DKIM milters, DMARC) still fail to stop phishing and executive spoofing because they sign mail at transit servers rather than at the human author's device — and even worse, allow automated web forms or compromised relays to share the same corporate domain signature as real employees. At the receiving end, reading corporate mail through non-compliant legacy IMAP clients strips cryptographic envelopes into unverified plaintext caches. OMVFS-MAIL-V1 solves messaging at the root: every message is composed, signed, and X25519-sealed end-to-end inside an OMVFS-compliant client using the author's plain-sight keyring (WP-0003), human principals (Tier T3) are mathematically disjoint from automated form/service generators (Tier T2), legacy external SMTP arrives strictly inside an explicit quarantine tier, and self-healing O(1) index snapshots serve mailboxes over pure HTTPS without 24/7 IMAP/SMTP daemons. End of Server-Side Milter & DKIM Ambiguity: Messages are sealed into OMVFS01 .omenc envelopes and signed directly in client RAM by the author's personal plain-sight key (WP-0003) before a single byte leaves the device — transit relays never touch plaintext or hold domain-wide signing keys. Zero-Daemon Serverless Mailbox Economics: Replaces stateful Postfix/Dovecot servers and exposed TCP ports (:25/:465/:993) with object-storage .omenc vaults and O(1) reconciled encrypted mailbox snapshots over HTTPS :443. 标题: Bitcoin é dinheiro? Uma revisão das funções monetárias e dos riscos técnicos
摘要: Este artigo revisa evidências públicas sobre o Bitcoin como meio de pagamento e reserva de valor e sobre seus riscos técnicos. Com base em fontes primárias (código, propostas de melhoria, avisos de vulnerabilidade, relatórios oficiais) e estudos revisados por pares, examinamos as funções do dinheiro e quatro classes de risco: falhas de consenso como o estouro de valor de 2010, uso inseguro do ECDSA, ataques quânticos às assinaturas e governança de mudanças de regra, além de custódia e orçamento de segurança. Argumentamos que o Bitcoin funciona como ativo especulativo de oferta fixa, e não como dinheiro, e que seu principal risco técnico é de coordenação. É uma revisão narrativa, não sistemática, sem experimentos. This paper reviews public evidence on Bitcoin as a means of payment and store of value and on its technical risks. Drawing on primary sources (code, improvement proposals, vulnerability disclosures, official reports) and peer-reviewed studies, we examine the functions of money and four classes of risk: consensus bugs such as the 2010 value overflow, unsafe ECDSA usage, quantum attacks on signatures, and governance of rule changes, plus custody and the security budget. We argue that Bitcoin works as a speculative fixed-supply asset rather than as money, and that its main technical risk is one of coordination. This is a narrative, non-systematic review with no experiments.

标题: PUCIA — Protocole Universel de Configuration des Intelligences Artificielles. Livre blanc, version 1.5
摘要: Résumé. PUCIA propose un protocole ouvert pour publier, vérifier, transférer, réutiliser et comparer des configurations spécialisées entre IA compatibles. La mutualisation d'un grand nombre de configurations pourrait permettre d'apprendre une fonction prédictive générant rapidement une configuration pour une tâche nouvelle. Le transfert d'adaptateurs se pratique déjà ; ce qui manque, c'est un manifeste signé et horodaté, une validation indépendante reproductible et une comptabilité complète des coûts et des paramètres. PUCIA fait d'une configuration un actif certifié, et non un simple fichier partagé. Nature. Proposition de recherche, de standardisation et de valorisation économique, à valider par l'expérimentation décrite dans le document : cinq hypothèses falsifiables, trois régimes, un plan expérimental. Ni la compatibilité universelle des poids, ni la programmation instantanée de compétences inédites ne sont acquises. Abstract. PUCIA (Universal Protocol for the Configuration of Artificial Intelligences) proposes an open protocol for publishing, verifying, transferring, reusing and comparing specialised configurations between compatible AIs. Pooling a large number of configurations could make it possible to learn a predictive function that quickly generates a configuration for a new task. Adapter transfer is already practised; what is missing is a signed and timestamped manifest, reproducible independent validation and complete accounting of costs and parameters. PUCIA turns a configuration into a certified asset, not merely a shared file. Nature. A research, standardisation and economic value proposal, to be validated by the experiments described in the document: five falsifiable hypotheses, three regimes, an experimental plan. Neither universal weight compatibility nor the instant programming of new competences has been achieved. Files. The French version is the reference; the English file is its translation, and in case of discrepancy the French version prevails. Both files are electronically signed by the author (PAdES) and carry an attestation of anchoring on the Bitcoin blockchain through OpenTimestamps.

标题: Bitcoin as an Inflation Hedge and Safe Haven in the Euro Area: Evidence from Inflation and Financial Stress
摘要: This paper separately evaluates whether euro-denominated Bitcoin returns are associated with a recursive euro-area HICP forecast error and whether Bitcoin offers protection during European equity-market stress. Monthly inflation innovations are treated as ex post time-series forecast errors rather than announcement surprises. Controlled H1 coefficients are not statistically significant at t, t + 1 or t + 2. Full-sample daily conditional equity betas are positive, but moving-block bootstrap intervals include zero and exclusion of 2020 removes statistical significance at the 10%, 5% and 1% lower-tail thresholds. A one-day shift in equity-return dating also reverses the sign of the 1% estimate. CISS-based tests provide broader, but equity-inclusive, stress classifications. The findings do not establish a reliable short-run inflation hedge or a stable, timing-invariant safe haven for euro-area investors. They underscore the importance of sample composition, return synchronization and transparent replication. The analysis is reconstructed from archived data with documented source-vintage limitations.

标题: PUCIA-0001 — Format du paquet de configuration et du manifeste. Projet de norme, version 0.1.0
摘要: Résumé. La présente norme définit le format d'un paquet de configuration PUCIA : la structure de l'archive, le contenu obligatoire du manifeste, le calcul des empreintes, la signature et la déclaration des preuves d'horodatage. Elle définit également les neuf contrôles qu'un vérificateur DOIT exécuter pour déclarer un paquet conforme. Un paquet conforme peut être publié, échangé, vérifié et activé par toute IA ou tout logiciel compatible avec PUCIA. Abstract. This standard defines the format of a PUCIA configuration package: the structure of the archive, the mandatory content of the manifest, the computation of fingerprints, the signature and the declaration of timestamp proofs. It also defines the nine checks that a verifier MUST perform to declare a package conformant. A conformant package can be published, exchanged, verified and activated by any AI or software compatible with PUCIA. Status. Draft standard (projet de norme), version 0.1.0 of 15 November 2026. Its normative JSON schema, the reference verifier and a signed example package are in the source repository. Files. The French version is the reference; the English file is its translation, and in case of discrepancy the French version prevails.
