标题: Probabilistic Limit Order Book Forecasting with Conditional Diffusion Models
作者: Junyu Chen; Franklin Liu; Moshu Xu; Lijian Yang
摘要: Modeling limit order book (LOB) dynamics is central to market forecasting and execution-strategy evaluation. While diffusion models achieve strong empirical performance, existing LOB snapshot models typically lack a learned recurrent encoder and formal statistical guarantees. We introduce LOBGrad, a conditional DDPM framework for probabilistic LOB forecasting that combines an autoregressive RNN encoder with a diffusion-based generator. In particular, we establish an excess-risk oracle inequality for the one-step DDPM noise-prediction objective under exponential mixing and regularity assumptions. We further show that, under contractive dynamics, the dependence on the conditioning-window length can be reduced to a dependence on the latent-state dimension. Experiments on BTC/USDT, GOOGL, and META show that LOBGrad improves on its encoder-free diffusion ablation across all reported queue metrics and obtains competitive results against other baselines. It also reproduces the key stylized facts of LOB microstructure, and yields reasonably calibrated queue-based predictive intervals. A stylized downstream task illustrates the potential value of the generated forecasts.

标题: Lead–Lag or Reversal? A Cross-versus-Self Test of Sparse-Attention Models for Cryptocurrency Return Ranking
作者: Ethan Geng; Shubhay Choubey; Manas Goel
摘要: Cryptocurrency markets price information into different assets at different times, which makes them a natural setting for deep models that forecast the cross-section of returns while recovering which assets lead which. Sparse cross-asset attention suits the problem because its attention matrix is at once the forecaster and a directed, per-bar graph of asset leadership. A graph-shaped attention pattern, however, does not by itself imply inter-asset lead-lag: it can equally encode an asset’s own short-horizon reversal, and no standard accuracy metric separates the two. We build on the self-lag ablation introduced with DeltaLag at ICAIF 2025. SelfLagNet is the lag-bank attention model with its cross-asset leader index removed, so it attends only to each asset’s own lag bank, and we turn that ablation into a test: the lag-bank model counts as lead-lag only when its per-bar forecasting skill separates from SelfLagNet’s on the same bars under a paired Diebold–Mariano test. We study two architectures that share an entmax-1.5 attention and a listwise ranking loss, a temporal-convolutional lag-bank model (LeadLagNet) and an exponentially gated recurrent encoder (xLSTM), on a fixed twenty-asset Binance USDT cross-section at three frequencies from five minutes to daily. On the matched test LeadLagNet separates from SelfLagNet by a small margin at five minutes, in every walk-forward fold, and not at one hour. The xLSTM is the stronger forecaster: its five-minute rank information coefficient of 0.073 significantly exceeds a rolling vector autoregression (Diebold–Mariano p < 0.001), and a sigmoid-gated variant performs the same. It also leads SelfLagNet at five minutes and one hour in every fold and at every seed, but SelfLagNet is not its matched control, and an own-history reversal rule leads SelfLagNet by as much when pooled across folds, so that margin does not by itself identify cross-asset information. Skill decays with horizon: at one hour the xLSTM trails the reversal rule, and at the daily horizon no model separates from the rest. A decile book built on the signal is economically positive through maker and institutional cost tiers and unprofitable at retail cost, marking the finding as short-horizon structure rather than deployable alpha.

标题: The Alert-Feedback Trap: Why Drift-Adaptive Fraud Detectors Fail Under Realistic Label Feedback, and How Much Exploration It Takes to Escape
摘要: Financial-crime detectors must adapt to drift, but in deployment they are retrained almost entirely on the labels their own alerts produce: only flagged transactions are investigated and labeled. We characterize the resulting failure mode, the alert-feedback trap. On the Elliptic Bitcoin dataset, detectors across linear, tree-ensemble, and graph-neural-network families collapse under a regime change (illicit-class F1 from 0.91 to 0.03), though ranking degrades far less than fixed-threshold metrics suggest. Under alert-only feedback, drift-adaptive learners that update from a recent window of alert-selected labels are trapped: a strong detector that catches 113 of 169 illicit transactions while frozen falls to 93 when it adapts on its own alerts—worse than freezing in all 200 bootstrap resamples and under every gate setting we tried—and a collapsed detector recovers only 9–30, versus 98 under bulk feedback. The trap is an interaction of selection bias and forgetting, not an inevitability of alert-only feedback: a practitioner baseline that retrains on the full label history plus the alert labels escapes it under the same feedback (113 → 130; collapsed 14 → 79), while the same alert labels without the history do not (74; 46). Off-policy ϵ -exploration, by contrast, is not a reliable escape once data variability is accounted for. We release a prequential protocol with delayed, budgeted, selection-biased feedback.

标题: CGGS: Confidence-Guided Graph Sampling for Scalable GNN Fraud Detection on Imbalanced Financial Networks
作者: Subham Kumar Singh; Kamna Meena; Adarsh Kumar; Kamal Kant; Siddhartha Asthana
摘要: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) offer a powerful paradigm for financial fraud detection by exploiting the relational structure of transaction networks to identify suspicious behaviour and coordinated fraud. Translating them into a viable production system, however, remains hard under strict memory, compute and latency budget – costs that span the entire model lifecycle, not merely GNN training. A real transaction graph of hundreds of millions of accounts is overwhelmingly a graph of benign nodes, so much of that lifecycle budget is spent processing nodes that carry little discriminative signal. The same benign majority drives a second challenge, fraud-class homophily collapse : because fraudsters deliberately interact with legitimate entities to camouflage and evade detection, the proportion of same-class edges incident on fraud nodes drops and the fraud class is driven into high heterophily, so neighbourhood aggregation averages the fraud signal away while imbalance biases the classifier toward the benign majority. We propose CGGS ( C onfidence- G uided G raph S ampling), a two-stage framework that turns both liabilities into a single opportunity at no additional compute cost. Stage 1 trains a lightweight tabular scorer – gradient-boosted trees (XGBoost) in our instantiation – on the node features, ranking every candidate entity by fraud probability without touching graph topology. Stage 2 prunes the confidently-benign entities before the graph is assembled, so the GNN trains only on the compact, higher-homophily subgraph of uncertain, high-risk, and informative nodes. We prove that confidence-guided pruning increases the expected fraud-class homophily and reduces the effective imbalance ratio under a mild ranking assumption. Experiments on a production-scale proprietary transaction graph and two public benchmarks show that CGGS reduces graph size and lifecycle computational cost while outperforming full-graph training and alternative pruning strategies, with ablations confirming robustness across pruning thresholds.

标题: Structure Before Scale: Package-Aware Bitcoin Volatility Forecasting from Multi-Leg Option Blocks
作者: Haoran Liu; Mingyao Zhou; Hao Yu; Qi Guo
摘要: Large option trades often execute as multi-leg packages. Aggregating their legs without package membership can obscure within-trade risk cancellation and concentration. We construct package-level Greek features that preserve these relationships for short-horizon volatility forecasting. Using exchange-provided block identifiers, we reconstruct 127,041 complete Bitcoin option block packages on Deribit over 2022–2025. Package-aware forecasting reduces QLIKE by up to 18.8% relative to a HARQ benchmark while retaining incremental reductions of 1.29%–3.44% beyond a 321-feature frontier that already spans HARQ dynamics, the implied-volatility surface, regular option flow, and net buying pressure; all primary gains survive false-discovery-rate control. At each of the three primary horizons—1, 4, and 12 hours—the observed assignment beats 198 of 199 hour-and-size-matched shuffles (prand = 0.010). An exploratory simulation applies the same two-day short-straddle rule to each forecast. The package-aware forecast improves pooled risk-adjusted performance under the reported setting, with substantial variation across years and thresholds.

标题: An Explainable Hybrid CNN–Transformer Framework for Fraud Detection in Digital and Cryptocurrency Transactions
作者: Nurudeen Olawale Ibrahim; Mustapha Olaitan Olarewaju; Hamid Dimeji Lawal; Yusuf Omotosho Bello-Sulayman
摘要: Fraud detection in digital payment and cryptocurrency systems is complicated by heterogeneous transaction records, class imbalance and limited model interpretability. This study proposed an explainable hybrid convolutional neural network (CNN)–Transformer framework for identifying suspicious transactions using the IEEE-CIS Fraud Detection and Ethereum Address Behavior datasets. Tabular features were transformed into spatial representations using the Image Generator for Tabular Data algorithm, while principal component analysis and rolling temporal sequences were employed to represent transaction behaviour. A dual-branch CNN–Transformer model was developed with cost-sensitive learning and hyperparameter optimisation using the Sparrow Search Algorithm. Model predictions were interpreted using SHapley Additive exPlanations, while an IPFS- and blockchain-based architecture was proposed for audit logging. Under the reported chronological evaluation procedure, the model achieved a precision of 0.7320, recall of 0.4956, F1-score of 0.5910 and area under the precision–recall curve of 0.5984 at a decision threshold of 0.5350. These results indicate moderate fraud-discrimination performance, although approximately half of the labelled fraudulent cases were not detected at the selected threshold. Further evaluation against established baseline models, independent validation of cryptocurrency fraud labels and experimental assessment of the proposed blockchain subsystem are necessary to establish the framework's comparative effectiveness and operational suitability.

标题: How stable are stablecoins in euro?
作者: Chiara Oldani; Giovanni S. F. Bruno
摘要: Stablecoins are promising evolution of digital currencies; they exhibit low transaction costs, have stable values and reduced volatility, if compared with cryptocurrencies, and are widely purchased by investors to diversify their portfolios. The introduction of the Market in Crypto Asset regulation has been the first attempt to regulate stablecoins and aimed at improving market’s stability. We investigate how stable are most traded stablecoins linked to the euro (Stasis, Tether, Celo, Euro Coin, Quantoz, StablR) from 3 rd January 2022 to 31 st December 2025. The stability of stablecoins’ prices is analyzed by employing the recursive methods for detecting collapsing bubbles, and episodes of abrupt market crashes. We supplement the analysis with tests of unit-root against stationarity in the presence of deterministic breaks. Contrary to stablecoins linked to the US dollar, most stablecoins linked to the euro show no sign of persistent bubbles or crashes. Implications of results presented in this paper relate with the broad goal of financial stability and rule setting in the digital ecosystem.

标题: From Bitcoin Mining to AI Infrastructure: Historical Equity Returns and Risk-Adjusted Performance, 2022-2026
Identity-based adaptor signature scheme and its application in cross-chain transactions
作者: Liu Yi; Sharifah Md Yasin; Mohd Izuan Hafez Ninggal; Aziah Asmawi
摘要: With the rapid proliferation of blockchain-based applications and mobile devices, ensuring secure and efficient digital signatures in resource-constrained environments has become increasingly important. Traditional public key infrastructure (PKI)-based signatures suffer from certificate management overhead and are not well-suited for decentralized systems. Identity-based cryptography offers a promising alternative by eliminating certificates, while adaptor signatures enable conditional execution and atomic transactions in blockchain systems. In this paper, we propose a novel identity-based adaptor signature (IBAS) scheme tailored for blockchain-enabled mobile environments. The proposed scheme integrates identity-based cryptography with adaptor signatures to support conditional signing and witness extractability, which are essential for applications such as atomic swaps and payment channels. Our construction leverages bilinear pairings and adopts a lightweight design to reduce computational overhead on resource-constrained devices. We formally define the security of the proposed scheme and prove that it achieves existential unforgeability under adaptive chosen message attacks (aEUF-CMA) in the random oracle model. In addition, we establish the witness extractability property, ensuring that the secret witness can be efficiently extracted from a valid pre-signature and its corresponding final signature. We implement the proposed scheme and evaluate its performance on mobile devices under different network conditions. Experimental results demonstrate that the scheme achieves efficient signature generation and verification, making it suitable for practical deployment in blockchain-based mobile applications.

标题: BE-RAKAP: Blockchain and ECC Based Robust Authentication Key Agreement Protocol for Medical Wireless Sensor Network
摘要: Abstract The Internet of Medical Things (IoMT) has revolutionized healthcare by enabling real-time remote monitoring through interconnected medical devices. However, ensuring secure and lightweight communication over resource-constrained wireless medical sensor networks (WMSNs) remains a critical challenge. In this paper, we propose BE-RAKAP—a robust and energy-efficient authentication and key agreement protocol that combines Elliptic Curve Cryptography (ECC), blockchain technology, and biometric fuzzy extractors to provide mutual authentication, secure key exchange, and forward secrecy. The protocol is validated through formal methods using the Scyther tool and the Random Oracle Model (ROR), confirming its resistance to common attacks such as replay, impersonation, and man-in-the-middle. Comparative analysis with recent schemes demonstrates that BE-RAKAP achieves up to 25% lower computational cost and 30% reduced communication overhead, making it highly suitable for real-time and scalable deployment in IoMT environments. Our solution significantly enhances the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of sensitive medical data while preserving user anonymity and device traceability.

标题: Evaluating a proof-of-concept blockchain-based architecture for secure personalized learning environments using the CIAAN framework
作者: Xibing Wang; Xiaoxuan Dong; Yunfeng Zhang; Yong Chen; Xiaoshu Xu
摘要: Abstract Personalized Learning Environments (PLEs) record fine-grained learner interactions, but most platforms still keep those records in centralized stores that can be altered without a durable audit trail. Blockchain work in education has mainly covered static artifacts such as certificates and micro-credentials, not the integrity of ongoing activity data. This paper presents PleAuth, a proof-of-concept architecture that writes SHA-256 digests of canonical xAPI statements to Ethereum Sepolia and uses OAuth 2.0 for role-based access to an off-chain Learning Record Store. The architecture is derived from CIAAN requirements (confidentiality, integrity, availability, authenticity, and non-repudiation). Testing used 1,000 simulated learners on modest cloud instances. A controlled demonstration showed that an off-chain LRS edit is exposed by hash mismatch against the on-chain digest; the exact number of scripted tamper cases was not retained after the prototype was decommissioned, so this result documents the detection mechanism rather than a detection rate. No successful authorization bypass was observed in 33,672 access events (Wilson 95% CI for a successful breach: 0.00–0.01%). REST API latency stayed low under moderate load; high-concurrency database writes increase response times. On-chain confirmation latency was not measured; in practice, public-testnet confirmation may introduce additional delays. Feedback from 90 students and educators is exploratory only, because the instrument did not use validated scales. The study shows that tamper-evident recording of dynamic learning interactions is technically feasible. It does not claim superiority over production LMS platforms.

标题: Does a minimal context change how a language model reviews? A controlled study with 270 repository reviews
摘要: Question. Does attaching short epistemic instructions (the "minimal context" of the Constellation Method) change the technical review a language model writes about a code repository? Design. Six models (three larger, three compact) reviewed three repositories under three conditions: no instructions ("bare"), the epistemic floor alone ("floor only") and the full minimal context ("triad"). Five repetitions per cell, 270 calls, 269 valid reviews, all on the same text material and without tools. The 11,832 extracted claims were checked against the material by verifier models, with a blind judge on disagreements. Result. In this task and at this scale, the minimal context does not demonstrably improve or worsen review capability. It changes how the models communicate, in the direction the instructions ask: they flag what they did not verify, praise less and describe more. 标题: A Two-Phase Framework for Cryptocurrency Portfolio Construction Under Deep Uncertainty: A Hybrid Approach Based on RR-DEA and Robust Optimization
作者: Mohammadmahdi Taheri; Hossein Ghanbari; Ronald Ravinesh Kumar; Peter Josef Stauvermann
摘要: Abstract Investment decision-making is a challenging problem in financial engineering, particularly when investors are presented with multiple investment options. The decision paths become more complex in the space of digital assets, where investors are faced with a huge number of assets to select from, before even deriving optimal allocations. Within virtual space, the market for cryptocurrencies is gaining traction among investors, especially due to its potential for substantial returns and diversification. However, the market for cryptocurrencies presents unique challenges due to its inherent volatility and uncertainty, underscoring the need for a robust and structured investment framework to guide decision-making. Noting this gap in the literature on cryptocurrency investment, we introduce an innovative two-phase framework for cryptocurrency portfolio construction, designed to address the complexities and uncertainties inherent in cryptocurrency markets. In a two-phased analysis, we start with a Robust Ratio Data Envelopment Analysis (RR-DEA) to screen and preselect the most efficient cryptocurrencies from a pool of available assets, followed by the application of a Robust Goal Programming (RGP) optimization procedure to allocate weights based on the investor’s risk preferences, return targets, and other relevant financial goals. The two-phased framework ensures that the final allocation is efficient and adaptable to the dynamics of the cryptocurrency market. We test our framework on 47 cryptocurrencies. Using the RR-DEA, we identify 24 cryptocurrencies. Applying the RGP procedure, we allocate weights and construct different portfolios under various scenarios, addressing uncertainties in the data and aligning with the investor’s objectives. The optimization process is carried out in Excel ® and GAMS ® . The proposed framework provides a robust and practical decision‑support tool for constructing cryptocurrency portfolios in highly volatile and uncertain market environments, enabling investors to systematically preselect efficient assets and derive resilient portfolio allocations that are aligned with their risk preferences, return objectives, and uncertainty considerations.

标题: Formal modeling and verification of parachain candidate validation and inclusion in relay chain polkadot
作者: Muhammad Rashid; Atika Qazi; Lal Khan; Mohammad Zubair Khan; Ibrahim Aljubayri
摘要: Polkadot is a next-generation blockchain platform that achieves scalability and interoperability through a heterogeneous multi-chain architecture, where multiple parachains operate concurrently under a shared security model. A fundamental component of this architecture is the candidate backing and inclusion mechanism, which governs the validation, verification, and incorporation of parachain blocks into the relay chain. This process involves coordinated interactions among collators, validators, parachains, and the relay chain, and proceeds through multiple stages, including candidate generation, validation, backing, availability checking, approval voting, and finalization. Subtle inconsistencies or design flaws within these stages may compromise system correctness, potentially resulting in invalid block inclusion or data unavailability. Consequently, rigorous formal verification is essential to ensure system reliability and robustness. Existing research predominantly emphasizes architectural design and empirical evaluation, with limited attention to formal verification of the candidate lifecycle. To address this gap, this study develops a comprehensive behavioral model using Promela, capturing key system interactions and concurrency aspects. Critical safety and liveness properties, including integrity, fairness, and fault tolerance, are formally specified in Linear Temporal Logic and verified using the SPIN model checker. The verification results confirm system correctness while highlighting state-space complexity and scalability considerations.

标题: Influential dynamic interactions of safe havens with facets of economic and monetary uncertainty
作者: Νikolaos Kyriazis; Stephanos T. Papadamou; Alexandros Koulis
摘要: Purpose This study aims to investigate the dynamic causal connectedness that a range of innovative uncertainty measures presents with gold and silver prices. Design/methodology/approach Monthly data from January 1985 to January 2024 and averaged dynamic connectedness and network dynamic connectedness based on the advanced quantile-vector autoregression framework are used. Findings The impact that risk stemming from economic, monetary, fiscal or trade uncertainty has on precious metals is estimated. Gold and silver are found to behave as drivers of impacts in bear markets but as absorbers of spillovers in bull markets, especially silver. This also holds for economic policy uncertainty (EPU), which is succinctly the dominant form of risk and is mostly linked with monetary policy uncertainty. Fiscal and trade policies create risk in flourishing eras when absorbers such as silver, gold or EPU are most needed to mitigate uncertainty in markets. Originality/value This paper provides insights for policymakers and investors in normal and crisis periods.

标题: Concentration of Bitcoin's base and institutional layers: preregistered decision rules for a prospective window (December 2026 – February 2027)
摘要: This registration fixes hypotheses and decision rules for an empirical chapter of a monograph on Bitcoin as money. The monograph's main hypothesis is that Bitcoin cannot perform the functions of money at scale for structural reasons: the features that make its base layer independent of intermediaries limit its monetary usefulness, and monetary functions are in practice delivered by concentrated intermediaries. Three hypotheses address one link of this argument: (H1) concentration of block production (mining pools) does not increase; (H2) concentration of US spot Bitcoin ETFs, their issuers and custodians persists; (H3) ETF holdings are more concentrated than block production. Historical data up to October 2026 were inspected before registration and are treated as exploratory; the decision rules apply only to December 2026 – February 2027. The full plan (in Polish) and the frozen analysis scripts are attached.

标题: Between the Lines: Multi-turn Contextual Investment Advice Detection
作者: Mingshu Li; Adam Boncz; Mate Toth; Justin Williams; Justin Chan; Dhagash B. Mehta
摘要: As large language models (LLMs) increasingly power financial conversational assistants, detecting investment advice in natural language has become a critical regulatory and safety challenge. Unlike explicit single-turn recommendations, investment advice often emerges implicitly and progressively over multi-turn conversations, shaped by user intent, delivery style, and contextual buildup. We introduce the first comprehensive framework for detecting both sequential and contextual investment advice in dialogue settings. Central to our approach is a modular, top-down synthetic data generation pipeline that systematically spans a taxonomy of advisory trajectories using an axis-bucket-descriptor schema. We simulate both benign and high-risk conversations across diverse user personas, financial instruments, and risk tiers, and evaluate detection capabilities using LLM-as-a-Judge with entropy-based uncertainty diagnostics. Our results show that contextual advisory detection remains substantially more challenging than sequential cases, even under few-shot prompting with tailored demonstrations. This work lays the foundation for scalable guardrail development in high-stakes, compliance-sensitive domains, where advisory risk is often subtle, distributed, and perception-dependent.

标题: Leveraging Time-Series Foundation Models for Financial Crime Detection
作者: Danae Natalie Savvidi; H. Çağrı Bilgi; Kubilay Atasu; Arie van Deursen
摘要: Financial crime detection requires identifying illicit activity within large transaction networks, where suspicious behaviour is rare and unfolds over time. Existing graph-based methods capture relationships among accounts but typically underuse the temporal behaviour encoded in account transaction histories. We introduce Temporal-Context Edge Enrichment (TCEE), a framework that addresses this gap by summarising each account’s transaction history with a frozen time-series foundation model (TSFM), and enriching each transaction’s representation with the relevant temporal context from these summaries. These enriched representations can be scored directly for edge classification, or fed into a graph neural network (GNN) as edge features to capture broader structural information. Across six AMLWorld datasets, TCEE improves PR-AUC over the strongest evaluated baseline on five by a relative \(10.8\%\) on average, while training 6.0 × faster end-to-end. Feeding TCEE’s representations into a GNN raises PR-AUC a further \(4.8\%\) on the four smaller datasets. On an Ethereum phishing dataset, we show that TSFM-generated account representations fed into a GNN are also effective for node classification, improving PR-AUC by \(14.5\%\) over the strongest baseline. As TSFMs continue to advance, our results suggest they can strengthen financial crime detection by capturing temporal signals that complement graph-based approaches.

标题: What Prediction-Market Contracts Reveal at Launch: Trading Volume and Dispute Risk
摘要: We address the question: “What does a prediction-market contract reveal at launch about its future?” Using a near-census of 802,863 resolved markets listed on Polymarket, a leading prediction market, between January 2023 and May 2026, and only information available at listing (the market’s title and description, named resolution source, and contract metadata), we predict lifetime trading volume and whether settlement is later disputed. Contract information predicts trading volume well (out-of-sample R 2 = 0.747 for log volume), and most of the signal is interpretable: market topic provides the largest gain (+ 0.289 R 2 over a 0.220 contract-feature baseline), wording and resolution-rule design add smaller but measurable improvements (+ 0.027 combined), and neural text models add little beyond the interpretable features. This performance does not survive a period of platform change coinciding with a shift in listing formats: accuracy in predicting whether a market reaches $1,000 falls from AUC 0.940 under same-period evaluation to 0.577 when training on past quarters and testing on later ones. The loss concentrates in markets whose question forms were absent from training (76.9% of test markets; on familiar forms the model still reaches 0.778), and a decomposition attributes more of it to a changed relationship between contract characteristics and demand than to an outdated mapping from text to features. Dispute predictors are more stable but less precise: launch-time features rank dispute risk far better than chance (AUC 0.78), yet at a 0.31% base rate precision is too low for case-by-case prediction (average precision 0.012), so the scores suit ranking groups of markets rather than forecasting individual disputes. The framework and results, besides their intrinsic interest, are actionable and likely extensible to other platforms, supporting further research in prediction markets.

标题: On-Chain Behavioral Signatures for Classifying Centralized Exchange Addresses on Ethereum Using Proof-of-Reserves
作者: Seongchan Park; Hyunho Jeon; Byungsoo Kang; Gaeun Kim; Minseob So; Seongyong Kim
摘要: Centralized exchanges (CEXs) are key gateways between traditional finance and digital asset markets, yet identifying their blockchain addresses remains challenging. Existing approaches often rely on opaque attribution labels or treat exchanges as secondary classification targets, leaving generalization to unseen exchanges insufficiently examined. This study develops a classification framework using Proof-of-Reserves (PoR) disclosures, with 3,033,857 Ethereum addresses from 15 CEXs and five Non-CEX categories. We derive 58 on-chain behavioral features and evaluate LightGBM against logistic regression (LR) under a leave-one-exchange-out protocol. Across five lookback windows (30–730 days), LightGBM consistently outperformed LR, with macro PR-AUC increasing from 0.6611 to 0.9594 using the selected 17 features, compared with 0.7697 for LR at 730 days. Robustness checks showed comparable performance when feature selection and hyperparameter optimization were repeated across splits and held-out exchanges, while exchange-balanced reweighting improved macro PR-AUC. SHAP analysis and feature-group ablation identified gas behavior, ERC-20 token activity, and internal transactions as key predictive signals in the constructed dataset. These findings support interpretable CEX address screening for blockchain monitoring, while the released feature dataset enables reproducible follow-up research.1

标题: Generative AI for Fraud Detection: From Theory to Enterprise Deployment
摘要: With the growth of complex frauds, cyber threats, and financial crimes, standard detection approaches typically fall short. Generative AI, with its capacity to synthesize synthetic data, analyze anomalies, and improve predictive analytics, provides creative answers to these difficulties. This book addresses the revolutionary impact of generative AI in fraud detection, addressing the expanding complexity of fraudulent operations in numerous sectors. This book starts with core idea, providing readers to the foundations of fraud detection and generative AI technologies such as Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) and Variational Autoencoders (VAEs). It then advances to key ideas, concentrating on synthetic data creation, anomaly detection, and the integration of machine learning models in fraud analytics. In this book, some topics like practical applications are also highlighted via case studies in financial services, healthcare, insurance, retail, and cybersecurity. This book illustrates how generative AI can detect credit card fraud, identify fake insurance claims, and safeguard e-commerce platforms against fraudulent transactions. On other side, emerging technologies like blockchain, IoT, and quantum AI are investigated as complementary methods for increasing fraud prevention frameworks. Also, some ethical aspects, including data privacy, AI biases, and regulatory compliance, are also highlighted to meet the problems of deploying generative AI ethically. With this book, readers will get insights on open-source technologies, industry-specific frameworks, and assessment criteria for installing fraud detection systems efficiently. We can assure to our readers that this book will provide a major setback to future researchers by addressing future trends, including real-time threat mitigation and policy implications for global fraud prevention.

标题: DA LAVOURA À BLOCKCHAIN: ARQUITETURA AUDITÁVEL PARA A LIQUIDAÇÃO AUTOMÁTICA DE SEGURO AGRÍCOLA PARAMÉTRICO
作者: Ana Victória Faria dos Santos; Beatriz Aarão de Melo; Bruno Henrique Volpini Stramasso; Gabriel Moreira Bittencourt; Lamys Bachir Fares
摘要: No Brasil, o seguro agrícola amparado pelo fundo de estabilidade indeniza perdas físicas efetivas, o que pressupõe apurar o dano em cada propriedade. A área segurada caiu de cerca de 13,45 milhões de hectares em 2021 para cerca de 3,2 milhões em 2025. O seguro paramétrico troca a apuração da perda por um índice objetivo, como o número de dias seguidos sem chuva, e paga quando esse índice atinge um limiar combinado de antemão. A regra pode ser escrita em um contrato inteligente, mas este não lê dados meteorológicos e depende de um oráculo, cujos erros ficariam registrados como se fossem verdadeiros. Este artigo investiga como permitir que terceiros confiram a decisão de pagamento desse seguro. Para isso, apresenta o AgroSmart, arquitetura projetada para auditoria em que contratos na rede de teste Ethereum Sepolia liquidam uma cobertura contra estiagem para a soja, com chuva derivada de registros oficiais (2020-2024). Resumos criptográficos vinculam os termos e a série a cada apólice, e um oráculo autorizado confere ambos antes de publicar. O fluxo completo funcionou em quatro cenários públicos de pagamento, não pagamento e cancelamento, e a equipe mantém 362 testes automatizados. Os autores reconstituíram as duas decisões publicadas sem usar o código do sistema, mas nenhuma auditoria externa foi feita, e a conferência dos termos depende de um texto guardado fora da cadeia. A sazonalidade observada vale para uma estação e cinco anos. Seguem em aberto a confiança no oráculo único, os poderes da seguradora e o risco de base.

标题: APPLICATION OF NEURAL NETWORKS TO BITCOIN PRICE TREND PREDICTION BASED ON TECHNICAL INDICATORS
作者: Nada Markićević; Jelena Veljković; Aleksandar Rakićević
摘要: This research examines the application of artificial neural networks (ANNs) to Bitcoin price trend prediction. The cryptocurrency market is characterized by high volatility and nonlinear dynamics, which makes explicit mathematical modeling of price movements particularly challenging. The aim of this study is to systematically compare the predictive capabilities of three ANN architectures: the Multilayer Perceptron (MLP), Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) network, and Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) network. The empirical analysis is conducted using daily market data covering the period from the beginning of 2014 to the end of 2025. Historical market information and 12 technical indicators are used as input variables, capturing different dimensions of market behavior, including ROC, MACD, RSI, Bollinger Bands, MFI, and ADX. Particular attention is devoted to the definition of the target variable, with the price trend formulated using different approaches based on price movements and their moving average. Multiple models with different combinations of input variables and target-variable definitions are developed and compared, while predictive performance is evaluated using standard classification metrics. The results indicate that the choice among MLP, LSTM, and GRU architectures does not lead to substantial differences in predictive performance, whereas the definition of the target variable has a considerably greater impact on forecasting quality, suggesting that appropriate problem formulation may be more important than the choice of neural network architecture itself.

标题: Global Risk Transmission and Monetary Stability in Brunei Darussalam: Evidence from a Time-Varying Parameter VAR Approach
作者: Magita Sari; Ibnu Qizam; Mohammad Nadhratuzzaman Hosen; Nur Hidayah; Rahmawati
摘要: This study investigates the impact of global risk factors specifically geopolitical risk (GPR), economic policy uncertainty (GEPU), market volatility (VIX), and commodity price dynamics on the monetary stability of Brunei Darussalam. Given the vulnerability of small open economies to external shocks, understanding the transmission mechanism of these risks is critical for maintaining the resilience of the Brunei Dollar (BND) peg. Utilizing monthly data from January 2015 to May 2025, the empirical analysis employs a dual-stage econometric framework: the Toda–Yamamoto Granger causality test for static inference and the Time-Varying Parameter Vector Autoregression (TVP-VAR) model for dynamic assessment. The results reveal that geopolitical tensions and gold prices are the predominant long-term predictors of exchange rate fluctuations. Furthermore, the dynamic connectedness analysis indicates that the transmission of global shocks is regime-dependent, intensifying significantly during systemic crises such as the COVID-19 pandemic and the 2022 geopolitical escalation in Ukraine. While digital assets exhibit limited influence, the study confirms that Brunei’s monetary stability remains deeply integrated into global energy and safe-haven markets. These findings underscore the necessity for the Brunei Darussalam Central Bank (BDCB) to adopt adaptive, time-varying macro-prudential monitoring to mitigate cross-border risk spillovers effectively in the future.

标题: Privacy and security preservation of bitcoin digital currency transactions on mixing services using enhanced heuristic-aided optimal weighted features and hybrid deep learning network
摘要: Bitcoin (BTC) is a Peer-to-Peer (P2P) digital currency that facilitates transactions using pseudonymous identities. Mixing services improve the anonymity of transactions but are misused for illicit activities such as money laundering, raising security concerns in the BTC ecosystem. This research implements a hybridized deep learning approach for privacy preservation in BTC transactions. The required data are gathered from Elliptic Dataset and Ethereum Fraud Detection dataset, and these datasets are used for evaluation. The features are extracted from these datasets, followed by weighted attribute selection. The optimal feature selection and fine-tuning of the weights are implemented using the Improved Current Mussel Time-based Eurasian Oystercatcher Optimizer (ICMT-EOO) algorithm. The weighted attributes are classified using a Faster Regions-based Convolutional Neural Network with Dilated Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (FRCNN-DBi-LSTM). Experimental evaluation is performed using existing classifiers and optimization algorithms to demonstrate the efficiency of the approach. The proposed method achieves an accuracy of 95.2%, an F1-score of 92.98%, a recall of 95.21%, and a precision of 90.84%, respectively. The results confirm that the developed model achieves improved performance and enhanced security compared to existing methods.

标题: Identification of the Most Influential Personal Factors on Cryptocurrency Trader Success Using Random Forest Regressor
作者: Nazwa Syaheba; Muhammad Fikry; Rizki Suwanda
摘要: Cryptocurrency trading is characterized by high volatility, making trader success influenced not only by market analysis but also by personal factors. This study aims to identify the most influential personal factor affecting cryptocurrency trader success using Random Forest Regressor. Data were collected through questionnaires from 238 respondents involving age, Fear of Missing Out (FOMO), Emotional Control, Risk Tolerance, Trading Discipline, Trading Activity, and Trader Success. Preprocessing was conducted using Min-Max normalization for age and feature extraction based on Mean, Variance, and Standard Deviation. The dataset was split using a 70:30 scenario, consisting of 166 training data and 72 testing data. The model was built using 100 decision trees with random_state 42 and evaluated using Mean Absolute Error (MAE). The testing result produced an MAE value of 0.2079. Based on feature importance, the most dominant feature was Mean Trading Activity with an importance value of 0.1193 or 11.93%. The result indicates that Trading Activity is the most influential personal factor in the prediction model of cryptocurrency trader success.

标题: Scalability and Efficiency enhanced based Machine Learning for Hyperledger Fabric and Private Ethereum in Smart Contract Execution
作者: Essam Halim Houssein; Ibrahim Ramadan; Hassan Shaban; Mina Younan
摘要: Abstract Blockchain platform selection for enterprise applications increasingly rests on empirical throughput and latency evidence rather than architectural claims alone. This paper proposed a benchmarking work flow based machine learning to compare Hyperledger Fabric v2.5 and private Ethereum (Geth) across four smart contract functions (QueryUser, Crea-5 teUser, IssueMoney, and TransferMoney) under varying network sizes (2–16 peers) and 6 transaction batch sizes (10–1,000), plus an additional 10,000-transaction scalability stress 7 test on Ethereum. Both platforms were independently rebuilt on a single-host Docker 8 deployment, implemented equivalent banking-application smart contracts in Solidity and 9 Go, and reran the full experimental matrix using an in-house benchmarking harness. Our 10 results corroborate the original paper’s central claims: Fabric outperforms Ethereum on 11 write-heavy invoke operations by a factor of roughly 1.4–8.2× depending on network size, 12 while Ethereum’s account-based ledger model yields consistently higher query throughput 13 (1,224 vs. 594 TPS, averaged across all tested batch sizes). This Paper additionally identify 14 a failure mode not emphasized in the original study: Fabric’s multi-key read-modify-write 15 function (TransferMoney) failed under optimistic-concurrency conflicts at every tested 16 batch size and, notably, at a rate that was statistically invariant to peer count. Beyond 17 reproduction, This Paper contributes a supervised machine-learning layer: Random Forest 18 and Gradient Boosting regressors trained on the reproduced dataset to predict through-19 put and latency directly from network configuration. Under leave-one-peer-count-out 20 cross-validation, the surrogate model predicts per-transaction latency with high fidelity 21 (R 2 = 0.887) but throughput far less reliably (R 2 = 0.478), a gap attribute to the discontinu-22 ous, contention-driven nature of the throughput data itself. This paper discuss deviations 23 from the original study’s setup and their implications for the generalizability of both papers’ 24 findings.

标题: МОДЕЛИ ЗАКОННОГО ДОСТУПА К ЗАШИФРОВАННЫМ ДАННЫМ В КОНТЕКСТЕ НАЦИОНАЛЬНОЙ БЕЗОПАСНОСТИ
摘要: The article reveals a number of features of providing legitimate access to encrypted data, the specifics of using special procedures for storing cryptographic keys or parameters that allow law enforcement agencies to gain access to cryptographically protected information. The article is a methodologically significant achievement, as it shifts the focus from the question of the presence or absence of legitimate access to the consideration of the architectural aspects of the encryption model and the role of a trusted party in ensuring access by law enforcement agencies to the data required for decryption, as well as the consequences associated with a specific legitimate access model. The use of key or parameter storage mechanisms in key escrow or key recovery systems inevitably leads to a change in the threat model, making the key or parameter storage infrastructure a significant target for potential attacks. The adoption of such models should take into account not only operational requirements, but also long-term aspects of information security, national security and constitutional guarantees of the right to communication secrecy.

标题: Rethinking Cryptocurrency Performance: Evidence From Sortino and Calmar Ratios
作者: Reksha Laksana; Erik Ridha Nugraha; Hadi Ahmad Sukardi; Agrie Wahyudi Kharisman
摘要: Penelitian ini mengevaluasi kinerja investasi 20 mata uang kripto terbesar berdasarkan kapitalisasi pasar selama periode 2021–2025 dengan menggunakan metrik risiko penurunan (downside risk). Pendekatan deskriptif kuantitatif diterapkan terhadap 36.500 observasi return harian yang diperoleh dari 36.520 data harga penutupan harian yang bersumber dari CoinGecko. Kinerja investasi diukur menggunakan Compound Annual Growth Rate (CAGR), annualized downside deviation, maximum drawdown, Sortino Ratio, dan Calmar Ratio, dengan tingkat suku bunga bebas risiko ditetapkan sebesar nol. Statistik deskriptif menunjukkan adanya excess kurtosis pada seluruh aset serta positive skewness pada 18 mata uang kripto, yang mendukung penggunaan metrik yang berorientasi pada risiko penurunan. Hanya enam aset yang mencapai Sortino Ratio di atas 1,0, dengan SHIB (10,0724), SOL (1,8578), dan BNB (1,7341) menempati nilai tertinggi. Sementara itu, hanya tiga aset yang memiliki Calmar Ratio di atas 1,0. Analisis kuadran mengidentifikasi tiga aset sebagai Alpha Leaders, tiga aset sebagai High-Yield Fragility, dan 14 aset sebagai Value Destruction. SHIB menunjukkan paradoks spekulatif, yaitu kombinasi antara kinerja luar biasa yang telah disesuaikan dengan risiko dan maximum drawdown sebesar 91,98%, yang disebabkan oleh harga awalnya yang berada pada tingkat yang sangat rendah. Sementara itu, LTC merupakan satu-satunya aset yang memiliki CAGR negatif. Temuan penelitian ini menunjukkan bahwa metrik risiko penurunan dapat memberikan perspektif yang saling melengkapi dalam mengevaluasi kinerja mata uang kripto dengan menekankan downside deviation dan drawdown, sehingga dapat mendukung pengambilan keputusan investasi yang lebih terinformasi.

标题: Die Freiheit, sich zu verpflichten
摘要: Will ein Truppenführer den Verlauf eines Gefechts ändern, greift er auf seine Reserve zurück. Mit dem Reservestärkungsgesetz will die Bundesregierung eine einsatzfähige Reserve auf strategischer Ebene schaffen. Dafür sollen Reservisten auch ohne freiwillige Meldung zu Reservedienstleistungen einberufen werden können. Entgegen vereinzelter Kritik handelt es sich dabei jedoch nicht um einen Rückgriff auf die Wehrpflicht. Eine freiwillige Entscheidung für ein Dienstverhältnis als Soldat beinhaltet auch Verpflichtungen, die über die eigentliche Dienstzeit hinausgehen.

标题: Identity Privacy Protection and Attack Research in Blockchain-Based Cryptocurrencies
摘要: A public blockchain establishes decentralized trust by having a globally verifiable ledger, but at the same time, the open nature of the ledger puts the user identity privacy into the danger of being associated with, tracked, and profiled for years to come. In most cases, users perform transactions using addresses without revealing their real names – and yet this approach is not anonymous because the address itself is a publicly available pseudonymous identifier. As soon as the addresses are cross-matched with exchange accounts, merchant purchases, social media data, wallets fingerprints, or even IP addresses of the network nodes, attackers can follow the flow of funds and behavioral patterns throughout the transaction graph. This paper aims to analyze the problems of user identity privacy being associated, transaction links being tracked, and network layer identities being revealed in public blockchain cryptocurrencies. Firstly, the pseudo-anonymity mechanism of Bitcoin, UTXO transaction format, and address clustering risk are analyzed; secondly, the privacy protection techniques of Monero, such as ring signatures, stealth addresses, and RingCT, are examined; thirdly, several attack techniques, like on-chain graph analysis, address clustering, change detection, cross-chain tracking, and IP-based de-anonymization in the network layer are summarized.

标题: Web3 Vulnerability Advisories Linked to Git-Verified Commits and Function-Level Code Changes
摘要: This dataset contains 1,488 published security advisories for blockchain software and links them to the code that changed. It spans three layers: infrastructure (677 advisories for node clients, consensus frameworks, compilers and virtual machines, cryptography and networking libraries), smart contracts (580, of which 528 are CVEs for individual Ethereum token contracts), and applications (142 for wallets, payment software and plugins), plus 89 notices of malicious packages that target cryptocurrency users. It covers 201 projects, including Bitcoin Core, go-ethereum, Vyper, Zebra, Cosmos SDK, CometBFT, libp2p and OpenZeppelin Contracts. All records are real; nothing is synthetic, and advisory text and source code are copied unchanged. Advisories were selected from the GitHub Advisory Database, the Go Vulnerability Database and the RustSec Advisory Database using a curated project list and a keyword search of all 404,000 database records followed by a review of 1,040 candidates. Each row gives identifiers, project, layer, category, severity, CVSS vector, CWE ids, affected packages with version ranges, and references. Advisories are linked to the commits they reference: 571 commit rows, of which 569 (99.6%) were fetched from the repository with git, covering 533 unique commits. For these commits the dataset records 4,957 changed files with git blob ids and 10,764 changed functions in 15 languages (mainly Rust, Go, Elixir, Python, TypeScript and Solidity), located with tree-sitter parsers; 4,577 functions were modified, 4,661 added and 1,526 removed. Source code before and after the change is included for 4,058 files and 10,371 functions, from commits whose license at that commit allows redistribution, and stays under each project's own license. A validation script re-checks every record against the source databases and every included file and function against its recorded hash (54 checks, all pass). In a random sample of 60 commits, 56 (93%) were the fix for their advisory; a text-based field flags commits that an advisory describes as introducing the bug. Verified commits exist for 28.8% of advisories, mostly infrastructure. The project list, labels and reviews were produced with an AI assistant and have not been validated by a second reviewer. Included source code remains under each project's own license; see LICENSE.md. This record is identical to the IEEE DataPort dataset with DOI 10.21227/1nww-h211.

标题: Signal Conversion Efficiency: Generative AI, Human Judgment, and Capital Formation in Token-Based Crowdfunding
作者: Paul Momtaz; Johan Wiklund; Ye Yuan
摘要: Abstract Information asymmetries between entrepreneurs and financiers shape the efficiency of entrepreneurial finance markets. Drawing on the distinction between information-endowment asymmetry (unequal access to signals) and information-utilization asymmetry (unequal processing of signals), we explore whether generative artificial intelligence (AI) improves ''signal conversion efficiency''(SCE), the effective utilization of the information endowment. We engineer an AI agent that uses information from blockchain-based crowdfunding campaigns to generate investment recommendations and compare them with recommendations by human experts and a human-built recommendation algorithm. AI advice outperforms other signals statistically and economically: Including it as a signal for capital formation raises R-squared by up to 35\%, and a one-standard-deviation increase in AI recommendation strength is associated with 48\% higher funding amounts. Explainable AI using Shapley values corroborates AI's predictive power. Consistent with our SCE conjecture, AI-human advice congruence is positively associated with capital formation, while the direction of divergence matters: campaigns rated more favorably by humans than by AI raise less funding than those for which AI is more optimistic. The AI agent's predictive performance increases across generations of large language models evaluated on the same class of historical disclosures. Our findings highlight information utilization as a central mechanism through which generative AI supports investment decisions in entrepreneurial finance. JEL Codes: C45, G24, G32, K22, L26

标题: Consideraciones sistemáticas sobre el blanqueo de capitales y figuras delictivas afines en el ámbito de los criptoactivos
摘要: Este artículo aborda los desafíos que plantea el uso de criptomonedas en la ejecución del blanqueo de capitales. Se analiza cómo estos activos virtuales facilitan cada etapa del proceso de blanqueo y la perpetración de tradicionales delitos previos, como la receptación, la corrupción y el fraude fiscal. Se examina la tipificación del delito de blanqueo en España y se destacan los riesgos emergentes asociados a las finanzas descentralizadas, las ofertas iniciales de proyectos cripto, los tokens no fungibles, los servicios mezcladores, entre otros. No solo se proponen soluciones jurídicas, sino que se destacan propuestas técnico-informáticas para la persecución del delito, porque la opacidad y descentralización de las criptomonedas dificultan significativamente la capacidad de las autoridades para investigar y sancionar eficazmente estas conductas ilícitas. 标题: SLIM-LQVAR: Post-LASSO Shrinkage for Quantile Connectedness and Tail-Risk Transmission in Cryptocurrency Markets
摘要: This study introduces Shrinkage of Lagged Influences in Multivariate LASSO-Quantile Vector Autoregression (SLIM-LQVAR), evaluated as SLIM-LQVAR10: a fixed 10% post-LASSO contraction of quantile vector autoregressive lag coefficients, for generalized variance-decomposition connectedness among BTC, ETH, BNB, XRP and ADA. An archived panel of Binance spot daily returns covers 2018–2026 (2,479 estimation and 620 holdout observations). The analysis reports q05/q50/q95 network estimates and sensitivity to covariance, horizon, lag order and training period. A 100-seed-per-quantile Monte Carlo study spanning five known-oracle DGP families and seven estimators finds a 4.73% q05 Edge MAE reduction relative to LASSO-QVAR; the DGP-stratified paired 95% interval for the absolute reduction excludes zero. Mean Edge MAE is 0.35% and 0.40% higher at q50 and q95, respectively, with intervals covering zero. The nonlinear heteroskedastic upper-tail DGP shows pronounced deterioration. A 100-replicate joint coefficient–covariance moving-block bootstrap provides conditional intervals for TCI, FROM, TO, NET and directed FEVD edges. Holdout quantile coverage is imperfect (q05: 1.97%; q95: 97.65%), and validation-only intercept recalibration does not resolve all asset-level failures. SLIM-LQVAR10 demonstrates statistically supported improvements in lower-tail network recovery relative to LASSO-QVAR, while maintaining competitive forecasting performance across quantiles. However, its network-recovery advantage does not generalize uniformly to the median and upper-tail states. The network estimates are noncausal, and the original tail forecasts are not validated for stand-alone Value-at-Risk use.

标题: Technological Concerns and the Blockchain Ecosystem
Factors Influencing Consumers' Intention to Use Cryptocurrency as a Substitute for Traditional Currency: An Empirical Study
摘要: Abstract Purpose. Cryptocurrencies are often promoted as an alternative to fiat money, yet little is known about why ordinary consumers would use them as a substitute for traditional currency rather than as a speculative asset. This study integrates the technology acceptance model, trust and perceived risk to explain attitude towards cryptocurrency, and tests whether regulatory awareness and volatility perception change how strongly that attitude turns into behavioral intention. Design/methodology/approach. A cross-sectional survey of 441 cryptocurrency-aware adult consumers in Indian metro and tier 2 cities was collected through purposive sampling and analyzed with partial least squares structural equation modeling (PLS-SEM) in SmartPLS 4. Inference used 5,000 bootstrap subsamples; moderation used the two-stage interaction approach with simple slopes and Johnson-Neyman analysis. Findings. Perceived usefulness (β = 0.265), perceived ease of use (β = 0.250) and trust (β = 0.310) strengthened attitude, while perceived risk weakened it (β = −0.270); together they explained 56.5% of the variance in attitude. Attitude was the strongest predictor of intention (β = 0.602). Attitude mediated all four antecedents: fully for ease of use and risk, partially for usefulness and trust. Regulatory awareness strengthened the attitude to intention link (β = 0.146), whereas volatility perception weakened it (β = −0.102). The model explained 53.5% of the variance in intention and showed high out-of-sample predictive power. All eleven hypotheses were supported. Originality/value. The study treats regulation and volatility as boundary conditions on the attitude to intention link rather than as further direct antecedents. This explains why favorable attitudes do not always become use: they convert into intention more readily when consumers understand the rules and less readily when they expect sharp price swings. Practical implications. Exchanges and wallet providers should pair usability and security messaging with plain-language explanations of tax and compliance rules, and should offer price-stabilizing options (stablecoin settlement, instant conversion) for payment use cases. Policymakers can raise conversion of interest into informed use by making the regulatory regime clearer and more visible.

标题: One Citizen, One Node, Instant Tally: End-to-End Verifiable, Secret-Ballot Electoral Systems on Self-Verifying Virtual File Graphs

标题: BSIDM: secure IoT data management using blockchain, AW-DAG consensus, and HABE encryption
作者: Anushrav Mishra; Kamta Nath Mishra; Rayees Ahamad; Ghanshyam Singh
摘要: Today, more than 55 billion IoT devices generate about 79.4 zettabytes of data per year, highlighting the growing gap between centralized cloud architectures and the security, scalability, and access-control needs of Internet of Things (IoT) applications. At the moment, blockchain solutions for managing IoT data remain fragmented: lightweight blockchains neglect access control, permissionless DAGs fail to provide fine-grained access control, and permissioned blockchains trade off throughput for Byzantine fault tolerance. In this paper, we propose a BSIDM (Blockchain-enabled Secure IoT Data Management) architecture that consists of four planes: IoT Sensing, Edge Preprocessing, Blockchain Coordination, and Cloud Storage that communicate via smart contracts. BSIDM architecture utilizes two novel ideas: an AW-DAG reputation-weighted, DAG-based Byzantine Fault Tolerance consensus protocol with sub-second finality due to parallel tip validation, and Hierarchical Attribute-Based Encryption (HABE), a hierarchical ciphertext-policy attribute-based encryption with fine-grained access control in O(m + log k) complexity, where m is the number of attributes matched by the access policy and k is the number of authorities in the hierarchy, so decryption cost grows linearly with m and only adds a small O(log k) hierarchical-delegation term that can be applied to edge computing devices. Dynamic sharding through consistent hashing ensures cloud storage load balancing, and blockchain-secured migrations ensure auditability. The security of the BSIDM is formally proved, as it provides IND-CCA2 security, Byzantine fault tolerance for f < n/3, and prevention of Sybil attacks. The experiments performed on the 500-node CloudLab testbed, for comparison with IOTA Tangle, Hyperledger Fabric v2.4, the IPFS storage system, and AWS IoT Core, demonstrate that BSIDM achieves 5,847 TPS throughput, an average latency of 320 ms, and 0.8 s finality. Thus, BSIDM has a 5.97 × (5,847 vs. 980 TPS) improvement in throughput and a 90.1% reduction in average latency compared with IOTA, using just 0.23 mJ per transaction, 1.7% more than AWS IoT Core energy usage. Comparative analysis across nine aspects demonstrates BSIDM’s dominance.

标题: Związek frazeologiczny wywrócić stolik we współczesnej polszczyźnie
摘要: This article discusses one of the expressions not included in the dictionaries, namely wywrócić stolik (lit. ‘to flip the table’). It appears especially in politicians' statements and press comments. The paper attempts to describe the semantic and syntactic properties of the phrase and its origin. It is proposed to distinguish the unit of two variant forms ktoś, coś wywróci – wywraca / przewróci – przewraca (jakiś) stolik (‘someone, something completely changes the situation, the status quo’). There are two hypotheses regarding the motivation of the expression. It may be a borrowing from English or an unit that originated in Polish language. It is very likely that the phraseologism is motivated by the language of games (by situations related to card games or chess).

标题: Blockchain for spectrum management, trading, and settlement in next-generation wireless networks
摘要: The rapid growth of mobile traffic and localised capacity pressure in 5G and beyond networks has exposed the limitations of conventional licensed spectrum management. Long-term exclusive spectrum assignment provides regulatory order and interference protection, but it is poorly suited to short-term, location-dependent variations in demand. In practice, spectrum may remain underutilised in some areas while others experience congestion, leading to inefficient use of a scarce resource. Existing dynamic spectrum trading approaches address part of this problem. Still, many remain limited at the execution layer: they assume trusted intermediaries, offer incomplete settlement models, and lack auditable coordination among independent stakeholders. Meanwhile, in shared indoor environments where multiple operators use neutral-host infrastructure, settlement between operators is typically governed by static fees that do not reflect the radio performance actually delivered to users. This thesis investigates how blockchain, smart contracts, and learning-assisted demand analysis can be combined to support flexible, accountable, and operationally credible spectrum coordination and settlement in 5G and beyond wireless networks. The work is developed around three connected contributions. The first contribution presents a blockchain-based decentralised spectrum trading marketplace implemented on the Ethereum Sepolia test network. The framework defines the roles of three main entities. The Telecommunications Regulatory Authority, spectrum holders, and spectrum buyers are defined, and a market mechanism comprising a dynamic posted-price function with a scarcity multiplier, a rule-based batch matching algorithm, and interference-aware feasibility constraints that ensure spatial, temporal, and frequency-domain coexistence among allocations is developed. Four smart contract functions cover the complete lifecycle of a spectrum trade, from listing through matching to payment settlement and ownership transfer. Security evaluation using static analysis across one hundred vulnerability detectors confirmed robustness against replay, payment manipulation, and front-running attacks. In contrast, a queueing-based scalability analysis demonstrated that the marketplace can support meaningful trading workloads within blockchain throughput constraints. The second contribution extends this foundation into a demand-aware and learning-assisted spectrum coordination framework. Analysis of cellular traffic data from Milan offers concrete evidence of underutilised spectrum across space and time. By applying a normalised index of utilisation together with a two-tier k-means clustering approach, the results show clear demand heterogeneity at both the city-wide and sub-regional level. An artificial neural network (ANN)-based traffic prediction model is introduced to enable proactive spectrum trading by forecasting low-demand intervals. To validate the framework in a realistic setting, it was extended and connected to a 5G testbed built on OpenAirInterface. The results show that once a spectrum trade is finalised on-chain, the gNB and UE can be reconfigured automatically, with no changes required to the PHY or MAC layers. This confirms, end-to-end, that blockchain-based spectrum trading can operate alongside real cellular deployments. The third contribution extends blockchain-based coordination into indoor neutral-host and Open RAN environments, addressing the problem of performance aware inter-operator settlement. A system model based on 3GPP channel models and a Monte Carlo system-level simulation quantifies the distributional improvement in received power, SINR, and achievable downlink throughput for neutral-host indoor service compared to a macro outdoor-to-indoor baseline. A throughput-centric QoS metric and a reward-penalty pricing mechanism are developed to adjust the wholesale price paid by the MNO to the neutral-host operator based on the measured QoS gain and the per-user degradation probability. Settlement is enforced on-chain via a smart contract that forwards payments with immutable audit trails. Sensitivity analysis under Worst and Random admission policies demonstrates that the risk-aware pricing mechanism appropriately rewards beneficial offloading and discounts unstable regimes, aligning neutral-host revenue with delivered performance. Together, the three contributions demonstrate that blockchain-based coordination can address real and complementary limitations in wireless spectrum management and shared infrastructure settlement. The results show that blockchain and smart contracts provide a credible foundation for auditable, multi-party telecom coordination, that learning-assisted demand analysis can improve responsiveness to localised resource imbalance. Performance-aware pricing can introduce accountability into neutral-host operation. The thesis identifies limitations of the present work and several directions for future investigation, including consortium blockchain architectures, tighter integration with O-RAN intelligent controllers, and richer multi-metric settlement models.

标题: Enigma Blockchain (ENB): A Tokenless Smart-Contract Ledger for Verifiable Records
摘要: Enigma Blockchain (ENB) is an EVM-compatible proof-of-authority ledger operated for the ENIGMA platform. It has no coin, no token and no fee market: the genesis block allocates no balances, blocks carry no reward and the gas price is zero. The report specifies the chain (QBFT consensus, validator and access model, external anchoring), a data policy that separates what may be written in clear from what may be written only as a salted commitment and what is never written, the five-contract suite, the trust model with dual signatures, the operations of the platform that already run on the public testnet, the foundations in the task approach and in learning theory, the application of the design to AI-native government, its relation to the IAIC 101 standard, governance, regulatory position, and the conditions for a mainnet launch.

标题: Web3 Vulnerability Advisories Linked to Git-Verified Commits and Function-Level Code Changes
摘要: This dataset contains 1,488 published security advisories for blockchain software and links them to the code that changed. It spans three layers: infrastructure (677 advisories for node clients, consensus frameworks, compilers and virtual machines, cryptography and networking libraries), smart contracts (580, of which 528 are CVEs for individual Ethereum token contracts), and applications (142 for wallets, payment software and plugins), plus 89 notices of malicious packages that target cryptocurrency users. It covers 201 projects, including Bitcoin Core, go-ethereum, Vyper, Zebra, Cosmos SDK, CometBFT, libp2p and OpenZeppelin Contracts. All records are real; nothing is synthetic, and advisory text and source code are copied unchanged. Advisories were selected from the GitHub Advisory Database, the Go Vulnerability Database and the RustSec Advisory Database using a curated project list and a keyword search of all 404,000 database records followed by a review of 1,040 candidates. Each row gives identifiers, project, layer, category, severity, CVSS vector, CWE ids, affected packages with version ranges, and references. Advisories are linked to the commits they reference: 571 commit rows, of which 569 (99.6%) were fetched from the repository with git, covering 533 unique commits. For these commits the dataset records 4,957 changed files with git blob ids and 10,764 changed functions in 15 languages (mainly Rust, Go, Elixir, Python, TypeScript and Solidity), located with tree-sitter parsers; 4,577 functions were modified, 4,661 added and 1,526 removed. Source code before and after the change is included for 4,058 files and 10,371 functions, from commits whose license at that commit allows redistribution, and stays under each project's own license. A validation script re-checks every record against the source databases and every included file and function against its recorded hash (54 checks, all pass). In a random sample of 60 commits, 56 (93%) were the fix for their advisory; a text-based field flags commits that an advisory describes as introducing the bug. Verified commits exist for 28.8% of advisories, mostly infrastructure. The project list, labels and reviews were produced with an AI assistant and have not been validated by a second reviewer.

标题: When Drift Does Not Warrant Retraining: A Held-Out Test for In-Context Adaptation versus Retraining in Markets
作者: Wilfried Ariel Mulyawan; Mengzhong Ma; Lin William Cong
摘要: A model trained on one market regime will eventually face another. Its user can keep it frozen, let it condition on observable market state, or retrain it. We ask which of the three a given change calls for, and show that standard drift detectors cannot tell. On a process with known ground truth, four of five named detectors fire on \(30\%\) to \(92\%\) of transitions whether or not refitting is warranted, with noise changing or constant, a failure that is structural for any detector reading only the input-outcome history. We give a retrospective held-out test, the recovery fraction: the share of the gap between freezing and refitting that conditioning on observable state already closes; and we use a signal-to-noise benchmark, standard in window selection under breaks, below which freezing beats re-estimation. On liquid crypto markets the test is a linear-regression analogue of in-context adaptation, and no in-context model is run. Across six framings, conditioning closes 0.77 to 0.88 of the held-out refit gap on every pooled impact map, and daily and five-minute return forecasts show no shift beyond a block-bootstrap null. The one-second forecast is the only forecast map with excess shifts: conditioning does not help there (about \(1\%\) worse than freezing in squared error). We read these results as market efficiency capping the change worth re-estimating, an interpretation we do not establish: the sixteen-coin cross-sectional prediction of that reading points the predicted way but misses its pre-registered rank-correlation bar, so we report it as exploratory.

标题: Risk-Preference-Conditioned Generative Reinforcement Learning for Hedging Prediction-Market Contracts
摘要: A desk that sells short-horizon binary contracts on a prediction market is short a digital option whose model delta becomes arbitrarily large near the strike as expiry approaches, exactly where transaction costs bite hardest. How aggressively to hedge depends on the desk’s risk preference, so we make that preference an input: a single generative policy, conditioned on the joint Binance–Polymarket history and on a vector of cost sensitivity, downside asymmetry and tail weight, which a language model resolves from a plain-English mandate without seeing market data. On 1,116 reconstructed 15-minute BTC contracts, with a chronological split and a Binance-defined proxy liability, dynamic delta hedging is dominated under our estimated execution costs: every learned policy has lower tracking error, cost and tail risk. One network traces a monotonic cost–accuracy tradeoff as cost sensitivity is varied, and we detect no significant difference from baselines tuned separately for each mandate. Its response to the downside and tail coordinates is weak, and its tail-risk advantage over not hedging does not survive an alternative settlement definition. A recurrent encoder tracks slightly better than attention encoders but barely responds to the preference vector.

标题: The relationship between Twitter uncertainty measures and stock market returns during the COVID-19 crisis
作者: Salma Hamrouni; Montassar Zayati; Makram Bellalah; Kamel Naoui
摘要: Purpose This paper aims to explore how uncertainty captured through social media, particularly Twitter, affects global stock markets during the COVID-19 crisis. It focuses on whether the Twitter economic uncertainty (TEU) and Twitter Market Uncertainty (TMU) indices contain information that helps explain market behaviour in periods of stress. Design/methodology/approach The analysis relies on daily data from January 2007 to May 2023. This paper combines linear and nonlinear Granger causality tests (Diks and Panchenko, 2006) with the BDS nonlinearity test, and a Dynamic Conditional Correlation-Generalized Autoregressive Conditional Heteroskedasticity (DCC-GARCH) connectedness framework is used (Gabauer, 2020) to capture the dynamic transmission of volatility between Twitter-based sentiment indicators and 13 international financial markets. Findings The results highlight strong nonlinear causal effects from Twitter-based uncertainty measures to market returns. TEU and TMU indices appear to drive fluctuations in stock returns, particularly during episodes of heightened uncertainty. The DCC-GARCH analysis shows that TEU-ENG and TEU-USA act as net transmitters of volatility to markets such as Japan, Ukraine, China, Germany and even Bitcoin. Research limitations/implications As the study focuses mainly on the COVID-19 crisis, future research could extend the analysis to other stress periods or explore alternative sentiment measures such as the volatility index. Practical implications The findings suggest that social media sentiment can serve as a timely indicator for risk managers and investors, complementing traditional uncertainty measures. Social implications The results highlight how collective behaviour on social networks can amplify uncertainty and market reactions, underscoring the need for responsible communication and better public understanding of financial information online. Originality/value This study offers fresh evidence on how Twitter-based uncertainty indices interact with market dynamics, combining behavioral–finance insights with nonlinear econometric techniques.

标题: Authentication Using Secrets in Plain Sight: Zero-Database Identity, Asymmetric Challenge Proofs, and 100% File-Reconstructible Keyrings Over Commodity Storage
摘要: Eliminating Password Databases, Opaque Cloud User Pools, and Credential-Bearing Requests Through Memory-Hard Wrapped Keyrings, Split-Knowledge Peppers, Biometric Passkey Unlocks, and Self-Verifying OMVFS01 Envelopes (OMVFS-AUTH-V1) For forty years, internet login systems have transmitted human passwords to servers and locked user identities inside proprietary cloud user pools and credential databases. OMVFS-AUTH-V1 inverts the model: a user's asymmetric signing and encryption keys live as encrypted, self-verifying OMVFS01 envelopes ("secrets in plain sight") delivered alongside a one-time login challenge. The client unlocks its Ed25519 private key strictly in local memory and returns only an asymmetric digital signature — zero passwords ever cross the network, password changes rewrite a single 32-byte wrapper in O(1) time without re-encrypting files, and copying plain object-storage files 100% reconstructs the entire identity provider without AWS Cognito or DynamoDB. Zero Passwords or Verifiers on the Wire: During sign-in, the client receives a one-time nonce plus its own encrypted keyring envelopes, derives an unlock key in RAM, unwraps its active Ed25519 signing key, and returns only a domain-separated asymmetric signature. Three Explicit Cryptographic Security Regimes: Quantifies exact offline and online work factors across (I) human passphrases hardened by sub-millisecond edge gating and split-knowledge server peppers/OPRFs, (II) 256-bit hardware biometric WebAuthn PRF secrets safe even on a 100% public CDN, and (III) composite biometric-plus-passphrase key derivation. O(1) Password Rotation & Multi-Epoch Key Lineage: Decoupling the transient UnlockKEK from the persistent MasterKEK lets users rotate passphrases or append new cryptographic epochs in O(1) bytes while retaining read access to historical encrypted files. Zero-Backdoor Asymmetric Account Recovery: Optional X25519/threshold recovery wrappers re-bind MasterKEK under a verified new passphrase during account recovery without exposing plaintext user files to authentication servers. 100% File-Reconstructible Identity & RBAC: Replacing opaque cloud user pools and NoSQL tables with conditional-ETag OMVFS01 envelopes turns disaster recovery, multi-cloud portability, and OAuth 2.1 / OpenID Connect issuance into deterministic file operations.
