标题: Enhanced Encryption Model for Secured Communication Using Blockchain Technology
作者: Onwuachu Uzochukwu Christian; E E Ndueso
摘要: This study proposes an enhanced encryption model for secured communication using blockchain technology. The proposed system employs the Advanced Encryption Standard in Galois/Counter Mode (AES-GCM) for message confidentiality and authenticated encryption, public-key cryptography for protecting message encryption keys, digital signatures for sender authentication, and cryptographic hashes for message integrity verification. A blockchain-inspired, hash-linked audit ledger records message hashes and relevant transaction metadata without placing plaintext messages or secret keys on the ledger. The system is designed as a Python Flask web application with a database for user and message metadata management. The research methodology covers system analysis, cryptographic model design, implementation, functional testing, security testing, and performance evaluation. The proposed evaluation examines encryption and decryption latency, throughput, integrity verification, unauthorized-access resistance, and the overhead associated with audit recording. Experimental results will be generated through repeatable tests using documented datasets, fixed configurations, and clearly defined measurement procedures. The expected contribution is a practical communication prototype that integrates authenticated encryption with tamper-evident audit records while recognizing the limitations of a locally maintained ledger compared with a decentralized blockchain network

标题: LAUNDERING CYBERCRIME PROCEEDS THROUGH VIRTUAL AND CRYPTO ASSETS (CYBER-LAUNDERING): TYPOLOGIES AND PREVENTION MECHANISMS
摘要: This article examines how proceeds of cybercrime are laundered through virtual and crypto assets. Drawing on FATF and EAG typologies, comparative case law and Uzbek legislation, it studies the general structure of cybercrimes in remote banking, and how crypto and e-money may facilitate the cyber-laundering. Based on the analysis, the paper provides policy suggestions to strengthen the legal framework.

标题: Joint Adaptive Quantile Network VAR and Connectedness-Adjusted Portfolio Allocation: Evidence from Cryptocurrency Markets
摘要: This study connects jointly estimated conditional-quantile networks with cryptocurrency portfolio allocation. A joint adaptive quantile network VAR (JAQN–VAR) represents cross-asset lag coefficients through quadratic B-splines over seven quantiles, combining adaptive group shrinkage, curvature regularization and soft noncrossing control. Normalized generalized forecast-error variance decomposition supplies directional transmitter scores to a connectedness-adjusted minimum-variance (CAMV) portfolio. BTC, ETH, BNB, XRP and ADA are modeled using 2,479 training observations and a matched 620-day evaluation with five-day rebalancing and transaction costs. Static q05 JAQN–CAMV earns −5.204% cumulative net return versus −5.640% for minimum variance, −15.373% for minimum CVaR and −32.621% for equal weighting; however, minimum CVaR records the lowest volatility and expected shortfall, and the mean-return difference versus minimum variance is statistically inconclusive. Updating the network every five days using a 1,000-observation rolling window yields −5.041% cumulative return. In known-oracle location-shift simulations (160 datasets per quantile), JAQN–VAR reduces GFEVD Edge MAE versus exact QVAR by 6.33%, 0.58% and 5.55% at q05, q50 and q95. Advantages versus separately penalized QVAR are conditional, and quantile-varying location–scale designs expose lower- and upper-tail failure modes. The findings support a feasible dynamic network-to-portfolio workflow, not uniform estimator or risk dominance.

标题: Identity Privacy Protection and Attack Research in Blockchain-Based Cryptocurrencies
摘要: A public blockchain establishes decentralized trust by having a globally verifiable ledger, but at the same time, the open nature of the ledger puts the user identity privacy into the danger of being associated with, tracked, and profiled for years to come. In most cases, users perform transactions using addresses without revealing their real names – and yet this approach is not anonymous because the address itself is a publicly available pseudonymous identifier. As soon as the addresses are cross-matched with exchange accounts, merchant purchases, social media data, wallets fingerprints, or even IP addresses of the network nodes, attackers can follow the flow of funds and behavioral patterns throughout the transaction graph. This paper aims to analyze the problems of user identity privacy being associated, transaction links being tracked, and network layer identities being revealed in public blockchain cryptocurrencies. Firstly, the pseudo-anonymity mechanism of Bitcoin, UTXO transaction format, and address clustering risk are analyzed; secondly, the privacy protection techniques of Monero, such as ring signatures, stealth addresses, and RingCT, are examined; thirdly, several attack techniques, like on-chain graph analysis, address clustering, change detection, cross-chain tracking, and IP-based de-anonymization in the network layer are summarized.

标题: Frozen Forward Rule: Options Flow in Spot Crypto ETFs and the Two-Week Ether Return
摘要: Spot bitcoin and ether ETFs trade options during US market hours, while the coins they hold trade all weekend. Two pre-registered grids on July 2025 to September 2026 found that Friday options flow in these ETFs does not predict the weekend crypto move. One in-sample cell survived every robustness check: when the 20-day premium-weighted bull share of notable options prints across six spot crypto ETFs (IBIT, ETHA, FBTC, GBTC, ARKB, BITO) has leaned bullish, ether's next two weeks have been weak (Spearman -0.42, n = 58, about 29 independent observations). Because it was found in-sample, it is treated as hypothesis generation and was frozen on 4 October 2026 as a forward rule. Every Friday at 16:00 ET, s is the 20-day bull share; if s > +0.10 the rule calls ETH down over the next two weeks, if s < -0.10 it calls ETH up, otherwise no call. The rule is judged once, after 25 non-overlapping calls have resolved, and passes only if all three criteria hold: hit rate of at least 60% on called weeks; Spearman(s, outcome) of -0.25 or lower with p < 0.05 over all forward Fridays; and a negative mean outcome after DOWN calls and a positive one after UP calls. Failing any criterion retires the lead, with no tuning step. A flow-collection gap in October 2026 is handled by a rule fixed on 2 November 2026, before any affected outcome existed: a Friday whose 20-day window has a missing or partial day gets no call and does not count. Author: Henry Zhang, Independent Researcher. Research only; not investment advice.

标题: Short Term Forecasting of Indonesia’s Policy Interest Rate Using ARIMA
作者: Dania Hellin Amrina; Fendi Prabowo Nurcahyo; Christophorus Novendra Putra; Aizun Gilang Ramadhan; Haryadi Fajar Saputra; Zakiy Bekti Nugraha; Rafi Satria Naufal Fadhilah
摘要: This study examines the short-term dynamics of Indonesia’s policy interest rate and develops forecasts using an autoregressive integrated moving average (ARIMA) approach. The analysis uses 95 monthly observations from January 2018 to November 2025 to generate forecasts for December 2025–February 2026. Model selection combines stationarity testing, information criteria, and residual diagnostics. The results indicate that the series becomes stationary after first differencing. Among the three specifications considered, ARIMA(1,1,1) provides the lowest Akaike and Bayesian information criteria, while residual tests reveal no significant autocorrelation. The model projects an approximately stable policy rate of 4.74% throughout the forecast horizon. A retrospective comparison shows that Bank Indonesia maintained the policy rate at 4.75% during all three months. Although the ARIMA forecasts closely approximate the observed rates, a no-change benchmark achieves lower forecast errors over this period. These findings highlight the persistence of Indonesia’s policy rate and the importance of benchmark comparisons in evaluating forecasting performance. The model provides a statistical baseline for short-term monetary analysis that can complement assessments of broader macroeconomic developments

标题: Walrus: An Efficient Decentralized Storage Network
作者: George Danezis; Giacomo Giuliari; Eleftherios Kokoris Kogias; Markus Legner; Jean-Pierre Smith; Alberto Sonnino; Karl Wüst
摘要: Decentralized storage faces a fundamental trade-off between replication overhead, recovery efficiency, and security guarantees. Current approaches either rely on full replication, incurring substantial storage costs, or employ erasure-coding schemes that struggle with efficient recovery, especially under high churn. We present Walrus , a decentralized blob storage system that addresses these limitations through multiple technical innovations. At the core of Walrus is Red Stuff , a two-dimensional erasure-coding protocol that achieves high security with only a 4.5× replication factor, while providing self-healing of lost data. This means that recovery is done without centralized coordination and requires bandwidth proportional to the amount of lost data. However, Red Stuff on its own is not sufficient for Walrus , as it is designed with a static set of participants in mind. To further support decentralization, we also introduce a multi-stage epoch-change protocol that efficiently handles storage node churn while maintaining uninterrupted availability during committee transitions. Our system incorporates authenticated data structures to defend against malicious clients and ensure data consistency throughout storage and retrieval. Walrus has been deployed in production since March 2025 and has secured 686~TB of data by July 2026. We conduct an experimental evaluation of the deployed system and demonstrate that Walrus achieves practical performance at scale.

标题: Meme Coin Factories: Uncovering Large-Scale Manipulations on pump.fun
作者: Nicolas Szwajcok; Taro Tsuchiya; Enze Liu; Kyle Soska; Mathias Payer; Nicolas Christin
摘要: Once complex, creating and deploying a new cryptocurrency has become trivial. Coin launchpads now allow users to generate a new coin with merely a few clicks, at a minimal cost. Launchpad popularity has grown in tandem with the rise of "meme coins," which usually do not offer any novel technological properties and are purely created for fun. The most prominent coin launchpad, pump.fun, has gained significant traction, grossing over 100 million USD in daily trading volume. The mass adoption of coin launchpads, however, also enables strategic actors to easily manipulate trading signals, unbeknownst to inexperienced traders who then buy certain coins, and enable these strategic actors to profit from rapid and unsustainable price increases ("pumps"). To identify such manipulations at scale, we conduct a large-scale study of pump.fun, collecting information on all 15 million coins launched in the last two years, and performing analysis on large, random samples of transaction data. We identify five classes of manipulation strategies: 1) wash trading, 2) creator address obfuscation, 3) coordinated sell, 4) copycat coins, and 5) social media manipulation. We find that strategic actors often bypass the platform interface and implement these strategies in a highly automated and low-latency fashion, by interacting directly with the blockchain. We further uncover the existence of "Market-Manipulation-as-a-service (MMaaS)," third-party tools that enable users to perform these manipulations without any technical expertise. We conclude by devising mitigations and proposing recommendations for traders, pump.fun, wallets or chain scanners, software development platforms, and regulators.

标题: Volatility Dynamics and Spillovers in Cryptocurrency Markets: Evidence from the Bitcoin ETF Approval
作者: Jingrui Li; Divykumar Patel; Apoo Koticha
摘要: This article examines the volatility spillover effects following the Bitcoin ETF approval shock. We identify October 23, 2023, as an endogenously detected structural breakpoint coinciding with heightened ETF-related market attention. Using high-frequency five-minute data, we decompose Bitcoin and Ethereum realized volatility into continuous and jump components using threshold bipower variation. We find a pronounced decline in Ethereum’s jump variation and a smaller but statistically significant decline in Bitcoin’s jump variation. Employing a VAR-X model augmented with market indicators, followed by a bivariate GARCH–BEKK analysis, we find that short-term cross-market volatility spillovers between Bitcoin and Ethereum markedly weaken after the breakpoint on October 23, 2023, indicating reduced immediate shock responsiveness. Conversely, long-term volatility interdependence strengthens, reflecting persistent linkages. Moreover, our conditional correlation analysis reveals that while pre-break correlations were robust (consistently above 0.8), post-break correlations weaken considerably—occasionally falling below 0.5—thereby unveiling a distinct shift in co-movements among cryptocurrencies.

标题: On the Limits of Consensus under Dynamic Availability and Reconfiguration
作者: Javier Nieto; Joachim Neu; Ling Ren
摘要: Proof-of-stake blockchains require consensus protocols that support Dynamic Availability and Reconfiguration (which we call the DAR model). Here, Dynamic Availability means that the consensus protocol should remain live even if a large number of nodes temporarily crash, and Reconfiguration means it should be possible to change the set of operating nodes over time. State-of-the-art protocols inspired by the DAR model, such as Ethereum, Cardano's Ouroboros, or Snow White, require additional model features comprising external mechanisms or node capabilities that are difficult to justify, such as social consensus or the requirement that key evolution be performed even when nodes have crashed. The key result of this paper is the necessary and sufficient adversarial condition under which consensus can be achieved in the plain DAR model, without any extra features. We then introduce an additional feature to the model that is justified by proof-of-stake blockchain designs: honest nodes complete a sign-off procedure the moment they express intent to exit from the set of operating nodes. This additional feature reduces the power of the adversary relative to the plain DAR model and helps us obtain a bootstrapping gadget that is particularly simple and efficient in the common optimistic case of few reconfigurations and no double spending.

标题: Resilient Alerting Protocols for Blockchains
作者: Marwa Mouallem; Lorenz Breidenbach; Ittay Eyal; Ari Juels
摘要: Smart contracts are stateful programs deployed on blockchains; they secure over a trillion dollars in transaction value per year. High-stakes smart contracts often rely on timely alerts about external events, but prior work has not analyzed their resilience to an attacker suppressing alerts via bribery. We formalize this challenge in a cryptoeconomic setting as the \emph{alerting problem}, giving rise to a game between a bribing adversary and~$n$ rational participants, who pay a penalty if they are caught deviating from the protocol. We establish a quadratic, i.e.,~$O(n^2)$, upper bound, whereas a straightforward alerting protocol only achieves~$O(n)$ bribery cost. We present a \emph{simultaneous game} that asymptotically achieves the quadratic upper bound and thus asymptotically-optimal bribery resistance. We then present two protocols that implement our simultaneous game: The first leverages a strong network synchrony assumption. The second relaxes this strong assumption and instead takes advantage of trusted hardware and blockchain proof-of-publication to establish a timed commitment scheme. These two protocols are constant-time but incur a linear storage overhead on the blockchain. We analyze a third, \emph{sequential alerting} protocol that optimistically incurs no on-chain storage overhead, at the expense of~$O(n)$ worst-case execution time. All three protocols achieve asymptotically-optimal bribery costs, but with different resource and performance tradeoffs. Together, they illuminate a rich design space for practical solutions to the alerting problem.

标题: Are Unreachable Nodes Truly Safe? Fully Eclipsing Monero's P2P Network!
作者: Ruisheng Shi; Jiaqi Zeng; Lina Lan; Shihan Zhang; Bing Han; Xiapu Luo; Qishu Jin; Wenliang Du; Qin Wang
摘要: Eclipse attacks isolate a blockchain node by monopolizing its network connections. Existing attacks on Monero (NDSS'25), Bitcoin (USENIX'15/21, S&P'20) and Ethereum (WWW'26) implicitly assume that the adversary can establish inbound connections, thereby excluding a large and practically dominant class of nodes: unreachable nodes operating behind NATs. Such nodes are widely believed to enjoy stronger networks. We challenge this assumption and show that unreachability does NOT imply the expected resilience! We present the first eclipse attacks tailored to unreachable nodes in Monero's P2P network. Our attacks require no inbound access to the victim. Instead, they first poison the peerlist of reachable nodes, which subsequently act as propagation relays to contaminate unreachable nodes' whitelists. The adversary then exploits Monero's built-in outbound connection refresh logic to evict benign neighbors and eventually monopolize all outbound connections. We instantiate this strategy in two attacks: Nyx, which targets long-running unreachable nodes and achieves a complete and persistent eclipse through network-wide poisoning; and Moros, a stealthier attack that exploits the bootstrapping phase to rapidly eclipse newly joined unreachable nodes. We ethically evaluate both attacks. Nyx is validated via large-scale simulations on a Monero network constructed using the SEED Emulator, while Moros is demonstrated on the Monero mainnet against controlled targets. Our results show that unreachable nodes can be reliably driven into stable, long-lived eclipse states. We also propose countermeasures.

标题: BitFraud: A Bitcoin Fraud Benchmark with Pseudonymised Transactions, Graph and Labels
作者: Salah eddine Bouchama; Samir Ouchani; Hafida Bouarfa
摘要: BitFraud is a benchmark for forward-in-time evaluation of Bitcoin fraud detection. It consists of six chronologically ordered blockchain snapshots between December 2024 and September 2025, each covering 100 consecutive blocks, with 1,687,072 transactions, of which 11,690 are labelled as involving an address reported as fraudulent. Contents- dataset_v21_benchmark_release_pseudo.csv: one row per transaction (20 columns): pseudonymised transaction hash, block height, timestamp, snapshot identifier, fifteen leakage-controlled learning features and the binary label.- bitfraud_pseudonymized.db: SQLite graph data with the tables blocks, transactions, transaction inputs and transaction outputs, and a metadata table (3,279,327 distinct addresses).- snapshot_ranges.json: chronological definition of the six snapshots.- feature_definitions.csv: description of the features.- label_statistics.csv: transaction counts, label counts and class distribution per snapshot.- README.md: documentation and usage instructions. DesignSnapshots D1 to D3 are intended for training, D4 for validation and D5 and D6 for testing. Labels and features use no information posterior to the transactions they describe. Because the full transaction graph is provided, the history of any address (the earlier transactions in which it appears) can be recomputed, which allows the study of transactions whose addresses have no prior history. LabelsA transaction is positive when it involves an address reported on ChainAbuse. Labels come from community reports and are not verified ground truth. The release contains no report text, address, report date or category. PseudonymisationTransaction hashes, block hashes and addresses are replaced by keyed pseudonyms, identically in the table and in the database. The graph structure is preserved exactly. Block heights, timestamps and values are unchanged. The original identifiers can be shared with researchers on request. LicenseData: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0). Users should check the terms of the original label sources before any redistribution.

标题: What Does It Cost to Force-Close a Lightning Channel? Evidence from 974,000 Channel Closes, 2018-2026
摘要: Bitcoin's Lightning payment network returns the funds of a channel that cannot close cooperatively through pre-signed transactions whose fees and delays fall on its operators. That fee design is being replaced: Bitcoin Core 31.0 removed the mempool rule anchor channels relied on, and the Lightning specification adopted zero-fee commitments in May 2026. What the old design costs has never been measured across fee regimes. We trace every public channel close and every force close on-chain from January 2018 to October 2026, 973,581 closes, and follow each output to its spend. A separate chain index confirms all 698,476 public closes we could compare. Fee spikes did not bring a wave of force closes. Force closes in a spike week and the next were 0.97 times the four weeks before, against 1.02 after ordinary weeks of the same years. A force close costs 2-6 times a cooperative close in fees and locks the closer's balance for days, which outweighs the fees only in low-fee years. When fees are high, pending payments are exposed: in 2023, 18.2% of HTLC timeouts confirmed more than 40 blocks after expiry. Yet since 2021, forwarding nodes lost only 38 payments, each with the preimage already on-chain. Anchor outputs cut late timeouts in fee spikes (20.6% against 30.5%), yet owners rarely bump commitments with them, and miners take most of what third parties sweep. Zero-fee commitments would save only 12% of the anchor mechanism's block space; they should be judged by how promptly payments resolve when fees spike.

标题: In Search of the Optimal Law Governing Digital Payment Rights
摘要: In the article In Search of the Optimal Law Governing Digital Payment Rights, Marek Dubovec evaluates how modern commercial legal frameworks can be modernized to accommodate emerging digital trade paradigms, such as deep-tier supply chain finance. The author analyzes and contrasts traditional legal approaches to receivables and negotiable instruments against functional digital equivalence models—such as the UNCITRAL Model Law on Electronic Transferable Records (MLETR)—and new digital asset frameworks like UCC Article 12 and the UNIDROIT Principles on Digital Assets and Private Law. By applying six core legal elements—scope, transfer mechanisms, divisibility, transferee protections, enforcement, and conflict of laws—the Article assesses how different regimes handle novel instruments like irrevocable payment undertakings and digital trade tokens. Dubovec finds that framing digital payment rights as controllable digital assets offers superior efficiency, certainty, and protection compared to attempting to digitize archaic negotiable instruments law or relying solely on traditional receivables rules. Ultimately, the author recommends that states adopt a Product-focused Reform Strategy (PRS) to tailor legislative solutions directly to the specific legal and operational needs of targeted financing structures.

标题: Adversarial Procurement in Blockchains
作者: Maryam Bahrani; Michael Neuder; Seth Matthew Weinberg
摘要: An emerging blockchain protocol design pattern leverages the asymmetry between the computational effort in performing versus verifying tasks. For example, cryptographic validity proofs (e.g., SNARKS) require the prover to expend significant effort demonstrating the correctness of their claim, while the verifiers benefit from extremely easy validation. The operationalization of this paradigm requires efficiently soliciting the performance of expensive tasks in pseudonymous, adversarial environments. We formalize this as a mechanism design question, with a protocol balancing the economic cost of a liveness fault, where the work is not completed, with the payments required to incentivize specific behavior from candidate suppliers. We show that the loss of the optimal protocol scales logarithmically in the cost of a liveness fault, scaled up by the adversarial fraction of the network. Further, we find that the optimal equilibria have an intuitive structure, allowing us to provide concrete advice to practitioners. Specifically, in many regimes the optimum designates a single, random node as the primary worker and a committee as a fallback, which is reminiscent of leader-based consensus mechanisms. We also characterize the asymptotic regimes where having negative payments (i.e., slashing in blockchain parlance) is especially helpful.

标题: Ark: Offchain Transaction Batching in Bitcoin
作者: Pim Keer; Matteo Maffei; Marco Argentieri; Andrew Camilleri; Zeta Avarikioti
摘要: Bitcoin is the cryptocurrency with the largest market capitalisation, but its widespread adoption is fundamentally limited by the scalability constraints of its consensus algorithm, which requires every transaction to be confirmed onchain. To address this, several Layer-2 scalability solutions have been proposed to move payments offchain---most notably, the Lightning Network. However, their deployment remains hindered by cumbersome setup requirements: users must lock funds onchain to participate and engage in complex auxiliary protocols (e.g., for channel rebalancing, top-ups, and routing). Other solutions, like payment pools, sidechains and rollups, cannot be implemented in a non-custodial way on Bitcoin due to its limited scripting capabilities, or require all protocol participants to update the offchain state. In this work, we present Ark, the first Bitcoin-compatible commit-chain. Ark enables offchain transactions of virtual UTXOs (VTXOs), through an untrusted operator who aggregates them into succinct onchain commitments. A distinctive feature of Ark is its ease of deployment: users can receive offchain payments without locking any funds beforehand, and Ark state updates require only the participation of users involved in that update. We formally define the Ark protocol and prove its security. During this process, we identified two attacks affecting the testnet implementation, which we responsibly disclosed; the proposed fixes have been now integrated into the mainnet implementation. Our experimental evaluation demonstrates that Ark can commit onchain to batches of arbitrarily many VTXOs with a constant-sized footprint of approximately 200 vB. Cooperative exits add one output per user, while unilateral exits require O (log n) transactions of roughly 150 vB per VTXO for a batch of n VTXOs.

标题: Beyond the Prank: The Hidden Expertise of TSS Scambaiters
作者: Saleh Alsyefi; Anish Chand; Matthew Edwards; Phani Vadrevu
摘要: This research studies how Technical Support Scams (TSS) are being countered by a uniquely dedicated community of volunteer counter-fraud operatives. Using a careful subject selection strategy, we interviewed 17 individuals who actively engage in TSS scambaiting activities in order to obtain insight into their motivations, the operational methods of the scammers they combat, the undocumented nuances of effective scambaiting action, and the various challenges scambaiters face. In our analysis, we find a community rich not only with insight into offenders, but with technical and operational expertise that is often lacking in research efforts targeting these same populations. At the same time, we find key areas where the community could be better supported and enabled. We discuss the implications of our findings for both future research and community protection strategies.

标题: ZK-eSIM: A Privacy-Centric Zero-Knowledge Approach for eSIM Provisioning
作者: Liza Ahmad; Quan Shi; Joshua Haworth; Yilu Dong; Prosanta Gope; Behzad Abdolmaleki; Syed Rafiul Hussain
摘要: GSMA Remote SIM Provisioning (RSP) enables over-the-air delivery of eSIM profiles, but it exposes long-lived identifiers during profile ordering and download. In particular, stable device identifiers (e.g., EID), profile identifiers, and long-lived certificate material enable mobile operators and profile-delivery infrastructure to link provisioning events to the same eUICC and, when combined with account records, to the same subscriber. This undermines subscriber anonymity and enables cross-session tracking. We present ZK-eSIM, a privacy-preserving redesign that achieves subscriber anonymity and provisioning-session unlinkability while retaining accountable traceability by exception. ZK-eSIM (i) replaces direct disclosure of device identifiers with a zero-knowledge proof of device validity and eligibility; (ii) enforces session unlinkability through short-lived, one-time pseudonymous credentials and per-session identifiers to prevent cross-session tracking; and (iii) provides privacy-preserving accountable traceability through a jointly authorised escrow mechanism, so that no single entity can unilaterally deanonymise a user. We formalise a multi-entity, honest-but-curious threat model and prove subscriber anonymity and the unlinkability of provisioning sessions under standard cryptographic assumptions. We implement a Java Card applet on a test eUICC to evaluate performance on commodity hardware with a modified LPA and SM-DP+ server. Our experiments quantify end-to-end cryptographic overhead relative to conventional RSP, confirming that ZK-eSIM adds only practical overhead, closing a critical privacy gap while preserving deployability within existing GSMA roles and interfaces.

标题: On Identifying Sound Conditions for Frontrunning Resistance
作者: Sebastian Holler; Anna Piscitelli; Jannik Albrecht; Stephan Dübler; Ghassan Karame; Clara Schneidewind
摘要: Blockchains enable decentralized applications through smart contra­cts---interactive programs executed through consensus. However, the inherently asynchronous nature of blockchain transaction ordering introduces a class of vulnerabilities known as frontrunning attacks, which have caused millions of dollars in losses in major blockchains, such as Ethereum. Frontrunning attacks arise because users interact with smart contracts through transactions, which are added to the blockchain by designated nodes called miners. Miners can exploit their ability to reorder, delay, or insert transactions to gain an advantage over honest users, effectively frontrunning them. Yet, to date, the field lacks a rigorous definition of what it even means for a contract to resist such attacks. Worse, we show that existing dynamic detection approaches are fundamentally inadequate: in a large-scale study comprising 287 smart contract audits, 55% of the 393 reported vulnerabilities identified by leading smart contract auditors fall outside the scope of state-of-the-art detection criteria. To address this gap, we propose the first formal definition of frontrunning vulnerability for smart contracts. Our definition captures a key insight: resistance to frontrunning is not an intrinsic property of a contract alone, but depends critically on how honest users interact with it. Grounded in this observation, we develop a sound algorithm for synthesizing secure interaction conditions, alongside a prototype implementation that we apply to audited real-world contracts—revealing previously undiscovered vulnerabilities in two Ethereum contracts.

标题: The Position of Digital Assets as Objects of Joint Marital Property under Islamic Law and Indonesian Positive Law
作者: Nazif Alwi; Adelia Adha; Muhammad Fajri Ramadhani; Rizky Ramadhan
摘要: The growth of the digital economy has produced assets that are intangible, held on platforms, and accessed through credentials, yet the Marriage Law and the Compilation of Islamic Law (KHI) were drafted with conventional property in mind. This normative juridical study examines whether digital assets acquired during marriage can be objects of joint marital property under Islamic law and Indonesian positive law. Using statutory and conceptual approaches, it analyses Articles 35–37 of Law No. 1 of 1974, Articles 1(f) and 85–97 of the KHI, the Civil Code provisions on objects, the Electronic Information and Transactions Law, and crypto-asset regulation, alongside Qur’anic and prophetic evidence interpreted through qiyās, ʿurf, maṣlaḥah mursalah and sadd al-dharāʾiʿ. The study finds that both systems share a functional test, namely economic value, lawful acquisition during marriage, and control by either spouse, so that e-wallet balances, crypto assets, monetised accounts and digital intellectual works can qualify as joint property, while assets brought into the marriage, inherited or received as gifts remain separate. The main difficulties lie in proof, valuation, access and concealment rather than in legal status. The article proposes a differentiated classification, evidentiary and valuation guidelines, and marital agreements as preventive tools.

标题: Explainable AI for tail-risk forecasting in cryptocurrencies: evidence from green and energy-intensive assets for risk-aware investment decisions
作者: Yesser Drira; Abir Abderrazek; Mouna Boujelbene
摘要: Purpose This study aims to develop an explainable deep learning framework for forecasting tail risk and volatility in cryptocurrency markets, with a particular focus on differences between energy-intensive and ESG-oriented digital assets. It aims to assess how volatility dynamics and downside risk exposure vary across environmental profiles and market regimes and how these differences can inform risk-aware investment decisions. Design/methodology/approach The proposed framework uses a quantile long short-term memory model to estimate predictive quantiles and Conditional Value at Risk (CVaR), enabling the modeling of asymmetric, fat-tailed and regime-dependent risks. The analysis focuses on four cryptocurrencies – Bitcoin and Litecoin (energy-intensive) and Algorand and Chia (lower-energy alternatives). The model integrates SHapley Additive exPlanations-based explainability and a regime classification (calm vs stress). Robustness is assessed using 20-, 40- and 60-day rolling evaluation windows, while predictive performance is evaluated through coverage rates, hit ratios and Kupiec and Christoffersen back testing procedures. Findings The results reveal substantial heterogeneity across the four cryptocurrencies rather than a uniform green-versus-energy-intensive ranking. Chia records the lowest Q50 root mean squared error (0.00149) and mean absolute error (MAE) (0.00119), whereas Algorand has the lowest full-sample CVaR (0.0293) and Litecoin the highest (0.0411). Regime results are also asymmetric: Bitcoin’s Q10 violation rate rises from 8.74% in calm periods to 11.74% in stress periods, while Litecoin and Algorand record more Q10 violations in calm than in stress regimes. Chia combines the lowest global Q10 violation frequency (2.98%) with the highest mean CVaR violation loss (0.127419), showing that infrequent breaches can still be severe. These findings support asset-specific tail-risk monitoring and cautious use of energy-profile information in risk-aware investment decisions. Originality/value This study contributes to the literature by integrating quantile-based deep learning, explainable artificial intelligence, regime-specific diagnostics and sustainability considerations into a unified risk-forecasting framework. Its main value lies in complementing connectedness and spillover studies with interpretable, asset-level distributional forecasts and formal tail-risk backtesting. The results provide decision-support information for risk monitoring and portfolio analysis, but do not imply that lower-energy cryptocurrencies are universally safer or that the observed differences are causal.

标题: A Segmented Framework for Cryptocurrency Adoption
作者: Bentzion Edgardo Szrajber; Ilan Alon; Shalom Levy; Ze’ev Shtudiner
摘要: Existing research often treats cryptocurrency adoption as uniform, overlooking differences among assets and users. This article develops a typology linking adopter profiles to institutional orientation, financial capability, technological embeddedness, and asset affinity. The article develops a conceptual typology through taxonomy-development logic, anchored in behavioral-institutional orientation: how individuals engage with cryptocurrency as a financial and socio-technical alternative. The typology identifies three ideal types: long-term investors, linked to bitcoin as a portfolio asset; resilient crypto traders, linked to stablecoins for monetary protection and resilience; and crypto-natives, linked to Ethereum/DeFi for participation, autonomy, and experimentation. The article moves beyond monolithic technology-adoption models and deconstructs the “cryptocurrency user” as uniform. It shifts focus from trust in technology to trust in the financial status quo, highlighting institutional distrust and inflation as segment-specific drivers.

标题: Thunderbolt: Fast Asynchronous Off-Chain Bitcoin Transfers
作者: Hongbo Wen; Hanzhi Liu; Yanju Chen; Jingyu Ke; Dahlia Malkhi; Yu Feng
摘要: We present Thunderbolt , an off-chain protocol that transfers Bitcoin UTXO ownership with seconds-scale latency, requires no channel graph, routing, or liquidity rebalancing, and lets the recipient be offline during transfer. A single UTXO is locked once on-chain under a fixed public key shared by the current holder and a threshold committee; ownership then passes through an unbounded sequence of holders; each transfer is a purely off-chain, asynchronous operation at zero on-chain cost, and the chain sees exactly two transactions regardless of how many transfers occur. The core invariant is an algebraic cancellation: at each transfer the recipient's fresh secret is added to the holder's share and subtracted from the committee's share, so both shares rotate while the key stays fixed. To enforce this, the recipient publishes an invoice to a shared append-only ledger (the Thunderbolt Ledger): a public commitment and encrypted copies for himself and the committee, with a zero-knowledge proof that all three encode the same secret. The sender fetches and verifies the invoice, homomorphically folds her secret into the recipient's ciphertext, and publishes the resulting ownership credential under a second zero-knowledge proof. Both proofs use a single Sigma-protocol response to force the same witness across elliptic-curve and Paillier equations, requiring no trusted setup. The committee operates under a standard (t,n) -threshold honest-majority assumption, tolerating up to t −1 corrupt members, and subtracts the fresh secret from its share. Distinct fresh secrets and context identifiers let UTXOs transfer in parallel. On our benchmark machine, a complete off-chain transfer finishes in 1022 ms with 3.8 KB of proofs. General-purpose SNARK backends are far slower on these relations: a reduced-parameter instantiation already proves two orders of magnitude slower, and a faithful one at the deployed modulus exhausts consumer memory.

标题: A Blockchain-Empowered Framework for Educational Data Security Sharing: Integrating Privacy Protection, Traceability, and Accountability Mechanisms
作者: Xiaohui Wang; Cunyan Li; Tian Zhang; Rui Chen; Yangyang Mei
摘要: Abstract The secure sharing of educational data across institutional boundaries remains challenging due to the tension between data utility and privacy protection. While individual cryptographic primitives---ciphertext-policy attribute-based encryption (CP-ABE), zero-knowledge proofs (ZKP), digital watermarking, and oblivious transfer (OT)---have been extensively studied in isolation, their compositional security properties when integrated into a unified framework lack formal treatment. This paper proposes a blockchain-empowered framework for educational data security sharing with formal game-based compositional security analysis. We introduce two novel cross-module security binding protocols: (i) a ZKP-CPABE binding protocol that cryptographically couples authentication proofs with access control policies, preventing cross-module relay attacks, and (ii) a Watermark-OT-Accountability protocol that establishes an end-to-end verifiable chain from data access to forensic traceability. We develop a hierarchical key management architecture with formal indistinguishability proofs under the DBDH and DDH assumptions. A functional prototype on Hyperledger Fabric with hybrid evaluation methodology combining prototype measurements, simulation estimates, and theoretical derivations demonstrates that the binding protocols effectively eliminate attack vectors at module interfaces with only 2.2\% additional encryption overhead over standalone CP-ABE. A system-level ablation study quantifies the marginal contribution of each module to overall security, performance, and adoption willingness.

标题: Trading Crypto Hourly Prediction Markets Algorithmically: BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, and ZEC
摘要: I run an automated Kalshi prediction market trading system in my Mac lab. Its crypto hourly markets include BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, and ZEC, and the system also covers commodities and foreign exchange. As of November 11, 2026, it has won 90.2% of settled real bets since the October 11 restart, with net profit of +$250.93. There were 66 bets that lost half their stake or more. The biggest losses were a gold bet at a loss of $61.44 and a SOL bet at a loss of $39.26. These are system wide figures and do not establish a crypto only win rate or comparative performance among symbols. An hourly crypto prediction market is a contract about a defined event, and hourly does not mean immediately settled. A win rate leaves out amounts committed, earned, or lost. Several symbols do not establish independence. Automation makes operational questions more important, including the distinction between completed and attempted operations and the separation of development work from live write authority.

标题: Decentralized science (DeSci): How blockchain reconfigures the balance between security and openness in science
摘要: Science and innovation are increasingly shaped by security agendas, making their combination with openness more difficult. Decentralized Science (DeSci) is a recent initiative that explicitly experiments with reconciling security and openness in open innovations by using blockchain technologies. Yet DeSci adopts technologies developed by libertarian and crypto-market projects, which can create conflicts with scientific and organizational goals. How do these organizations address the combination of security and openness, and how do they align their goals with the prior norms embedded in the technologies they adopt? Combining institutional entrepreneurship with actor-network theory, the study analyzes public documents from 25 DeSci organizations and traces how actors legitimize novel formats by theorizing the links between problem framing, scientific norms, and inherited norms in blockchain design. The study identifies five configurations of DeSci organizations. Crypto-commonal and commonal open science types use blockchain to secure data and decision-making while focusing on community products, whereas the open science type treats blockchain mainly as infrastructure supporting transparent research processes. The crypto-libertarian type focuses on resistance to external control, while libertarian open science prioritizes the personal security of participants in sensitive research. DeSci organizations selectively align their goals with prior technological norms: they predominantly adopt Ethereum-style crypto-commonal scripts of cooperative, token-mediated coordination, while hybrid types re-script these norms by combining them with scientific goals. The study contributes to research on digital infrastructures of open innovation by showing that technologies do not merely facilitate knowledge exchange but also shape how openness, security, participation, ownership, and control can be combined.

标题: Decrypting Crypto: Supervision, Intelligence, and Recovery in the Virtual Assets Era. A Reference for Latin America and the Caribbean Financial Intelligence Units and Regulators
作者: Jose Angel Arias Alvarez; Guillermo Lagarda; Paulina Verastegui Lira; John Grajales; Nicolás Dassen; Marcela Duque; Kamal Anwar
摘要: The rapid expansion of cryptoassets and blockchain technologies is reshaping global financial systems, presenting both opportunities and significant risks for financial integrity. This publication, aimed at Financial Intelligence Units (FIUs) and regulatory authorities in Latin America and the Caribbean (LAC), provides a comprehensive technical, regulatory, and operational reference on virtual assets. It covers foundational blockchain technology, virtual asset categories, regional adoption trends, illicit finance typologies, beneficial ownership challenges, transaction reporting standards, and cryptoasset recovery frameworks. The document addresses the structural gap between fast-evolving technology and slower-adapting regulatory systems, compounded by institutional asymmetries across LAC jurisdictions. Drawing on FATF standards--particularly Immediate Outcomes 6, 7, and 8--and cross-country experiences, it debunks common myths about cryptocurrency anonymity and recovery complexity, while providing actionable guidance for investigations, seizures, and international cooperation. The publication advocates for risk-based, proportionate regulation grounded in technical understanding, public-private partnerships, and regional coordination, offering a roadmap to strengthen AML/CFT/CPF resilience across the region in the virtual assets era.

标题: MnemonicHack: Recovering the Master Seed from Bitcoin Hardware Wallets via Side-Channel Attacks
作者: Jiwoo Baek; Daehyeon Bae; Gyusang Kim; Gilsang Ahn; Insup Lee; S.-H. Park; Seokhie Hong; Hee Seok Kim
摘要: Hardware wallets isolate private keys from compromised hosts but, as user-held devices, must also resist physical attacks, including side-channel analysis. The mnemonic code is the root of a wallet's key hierarchy, and recovering it enables an attacker to reconstruct the wallet and all derived private keys. Yet prior studies have mainly evaluated cryptographic operations such as digital signatures, elliptic-curve scalar multiplication, and key derivation, leaving mnemonic-code processing unexplored as a side-channel attack surface. We show that BIP39's efficiency-oriented word-lookup guidance can produce implementations whose execution varies with the secret word and leaks information through side channels. We demonstrate this vulnerability on the Trezor One by applying deep learning-based side-channel analysis to electromagnetic leakage from its mnemonic integrity verification process. Across 20,000 traces collected from a device excluded from training and validation, our model recovered all 24 words using a single trace in 87.28% of trials and achieved an average word-recovery accuracy of 99.41%. The attack requires no modification of the target firmware and only temporary physical access. Following responsible disclosure, SatoshiLabs released firmware mitigations. Analysis of firmware from eight additional vendors identified similar data-dependent mnemonic-processing patterns beyond Trezor.

标题: Duty-Free Bits: Projectivizing Garbling Schemes
作者: Nakul Khambhati; Anwesh Bhattacharya; David Heath
摘要: Garbling schemes are powerful primitives that enable secure computation between a mutually untrusting garbler and evaluator. A projective garbling scheme is one that encodes the evaluator's input in a simple bit-by-bit manner. Projective schemes, such as the seminal scheme of Yao, are versatile, as they are naturally compatible with other simple tools, such as 1-out-of-2 oblivious transfer (OT). There exist garbling schemes that naturally operate over large finite fields, some of which require only efficient information-theoretic (IT) techniques. However, here the evaluator's input is encoded via an affine function over a large field, so these schemes are not naturally projective, reducing their versatility. We provide a transformation that efficiently projectivizes such schemes. Consider an arithmetic garbling scheme where the evaluator's input consists of elements from a large prime field. Our symmetric-key-based techniques give a mechanism to translate from Yao-style labels to IT-style labels at cost proportional to the input and output labels : crossing the border is duty-free! We apply our technique to two problems. First, recent works show that projective garbling schemes solve a problem central to trust-minimized bridges for the Bitcoin blockchain, where BABE (Garg et al., 2026) and Argo MAC (Eagen and Lai, 2026) each implicitly construct an efficient IT garbling scheme, then use naive bit-decomposition to achieve projectivity. We construct and implement drop-in replacements for both; we improve BABE's encoding size by 51×, and Argo MAC's by 23×. Second, our technique implies a non-interactive reduction from vector oblivious linear evaluations (VOLEs) over F p to 1-out-of-2 OTs. This is the state-of-the-art Minicrypt (plus base OTs) protocol for large field VOLE secure against a malicious receiver, and a length- S VOLE costs only O((λ + S )?g p) bits.

标题: International Cooperation in Relation to Financial Crimes in Nigeria: Assessment of Legal Frameworks, Mechanisms and Challenges
摘要: Financial crimes such as money laundering, corruption, terrorist financing, tax evasion and cyber-related fraud have increasingly assumed transnational dimensions, making it difficult for individual states to effectively combat them in isolation. As criminal networks operate across borders and exploit differences in legal systems, international cooperation has become an essential tool in the prevention, detection, investigation, and prosecution of financial crimes. This study examines the significance, mechanisms, and challenges of international cooperation in addressing financial crimes, particularly in developing jurisdictions. The study adopted a doctrinal research methodology, relying primarily on the analysis of statutes, international conventions, judicial decisions, policy documents, and scholarly literature relating to financial crime control and international cooperation. Relevant legal frameworks, treaties, and institutional mechanisms that facilitate cooperation among states were critically examined to evaluate their effectiveness. The study found out that international cooperation plays a vital role in combating financial crimes through mechanisms such as mutual legal assistance, extradition, information sharing, asset tracing, and recovery of proceeds of crime. However, the study identifies several challenges, including differences in domestic legal systems, sovereignty concerns, bureaucratic delays, inadequate political will, weak institutional capacity, and limited technological infrastructure in some developing countries. The research concluded that while international cooperation remains indispensable in the fight against financial crimes, its effectiveness depends largely on the commitment of states to implement international standards, strengthen domestic institutions, and harmonize legal frameworks.

标题: Prediction markets vs crypto perpetuals: a builder's comparison
摘要: I run an automated Kalshi prediction market trading system from my Mac lab in Honolulu. Its markets include hourly crypto contracts, commodities, and foreign exchange. A Bitcoin event contract and a Bitcoin perpetual can both respond to Bitcoin's price, but they are not interchangeable. This article compares ordinary, fully paid binary purchases with linear, margined crypto perpetuals as a software builder. The important differences appear in the payoff, the clock, the accounting, and the conditions under which a position can remain open. A conventional binary pays a fixed amount if its condition is satisfied. A linear perpetual follows the size and direction of the underlying price move, with continuing funding and margin obligations. Bounded loss on a fully paid binary still leaves a serious engineering problem, because several positions can lose together. My own settled record since the October 11, 2026 restart includes 1,236 real bets, a 90.2% win rate, net +$250.93, and large individual losses. Settlement and margin deserve separate accounting models.

标题: On the Communication Complexity of Sleepy Consensus
摘要: Sleepy consensus allows parties to join and leave execution arbitrarily, which is a fundamental requirement for large-scale distributed systems. Classic longest-chain protocols, such as Bitcoin and its variants, achieve consensus under this model but suffer from inherent long latency. In contrast, recent protocols that build upon the classic view-based BFT paradigm can achieve constant expected latency and short best-case latency under optimal resilience, but they often incur high communication cost. We observe that the high communication overhead stems from the time-shifted quorums, a technique that makes quorum certificates transferable under dynamic participation. The technique relies on extensive message forwarding to reconcile parties' inconsistent local views, and thus incurs a cubic communication cost unavoidably. In this work, we tackle the problem by proposing a novel way to transfer certificates. Building on this, we construct a Byzantine Agreement (BA) protocol secure against the state-of-the-art growing adversary model. Our BA protocol achieves optimal resilience, constant expected round complexity, and an expected communication complexity of O ( nNL + nN ? + nN log N ), where n is the maximum number of awake parties throughout the execution, N is the total number of eligible parties, L is the input length, and ? is the security parameter. We also present an efficient recovery mechanism for our BA, incurring only O ( N ? + nL ) bits per recovering party. Then we extend our BA to an Atomic Broadcast (ABC) protocol that achieves optimal resilience, constant expected latency, and an expected amortized communication complexity of O ( nNL + nN ? + nN log N ) per input value. The recovery mechanism for our ABC incurs ?? ( ?? ?? + ??ℓ?? + ??ℓ ?? ) bits per recovering party, where ℓ is the number of views that the party has slept for. Last but not least, we establish communication lower bounds of Ω( N 2 L ) for sleepy BA and ABC. The result shows that our BA and ABC are communication-optimal when L is sufficiently large (i.e., when L = Ω ( ? + log N )), and highlights a fundamental limitation of communication efficiency in the sleepy model.

标题: Universally Composable Adaptor Signatures
作者: Paul Gerhart; Daniel Rausch; Dominique Schröder
摘要: Adaptor signatures extend the functionality of digital signatures by enabling the computation of pre-signatures on messages relative to statements in NP relations. Pre-signatures are publicly verifiable objects that simultaneously hide and commit to a standard signature on the same message. Anyone possessing a valid witness for the statement can adapt the pre-signature into a full signature under the underlying signature scheme. Since adaptor signatures are commonly used as building blocks in larger systems, in particular blockchain protocols, it is natural to seek a security definition in the Universal Composability (UC) framework. Tairi et al. (CCS'23) recently took a first step in this direction by proposing a UC functionality for adaptor signatures. This paper investigates UC-secure adaptor signatures as a primitive, making both negative and positive contributions. On the negative side, we show that the functionality proposed by Tairi et al. suffers from critical limitations: •The functionality fails to guarantee extractability and adaptability , which are core security properties of adaptor signatures, to higher-level protocols.•No adaptor signature scheme can realize the functionality. On the positive side, we propose a new UC functionality that faithfully captures the latest security guarantees of adaptor signatures as formalized via game-based notions by Gerhart et al. (EUROCRYPT'24). •Our functionality guarantees extractability and pre-signature adaptability in a way that is composable and meaningful for higher-level protocols.•We show that it is realizable by an enhanced Schnorr-based adaptor signature scheme that we construct. Our construction maintains compatibility with existing infrastructure and is efficient enough for practical deployment, particularly in Bitcoin-like environments.

标题: Underutilisation of intelligent construction information management systems in construction organisations in Nigeria
作者: Ogbonna Orji; Victor Onyebuchi Ohamma; Gospel Okere
摘要: The purpose of this article was to assess the factors leading to the underutilisation of intelligent construction information management systems (ICIMS) in construction organisations in Nigeria. Since the public introduction of Industry 4.0 in 2011 and the advent of Construction 4.0 around 2014, information management systems in the construction industry across the globe transitioned from a web-based information management system to a real-time information management system. This transition has been gainfully deployed in developed countries but seems to be less adopted in developing countries like Nigeria; hence, the need to identify new country-specific determinants is crucial. To achieve this, the study implemented a quantitative survey methodology to gather data from 329 construction professionals from a population of 1,203 professionals in South East Nigeria. The SPSS software package was used to analyse the data, generate relevant measures of dispersion, and run inferential statistical tests. The study revealed that cost-related issues are top-ranked concerns among the determinants of ICIMS underutilisation in the region. In addition, low satisfaction with the current method of working, a dearth of staff with requisite skills, and high fees charged by service providers are other critical issues that stakeholders must address to improve ICIMS utilisation in construction organisations. The pertinent knowledge and mitigating strategies for these factors should principally address incompatibility, costs, document management, risks, low integration or isolated applications, information and communication technology (ICT) infrastructure, and client commitment. Therefore, a tailored solution can be developed to mitigate these challenges in micro, small, and medium construction firms in Nigeria.

标题: TSL-GFDN: temporally-aware soft structural learning for group-based fraud detection network
作者: Guangxiao Yuan; Guosheng Liu; Tao Zou; Zhigang Liu
摘要: The rapid expansion of the digital economy has fostered a complex fraud ecosystem in which group-based attacks, including Sockpuppet-based Targeted Attacks on Reviewing Systems (STARS), manifest as both dense interaction structures and coordinated temporal bursts. Graph neural networks for cohesive subgraph mining have advanced fraud detection, but existing methods often rely on static, discrete core decompositions, such as k- core and ( α , β )-core analyses. These hard structural operations are limited by an inability to model temporal coordination, which ignores the temporal synchronization of fraudulent behavior, and by loss of information near hard thresholds, which limits the model’s use of near-boundary structural signals. We propose T emporally Aware S oft Structural L earning for G roup-based F raud D etection N etwork (TSL-GFDN), a temporally aware extension of GFDN that integrates sliding-window temporal weighting into soft ( α , β )-core feature learning. TSL-GFDN maps temporally weighted degree margins to continuous soft membership scores and uses a temporal risk intensity autoencoder to support community discovery, edge classification, and vertex classification. On the real-world TianChi e-commerce dataset, where fraud exhibits clear spatiotemporal concentration, TSL-GFDN improves F1-score by 13.1% and precision by 25.4% relative to GFDN. On Bitcoin Alpha and Bitcoin OTC, the advantage is more limited because the hub-dominated topology and synthetic attack labels provide little within-density temporal variation. These results show both the value and the boundary of temporal structural learning for group-based fraud detection.

标题: Neon-HTLC: Collateral-Free HTLCs with Logarithmic Timeout
作者: Sebastian Faust; Noemi Glaeser; Marius Hagemann; Ziyan Qu
摘要: Hashed time-lock contracts (HTLCs) are fundamental building blocks for decentralized finance, enabling trustless cross-chain asset exchanges and off-chain payment networks. However, standard HTLCs are vulnerable to bribery attacks, where malicious actors incentivize miners to censor honest transactions. While recent works propose incentive-compatible HTLCs to mitigate these attacks, they suffer from a severe scalability bottleneck: to secure a given payment amount, they require either a linear collateral or superlinear timelock (both in the payment amount). We formalize this barrier by showing that the above tradeoff holds for a generalized class of HTLCs that we call ''two-phase''. Our analysis also identifies optimal parameter settings for two-phase HTLCs, improving on the previous state-of-the-art, He-HTLC (NDSS'23). We then present Neon-HTLC, a novel incentive-compatible HTLC protocol that eliminates the need for collateral while drastically reducing protocol timeout. Neon-HTLC overcomes prior limitations by leveraging a novel punishment mechanism that increases exponentially over time. Consequently, Neon-HTLC achieves a timeout that scales only logarithmically with the payment amount. This timeout is not only asymptotically but also concretely practical: even for the total amount of Bitcoin, the required timeout is a small constant (max 51 blocks, or ≈ 8.5 hours). Our evaluation demonstrates that Neon-HTLC outperforms the state-of-the-art He-HTLC by several orders of magnitude: for a $100,000 USD payment, Neon-HTLC safeguards the transfer in just 26 blocks with zero collateral, whereas He-HTLC requires a 496-block timeout and $5,000 USD collateral.

标题: BABE: Verifying Proofs on Bitcoin Made 1000x Cheaper
作者: Sanjam Garg; Dimitris Kolonelos; Mikhail Sergeevitch; Srivatsan Sridhar; David N. C. Tse
摘要: Endowing Bitcoin with the ability to verify succinct proofs has been a longstanding problem with important applications such as scaling Bitcoin and allowing the Bitcoin asset to be used in other blockchains trustlessly. It is a challenging problem due to the lack of expressiveness in the Bitcoin scripting language and the small Bitcoin block space. BitVM2 is the state-of-the-art verification protocol for Bitcoin used in several mainnets and testnets, but it suffers from very high on-chain Bitcoin transaction fees in the unhappy path (over 14,000 in a recent experiment). Recent research BitVM3 dramatically reduces this on-chain cost by using a garbled SNARK verifier circuit to shift most of the verification off-chain, but each garbled circuit is 42 GiBytes in size, so the off-chain storage and setup costs are huge. This paper introduces BABE, a new proof verification protocol on Bitcoin, which preserves BitVM3's savings of on-chain costs but reduces its off-chain storage and setup costs by three orders of magnitude. BABE uses a witness encryption scheme for linear pairing relations to verify Groth16 proofs. Since Groth16 verification involves non-linear pairings, this witness encryption scheme is augmented with a secure two-party computation protocol implemented using a very efficient garbled circuit for scalar multiplication of elliptic curve group elements. The design of this garbled circuit builds on the recent work Argo MAC, a garbling primitive that efficiently computes homomorphic MACs on such curves.

标题: BitVM3: Efficient Bitcoin Bridges via Garbled Circuits
作者: Robin Linus Woll; Ioannis Alexopoulos; Lukas Aumayr; Zeta Avarikioti; Matteo Maffei; David N. C. Tse
摘要: Bitcoin bridges, protocols that lock BTC on Bitcoin and represent it on a secondary system, underpin much of Bitcoin's application layer, yet remain poorly secured. Deployed bridges rely on federated custody with honest-majority assumptions, while BitVM2, the state of the art in trust-minimized bridging, incurs worst-case dispute costs of ~16,000, requiring large operator bonds and deposits that restrict participation to well-capitalized parties. We present B it VM3- bridge, a trust-minimized bridge from Bitcoin to (i) chains with finality certificates, such as Ethereum, and (ii) Bitcoin rollups. The bridge is powered by B it VM3- core, a modular abstraction for permissionless off-chain computation on Bitcoin using garbled circuits (GCs). A challenger evaluates a garbled circuit entirely off-chain and obtains a fraud-proof witness if and only if the operator's claim is incorrect. This reduces total on-chain costs to approximately 5, with the challenge transaction itself costing 0.20, a more than 3000× reduction that enables smaller bonds, broader operator participation, and smaller deposit sizes. We further formalize B it VM3- core as a sound and complete on-chain proof system under standard cryptographic assumptions. Where prior GC-based proposals give informal or construction-specific security arguments, our framework captures existing constructions within a uniform model based on axiomatized security and functional assumptions. Finally, we introduce an on-chain Bitcoin light client secure in the variable-difficulty setting, enabling permissionless chain introspection and thereby the rollup variant of B it VM3- bridge.

标题: Two AI proofs of critical percolation, checked against a statement written independently from the textbook
摘要: Version 1.2, 13 November 2026. Added: three follow-ups on the same development, each under rules sealed before the work. (1) θ is continuous on [0, 1] for every d ≥ 2, proved in Lean in the independent encoding, on top of Anthropic's library (a 340-line proof file; with it right-continuity, left-continuity above p_c and 'continuous ⇔ θ(p_c) = 0'): the three standard axioms, Comparator with the hand-written statement as the challenge on Lean's kernel and nanoda, a full replay from scratch, two planted false variants proved false and refused. The step from θ(p_c) = 0 to continuity is classical (van den Berg and Keane, 1984); the heavy ingredients are Anthropic's (uniqueness of the infinite cluster, the zero–one law, θ(p_c) = 0); the search for an earlier formal proof was partial, and no priority is claimed. (2) Kozma–Nitzan's Conjecture 3 as printed (arXiv:2401.12397v1) against Anthropic's Lean statement, which its README calls 'verbatim': a statement written from the paper alone is proved equivalent to it, in both directions and without using the conjecture, under the reading in which 'any graph' is any finite graph (also for countable graphs, A nonempty, A proper; the converse for one common p was not attempted). Anthropic's statement has no graph (weights on all pairs of Fin n). The one divergence published before, by A. Bou-Rabee (A = ∅ allowed), was found blind and is proved immaterial. (3) Kozma–Nitzan's Conjecture 1 as printed against A. Bou-Rabee's Lean proof (nitromannitol/percolation-after-anthropic at a5cc72bd): CERTIFIED as printed by the same method; 41 sealed definitions, written with no compiler, elaborated unchanged; eleven planted variants proved false and refused; the unprinted 'nonempty' of his statement proved immaterial. A restatement by the same author exists since 5 September 2026, so this is not a first check; the independence is by procedure only (his Lean was produced with Claude and ChatGPT; this statement, bridge and replay were made with Claude agents). 'As printed' means that the Lean sentence and the reading of the printed sentence recorded here are the same statement by proof, not that the paper's authors endorse either. Unchanged: the proofs are the labs' and the third party's; the informal papers and Kozma–Nitzan's reduction as printed are not checked. Version 1.1, 12 November 2026 (evening). Added: both labs' proofs, both bridges and the statement checked in ONE Lean (v4.32.0, Mathlib 81a5d257): OpenAI's ℤ³ proof ported to that version (22 of 34 files changed, almost all renamed library lemmas; its statement file byte-identical), a clean build, the three standard axioms, Comparator with the hand-written statement as the challenge on Lean's kernel and nanoda, Comparator of OpenAI's own theorem against its unchanged challenge file, a full replay from scratch, and eight planted false builds refused there. Also added: the statement's body proved false at d = 1 (Mathlib only, at both Lean versions), so the condition d ≥ 2 is needed. The first version's caveat that the two bridges ran on two Lean versions (a careful reading) is replaced by this check. The first run of the check failed its build on stray files from the checker's own archive; both runs are in the records. In August and September 2026, Anthropic (J. Leder with Claude) and OpenAI released Lean 4 proofs that Bernoulli bond percolation on Z^d has no infinite cluster at the critical probability, θ(p_c) = 0, a question open in dimensions 3 to 10. The proofs are theirs. Before reading either, I wrote the statement in Lean from Grimmett's Percolation (2nd ed., §1.3–1.4), with Mathlib only and encoded differently from both (edges as unordered pairs at ℓ¹ distance one, the product measure by Measure.infinitePi, p_c as Grimmett's supremum), and checked, with Claude, that both proofs prove it: Anthropic's for every d ≥ 2 and OpenAI's for d = 3, each by a Lean bridge (299 and 306 lines; the monotonicity of θ in OpenAI's case proved by us). Both bridges are accepted by Lean's kernel and by nanoda with the independent statement as the Comparator challenge, and leanchecker --fresh replays both environments; Anthropic's development replays as shipped; planted false statements, one of them proved false in Lean in the same environment, are refused by both bridges; θ(0) = 0 and θ(1) = 1 are proved in the independent encoding, so the statement is not vacuous. What stays open: in the single-Lean check OpenAI's proof is a port made here, not the proof as shipped (that one was checked on its own Lean version); neither lab's informal paper, nor Kozma–Nitzan's reduction as printed, is checked. Rules were sealed before each stage and results after, with a public registry and Bitcoin anchors. Files: the report (PDF) and the records, every file pinned by its hash.

标题: Self-Timestamping, Browser Co-Witnessing, and Revision Tracking of Intellectual Property Backed by Public Blockchains
摘要: Zero-Wallet, Privacy-Preserving Authorship & Prior-Art Declarations Using Self-Verifying Files, Native Browser Keys, and Bitcoin Merkle Calendars (OMVFS-CERT-V1) Creators constantly lose priority over inventions, designs, manuscripts, and research because traditional notarization is slow and expensive, while crypto wallets and PGP keys are too complex for ordinary humans. When a creator opens a freshly packaged draft to review it, their signature naturally records as Signature #1 (Self-Declaration), while embargoed preview readers act as independent witnesses before automated public crawlers take over. 标题: The Epistemological Delirium of the Risk Society 2.0: The Emergence of Hyperstitions as Regulatory Devices for Securing Interests Through Securitization
摘要: To better understand modes of reasoning as modes of communication in relation to risk controversies, an analytical approach can be developed on the basis of triadic model of rhetoric derived from Aristotle: logos, pathos , and ethos . This enables the hypothesis that controversies surrounding risks and uncertainties are more likely to emerge when logos, pathos and ethos are misaligned. The second hypothesis that can be developed on that basis is that we (at least most of us) are increasingly confronted with risk controversies that have given rise to the concept of the Risk Society (1.0), which represents a threshold at which securitization engenders more insecurity. The third hypothesis that follows is that the same factors that have engendered this Risk Society as insecurity through securitization have now accelerated into an apocalyptic condition, which can be characterized as an “epistemological delirium” (the Risk Society 2.0). In such a condition, assertions that are not anchored in experienced reality become real through a digital-technologically amplified real abstraction in the form of hyperstitions. As hyperstitions do not require the ideological inclusion of large sections of the public, it is no longer necessary to attune truth claims to actual experiences. This means that it becomes increasingly difficult to differentiate between science, politics and experience, which may have devastating consequences for the planet.

标题: Bitcoin hourly strikes: thinking about volatility for binary contracts
摘要: I run an automated Kalshi system that includes Bitcoin hourly markets alongside other crypto, commodity, and foreign exchange markets. A view about Bitcoin's direction is incomplete without the contract's threshold and deadline. An hourly binary asks whether a specified settlement value satisfies a condition, and it does not pay proportionally to how far Bitcoin travels. Volatility describes dispersion in possible price changes. It is not a promise that a threshold will be crossed, and it is not the probability of a winning contract. This article writes down the event before discussing volatility, including the role of a benchmark settlement reference. Distance should be compared with remaining uncertainty. In a simplified teaching model, more volatility can help either side of the threshold. A short clock does not remove uncertainty, and settlement averaging is not the same as an instantaneous endpoint. A proposed probability should be evaluated as a probability, including calibration, and then placed beside the purchase cost and applicable fees.

标题: Blockchain Protocols across Heterogeneous Cryptocurrencies
摘要: Use cases for blockchain-based cryptocurrencies have evolved beyond simple transfers into complex financial applications. Existing cryptocurrencies, originally designed for different use cases, natively provide different functionality: Ethereum provides an expressive programming language to implement smart contracts, while Bitcoin provides a more restricted scripting language, and other cryptocurrencies, like Monero or Zerocash, provide little or no support for smart contracts or scripting language at all. This leads to a major interoperability challenge: the same application requires multiple implementations and the consequent security analysis, each tailored to a different cryptocurrency. For instance, an application implemented as a smart contract on Ethereum cannot be deployed on Bitcoin, Monero or Zcash, and vice versa. Unfortunately, this increases the required efforts in design, development and security analysis of financial applications. Instead, the approach we pursue in this dissertation is to conceptualize the least common functionality in existing cryptocurrencies, e.g., the payment authorization, as a cryptographic primitive and leverage it as a building block in a multi-party cryptographic protocol (called blockchain protocol) that outputs one (or more) payment authorizations as required by the logic of the application. This approach allows for implementing applications in a blockchain-agnostic manner by relying on payment authorization as the least building block common to all cryptocurrencies. Yet, this approach raises new interesting research challenges: First, how can we design new cryptographic primitives that can be leveraged in the design of chain-agnostic blockchain protocols? Second, how can we streamline the security analysis of the resulting complex blockchain protocols? The thesis aims to approach these research questions using methods from cryptography and formal verification.
