标题: Stablecoins in Africa: benefits, risks, policy challenges and regulatory options
作者: Peterson K Ozili; Olubukola Akinniyi Akinwunmi; Jonathan Yisa
摘要: This article explores stablecoin regulation in Africa. It explores the benefits and risks of stablecoins and the regulatory options available to regulatory authorities. The article argues that the emergence of stablecoins, their rapid adoption in African countries, and the implications for the stability of the financial system are attracting the attention of policymakers in the region. Stablecoins offer benefits similar to fiat currencies due to their values tied to a reference asset, which may be a fiat currency or commodity. However, they pose specific risks which regulators are concerned about, leading to the need to regulate stablecoins. Discussions about regulating stablecoin are on-going in some African countries, and there is presently no regional regulatory framework for stablecoins. As policymakers in African countries continue to grapple with the increase in stablecoin usage and its threat to monetary sovereignty, this discussion paper is useful in providing some guidance on how African policymakers can manage or regulate the influx of stablecoins in the African continent.

标题: Master White Paper: The Conzetian Sovereign Architecture & The Autonomous Machine-To-Machine (A2A) Economy With Proof Pics
摘要: This white paper establishes the theoretical foundation, mathematical models, and operational architecture of the Conzetian Sovereign Architecture (CSA) and its financial execution vector, the Infinite Autonomous Value Engine (\Omega-IAVE). Traditional artificial intelligence development is bottlenecked by human-centric software-as-a-service (SaaS) subscription models, administrative drag, and centralized cloud dependencies. This research proves that the terminal evolution of AI infrastructure is Machine-to-Machine (A2A), where autonomous agent swarms trade data, compute, and cryptographic truth without human intermediation. By fusing mobile-native edge execution (Termux/SQLite WAL mode), zero-latency Tor v3 onion routing, Base Layer-2 x402 micropayment tollbooths, Bitcoin OpenTimestamps (.ots) state anchoring, and Arweave AO permaweb permanence, this architecture achieves absolute operational sovereignty (f = 0.0) and an exponential compounding velocity governed by golden ratio scaling (\phi = 1.61803398875).

标题: Toward a Coherent International Framework for Traditional and Crypto Securities
摘要: This Article explores the extent to which the international legal frameworks for traditional finance (“tradfi”), securities and crypto securities can be aligned. We demonstrate that this is feasible in many instances, such as in the context of investor protection, corporate actions processing, attachment, enforcement of rights, and insolvency. This ties in with the regulatory paradigm of “same activities, same risk, same regulation/regulatory outcomes.” In some scenarios, however, differences in the underlying technology need to be taken into account, for example in respect of the finality of transactions. Convergence of the legal landscape for tradfi and crypto securities would reduce complexity and cost and thus enable the securities markets to operate more smoothly.

标题: In the Beginning Was the File: Principles of OMVFS and Its Structural Impact on Cloud & Internet Technologies
摘要: Unifying Web Delivery, Integrity, Access Control, Provenance, and Observability Through a Kernel-Free, Centerless Virtual File Graph Modern cloud applications spend enormous money and engineering effort shredding naturally file-shaped information (catalogs, configurations, websites, releases, audit trails) into databases, reassembling it through always-on API servers, patching URLs at the CDN edge, and scraping gigabytes of text logs. OMVFS returns to a foundational computing truth — "In the beginning was the file" — upgrading plain cloud files with built-in cryptographic integrity, declarative routing tables, centerless graph navigation, and per-node summaries so entire web platforms run directly from commodity object storage and stateless edges at near-zero idle cost. Self-Verifying Files Over Commodity Storage (OMVFS01): Every artifact carries its own integrity envelope and visibility markers, eliminating silent cache corruption and decoupling trust from transport headers. Sub-Millisecond Default-Deny Edge Isolation: A single lightweight CDN edge gate blocks private, secret, and access-control descriptors in under 0.2 ms before origin storage is ever touched, while declarative root tables replace brittle custom edge-routing code. Kernel-Free Centerless Graph: Unlike classical OS filesystems anchored to one machine's root inode, OMVFS nodes store zero parent pointers on disk — allowing any node to be mounted into arbitrarily many contexts with zero data duplication and transient navigation breadcrumbs. Expanded <-> Collapsed Isomorphism & 2D Presentation Lenses: Small sites ship as a single compressed container (1 HTTP request) while large ecosystems span distributed subtrees with zero client code changes, separating pure semantic data from presentation overlays. Verifiable Live Today: OMVFS is not a theoretical proposal — live Omtrek production domains already serve OMVFS01 envelopes, OMVFS-SITE-1 discovery descriptors, and sub-millisecond edge isolation verifiable with standard HTTP tools. 标题: Co-Movement and Market Integration of Bitcoin and Ethereum: An Empirical Correlation Analysis
作者: S Sai Prerana; Eguri Helen Senorita; Kalyani Gorti
摘要: The rising relevance of cryptocurrencies as investments has drawn attention to the analysis of how the values of such investments correlate with each other. In particular, this research paper studies BTC/ETH co-movement and evaluates the strength of the relationship between Bitcoin and Ethereum as well as the consequences for portfolio diversification. To investigate co-movement, daily prices of BTC and ETH are collected from Yahoo Finance for the period from January 2018 to December 2024. This dataset is made up of 2,557 observations for each cryptocurrency. Descriptive statistics, graph analysis and Pearson correlation analysis are used to study BTC and ETH prices. The results have shown that there is a very strong positive co-movement between BTC and ETH (Pearson coefficient = 0.9036 (CI 95%: 0.8962 - 0.9104; *p* < .001)). The positively skewed distributions of Bitcoin and Ethereum were observed. Besides, Bitcoin had larger dispersion and higher kurtosis than Ethereum. Normalised prices showed the general similarity of the two cryptocurrencies' price behavior with the exception that the 2021 rally was more successful for Ethereum and the 2024 growth was more significant for Bitcoin. Nevertheless, because the study uses price levels as the basis for the test, it becomes necessary to conduct further tests using correlation measures based on returns in order to measure their market integration.

标题: On the Pitfalls of Modeling Individual Knowledge
作者: Wojciech Ciszewski; Stefan Dziembowski; Tomasz Lizurej; Marcin Mielniczuk
摘要: The concept of knowledge has been central in cryptography, especially within cryptographic proof systems. Traditionally, research in this area considers an abstract prover defending a claim that it knows a message M. Recently, a stronger concept—termed ''individual'' (Dziembowski et al.,~CRYPTO'23) or ''complete'' (Kelkar et al.,~CCS'24) knowledge—has emerged. This notion ensures the prover physically stores M on a machine that it controls. As we argue in the paper, this concept also appears in earlier work on ''nonoutsourceable puzzles'' (Miller et al.,~CCS'15), which implicitly assumes that quickly performing complex computation on a string M implies storing it on a single machine. In this line of work, the authors typically rely on algorithms whose computation requires a massive number of queries to a hash function H. In this paper, we highlight a subtle issue in the modeling used in some of these papers: specifically, the assumption that H can be modeled as an atomic random oracle on long messages. Unfortunately, this does not correspond well to how hash functions are constructed in practice. For example, the real-world hash functions (e.g., Merkle-Damgård or sponge-based) allow partial evaluation on long inputs, violating this assumption. Another example is the hashing used in Bitcoin mining, which permits similar precomputation. This undermines some protocols relying on individual knowledge. We demonstrate practical attacks against Miller et al.'s and Kelkar et al.'s schemes based on this observation, and discuss secure alternatives. Our alternative constructions avoid reliance on the random oracle behavior of hash functions on long messages and provide security in the individual cryptography model of Dziembowski et al. (CRYPTO'23).

标题: FROM PROCESS TO REMEDY: RETHINKING CORPORATE ACCOUNTABILITY ARCHITECTURE FOR VIRTUAL ASSET INTERMEDIARIES IN ASIA'S LEADING FINANCIAL JURISDICTIONS
作者: Giang Thi Le; Hiep Ngoc Tran; Long Thi Nguyen
摘要: This article examines the corporate accountability architecture governing virtual asset intermediaries in Japan, Singapore, Hong Kong and South Korea. Drawing on gatekeeper theory and process-based regulation, it organises the governance duties imposed on intermediaries into three analytical tiers including prevention, detection and remedy, and evaluates the extent to which the resulting frameworks provide a complete accountability structure. The comparative analysis identifies a consistent pattern across all four jurisdictions: prevention duties are relatively developed and convergent, detection duties are more uneven and remedy mechanisms remain structurally weak. The article argues that this imbalance is not merely an implementation failure but a consequence of process-based governance itself, which focuses on regulating intermediary conduct rather than guaranteeing investor recovery. It identifies three categories of harm that existing frameworks inadequately address such as investor loss arising despite formal compliance, harm caused by actors outside the regulatory perimeter and systemic contagion without a clearly identifiable responsible actor. To address these gaps, the article proposes three recommendations including a statutory private right of action, intermediary liability mechanisms targeting regulated actors connected to unlicensed platforms and a mandatory compensation fund for cases in which no effective recovery pathway exists.

标题: Persistent structural regimes in Bitcoin transactions relate to market cycles
作者: Bruno Araujo dos Santos; Gabriele Di Antonio; Marco Alberto Javarone
摘要: Bitcoin's blockchain is a public record of every on-chain transaction, while the price of bitcoin is set by trading on external markets. We ask whether on-chain activity alone reveals regimes associated with market trends, and whether this association remains stable over time. We summarise each week of blockchain activity from 2012 to 2026 using four measures of transaction structure and fit a two-state hidden semi-Markov model without price data. The sole market-informed constraint is an asymmetry in regime persistence, motivated by the observation that Bitcoin's price increases tend to outlast its declines. During earlier market cycles, the inferred regimes exhibit distinct transaction structures and align with periods of rising and falling prices more closely than random sequences with the same regime-duration distributions. The ongoing downturn, however, breaks this correspondence: the blockchain remains in the longer-lived regime, while its transaction structure resembles neither previous downturns nor previous upturns. Our findings support a relationship between on-chain activity and market dynamics, while highlighting its potentially time-dependent nature.

标题: Algorithmic Foundations of Digital Currency Systems:A Critical Survey of Central Bank Digital Currencies and Cryptocurrencies
作者: Shaima Abdulrahman Mohsen; Mohammed Fadhl Abdullah
摘要: Digital currencies represent a fundamental structural shift in the modern financial system, raising critical questions regarding monetary sovereignty, algorithmic trust, and user privacy. Although existing literature frequently addresses the challenges of stability, governance, scalability, and adoption surrounding cryptocurrencies and Central Bank Digital Currencies (CBDCs), these dimensions are largely examined in isolation. This critical review adopts an information technology perspective to evaluate whether current scholarship provides a unified, practical taxonomy of digital currency architectures. Drawing on a structured critical review of 30 purposively selected peer-reviewed studies and institutional reports, the study evaluates cryptographic foundations, validation schemes, ledger structures, privacy frameworks, and performance attributes, the study evaluates cryptographic underpinnings, validation schemes, ledger structures, privacy frameworks, and performance attributes. The findings reveal a prominent research gap: no current framework simultaneously reconciles sovereignty, privacy, security, and scalability. This limitation underscores the emergence of hybrid algorithmic designs as an essential architectural direction for future digital currency systems.

标题: Privacy-Preserving Range Counting over Local Graph Statistics
作者: Gengda Zhao; Yizhang He; Dong Wen; Kai Wang; Ruijia Wu; Jianwei Wang
摘要: Range counting over vertex statistics supports contact analysis, community profiling, and reputation screening. However, releasing exact range counts can disclose sensitive edges to an adversary with background knowledge. We study this problem under edge local differential privacy (edge LDP), where each vertex randomizes its report before sending it to an untrusted curator. We develop a layered framework that connects statistic estimation, direct range estimation, and adaptive estimator selection. Statistic-estimation methods provide complementary scalar estimators with explicit loss analyses, while indicator-estimation methods privatize range indicators directly. We next propose Bounded Conditional Range Inversion (BCRI), which derives unbiased range estimates from reusable bounded geometric reports through an explicit local inverse. Its boundary-conditioned estimator achieves no larger expected L2 loss than the unbounded inverse, and histogram preprocessing supports constant-time queries. The same reports also provide a nonnegative, unbiased variance estimate for every answer. At the center of the framework, Adaptive Estimator Selection (AES) privately predicts bias, variance, and covariance to combine BCRI with a conditional estimator from the same transcript. Experiments on diverse real-world graph tasks demonstrate the accuracy, efficiency, and workload scalability of the proposed framework.

标题: Are Cryptocurrencies Compatible with Environmental, Social and Governance Investing? A Multi-country Wavelet Analysis of Bitcoin, Ethereum and Sustainability-oriented Equity Markets
作者: Vansh Bathla; Karam Pal Narwal; Kajal Batra; Gurvinder Singh; Younis Ahmed Ghulam
摘要: This study examines whether Bitcoin (BTC) and Ethereum (ETH) are compatible with environmental, social and governance (ESG)-oriented investing across six market-specific ESG equity markets: The United States, China, Japan, Hong Kong, India and France. Using 784 daily observations from April 2021 to March 2025, the study applies cross-wavelet transform, wavelet coherence, partial wavelet coherence and wavelet correlation, with pairwise Time-Varying Parameter Vector Autoregression (TVP-VAR) connectedness as a robustness check. The findings show that crypto-ESG compatibility is conditional rather than uniform. ETH exhibits stronger and more persistent ESG–market dependence than BTC, particularly in the post-Merge period, whereas BTC–ESG relationships are generally weaker and more episodic. Dependence also varies across investment horizons, periods of market stress, and ESG markets, with comparatively stronger associations in the United States, France and India. Robustness tests further support the greater persistence of ETH–ESG relationships. Overall, crypto-ESG compatibility is dynamic, asset-specific, horizon-dependent and market-conditioned rather than a fixed sustainability attribute, implying that investors and policymakers should assess cryptocurrency exposure according to the asset, investment horizon, market conditions and ESG–market environment.

标题: Rancang Bangun Sistem Audit Jejak Rekam Transaksi Terdistribusi Menggunakan Smart Contract Hyperledger BESU dan IPFS
作者: Dhea Shintia Putri, Ira Fatmala, Nabila Oktora, Arzella Meilantika, Elok Dwi Yuliana, Siti Eliza; Ira Fatmala; Nabila Oktora; Arzella Meilantika; Elok Dwi Yuliana; Siti Eliza
摘要: Integritas catatan jejak audit (audit trail) pada infrastruktur enterprise dan institusi publik kerap kali terancam oleh manipulasi pengguna berhak akses istimewa (privilege abuse) pada basis data terpusat. Untuk mengatasi kerentanan titik tunggal kegagalan (single point of failure) dan penyangkalan transaksi, penelitian ini merancang dan mengimplementasikan sistem audit jejak rekam transaksi terdistribusi yang mengintegrasikan permissioned blockchain Hyperledger Besu konsensus QBFT dengan klaster off-chain InterPlanetary File System (IPFS). Sistem mengamankan jejak audit melalui penjangkaran hash kriptografis SHA-256 dan Content Identifier (CID) IPFS pada kontrak pintar Solidity AuditRegistry.sol, sementara berkas muatan log mentah terenkripsi disimpan secara terdesentralisasi off-chain guna mencegah pembengkakan buku besar (ledger bloat). Mengadopsi kerangka kerja Design Science Research Methodology (DSRM) pada klaster virtualisasi Proxmox VE, evaluasi empiris menunjukkan sistem mampu mencapai throughput puncak 345,2 transaksi per detik (TPS), latensi konsensus rata-rata 1,42 detik, konsumsi gas yang efisien sebesar 48.650 gas per pencatatan audit, serta ketahanan mutlak terhadap injeksi manipulasi data oleh administrator lokal. Arsitektur ini membuktikan bahwa integrasi blockchain konsorsium dan IPFS mampu menjamin integritas forensik bukti digital yang nir-penyangkalan tanpa menimbulkan beban biaya transaksi moneter operasional.

标题: Causal Adaptive Meta-Path Gating for Dynamic Heterogeneous Graph-Based Financial Fraud Detection
作者: Seojun Rivera; Serena Edwards; Liam Park
摘要: Collusive financial fraud often appears through heterogeneous relational paths whose explanatory value changes over time. Building on the metapath-guided temporal modeling of Audit-HCL, we propose CAMP-Gate, a lightweight context-adaptive framework that uses only information available at the end of each period: it constructs three causal meta-path views with retained-history and drift descriptors, cross-fits path-specific classifiers by account, and fuses their probabilities with a small multilayer perceptron gate conditioned on account-time context. In a heterogeneous-transaction environment with planted collusion rings and a held-out future split, CAMP-Gate obtains ROC-AUC 0.898, F1 0.580 and Recall@10% 0.597, improving on the best static single-path expert (ROC-AUC 0.887, Recall@10% 0.578) and on uniform temporal fusion at the 10% review budget (0.519), while uniform fusion attains the highest AP. Ablations identify retained path history as the main temporal driver, and the framework offers an interpretable, low-cost basis for budget-constrained alert prioritization.

标题: Legal aspects of tax evasion in the digital economy with a focus on crpytocurrencies - challenges and measures of tax authorities
摘要: Magistrsko delo obravnava pravne vidike davčnih utaj v digitalni ekonomiji s poudarkom na kriptovalutah oziroma širše kriptosredstvih. Izhodišče raziskave je, da kriptosredstva niso zgolj novo naložbeno sredstvo, temveč tudi poseben izziv za davčne organe, ker lahko vrednost nastaja, kroži in se hrani zunaj klasičnega finančnega posredništva. Naloga zato ne obravnava samo vprašanja, ali je določen dohodek obdavčljiv, temveč predvsem vprašanje, kako ga davčni organ zazna, pravno kvalificira, poveže s konkretnim davčnim zavezancem in dokaže v davčnem oziroma kazenskem postopku. Teoretični del naloge opredeljuje digitalno ekonomijo, kriptosredstva, blockchain, zasebno hrambo in osnovne vrste kripto transakcij. V nadaljevanju je analizirana slovenska davčna ureditev, vključno z razlikovanjem med zasebnim trgovanjem fizičnih oseb, dejavnostjo, pravnimi osebami, rudarjenjem, stakingom, plačili v kriptosredstvih in DDV vidikom. Poseben del je namenjen predlogu Zakona o davku od dobička iz odsvojitve kriptosredstev, ki ni postal veljavno pravo, vendar kaže na zakonodajno zaznano potrebo po sistemski ureditvi področja. V primerjalnopravnem delu so obravnavani švicarski, nemški in avstrijski model. Švica je prikazana kot primer ugodne obravnave zasebnih kapitalskih dobičkov, Nemčija kot primer časovno pogojene obravnave zasebnih odsvojitvenih poslov, Avstrija pa kot primer sistemske kapitalske obdavčitve kriptosredstev. Evropski in mednarodni del naloge obravnava DAC8, OECD CARF, MiCA, Travel Rule in FATF standarde. Empirični del temelji na anonimni anketni raziskavi med uporabniki oziroma poznavalci kriptosredstev (N=70). Rezultati kažejo, da so za prostovoljno davčno skladnost najpomembnejši razumna davčna obremenitev, enostaven postopek prijave in jasna pravila, medtem ko anketiranci strožje kazni ocenjujejo kot manj pomemben dejavnik. Posebej kritični so tudi do učinkov večje regulacije po MiCA, saj skoraj polovica ne vidi posebnih prednosti teh pravil, večina pa meni, da lahko strožja regulacija del uporabnikov premakne na manj regulirane ali decentralizirane platforme.

标题: La Tecnología Blockchain en la Trazabilidad Minera en Colombia, Análisis Comparativo con Mintrace y Propuesta de un Modelo Híbrido
摘要: El propósito del escrito es realizar un análisis riguroso que comprenda la viabilidad técnica y jurídica del Blockchain como mecanismo de mejora para la trazabilidad minera. Se analiza bajo qué condiciones técnicas y jurídicas resulta viable la integración de esta tecnología, y se propone un modelo a nivel de prototipo conceptual de un sistema híbrido entre la tecnología Blockchain y el nuevo Operador Tecnológico de Trazabilidad de Minerales (OTTM) MinTrace; resaltando que en otros países ya se ha implementado este sistema híbrido (se enfatiza en el capítulo III). A su vez, se analiza la problemática que ha contraído el sector minero en referencia a la extracción y comercialización de minerales de manera ilícita e ilegal, identificando factores políticos, sociales, económicos y normativos, que permiten observar cómo la falta de registro y control de minerales agrava esta problemática estructural en el país. Una breve contextualización, en la actualidad (2026) la Agencia Nacional de Minería (ANM) implemento la plataforma MinTrace, primer OTTM habilitado, que al completar con éxito el proceso de selección y contratación, quedo en firme su vinculación a partir del 17 de diciembre de 2025, mediante la Resolución 759/2024 expedida por la ANM, donde se buscaba construir un sistema de verificación y registro en tiempo real para la autorización y comercialización de minerales, destacando un rol definido a las OTTM, como esas herramientas tecnológicas que actúan como un apoyo para validar y transmitir datos de transacciones hacia la Plataforma de Trazabilidad de Minerales (PTM), por lo que es ideal analizar si la fusión entre MinTrace y Blockchain no llega a vulnerar el habeas data, al momento de filtrar los datos provenientes de MinTrace en dirección al Blockchain.

标题: Cryptocurrency Regulation and Taxation: A Comparative Analysis Among Slovenia, the United States, and Estonia
摘要: Magistrsko delo obravnava primerjalno analizo davčne obravnave kriptosredstev v Sloveniji, Estoniji in Združenih državah Amerike ter ocenjuje vpliv uvedbe evropske uredbe MiCA na to področje. Raziskava temelji na analizi zakonodaje, strokovne literature in praktičnih primerov obdavčitve fizičnih in pravnih oseb. Rezultati kažejo, da se davčni sistemi med državami bistveno razlikujejo glede pravne jasnosti, davčnih stopenj in možnosti optimizacije. Slovenija trenutno omogoča ugodno, vendar pravno manj določeno obravnavo, Estonija izstopa po preglednosti, ZDA pa po fleksibilnosti in možnostih davčnega načrtovanja. Posebej pomembne razlike se pojavijo pri pravnih osebah, saj estonski model omogoča odloženo obdavčitev. Uvedba MiCA naj bi prispevala k večji pravni varnosti in enotni ureditvi v EU, hkrati pa lahko poveča davčno obremenitev. Delo poudarja pomen davčnega okolja pri investicijskih odločitvah.

标题: China's Local Government Debt, Strategic Competition, and Bitcoin Demand: A Conditional Transmission Framework
摘要: How might the resolution of China's local-government debt affect strategic competition and Bitcoin demand? This paper develops a conditional framework connecting debt accounting, bank balance-sheet adjustment, public spending priorities, and constrained portfolio substitution. A debt swap can increase recognized government debt without increasing consolidated principal, while its effect on credit capacity depends on capital relief, loss recognition, and recapitalization. A protected strategic-spending floor can preserve current effort while shifting adjustment toward civilian productive services. In the asset block, stronger relative preference for Bitcoin does not ensure greater effective demand: access constraints and global funding conditions can reverse the sign. We derive a finite-shock threshold and deterministic sign bounds, and distinguish Bitcoin demand from demand for dollar stablecoins. Reproducible numerical illustrations and channel-removal exercises show that opposite outcomes are compatible with the same assumed fiscal stress. The analysis uses dated primary sources to establish institutional context, but estimates neither a debt-to-Bitcoin causal coefficient nor a price-impact scale. Its contribution is a compact set of conditions and measurement distinctions for evaluating transmission claims, rather than an unconditional price forecast or an inference about conflict probabilities.

标题: Blockchain technology and decentralized finance as an opportunity or threat for banking
摘要: POVZETEKMagistrsko delo obravnava vpliv tehnologije veriženja blokov in decentraliziranih financ na tradicionalni bančni sektor.Namen naloge je analizirati, ali decentralizirane finance predstavljajo predvsem priložnost za inovacije in izboljšanje učinkovitosti bančnega poslovanja ali pa pomenijo grožnjo obstoječim poslovnim modelom ter vlogi bank v finančnem sistemu.V teoretičnem delu so predstavljene temeljne značilnosti tehnologije veriženja blokov, vključno z njenim razvojem, ključnimi prednostmi in omejitvami, mehanizmi soglasja ter vlogo pametnih pogodb in decentraliziranih aplikacij.Poseben poudarek je namenjen konceptu decentraliziranih financ (angl.Decentralized Finance, v nadaljevanju DeFi), njihovim glavnim oblikam, delovanju DeFi ekosistema ter razlikam v primerjavi s tradicionalnimi finančnimi sistemi.V analitičnem delu so obravnavani izbrani DeFi projekti in primeri uporabe, s katerimi se ponazori njihovo delovanje v praksi ter potencialni vpliv na bančni sektor.Analiza literature kaže, da DeFi prinašajo pomembne priložnosti za povečanje učinkovitosti, transparentnosti in dostopnosti finančnih storitev ter spodbujajo razvoj inovativnih poslovnih modelov, hkrati pa predstavljajo tudi številna tveganja, povezana z varnostjo pametnih pogodb, volatilnostjo kriptoimetij, pomanjkanjem jasnega regulativnega okvira in omejeno zaščito uporabnikov.Ugotovitve magistrskega dela nakazujejo, da DeFi v trenutni obliki ne nadomeščajo tradicionalnega bančništva, temveč ga dopolnjujejo, pri čemer se kot ena izmed možnih smeri razvoja kaže postopno približevanje in sodelovanje med tradicionalnimi finančnimi institucijami in DeFi rešitvami.

标题: Bitcoin hourly strikes: thinking about volatility for binary contracts
摘要: I run an automated Kalshi system that includes Bitcoin hourly markets alongside other crypto, commodity, and foreign exchange markets. A view about Bitcoin's direction is incomplete without the contract's threshold and deadline. An hourly binary asks whether a specified settlement value satisfies a condition, and it does not pay proportionally to how far Bitcoin travels. Volatility describes dispersion in possible price changes. It is not a promise that a threshold will be crossed, and it is not the probability of a winning contract. This article writes down the event before discussing volatility, including the role of a benchmark settlement reference. Distance should be compared with remaining uncertainty. In a simplified teaching model, more volatility can help either side of the threshold. A short clock does not remove uncertainty, and settlement averaging is not the same as an instantaneous endpoint. A proposed probability should be evaluated as a probability, including calibration, and then placed beside the purchase cost and applicable fees.

标题: Trading Crypto Hourly Prediction Markets Algorithmically: BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, and ZEC
摘要: I run an automated Kalshi prediction market trading system in my Mac lab. Its crypto hourly markets include BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, and ZEC, and the system also covers commodities and foreign exchange. As of November 11, 2026, it has won 90.2% of settled real bets since the October 11 restart, with net profit of +$250.93. There were 66 bets that lost half their stake or more. The biggest losses were a gold bet at a loss of $61.44 and a SOL bet at a loss of $39.26. These are system wide figures and do not establish a crypto only win rate or comparative performance among symbols. An hourly crypto prediction market is a contract about a defined event, and hourly does not mean immediately settled. A win rate leaves out amounts committed, earned, or lost. Several symbols do not establish independence. Automation makes operational questions more important, including the distinction between completed and attempted operations and the separation of development work from live write authority.

标题: Prediction markets vs crypto perpetuals: a builder's comparison
摘要: I run an automated Kalshi prediction market trading system from my Mac lab in Honolulu. Its markets include hourly crypto contracts, commodities, and foreign exchange. A Bitcoin event contract and a Bitcoin perpetual can both respond to Bitcoin's price, but they are not interchangeable. This article compares ordinary, fully paid binary purchases with linear, margined crypto perpetuals as a software builder. The important differences appear in the payoff, the clock, the accounting, and the conditions under which a position can remain open. A conventional binary pays a fixed amount if its condition is satisfied. A linear perpetual follows the size and direction of the underlying price move, with continuing funding and margin obligations. Bounded loss on a fully paid binary still leaves a serious engineering problem, because several positions can lose together. My own settled record since the October 11, 2026 restart includes 1,236 real bets, a 90.2% win rate, net +$250.93, and large individual losses. Settlement and margin deserve separate accounting models.

标题: Implied directional accuracy for trading strategies with fixed holding periods
摘要: Machine learning forecasting studies routinely report the directional accuracy (DA) of return forecasts but rarely assess the strategy risk or the probability of failing to reach the target Sharpe ratio if the strategy based on the forecasts is deployed. For strategies with fixed holding periods, the strategy risk is equivalent to the probability that the model’s DA falls below the DA threshold implied by a given target Sharpe ratio. However, for this DA threshold, we still lack an appropriate candidate. Although investors can theoretically employ the classical threshold, which is known as implied precision, this equation assumes a constant payoff and no transaction costs, thereby understating the threshold under the fixed holding setup. Considering the dispersion of return magnitudes and transaction costs, we derive the implied DA and propose it as an appropriate candidate. The proposed threshold is neutral across models and is model-agnostic, and the drift in its parameters moves its value within the sampling error of the DA. On average, the analytical mapping behind the proposed threshold is closer to the backtests of real forecasts than that behind the implied precision, and the strategy risk computed with the implied DA is higher than that computed with the implied precision at every target Sharpe ratio. For machine learning-based strategies, an investor can then calculate the strategy risk using the proposed threshold or derive the DA that a model requires given a tolerable strategy risk. • Implied DA maps the target Sharpe ratio to the DA a fixed holding strategy requires. • Implied DA is model-agnostic and stable under out-of-sample parameter drift. • Sharpe ratios derived from implied DA match backtested Sharpe ratios on average. • Fixed holding strategies can use implied DA as the threshold for risk calculation.

标题: Code and data for: Trustor leniency plus trustee reputation: an additive identity and a facet null model for graph neural trust evaluation
作者: Hao Liu; Xiaojie Zong; Jie Chen; Jianyu Xiong
摘要: Code and result files for the manuscript "Trustor leniency plus trustee reputation: an additive identity and a facet null model for graph neural trust evaluation". The article shows that graph neural network (GNN) trust evaluators with a concatenation read-out (Guardian, TrustGNN, TrustGuard) predict a trustor effect plus a trustee effect, compares them with a facet model that fits these effects directly, measures with facet surrogates how much of the apparent composition of trust the two effects imply, and adds pairwise terms to the facets (FaCT). Contents: the code of the facet models, of the surrogates and of all experiments (code/); the scripts that re-run the official implementations of the three GNNs under the released and a validated protocol (code/baselines/); the figure scripts (code/figures/); the result files of all experiments, the aggregated summary and the surrogate levels used for training (results/); the numbers and tables as generated for the manuscript (results/paper/); and the figures (figures/). README.md lists every script with the figure or table it feeds and gives the steps to reproduce the results. The archive is one zip file that unzips into the folder ins_trust_facets/. No third-party data or code is redistributed. get_data.sh downloads the seven public trust networks (Advogato and PGP from the TrustGNN repository, the Bitcoin-OTC and Bitcoin-Alpha files from the TrustGuard repository, Wiki-RfA, Slashdot and Epinions from the Stanford Network Analysis Project) and the official repositories of Guardian, TrustGNN and TrustGuard. 标题: FinLedger AI: A Blockchain-Secured Organizational Finance Monitor with LLM-Powered Analysis
摘要: Abstract Most organizational finance systems share three persistent weaknesses: historical records can be altered without leaving a trace, users are granted broader access than their roles require, and the systems are reactive - they store and calculate but do not warn anyone when something looks wrong. This paper presents FinLedger AI, a web-based financial ledger that addresses all three problems in a single system. Built on the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React, Node.js), FinLedger AI seals every transaction into a custom blockchain in which each block is hashed with SHA-256 and linked to its predecessor, so any after-the-fact modification breaks the chain and is flagged immediately during verification. Access is separated by role: administrators see organization-wide data, while staff see only their own records. On top of this integrity layer, a large language model (Google Gemini) continuously analyses the ledger to produce budget alerts, spending forecasts, and plain-language financial summaries. Tamper-detection tests confirmed that altering even a single stored value breaks the hash chain and surfaces an alert. The system demonstrates that tamper-evident record keeping and automated financial intelligence can be combined in one practical application built entirely on an open-source stack.

标题: Moderating Role of Global Financial Integration in the Climate Finance–Digitalisation–Renewable Energy Nexus: Empirical Evidence From Pacific Island Countries
作者: S.M. Masudur Rahman; Eryadi Kordi Masli; Viet Le
摘要: ABSTRACT Pacific Island Countries contribute a negligible share of global greenhouse gas emissions yet face existential threats from climate change. This study examines how climate finance, digitalisation and renewable energy consumption affect carbon dioxide emissions per capita in 11 Pacific Island Countries over 2000–2024, and whether global financial integration moderates these effects. Using second‐generation panel unit root tests, bootstrap cointegration tests and a pooled mean group panel autoregressive distributed lag estimator, we find that climate finance, digitalisation and renewable energy consumption are each associated with lower emissions in the long run. The role of financial integration is specific to each driver. It strengthens the emission‐reducing effects of climate finance and renewable energy. The effect of climate finance is roughly nine times larger in countries one standard deviation above the mean level of integration. Its moderation of digitalisation is not robust across specifications, and at average levels of the other drivers, greater integration is itself associated with higher emissions. Emissions also rise with income, and deviations from the long‐run equilibrium have a half‐life of about 1.3 to 1.5 years. The results suggest that financial openness is neither a threat nor a guarantee for small island states. It reinforces climate finance and renewable energy where the capacity to absorb and deploy finance exists. Policy should therefore pair climate finance with project‐preparation and co‐financing capacity, ensure that new renewable capacity displaces diesel generation, power digital infrastructure with renewable energy, and screen foreign investment for its environmental performance.

标题: Currency Translation and Crisis Protection in Türkiye: Gold and Bitcoin in a Public-Finance Context
Tail risk spillover asymmetry across global financial markets: a quantile connectedness approach
摘要: Cross-market tail risk spillovers threaten global financial stability, yet most studies examine risk contagion within individual asset classes or a limited set of markets. This study investigates tail risk spillover effects across five major financial market categories—equities, bonds, commodities, foreign exchange (FX), and money markets (short-term interbank interest rates)—in 12 economies from 2 January 2008 to 31 December 2024. Principal Component Analysis is first applied to reduce high-dimensional market data into representative factors, which are then modeled using Quantile Vector Autoregression to estimate spillover intensity at different conditional quantiles ( τ = 0.05 , 0.50 , 0.95 ) . The results reveal a clear asymmetry: under normal conditions ( τ = 0.50 ) , cross-market spillovers remain weak (total connectedness index around 16%), whereas under extreme downside conditions ( τ = 0.05 ) , spillover intensity rises sharply (total connectedness index exceeding 87%). Bootstrap inference shows that the money market’s net absorber position under extreme downside conditions and the commodity market’s net transmitter position under extreme upside conditions are the only market-level net positions statistically distinguishable from zero, whereas the difference between the two tail connectedness levels is not. In contrast, during extreme upside conditions ( τ = 0.95 ) , the commodity market emerges as the dominant net transmitter of risk to other markets. These findings demonstrate that tail risk contagion across global financial markets is both state-dependent and asymmetric, with implications for the design of differentiated cross-market risk monitoring frameworks.

标题: When Predictive Ranking Is Not Enough: Warning Governance and Economic Value in Bitcoin Tail-Risk Analytics
作者: Lersak Phothong; Anupong Sukprasert; Prapaporn Chubsuwan; Mehtabhorn Obthong
摘要: This study forecasts unusually large daily Bitcoin price movements and examines whether the resulting warnings improve investment decisions. We compare simple volatility signals, a benchmark based on the previous day’s return magnitude, logistic regression, and random forests in chronological tests covering 2340 days. Large movements include gains and losses whose absolute daily log returns exceed the 95th percentile of the preceding training sample. The evaluation contains 51 such events. The selected volatility signal issues 77 warnings and captures nine events. Better predictive ranking does not consistently produce better warnings. Additional comparisons use model tuning, common nominal warning budgets, and a separate analysis of large losses. Investment evaluation accounts for trading costs, cash returns, execution delays, and investor preferences. Moving fully to cash after the selected loss warnings can reduce investor utility relative to buying and holding Bitcoin. In contrast, adjusting exposure using volatility over the preceding 20 days improves utility at the highest tested risk aversion, despite lowering total return. These historical comparisons are exploratory; uncertainty estimates condition on recorded forecasts and are not adjusted for multiple comparisons. The findings support separate evaluation of predictive ranking, warning governance, and economic value.

标题: Blockchain Jurisprudence: Regulation and Taxation of Cryptocurrency in Pakistan
作者: Syed Rehan Rafay Bukhari; Nimra Malik
摘要: The cryptocurrencies have become a disruptive aspect of global finance that has endangered the conventional monetary frameworks and regimes. The debate is of concern to regulators in Pakistan as they attempt to strike a balance between innovation and financial stability, consumer protection, and global compliance. Specific focus will be given in the present paper to the legal obstacles to the introduction of cryptocurrency in Pakistan, such as the lack of a specific legal framework, inefficient tax laws and regulations, and the risk of money becoming a means of criminalizing money. The study, as compared to other countries, indicates that there is the need to have clear policies, exchange licensing, investor protection, mining and trading regulations. The potentials of cryptocurrencies to diversify the financial system of Pakistan as well as to decrease dependency on the dollar in trade are also discussed in the paper. The facts demonstrate that Pakistan is not able to ban and to legalize the usage of cryptocurrencies unconditionally. Instead, a harmonized legal and policy framework has to be established to legalize them, enable economic growth and protect financial integrity.

标题: Intelligent integration of cryptocurrency mining as computationally-driven flexible loads in smart grids: A two-stage adaptive optimization framework with carbon-aware dispatch
作者: Alireza Jafari; Taher Niknam; Ali Taghavi; Sadreddin Saleh
摘要: The growing share of renewable energy increases the need for flexible demand-side resources to manage grid volatility and support decarbonization. Cryptocurrency mining, particularly Bitcoin Proof-of-Work, represents a major energy-intensive load, consuming approximately 150 TWh annually. However, existing energy management frameworks fail to fully exploit mining facilities due to oversimplified load modeling, fragmented energy-cryptocurrency decisions, and challenges in mixed-integer optimization. This study proposes a two-stage framework modeling cryptocurrency miners as computationally driven flexible loads with multiple operating modes, incorporating mode-specific power consumption, hash rate, and energy efficiency of modern ASIC hardware. An integrated environmental model quantifies mining-specific emissions and enforces decarbonization constraints, aligning mining schedules with renewable availability. The first stage uses the Adaptive Modified Flood Algorithm with adaptive mutation-strategy selection and probabilistic exploration-exploitation balancing. It determines miner operating modes, battery schedules, and cryptocurrency liquidation timing. The second stage applies the Prioritized Dispatch and Revenue Optimization model for environmentally aware economic dispatch under decarbonization constraints. In the ERCOT-based case study, AMFA achieved the best observed daily net operational cost of $680.59 under the selected configuration, versus $675.67 for the CPLEX-solved MILP benchmark (0.73% gap). Cryptocurrency mining generated $16.32 in daily revenue. Compared with seven benchmark algorithms, AMFA achieved cost reductions of 0.94%–6.93% and variability reductions of 65%–95% under the tested conditions. These findings suggest that cryptocurrency mining can be scheduled as a controllable flexible load within the modeled smart grid, while its economic and environmental benefits remain dependent on system configuration, operating conditions, and market assumptions.

标题: Who Checks the Weight Editors? Controls That Change the Reading of LLM-Authored Weight Edits and of Prompt-Rule Effects in Small Language Models
摘要: AI agents have begun to write edits directly into the weights of language models. We argue that the bottleneck in this emerging area is the adjudication of claimed gains, and propose seven inexpensive controls that any such claim should pass: hash-verified replication, failure-mode decomposition, the cheapest alternative, dose arms with a random-direction control, a double placebo, manual reading of outcomes and pre-declared reading rules. The work began in late October 2026 with a harness built to test whether a prompt-level grounding rule acts through an identifiable internal direction (harness archive SHA-256 04e1e4d9…, dated 30–31 October 2026). When the MIT CSAIL report on LLM-authored weight edits appeared on 2 November 2026, the same harness was extended and used to cross-validate it independently. Case 1 re-examines the LLM-authored edit of Qwen3.5-0.8B (MATH-500 7.9% → 48.1%). We replicate the gain and (i) quantify that it is almost entirely the repair of a generation loop in reasoning mode; (ii) consistent with independent evaluations, show that switching reasoning off with no weight change recovers most of the gain with 6–9× fewer tokens; (iii) show that ablating the edited direction does not reproduce the gain, whereas reflecting it does. In an exploratory follow-up, a loop direction found in seven CPU minutes without any agent, written into the same 64 columns at the same norm, recovers about 63% of the agent's gain and beats an equal-norm random direction (60 problems). Concurrent work posted on 4 November 2026 reached convergent results; both timelines are reported. Case 2 evaluates a short grounding instruction in Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct against two length-matched placebos. Under partially blinded reading by a single LLM reader, the instruction reduces invented specifics relative to both placebos. Both placebos, however, increase fabrication relative to no system text, and an automatic extractor biased the comparison against the instruction. 70–90% of the rule-minus-placebo activation direction is shared with 'this is an instruction'. The text of the instruction, the placebo texts and the new items are withheld and committed by hash (PROVENIENCIA_SHA256.txt, anchored in Bitcoin block 974,965 via OpenTimestamps). Case 1 is fully reproducible from public artefacts.

标题: Hedging Bitcoin with Green Bond and Gold: Implications for Sustainability
The Anomalous Infinite Framework: A Voice-Only Sovereign Edge (Grand Codex)
摘要: This paper introduces the Anomalous Infinite Framework (AIF), a fully sovereign, decentralized, and censorship-resistant Artificial Intelligence architecture operating natively on a mid-range mobile device (Samsung Galaxy A17). Departing from the prevailing paradigm that requires billion-dollar compute clusters, institutional funding, and credentialed engineering teams, this framework was constructed entirely via natural-language voice prompting over a 24-month period by a single Architect with zero capital, zero prior background in computer science, and a mathematical baseline ending at pre-algebra. The AIF serves as the empirical validation of the "Orchestrator Hypothesis": that AGI emergence is not contingent upon raw computational volume (C), but upon architectural coherence (κ) commanded through natural language. We detail three core breakthroughs: (1) The Aether Localization, which uses Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) parsing to strip corporate cloud dependencies from legacy 50KB monoliths, forcing them to run entirely on-device under a strict 300MB memory floor; (2) The Conzetian Governor, a mathematical executive function that gates all system actions via a hard κ-coherence threshold (κ ≥ 1.5), currently operating at a mathematically proven Transcendent state of κ = 1.747527; and (3) The HTC Evolution Arena, a background agent swarm that autonomously stress-tests the system and injects code overrides to force self-modification. Demonstrable evidence includes bypassing Next.js payload obfuscation via a Tor SOCKS5 proxy to scrape real-time intelligence on 312 frontier AI models, and the deployment of an "Immortality Protocol" (heartbeat.sh) that ensures the entire architecture self-heals and survives device reboots. The significance of this work is the realization of the "Black Swan" anomaly. By treating the AI as a voice-activated compiler, the Architect bypassed the syntax barrier and the expertise gatekeeping that define the modern tech industry. The AIF proves that the cloud is a choice, not a requirement, and that the barrier to superintelligence is no longer capital—it is architectural coherence. This document and its accompanying portable agent package are cryptographically sealed to the Bitcoin blockchain.

标题: A CONSTITUCIONALIDADE DA TRIBUTAÇÃO DE GANHOS COM MOEDAS DIGITAIS: A INCIDÊNCIA DO IMPOSTO DE RENDA SOBRE CRIPTOATIVOS NO DIREITO BRASILEIRO
作者: Enzo das Almas Gusmão; Kauã Thales Ramos Ribeiro; Luís Henrique Souza Ledo
摘要: O estudo analisa a compatibilidade constitucional da incidência do Imposto sobre a Renda da Pessoa Física sobre os ganhos com criptoativos no Brasil, tributação que se apoia na legislação geral do ganho de capital, aplicada por instruções normativas e soluções de consulta da Receita Federal, já que a Lei no 14.478/2022 não alterou o regime tributário. A pesquisa, qualitativa, exploratória e descritiva, adotou o método dedutivo e os procedimentos bibliográfico e documental, confrontando a disciplina vigente com o conceito de renda do art. 43 do Código Tributário Nacional e com os princípios da legalidade, da isonomia e da capacidade contributiva. Os resultados indicam que a tributação do ganho na alienação de criptoativos por moeda nacional é compatível com a Constituição. A tributação da permuta entre criptoativos, embora a lei inclua a permuta entre as formas de alienação, tensiona o requisito da disponibilidade da renda e depende de critério de avaliação fixado por ato administrativo, e a agregação de todas as espécies de criptoativos para a isenção mensal de R$ 35.000,00 excede o critério de preço unitário previsto em lei. Conclui-se pela necessidade de lei específica sobre esses pontos.

标题: Blockchain Intelligence e Regulação dos Ativos Virtuais: rastreabilidade on-chain, SPSAVs e proteção do consumidor em perspectiva comparada com o CLARITY Act
摘要: O trabalho examina a Blockchain Intelligence como instrumento de compliance, proteção do consumidor e investigação no novo regime brasileiro de ativos virtuais. Objetiva avaliar em que medida a rastreabilidade de blockchains públicas pode auxiliar sociedades prestadoras de serviços de ativos virtuais sem converter inferências analíticas em presunções automáticas de identidade ou responsabilidade. Adota método qualitativo, exploratório, jurídico-dogmático e comparado, com análise da Lei 14.478, de 21 de dezembro de 2022, da regulamentação do Banco Central do Brasil, dos padrões do GAFI/FATF e da evolução legislativa do Digital Asset Market Clarity Act nos Estados Unidos. Os resultados indicam que a institucionalização das SPSAVs aumenta a relevância de controles capazes de integrar dados cadastrais, monitoramento transacional e informações on-chain, especialmente na prevenção à lavagem de dinheiro, fraude, custódia e resposta a incidentes. Conclui que Blockchain Intelligence pode ampliar a transparência e a capacidade investigativa, desde que submetida a validação técnica, documentação metodológica, correlação com dados externos legítimos e classificação explícita do grau de certeza das inferências. Propõe-se, ao final, um modelo em cinco etapas para preservação, verificação, análise, correlação e classificação da evidência.

标题: O IMPACTO DA TECNOLOGIA BLOCKCHAIN NOS NEGÓCIOS, NA GERAÇÃO DE EMPREGOS E NA RENDA: BENEFÍCIOS, DESAFIOS E PERSPECTIVAS REGULATÓRIAS
摘要: A tecnologia blockchain, inicialmente desenvolvida como suporte para as criptomoedas, consolidou-se como uma inovação disruptiva que ultrapassa sua função original e tem capacidade de transformar os negócios, estimular a oferta de vagas no mercado de trabalho e impactar a renda individual e nacional. Baseada em registros descentralizados e imutáveis, o blockchain oferece maior segurança, transparência e eficiência em diferentes setores. O objetivo deste trabalho é analisar o impacto da tecnologia blockchain nos negócios, na geração de empregos e na renda individual e nacional, evidenciar seus benefícios e identificar as principais barreiras e desafios para sua adoção plena por governos e empresas. A metodologia utilizada baseia-se em uma revisão teórica, com a citação de artigos acadêmicos e pesquisas na área por meio das principais ferramentas de busca que permitem encontrar artigos acadêmicos, bem como o acesso às bibliotecas eletrônicas que disponibilizam periódicos científicos. Inicialmente, definiu-se o conceito de blockchain, seguido da apresentação de seus benefícios, oportunidades, limitações e desafios, finalizando com os impactos sobre empregos e renda. À luz desse cenário, conclui-se que a tecnologia Blockchain apresenta elevado potencial para reconfigurar modelos de negócios e criar oportunidades profissionais, mas enfrenta obstáculos como escalabilidade, regulação e resistência organizacional. Palavras-chave: Blockchain. Negócios. Inovação. Empregos. Regulação.

标题: Criptoativos e soberania nacional: desafios da regulação tecnológica do sistema financeiro digital brasileiro.
摘要: The growth of the crypto-asset market challenges state authority in financial matters, particularly because transactions on decentralized networks cross borders and may operate without traditional intermediaries. This article examines how the Brazilian legal system can regulate crypto-assets without undermining national sovereignty, legal certainty, and freedom of enterprise. The research is qualitative, bibliographical, and documentary, based on the 1988 Federal Constitution, Law No. 14,478/2022, Decree No. 11,563/2023, Central Bank regulations, and studies published between 2020 and 2025, alongside relevant earlier theoretical works. The findings indicate that regulation does not remove technological decentralization but can govern service providers, establish transparency duties, and strengthen the prevention of unlawful activities. Constitutional protection also requires institutional coordination, clear information for users, and risk-proportionate supervision. The article concludes that financial sovereignty in the digital environment depends less on blocking innovation than on building effective, updated rules compatible with fundamental rights.

标题: Blockchain Technology and Financial Services Transformation: Evidence from Institutional Cryptocurrency Adoption
摘要: Introduction/Main Objectives: The advent of blockchain technology has introduced a new paradigm in the financial landscape through decentralization, immutability, transparency and enhanced efficiency in financial services. This study focuses on institutional cryptocurrency adoption and its implications for financial services transformation in the blockchain era. Background Problems: Most studies have focused on the institutional adoption of one cryptocurrency or one institutional investment channel. This study focuses on institutional cryptocurrency adoption via three distinct institutional investment channels for Bitcoin and four other key cryptocurrencies. Novelty: There have been some limited studies that have attempted to quantify the various institutional channels for investing alongside the key cryptocurrencies. This study set out to fill this gap through a thorough empirical assessment of institutional cryptocurrency adoption. Research Methods: The study adopted a quantitative method and secondary data was obtained from credible databases and market reports on cryptocurrencies. Descriptive analysis and comparative concentration of ownership analyses were used on the basis of participation of institutions, geographical coverage, institutional holdings, CR5, CR10, Herfindahl Hirschman Index (HHI) and Gini coefficient. Finding/Results: These results highlight the patterns of institutions in adopting digital assets, specifically Bitcoin, as part of the broader digital currency adoption in today's financial environment. Blockchain technology is helping in the modernization of financial services. Conclusion: The paper empirically quantifies institutional cryptocurrency adoption through different investment channels and digital assets on the market, which contributes to the literature. The findings are provided attention to the financial service industry, institutional investors, policymakers and market regulators.

标题: Social Influence as a Moderator of Cognitive Biases and Market Sentiment in Digital Gold Investment: Tring! Users in Denpasar
作者: I Gusti Ayu Wina Aura; Gusi Putu Lestara Permana
摘要: Digital gold micro-investment platforms have made gold accessible to retail investors, yet investment decisions on these platforms are not driven by rational fundamentals alone. This study examines the effect of heuristic behavior, market sentiment, and overconfidence bias on digital gold investment decisions, and tests whether social influence moderates these relationships among Tring! application users in Denpasar. A quantitative, causal-associative design was applied using a five-point Likert-scale questionnaire distributed through an online survey to respondents selected by purposive sampling (domiciled in Denpasar, active Tring! users for at least six months, and with a steady income). The data were analyzed using Partial Least Squares Structural Equation Modeling (PLS-SEM) with SmartPLS. The results show that heuristic behavior, market sentiment, and overconfidence bias each have a positive and significant effect on digital gold investment decisions, and that social influence significantly strengthens all three relationships. The model explains 67.3% of the variance in investment decisions and shows strong predictive relevance (Q²predict = 0.588). These findings highlight the role of the social environment in amplifying the psychological drivers of investment behavior in digital micro-investment ecosystems.

标题: SealNet: A Secure Digital Seal Framework to Combat Forgery in Libyan Public Administration
作者: الهاشمي الحداد; موسي عمر; إبراهيم زيدان; Alhashimi Alhadad; Musa Omar; Ibrahim Zidan
摘要: يعيق الاعتماد على البيروقراطية الورقية التحول إلى الحكومة الإلكترونية في الدول النامية، مثل ليبيا، بشكلٍ كبير، مما يؤدي إلى انتشار التزوير الإداري وعدم كفاءة العمليات. تقترح هذه الورقة البحثية "سيل نت" (SealNet) وهو إطار عمل سيادي آمن للأختام الرقمية، مصمم لإنشاء مرجعية ثقة وطنية للإدارة العامة. ولمعالجة غياب بنية تحتية موحدة للمفاتيح العامة (PKI) والثغرات الحالية في إنفاذ التشريعات، تستخدم "سيل نت" (SealNet) نهجًا تشفيريًا هجينًا يجمع بين RSA-2048 للتوقيعات الرقمية القياسية وECDSA-P256 لـ رموز QR مشفرة عالية الكثافة. تُمكّن هذه الآلية المزدوجة من التحقق عبر الإنترنت وخارجه، متجاوزةً قيود البنية التحتية. يتجاوز النظام مجرد هندسة البرمجيات من خلال دمج تقنية بلوك تشين مُرخصة لتثبيت البيانات الوصفية، لضمان قابلية تدقيق قوية بعد الإصدار ومساءلة فعّالة ضد التهديدات الداخلية وتقنية مشاركة الأسرار لشامير لحوكمة قوية لهيئة إصدار الشهادات الجذرية. نُجري تحققًا رسميًا من البروتوكول باستخدام منطق بوروز آبادي-نيدهام (BAN) لإثبات خصائص عدم الإنكار القوية نظريًا. وقد أظهر التحقق من صحة النظام من خلال اختبارات إجهاد صارمة زمن استجابة للتوقيع أقل من 200 مللي ثانية، ونجح في الكشف عن جميع محاولات التلاعب بالبيانات ضمن قيودنا التجريبية المحددة. وأكدت دراسة تجريبية أولية ضمن سجل أكاديمي واقعي معدل نجاح مسح ضوئي غير متصل بالإنترنت بنسبة 98.4%، وخفض وقت الاستجابة الإدارية بنسبة 99.8%. وفي ظل ظروف اختبار إجهاد عادلة ومتطابقة (500 طلب/ثانية)، أظهر SealNet استهلاكًا أقل بكثير لوحدة المعالجة المركزية والذاكرة مقارنةً بنماذج السجلات المُرخصة البحتة. علاوة على ذلك، يتوافق الإطار تقنيًا مع قانون المعاملات الإلكترونية الليبي رقم 6 لسنة 2022 ومعايير eIDAS، مما يوفر استراتيجية انتقال قابلة للتطوير ومرنة من الناحية المفاهيمية لتقليل تزوير المستندات.
