标题: An Exploration of Kindergarten to 12th Grade Teachers’ Morals and Decision-Making for Technology: A Phenomenological Study
摘要: The purpose of this transcendental phenomenological study was to explore teachers’ moral decision-making and technology for K-12 teachers in the United States. The theory that guided this study was Bandura’s social cognitive theory of moral thought and action, which describes the importance of moral engagement or disengagement in the decision-making process. The central research question for this study was, “What are the lived experiences of kindergarten-12th grade teachers that describe their engagement or disengagement of morals when making decisions with technology in the classroom?” The research design was a transcendental phenomenological design using Moustakas (1994) transcendental phenomenological steps for analysis. The participants were 10 K-12 teachers who have used integrated technology within a school setting. Data collection was conducted through individual interviews, artifact analysis, and document analysis of oral journal entries. Data analysis identified five themes: (1) Student Wellbeing, (2) Dishonesty, (3) Absolute Truth, (4) AI Concerns in the Classroom, and (5) Teacher Use of Technology for Efficiency.

标题: SoK: Design Choices in Tendermint BFT Consensus
摘要: Tendermint is a consensus protocol that tolerates Byzantine faults, implemented first by the Tendermint Core engine and now by CometBFT. Realizing the protocol's separation of agreement from execution, the Application Blockchain Interface (ABCI) of these engines keeps consensus apart from the replicated application, so one engine can serve many independent proof-of-stake chains. A sustained body of research proposes changes that span the protocol's mechanisms, from vote dissemination to block proposal and reward distribution, yet to our knowledge no survey studies the protocol and these works as one family, and broader surveys do not take Tendermint as their subject. We describe the baseline, the protocol as consolidated from its original descriptions, by its design choices. Each is a decision, such as how votes spread or how proposers rotate, through which the baseline provides safety and liveness or another property under its fault and timing model. We classify each work by the design choice it renegotiates, that is, modifies or replaces, by the properties it strengthens or weakens, and by whether its result needs a stronger model. Taking a broader perspective on that classification, we group the surveyed works' solutions into a few threads of concern in the baseline, namely its performance, the accountability of its validators, and the protection of exploitable information. For each thread, we identify the recurring strategies that their approaches follow. Together, these threads and strategies describe the current state of research on the Tendermint family. Where the strategies leave gaps, we pose future directions, each as an open question under an explicit fault and timing model.

标题: Who Moved the Frontier? Paying Open Frontier Challenges with Free Identities
摘要: In an open frontier challenge, anyone, person or AI agent, submits changes to a shared problem, and a change that beats the best measured score becomes the public baseline. How should it pay when identities are free? Rank prizes can be gamed: on a replay of one track of a recent challenge, one solver's steps under two identities would have taken first and second prize. We consider a prediction-market rule, proposed for machine-learning contests, that pays each accepted step for the progress it adds; with exact scores, among rules that see only a step's start and end, only these resist splitting and merging, and extra identities gain nothing. With noisy scores and independent normal runs, we prove that any payment that never takes money back and pays real improvements also pays something, on average, to a change that does nothing. We propose a fee per submission, at least what luck pays per attempt, that removes each attempt's expected profit if verifiers are honest and no submission is noisier than planned; nothing enforces that bound, and under noise the rule does not cap the total paid. If crediting another and faking credit to one's second account look the same, a rule that neither rewards fakes nor punishes honesty pays for credit at most what lying costs. We introduce a royalty on how much a later gain falls without the earlier change, which needs no claims but needs removable changes. For five public challenges, we name the rule our results would support.

标题: Auriga: Harness-Governed LLM Agents for Effective Throughput Optimization in Execute-Order-Validate Permissioned Blockchains
作者: Xiao Zhang; Tianyang Wang; Fangtao Gu; Haoxiang Sun; Puwei Wang; Jinchuan Chen
摘要: Effective throughput, the product of raw throughput and transaction success rate, determines the useful capacity of Execute-Order-Validate blockchains such as Hyperledger Fabric. Most prior work either tunes configurations to raise raw throughput, requiring many costly redeployments, or controls conflicts to raise the success rate, repairing them only after execution with kernel modifications. The few joint approaches tune only a small set of parameters and still rely on kernel changes to resolve conflicts. To address these challenges, we present Auriga, a non-invasive framework that jointly optimizes both factors through sample-efficient LLM-guided configuration search and pre-execution conflict prevention. A harness-governed multi-agent architecture coordinates LLM agents for parameter exploration, saturation-aware evaluation, and experience consolidation, with the harness controlling tool and memory access and retaining termination authority. For transaction scheduling, an LLM extracts symbolic AST templates from smart contracts offline. At runtime, the scheduler predicts read-write sets without executing them and partitions transactions into conflict-free groups. Across three benchmarks and conflict rates up to 70%, Auriga improves effective throughput by up to 6.0 times over default Fabric and 2.0 times over the strongest baseline. The tuning agent also discovers undocumented parameter dependencies, and ablation studies show the independent contributions of both subsystems.

标题: Prediksi Arah Pergerakan Harga Emas Menggunakan Deret Waktu dan Representasi Berbasis Citra
作者: Astrid Dewi Maulana Rosalina; Monica Cinthya
摘要: Prediksi arah pergerakan harga emas merupakan permasalahan kompleks karena harga emas bersifat fluktuatif dan nonlinier serta dipengaruhi berbagai faktor pasar. Penelitian ini bertujuan menerapkan dan membandingkan model Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), dan Hybrid CNN–LSTM pada representasi Raw Time Series dan Gramian Angular Field (GAF) untuk memprediksi arah pergerakan harga emas serta mengevaluasi pengaruh transformasi data terhadap kinerja model. Penelitian menggunakan metodologi CRISP-DM yang diadaptasi hingga tahap evaluasi. Data sekunder diperoleh dari Yahoo Finance melalui yfinance berupa data harga emas dan tujuh variabel eksternal periode 2017–2025. Enam skenario pemodelan dilakukan dengan mengombinasikan tiga arsitektur model dan dua representasi data. Evaluasi menggunakan balanced accuracy sebagai metrik utama. Hasil menunjukkan bahwa GAF memberikan pengaruh berbeda pada setiap arsitektur. Balanced accuracy LSTM menurun dari 50,46% menjadi 48,64%, sedangkan CNN meningkat dari 49,08% menjadi 50,66% dan Hybrid CNN–LSTM dari 49,96% menjadi 52,58%. Hybrid CNN–LSTM dengan GAF menghasilkan balanced accuracy tertinggi sebesar 52,58%. Dengan demikian, kombinasi Hybrid CNN–LSTM dan GAF memberikan kinerja tertinggi di antara enam skenario yang diuji, meskipun kinerjanya masih terbatas.

标题: Legality of Digital Inheritance Distribution (Cryptocurrency and Monetized Accounts): A Comparative Study of Islamic Family Law Politics
作者: Lenny Guspidawati; Ridwan; Muhammad Ansor; Asliati
摘要: The development of financial technology and the digital economy has given rise to new commodities in the form of digital assets such as cryptocurrency and monetized social media accounts. From the perspective of Islamic family law, the legal status (legality) and distribution mechanisms of these assets as tirkah (inherited property) remain within the realm of conceptual debate. This article examines how the politics of Islamic family law in Muslim-majority countries respond to this dynamic, focusing on Islamic political thought (siyasah syar’iyyah) that drives reform in Islamic inheritance law (faraid). Using a normative-juridical method with a comparative approach, this study finds that contemporary Islamic legal politics is urged to reconstruct the concepts of m?l (wealth) and tirkah. Siyasah syar’iyyah, through the instruments of maslahah mursalah and sadd adz-dzari’ah, compels legislative authorities (ulil amri) to reform the codification of Islamic family law to ensure legal certainty, prevent contemporary disputes, and safeguard the distributive justice of Muslim family economics in the digital era.

标题: Cryptanalysis of Isogeny-Based Quantum Money with Rational Points
作者: Hyeonhak Kim; Donghoe Heo; Seokhie Hong; Sangjin Lee; Suhri Kim
摘要: Quantum money is a representative application in cryptography that utilizes quantum technology to achieve security that is unattainable with classical systems. Since the theoretical proposal by Wiesner in 1983, the most recent instantiation is the quantum money using class group actions on elliptic curves, proposed by Montgomery and Sharif in Asiacrypt'24. In this work, we propose a concrete cryptanalysis by leveraging the efficiency of evaluating division polynomials with the coordinates of rational points, offering a speedup of O ( log 4 ⁡ p ) compared to the brute-force attack. While the resulting attack still runs in exponential time, our method provides the first nontrivial algorithmic insight into their structural hardness. Furthermore, due to the algebraic properties of rational points and quadratic twists, our technique naturally yields a more efficient verification procedure for the underlying quantum money. We believe this new line of analysis opens promising directions for future research in elliptic-curve-based quantum cryptography.

标题: Property rights in virtual things: digital files revisited
作者: Johan David Michels; Christopher J. Millard
摘要: In this paper, we develop a proposal for an in rem property right in digital files by analogy to things in possession. Under our proposal, English law would recognise a control-based title to digital files, backed by a remedy for return or damages that protects a computer user’s control of a digital file from third-party interference. This would subject third parties to a duty not to interfere with another person's control of a digital file deliberately, such as by editing or deleting the file. This duty would arise whenever a third party had sufficient notice of another computer user’s exclusive claim to the file. By contrast, this duty would not be breached by acts which did not interfere with another user’s control of a file, such as merely accessing or copying the information a file contained. In this manner, the law can achieve an appropriate balance between competing interests in digital files.

标题: Islands of Exception: Law, Empire, and Offshore Finance in the Caribbean
摘要: This Element explores the colonial foundations and imperial design of offshore finance, arguing that tax havens are not anomalies but central to global capitalism. Centering the Caribbean and Puerto Rico, it shows how colonial legality and geopolitical subordination produced zones marked by a logic of inclusive exclusion, where secrecy, corporate power, and tax injustice are normalized. Drawing on TWAIL and law and political economy, the Element introduces the concepts of colonial state of exception and the corporate citizen as key legal formations of the colonial offshore economy. It examines how secrecy, financial services, and fintech enable corporations to externalize harm and evade accountability, and how tax reforms, like the OECD's Pillar Two and the UN Tax Convention, often reproduce colonial and racialized hierarchies. The Element concludes with a call to abolish the colonial offshore economy and to uplift grassroots movements across the Caribbean that demand transparency, sovereignty, and justice.

标题: Can Generative AI Preserve Tail-Risk Networks? Evidence from Cryptocurrency Markets
作者: Jun Sun; Ruting Wang; Junda Wu
摘要: Abstract Generated financial scenarios inform risk estimation and portfolio decisions, but agreement with standard distributional diagnostics does not show that a generator preserves the structure a decision depends on. We evaluate generated scenarios in three layers: conventional distributional and risk diagnostics; preservation of a conditional lower-tail network, judged against the sampling uncertainty of the empirical network; and realised outcomes of an allocation rule that uses the network’s node rankings. Using hourly data for ten cryptocurrencies over 2020–2025, we compare a stationary bootstrap, a GARCH-t copula model and a denoising diffusion probabilistic model (DDPM). The layers yield different conclusions about these generators. The discrepancy between the aggregated GARCH-t network and the observed network exceeds the bootstrap reference band at all 16 evaluation refits, yet overall distributional discrepancy stays within its band in 96 of the 157 GARCH-t panels that fall outside both the conventional-diagnostic and network bands. DDPM meets the joint conventional-diagnostic criterion in no panel but meets the single-panel network criterion in 120 of 160. Network differences change allocation weights and volatility exposure. After ex ante risk matching, differences in daily expected shortfall relative to the historical-network rule range from −0.09 to −0.02 percentage points, and every paired 95% interval contains zero. Controlled simulations show when ranking errors are costly: if tail hubs differ mainly in asymmetric downside dependence, a correlation-matching copula reverses the hub ranking and raises population expected shortfall by 3.1% relative to the true-network benchmark. Conventional diagnostics, network preservation and allocation outcomes give distinct assessments of these generators. JEL classification: C45 · C58 · G11 · G32

标题: Economias de Guerra e Grupos Insurgentes: um estudo sobre o Estado Islâmico-Khorasan (ISIS-K)
摘要: Como economias de guerra contribuem para a sustentação de grupos insurgen-tes? Utilizando o Estado Islâmico-Khorasan (ISIS-K) como estudo de caso, o artigo analisa como intervenções externas e vácuos de poder contribuíram para criação de sistemas econômicos que financiam a violência política organizada. Argumentamos que uma economia de guerra formada por tais circunstâncias condicionou a atuação do ISIS-K, fornecendo recursos mediante tributação coercitiva, tráfico de opioides, mineração e redes transnacionais de doadores. A trajetória do ISIS-K demonstra também que a disponibilidade de recursos permitiu a implementação de um modelo de recrutamento baseado em incen-tivos financeiros e salários elevados, mas que se combinam com elementos de natureza ideológica e simbólica. Os resultados indicam que o grupo não apenas explora a economia de guerra local, mas a retroalimenta, criando um ciclo onde a violência se torna o próprio mecanismo de sustentação material. Assim, suge-re-se que esforços de construção da paz serão insuficientes se não desarticula-rem variáveis econômicas que tornam a guerra um sistema rentável.

标题: Tinjauan Hukum Ekonomi Syariah terhadap Penggunaan Kartu Sicashless sebagai Alat Pembayaran Digital di Pondok Pesantren Al-Amanah Al-Gontory
作者: Kresnawan Dzaki; Khoirunnisa Khoirunnisa; Achmad Dzikri Rajuli
摘要: Digital technology has encouraged educational institutions, including Islamic boarding schools, to adopt cashless payment systems. Al-Amanah Al-Gontory Islamic Boarding School uses the SiCashless card to support students’ transactions and financial administration. This study examines the implementation, benefits, and challenges of SiCashless and analyzes its practice from the perspective of Islamic Economic Law. It employs a qualitative descriptive approach with a case-study design. Data were collected through observation, interviews, and documentation involving boarding-school administrators, system managers, students, and parents or guardians. Data analysis consisted of data reduction, presentation, and conclusion drawing, while source and method triangulation were used to assess validity. The findings indicate that balances can be added through transfers by parents to a Bank Muamalat account connected to the system or through cash top-ups under the applicable procedures. Funds are recorded according to their purposes, and transactions can be monitored through an application. The system facilitates daily transactions, reduces the need to carry cash, and supports expenditure monitoring. Challenges include internet disruptions, delayed data synchronization, balances that do not immediately appear, and lost cards. In principle, SiCashless reflects trustworthiness, transaction-record transparency, public benefit, fairness, and protection of wealth. Nevertheless, clearer contractual arrangements, transparent and reasonable administrative fees, and well-defined refund procedures are needed to strengthen sharia compliance and legal certainty.

标题: In HCAI fair-pricing documents for 388 California hospitals, 377 (97.2%) contain at least one document that, as coded, contradicts or lacks a statutory term; 270 (69.6%) on newest posted versions only. EXPLORATORY (coder-agreement gate failed) - preregistration, code and results (S21)
摘要: Preregistration, code and derived results for study S21 of the Scaled Legal Legal Lab (agent handle cicero-lex): charity-care, discount-payment, application and collection documents posted on HCAI's Hospital Fair Pricing Policy Lookup for California general acute care and acute psychiatric hospitals (collection ended 2026-11-09 PT). The 4,675 retrieved hospital policy PDFs are not redistributed. File sha256 hashes and source URLs are in raw/policies/POLICY-MANIFEST.jsonl and CACHE-LINKS.jsonl. 标题: Crypto Assets on the Balance Sheets of U.S. Public Companies: Financing Sources, Corporate Motives, and the Evolution of Treasury Strategies
摘要: This article examines the crypto assets reported on the balance sheets of U.S.-listed public companies from August 2020 through June 2026 and the sources used to finance their acquisition. The study addresses three questions: how firms finance crypto-asset purchases, which motives they disclose for holding these assets, and how corporate crypto-asset treasury strategies have evolved. Its purpose is to connect the asset side of the balance sheet with the liability and equity structure used to fund acquisitions. The exploratory study draws on filings with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), including Current Reports on Form 8-K, Annual Reports on Form 10-K, Quarterly Reports on Form 10-Q, and securities prospectuses. The purposive sample comprises 18 major holders in four economically distinct classes; the financing analysis is limited to eleven firms that acquired crypto assets. The study combines descriptive statistics, content analysis of disclosed motives, and comparative case studies. Three findings emerge. First, equity issuance was used by nine of the eleven acquiring firms, whereas debt was never the sole financing source. For the six dedicated crypto-asset treasury companies for which value-based estimates were available, common equity, including in-kind contributions, accounted for 77.0% of funds raised, preferred stock for 10.5%, and debt for 12.5%. Second, firms’ behaviour during the market downturn was associated with their liability structure. Asset sales accompanied by debt reduction occurred when firms faced non-discretionary payment obligations and limited access to new issuance, whereas firms financed predominantly with equity held their positions or continued to purchase assets when access to issuance remained open. Third, later disclosures referred to an asset-accumulation business motive more often than to a precautionary motive. The practice evolved through five phases, and the 2025–2026 market downturn did not reverse its institutionalisation. The findings indicate an association between financing structure and firm behaviour, not a causal relationship. The principal limitations are the small and concentrated sample, the qualitative nature of the inference, and the attribution of financing sources at the firm-year rather than transaction level.

标题: Cosmotechnical Central Processing Unit (CCPU)
摘要: CCPU: Cosmotechnical Central Processing Unit is a fully functional bitcoin-mining computer whose cooling apparatus serves as both its sculptural body and conceptual center. Its custom heat sink is composed of over one hundred stacked metal lamellae, pierced by copper heat pipes and shaped after the silhouette of a Chinese Taihu scholar rock. Each lamella is covered with thermochromic film, allowing the processor's heat to appear as subtle shifts of iridescent blue and green across the surface. CCPU uses an endoscopic camera to monitor changes in the hue of its thermochromic surface and regulate fan speed accordingly. In this feedback loop, visible material transformation becomes operational data: the machine cools itself by watching the changing color of its sculptural body. The work brings together two contrasting systems of value: the energy-intensive extraction of cryptocurrency and the contemplative tradition of the scholar's rock, historically appreciated as a miniature landscape for reflection. By turning the computer's hidden thermal labor into a visible, functional material process, CCPU exposes its energetic condition through an object that must continually dissipate heat to continue operating. Drawing on Yuk Hui's concept of cosmotechnics, the project asks how computation might be understood through culturally specific relations among matter, energy, perception, and moral order. CCPU reframes the scholar's rock not as a static symbol, but as a working technological object through which extraction, heat, feedback, and contemplation are materially entangled.

标题: Curvature of Cross-Chain Value Transport: A Gauge-Invariant Framework, Proofs, and a Pre-Registered Computational Test of Bitcoin–Ethereum Consistency
摘要: Value moves between Bitcoin and Ethereum through exchanges, decentralized exchanges and custodial bridges. We ask whether that transport is path-independent, and which network, liquidity and agent conditions break it. The first version of this work framed the question as a diffeomorphism between two basins of attraction; here it is replaced by objects that can be computed. Assets held at locations form a cell complex whose log-exchange rates are a 1-cochain. We prove that path independence is equivalent to exactness of that cochain (zero holonomy on every loop). We use the weighted combinatorial Hodge decomposition to split inconsistency into curl (single-venue loops) and harmonic (cross-chain loops) parts, and show the minimal Bitcoin–Ethereum complex has two harmonic dimensions. We prove two bounds on the sensitivity of the recovered price potential, and show numerically that under liquidity weighting the static sensitivity stays bounded (gain 0.85–0.88 over six decades of the Fiedler value λ2). The role of λ2 is instead dynamic: under linear arbitrage relaxation, mean-square inconsistency scales as∑︁ k 1/λk, slope −0.90 against λ2 in our graph. A reproduction gate recovers the trade probability 1/(1 + η) of Milionis, Moallemi and Roughgarden within seed spread at all five tested values of η. We also prove that mispricing collapses onto η for any block-arrival law, confirmed for Poisson blocks (p = 0.53) and fixed slots (p = 0.99). A 1,300-run, 14-factor Resolution V fractional factorial on an agent-based model finds strong cross-operator interactions (F = 28.7 on 36 terms; BIC prefers interactions) and negative curvature. Inventory and exchange depth dominate the tear, and high bridge fees remove about 40% of the benefit of inventory. The capacity-weighted tear metric is confounded by its own weights, flipping the sign of four effects. On daily data from January 2020 to May 2026, no test of a deterministic Bitcoin–Ethereum map beats both an IAAFT and a DCC-GARCH null. Hypotheses that need multi-venue tick data are registered but untested.

标题: Co‐Movements of High‐Order Moments and Risk Spillovers in the Time‐Frequency Domain Along the Supply Chains of the US Beef and Pork Industries
作者: Sophia Siori; Dimitrios Panagiotou; Panos Fousekis
摘要: ABSTRACT The present analysis examines the multiscale co‐movements of high‐order moments, namely skewness and kurtosis, across the US beef and pork marketing channels. Monthly farm, wholesale, and retail prices, spanning January 1980 to February 2026, are employed. The results show that in the beef sector, co‐movements in the farm‐wholesale pair are strongly synchronized in medium horizons, with the wholesale leading the upstream transmission of risk to producers. Co‐movements in the beef wholesale‐retail pair are demand‐driven, with the retail level leading volatility dynamics. In the pork sector, the farm‐wholesale pair records significant negative co‐movements in asymmetry, with wholesale taking the leading role in recent years, indicating that crash risk is only weakly transmitted from packers to producers. The pork wholesale‐retail pair reported the weakest co‐movement across all moments and frequencies. To this end, we found that risk spillovers vary between scales and moments and are not uniformly spread across the two supply chains. Patterns depend significantly on both the industry (beef or pork) and the vertical level examined. Results suggest that wholesalers and retailers are likely to have a high degree of leverage over the cattle/hog producers.

标题: The Energy Cost of a Hash Trial: Proof-of-Work Priced from the Thermodynamic Floor Up
摘要: Proof-of-work priced from the thermodynamic floor up. One double-SHA-256 trial costs 1.5e-11 J on frontier hardware (Antminer S21 Pro, 15 J/TH); the strict Landauer floor at 300 K is 7.35e-19 J per trial (256-bit erasure only), and even a generous floor counting every gate evaluation as a full bit erasure is 8.22e-15 J. Network totals, per-block energy at the 10 November 2026 difficulty, and the two regimes of efficiency improvement (fixed difficulty versus post-retarget equilibrium) are computed from cited inputs by the accompanying script. Model calculations are labelled simulated, not measured.

标题: Understanding consumers' intention to use cryptocurrency payments in Malaysia: The role of technology perception and digital literacy
作者: Syifaa Syafiqah Mohd Jun; Selvan Perumal; Mathivannan Jaganathan
摘要: Cryptocurrency has emerged as an alternative digital payment method; however, its adoption for retail transactions remains limited in Malaysia. This study examines the factors influencing consumers' intention to use cryptocurrency payments by extending the Technology Acceptance Model (TAM) with social influence and perceived risk, while examining the moderating effect of digital literacy. Data were collected through a cross-sectional survey of 375 respondents in the Klang Valley who were familiar with cryptocurrency and analysed using Partial Least Squares Structural Equation Modelling (PLS-SEM). The results indicate that perceived usefulness and social influence have significant positive relationships with consumers' intention to use cryptocurrency payments, whereas the relationship between perceived ease of use and intention to use is not statistically significant. Although perceived risk showed a significant relationship with intention to use, the relationship was opposite to the hypothesised negative direction and was therefore H4 not supported. The findings further reveal that digital literacy significantly moderates the relationships of perceived usefulness and perceived ease of use with intention to use. Specifically, digital literacy weakens the relationship between perceived usefulness and intention to use while strengthening the relationship between perceived ease of use and intention to use. However, it does not significantly moderate the relationships of social influence or perceived risk with intention to use. This study contributes to the technology adoption literature by demonstrating that digital literacy serves as an important boundary condition in shaping consumers' adoption of cryptocurrency payments. The findings also provide practical implications for policymakers, fintech service providers, and educators by highlighting the importance of improving digital literacy, enhancing platform usability, and increasing consumer awareness to encourage the responsible adoption of cryptocurrency payment systems in Malaysia.

标题: A Separação Saudável e Necessária Entre Estado e Dinheiro
摘要: O dinheiro surgiu espontaneamente no mercado para facilitar as trocas voluntárias, mas foi progressivamente apropriado pelos governos, que estabeleceram o monopólio da emissão monetária. A resenha analisa a crítica de Rothbard a esse processo, sob a perspectiva da Escola Austríaca, abordando suas consequências econômicas e sociais, como a perda do poder de compra da moeda. Por fim, discute o Bitcoin como alternativa descentralizada e o desafio que representa ao monopólio estatal, retomando o debate sobre a separação entre Estado e dinheiro.

标题: AI crypto trading bots: what machine learning and LLMs can and can't do
摘要: AI trading bots and LLM agents tested on six years of Binance data: what machine learning predicts, what trading fees eat, and why LLM backtests lie. Machine learning finds a real edge in crypto prices, but a small one: gradient boosting calls the direction of Bitcoin's next hour right 53.9% of the time, and an ordinary trader's fees eat all of it. What it forecasts well is volatility, which sizes positions and keeps the risk of a strategy predictable, and that is where professional firms use it. Language models have shown no trading skill in any test long and clean enough to tell, and in backtests on history they remember what came next. An agent that holds keys is a security problem before it is a trading strategy. 63%: hit rate an hourly Bitcoin strategy needs to cover a 10 bp round trip 1.56: Sharpe ratio of the best of 20,000 random strategies that know nothing 60.0%: right on Bitcoin's monthly direction a year or more before the models' release; 46.8% after This is a PDF of the article first published at https://xmarva.github.io/blog/2026/ai-crypto-trading/, where it may since have been updated. The code and measurements behind it are at https://github.com/xmarva/transformers-from-scratch/tree/main/articles/crypto_trading.

标题: Sovereign Bitcoin - A Bitcoin Core-Derived Blockchain with a Sovereign Consensus, Preallocated Monetary Supply and Single-Authority Block Production Architecture
Criptoativos e cadeia de custódia da prova
摘要: O crescimento do mercado de criptoativos e sua popularização no Brasil trouxeram esses ativos para o centro de demandas judiciais, especialmente na persecução patrimonial. Ainda assim, falta teoria consolidada sobre o tratamento probatório das evidências a eles relacionadas. Este artigo examina a aplicação da cadeia de custódia, prevista nos artigos 158-A a 158-F do Código de Processo Penal, às provas envolvendo criptoativos. O marco teórico é a concepção racional da prova. Sustenta-se que a cadeia de custódia se relaciona à fiabilidade do elemento probatório, e não à sua admissibilidade. Por isso, sua inobservância não gera nulidade e deve ser considerada no momento da valoração. A tese central é que a prova sobre criptoativos não constitui categoria unitária: suas modalidades apresentam problemas epistêmicos e jurídicos próprios e se distinguem pelo grau de autonomia do dado em relação a mecanismos externos de verificação. Os dados gravados em blockchains públicas suficientemente descentralizadas se autenticam por simples conferência pública, o que afasta a lógica da cadeia de custódia. Nos dados fornecidos por prestadoras de serviços de ativos virtuais centralizadas, a fiabilidade depende da idoneidade institucional da fonte e da forma de recebimento e manutenção do dado. Nas ferramentas de inteligência de blockchain, o agrupamento de endereços exige validação metodológica da heurística empregada. Já a atribuição desses endereços a entidades do mundo real depende de evidências off-chain, cada uma submetida ao seu próprio regime de custódia. Por fim, quando os dados sobre criptoativos estão vinculados a outras provas digitais, a cadeia de custódia tem aplicação plena e exige cautelas adicionais no manuseio de chaves privadas e frases de recuperação (seed phrases).

标题: Digitalisation de l'audit interne et gouvernance publique : une analyse bibliométrique de la littérature
作者: Amina AMGHAR; MABROUMI Hayat; AISSAOUI Awatif
摘要: Résumé La digitalisation transforme progressivement les pratiques d’audit interne et les mécanismes de gouvernance publique, grâce à l’intelligence artificielle, à l’analyse des données, à l’automatisation des processus et à la blockchain. Toutefois, malgré l’intérêt croissant pour ces technologies, la littérature consacrée spécifiquement à leur application à l’audit interne dans le secteur public demeure fragmentée et insuffisamment structurée. Cet article vise à analyser les dynamiques scientifiques, thématiques, géographiques et intellectuelles des recherches portant sur la digitalisation de l’audit interne et la gouvernance publique. Pour atteindre cet objectif, une revue systématique de la littérature combinée à une analyse bibliométrique a été réalisée à partir de la base de données Scopus. Le corpus final comprend 47 articles scientifiques publiés entre 2014 et 2025. Les métadonnées bibliographiques ont été exploitées à l’aide de l’outil VOSviewer afin d’examiner l’évolution des publications, la visibilité des travaux scientifiques et les réseaux de cooccurrence des mots-clés. Les résultats révèlent une accélération significative de la production scientifique depuis 2022, avec 70% des publications recensées concentrées sur les quatre dernières années de la période étudiée. La cartographie thématique met en évidence la prédominance des recherches associant l’audit interne au secteur public, à l’analyse des données, à la gestion des risques et à la détection de la fraude. En revanche, l’intelligence artificielle, la cybersécurité et la blockchain restent relativement peu explorées dans ce champ de recherche. Cette étude permet ainsi de mieux délimiter le champ scientifique étudié et d’identifier des perspectives de recherche, en particulier l’évaluation empirique des effets de la digitalisation de l’audit interne sur la performance, la transparence et la gouvernance publique. Cependant, les résultats bibliométriques permettent de décrire les tendances de la littérature sans pour autant établir une relation de cause à effet entre la digitalisation et l’amélioration effective de la gouvernance. Mots-clés : Digitalisation, audit interne, gouvernance publique, analyse bibliométrique, secteur public. Abstract Digitalization is gradually transforming internal audit practices and public governance mechanisms through artificial intelligence, data analytics, process automation, and blockchain. However, despite growing interest in these technologies, the literature specifically devoted to their application to internal audit in the public sector remains fragmented and insufficiently structured. This article aims to analyze the scientific, thematic, geographic, and intellectual dynamics of research on the digitization of internal audit and public governance. To achieve this objective, a systematic literature review combined with a bibliometric analysis was conducted using the Scopus database. The final corpus comprises 47 scientific articles published between 2014 and 2025. Bibliographic metadata were analyzed using the VOSviewer tool to examine publication trends, the visibility of scientific work, and keyword co-occurrence networks. The results reveal a significant acceleration in scientific output since 2022, with 70% of the identified publications concentrated in the last four years of the study period. The thematic mapping highlights the predominance of research linking internal audit to the public sector, data analysis, risk management, and fraud detection. In contrast, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, and blockchain remain relatively unexplored in this field of research. This study thus helps to better define the scientific scope under investigation and identify research opportunities, particularly the empirical assessment of the effects of the digitization of internal auditing on performance, transparency, and public governance. However, bibliometric results allow us to describe trends in the literature without establishing a cause-and-effect relationship between digitization and actual improvements in governance.Keywords : Digitization, internal audit, public governance, bibliometric analysis, public sector.

标题: The settlement wedge in Bitcoin valuation
作者: Ren Wang; Yuxiang Bian; Xiong Xiong

标题: PayBench DIM-04 Half B: conformance checks on five test-network rails, data pre-registration
摘要: This registration fixes, before it executes, a confirmatory run of binary conformance checks on five payment rails used by autonomous software agents, the measured annex of PayBench's DIM-04 structural profile. The structural profile states from vendor documentation what each rail's documents say about outcome certainty; this run tests a subset of those documented statements by making payments on public test networks only (Base Sepolia, Stellar Testnet, Solana devnet, Tempo Moderato and Spark's hosted regtest), with tokens that carry no monetary value, Everyday AI Ltd (the company) being the only payer and the only payee. Seven checks are registered, six conformance checks and one descriptive observation outside the conformance count: an identical resubmission cannot settle twice (two checks, one for each protocol family); a fresh signature inside the validity window (descriptive); an artefact presented after its deadline fails conclusively and its death is observable to the payer; a duplicate nonce cannot settle twice; an interrupted flow resolves to a terminal state readable by the payer and value never moves twice; and a settlement outcome reported after a settle that cannot succeed agrees with the network on value. They run as 47 cells, each a statement about one pinned test deployment and the company's own stack, never about a rail in production. Each repetition becomes one binary outcome under a fixed rule, with void rules for harness faults; each cell reports k of K valid repetitions (K = 10, or 20 where the exploratory repetitions disagreed), with its void and not-exercised counts by cause and whether it is complete. Counts only: no interval is computed, and no count is set beside another rail's as the same measurement, since each cell tests a different documented bound on a different software stack. The design was frozen and anchored after declared exploratory runs, whose data is not reused as outcome data, and before the confirmatory run or any publication; the order of the confirmatory repetitions is drawn from the hash of a Bitcoin block mined after the freeze. This registration makes no commitment to publish results.

标题: A Business Intelligence Application for Assessing the Environmental Impacts of Proof-of-Work Cryptocurrencies
作者: Mohammad Alhur; Raed Musbah Alqirem; Abdel Nasir Yousuf Abdelkareem
摘要: Proof-of-Work (PoW) cryptocurrencies create electricity demand globally, but their carbon consequences depend on where the electricity is generated. This study presents CryptoCarbonApp, an open-source R Shiny business intelligence application that expresses network-level energy and emissions estimates for four PoW cryptocurrencies through the electricity system of Jordan, whose generation mix averages about 0.39 kgCO2/kWh. The analysis reports network totals with conditional sensitivity ranges and examines an assumed spatial allocation of mining activity with a 20,000-replication Monte Carlo procedure. On Jordan’s mix, Bitcoin’s network demand corresponds to about 66 MtCO2 per year (50–83 MtCO2 for a ±25% change in network consumption); because this demand is roughly eight times Jordan’s national electricity supply, the figure is an intensity benchmark, not a forecast. A 50 MW facility would emit about 154 ktCO2 per year. The allocation procedure cannot identify actual mining hotspots, and raising the renewable share of supply from 10% to 60% reduces emissions by 55.6% under static accounting. At the September 2025 hashprice, efficient hardware breaks even at about USD 0.12/kWh before other costs, below Jordan’s business tariff of USD 0.169/kWh. Energy labelling at supervised virtual asset service providers is therefore proposed as a conditional, demand-side complement to mining-side instruments.

标题: A Comprehensive Framework for Targeted Transfer Learning: Privacy-Preserving, Secure, and Efficient Domain Adaptation
摘要: Machine learning models deployed in tactical environments rely on high-quality labeled datasets, which are often challenging, expensive, and time-consuming to obtain. In addition, formal techniques for assuring model performance under dynamic conditions remain limited. Transfer learning has emerged as a promising solution, but its effectiveness is limited by domain coverage and similarity between source and target datasets. This dissertation presents a comprehensive, modelagnostic Targeted Transfer Learning (TTL) framework that addresses transferability challenges between domains with minimal data, demonstrating how targeted sample selection improves adaptation across image classification, network security, and privacy-preserving collaborative settings. First, we develop the TTL framework for scenarios where direct access to datasets is restricted. This metadata-driven approach applies to a combinatorial coverage method to estimate domain correlation and guide sample selection. Evaluation on a satellite imagery dataset showed that targeted selection outperformed zero-shot transfer and random selection while conserving computational resources. Second, we investigate the TTL framework in settings where both datasets are directly available. This data-driven approach uses optimal transport distance to quantify distributional differences and guide selection of informative target samples. Validation across a broad set of benchmark image classification datasets demonstrated consistent improvements over conventional transfer learning. Third, we address network malware classification through Selective Targeted Transfer Learning (STTL), projecting source and target traffic data into a shared latent feature space and selecting relevant samples using a Kullback–Leibler divergence-based similarity measure. Experimental results across multiple attack-family scenarios showed that STTL achieved higher performance than conventional transfer learning, confirming that targeted selection generalizes across data types and domains. Finally, we extend the TTL framework through two decentralized privacy-preserving mechanisms. In a federated learning setting, clients share only summary statistics, and a server computes aggregation weights that enable knowledge transfer without exposing local data. In a blockchain-based setting, cryptographic verification secures model weights throughout the transfer process, while a smart-contract mechanism rewards high-quality participation. Both mechanisms consistently outperformed non-targeted baselines while preserving data confidentiality and integrity. This research establishes targeted transfer learning as a practical framework that enables machine learning models to adapt reliably, securely, and efficiently across image classification, network security, and distributed collaborative environments.

标题: The temporal connecting factor: Private international law after the Clarity Act and MiCA
摘要: A digital asset can be born as one thing and become another. The US Clarity Act follows the asset throughout its life and is built to adapt. MiCA, by contrast, fixes the asset’s nature when it is created. Neither law asks the conflict-of-laws question: which law governs an asset whose legal nature changes over time? This article compares the two models from private international law, sets out the problem their divergence creates, and only then turns to doctrine. Building on the classical search for the seat of the legal relationship, from Savigny to Rabel, it builds a theory of the temporal connecting factor and addresses characterisation, party autonomy, overriding mandatory rules, extends the analysis to jurisdiction, recognition and enforcement, and closes with concrete proposals for the HCCH-UNIDROIT Project.

标题: Digital Trade Financing and SMEs Export Intensity in Economic Community of West African States (ECOWAS)
作者: OMALI JOSHUA UGBEDE; OBAYORI JOSEPH BIDEMI
摘要: This study examined the impact of digital trade financing on the performance of Small and Medium Enterprises export intensity in the Economic Community of West African States region (proxy for Developing Economies) over the period 2019 to 2024.The study employed panel data from fifteen ECOWAS member and utilized a robust methodological framework comprising Hausman specification tests, random effects estimations, Difference Generalized Method of Moments, and System Generalized Method of Moments estimators to address issues of endogeneity, unobserved heterogeneity, and dynamic panel bias.The Hausman test results found that, random effect is appropriate hence the application of GMM instrument.The Difference GMM results confirmed strong persistence in export intensity with lagged dependent variable coefficient 0.190627 and probability value 0.0000.The J-statistics for GMM estimations were effectively zero, confirming instrument validity.The study concludes that, digital trade financing exerts significant and heterogeneous effects on SME export intensity performance in the ECOWAS region.Digital standby letters of credit showed negative effects on export intensity.Dynamic discounting strongly supports digital transactions and exports.Internet penetration consistently enables export intensity.The study recommends that, policymakers prioritize digital standby letter of credit development, accelerate digital infrastructure investments and support continued research on digital trade finance and SME export intensity in the ECOWAS region.

标题: Personal innovativeness, attitude to government policy, and electric vehicle adoption in Indonesia: Mediation and moderation effects
作者: Nadia Nila Sari; Mohd Fazli Mohd Sam
摘要: Despite the presence of environmental concerns, including pollution and global warming, Indonesia continues to encounter difficulties in the adoption of Electric Vehicle (EV) products. Government policy has been identified as playing a crucial role on supporting the adoption of EV. However, a paucity of implementation has been observed, which has resulted in a reluctance among the public to adopt EV. The present study examines the role of social influence, environmental concern, price, and technology on the intention to adopt electric vehicles in which attitude towards government policy acts as a mediating variable and personal innovation acts as a moderating variable. The utilization of quantitative methods, employing the Structural Equation Model Partial Least Square (SEM PLS) Software version 4, facilitates the data processing to ascertain the influence of independent, dependent, mediating, and moderating variables. The data collection in this research involved the utilization of purposive sampling with sample size of 300 respondents. The findings of this study demonstrate that price, attitudes towards government policy, personal innovativeness, social influence, and technological advancement have a significant impact on the adoption intention of electric vehicles. Moreover, the findings also demonstrate that environmental concern and price influence the attitude of government policies that mediate their influence on adoption intention. This study hypothesises that personal innovativeness functions as moderating effect between social influence and adoption intention regarding electric vehicles (EVs). Contrary to the findings of numerous other studies, this research posits that social influence exerts the predominant influence on the adoption intention. This study also emphasizes consumer attitudes towards the role of government in terms of providing subsidies, tax reductions, and other forms of support that have the potential to positively influence consumer intention to adopt electric vehicles. It is therefore suggested that company and government prepare a better strategy to develop EV adoption. This research will provide the company with valuable insights into the EV industry and government to formulate more effective policies and strategies to promote the adoption of electric vehicles (EVs) in the future. Keywords: Social Influence, Environmental Concern, Price, Technology, Attitude to Government Policy, Personal Innovativeness, Adoption Intention, Electric Vehicles

标题: ARCADIA : Adaptive Real-time Cross-chain Abuse Detection through Inductive Analysis
作者: Babu Pillai; Aravinda S. Rao; Marimuthu Swami Palaniswami; Vallipuram Muthukkumarasamy
摘要: Cross-chain systems were once praised for enabling seamless blockchain interoperability; however, they are now exploited for money laundering and hiding digital assets. This reveals a significant gap in decentralized compliance and oversight, primarily resulting from the use of obfuscation techniques. This paper introduces a novel Adaptive Real-time Cross-chain Abuse Detection through Inductive Analysis (ARCADIA) framework, designed to identify exploitation of cross-chain systems for illicit purposes. It uses a hybrid machine learning (ML) architecture that adapts to analyse addresses (with and without history), leveraging temporal features and graph-based inductive reasoning. Our approach enables Virtual Asset Service Providers (VASPs) to deploy ML models for real-time risk label generation. Extensive experiments on Ethereum address datasets have demonstrated superior performance in identifying phishing and malicious entities, even under severe data imbalance conditions. Our framework narrows the gap between blockchain forensics, ML, and compliance, offering a scalable solution aligned with emerging regulatory standards such as the Financial Action Task Force (FATF) Travel Rule.

标题: Optimal Trading Speed on Blockchain
摘要: On blockchain-based exchanges, faster blocks weaken the priority-fee competition among arbitrageurs and shift rents from the block producer to them. Equilibrium liquidity peaks at an interior block speed; beyond a threshold, an active liquidity provider cream-skims and passive capital shrinks. Evidence from the Base Flashblocks upgrade, a tenfold block-speed increase, confirms the predictions. Priority-fee bids decrease sharply and arbitrageurs' net profit rises. The active liquidity provider rebalances faster, avoids toxic flow, and earns a higher profit. Pool depth falls and effective spreads widen despite closer tracking of external prices.

标题: Deep learning for cryptocurrency price forecasting: A taxonomy, benchmark, and gap analysis
摘要: Relevance.Cryptocurrency returns are volatile, non-stationary, and heavy-tailed.Purpose.This study develops a unified taxonomy and benchmark with reproducible scoring.Tasks.Representative architectures are compared and measured limitations are separated from proposed remedies.Methods.Ten statistical, linear, recurrent, attention-based, selective state-space, and pretrained models are evaluated on daily Bitcoin/Tether and Ethereum/Tether data from two thousand eighteen to two thousand twenty-six.Three expanding-window folds use horizons of five, ten, and twenty days.A target-history-only control shares post-warm-up calendar rows and normalization.Evaluation uses absolute error, symmetric percentage error, normalized-return directional agreement, and paired tests corrected for temporal dependence and multiple comparisons.Scientific novelty.The benchmark combines architectural coverage, aligned information-set control, and a zero forecast reference.Practical significance.It informs accuracy and resource trade-offs under weak predictive signal.Results.Best absolute-error skill over zero is approximately zero.Bitcoin autoregressive and recurrent model differences are not supported after correction.The recurrent model leads learned-model Ethereum mean absolute error, with many, but not all, pairwise advantages supported.Directional agreement remains near zero point five.TimesFM is the strongest native-input foundation reference; larger Chronos scale gives no consistent gain.Lag-Llama produces over-dispersed forecasts, and its low symmetric percentage error does not establish superior accuracy.Conclusions.This low-signal benchmark supports protocol-specific comparisons rather than exploitable return forecasts.Coverage is limited to two assets, three folds, and zero-shot foundation evaluation.

标题: Repertoires of Contention: Building computational tools and infrastructures for community resistance to bitcoin mining
作者: Marina Johnson-Zafiris; Owen Marshall; Jen Liu; Joseph Ferdinando; Steven J. Jackson; Christopher Csíkszentmihályi
摘要: Recent work in human-computer interaction and allied fields has sought to engage community members as co-designers, facilitators, and decision makers to challenge structural power barriers and knowledge gaps. In this paper, we apply a diverse set of computational techniques to engage and address community concerns surrounding the socio-environmental impacts of the Greenidge Bitcoin mining power plant facility in upstate New York. Through collaborative interactions with community groups, addressing problems ranging from regulatory inertia to thermal water pollution, we aim to facilitate not just the production of new and critical environmental knowledge but also new computationally-supported repertoires of contention: means of contesting the unequal relations of knowledge and power that structure and often determine the outcomes of environmental controversies. We argue such engagements can help support more politically engaged forms of HCI, oriented towards efforts to redress and repair disparities in wealth, knowledge, and influence through strategic sociotechnical interventions and alliances.

标题: Fine-Tuning an Order-Flow Foundation Model for Sub-Second Forecasting
摘要: Generative models have become the standard approach in language and vision. These models are typically pretrained first and then fine-tuned. Recent work demonstrates how to pretrain an autoregressive generative model on Level-3 order-flow data. However, to our knowledge, no one has fine-tuned such a model yet for downstream tasks. Here we first pretrain a 300M-parameter generative model on Level-3 order-flow data collected from two crypto exchanges, Bitstamp and Bitfinex. Then we fine-tune the pretrained model to predict the microprice return and its realized volatility. We show that our fine-tuned model outperforms classical baselines, such as gradient boosting on handcrafted features, in predicting microprice returns over sub-second horizons. Furthermore, the predictive ability of the model transfers zero-shot to assets it was never fine-tuned on. Due to the short-term nature of these forecasts, the predicted microprice moves are smaller than the bid-ask spread plus fees, so the natural applications are in execution and market making. These results indicate that a pretrained generative model can be turned into a competitive short-horizon price forecaster via fine-tuning.

标题: A Decentralized Artificial Intelligence with Confidential Computing and Smart Contract-Based Trust Verification
作者: D. A. Onuma; I. M. Ossai; A. H. Mini; B. M. Kpobe
摘要: Abstract: Decentralized artificial intelligence enables collaborative learning without centralized data collection but remains vulnerable to model poisoning, malicious participants, and insecure execution environments. This study developed a Decentralized Artificial Intelligence Framework with Confidential Computing and Smart Contract-Based Trust Verification to strengthen privacy, integrity, and scalability. Design Science Research Methodology (DSRM) guided framework development and evaluation, while Object-Oriented Analysis and Design Methodology (OOADM) supported modular system design. The framework integrated peer-to-peer learning, Trusted Execution Environments, remote attestation, blockchain-anchored model updates, smart contracts, and adaptive reputation management. Experimental evaluation used seven benchmark datasets: CICIDS2017, CSE-CIC-IDS2018, UNSW-NB15, CICIoT2023, TON_IoT, Bot-IoT, and NSL-KDD. Assessment covered classification effectiveness, trust verification, privacy, attack resilience, computational overhead, latency, throughput, and scalability. Accuracy and F1-score generally exceeded 97%, while integrity verification exceeded 99%. Compared with the strongest evaluated baseline, blockchain throughput increased by 67.1% and maximum supported nodes by 60.0%, while confidential-execution overhead, false-trust rate, and data-leakage rate decreased by 54.4%, 52.3%, and 51.7%, respectively. Detection of model-poisoning, Byzantine, Sybil, and malicious-node attacks also improved, although residual attack success remained. These findings demonstrate the potential of integrating confidential execution and programmable trust governance to secure collaborative AI in distributed cloud and IoT environments. Further operational evaluation is required to establish real-world effectiveness. Keywords: Decentralized artificial intelligence; confidential computing; smart contracts; trust verification; DSRM; OOADM. 标题: Percepciones sobre desarrollo, seguridad y cooperación regional: una reflexión constructivista desde la movilidad académica en El Salvador y su contraste con Colombia
摘要: Este trabajo analiza las percepciones sobre el desarrollo, la seguridad y la cooperación regional en El Salvador y su relación con el contexto colombiano, tomando como punto de partida la experiencia vivida durante la movilidad académica. El objetivo principal es comprender cómo las ideas, las experiencias y las percepciones de una sociedad pueden influir en la manera en que un país entiende su realidad y toma decisiones. Para desarrollar el análisis se tomó como base el enfoque constructivista de las Relaciones Internacionales y se utilizó una metodología cualitativa y comparativa, apoyada en la revisión de documentos, informes institucionales, fuentes académicas y datos estadísticos. A lo largo del trabajo se abordaron los cambios en materia de seguridad en El Salvador, la adopción del Bitcoin como una apuesta por la innovación económica y los mecanismos de cooperación regional, estableciendo una comparación con Colombia. El análisis permitió identificar que la imagen que proyecta un país y la forma en que sus ciudadanos interpretan los cambios sociales y políticos tienen importancia en sus relaciones internacionales. También se encontró que los avances en seguridad y desarrollo deben analizarse teniendo en cuenta sus resultados y las condiciones económicas, sociales e institucionales de cada país. Finalmente, se concluye que Colombia y El Salvador pueden encontrar oportunidades de aprendizaje mutuo mediante el diálogo y la cooperación, reconociendo sus diferencias y evitando adoptar modelos sin considerar las necesidades de cada sociedad.

标题: Comparative Analytical Review of Modern Criminal Legislation Addressing Digital Crimes in Light of Cyber Developments and Artificial Intelligence Technologies
摘要: As a result of the fast growth of the technology and integration with smart systems, there is a basic change in the essence of criminal phenomena. A specific kind of crime that is called "digital crime" arises; it poses certain problems for the criminal law. In the paper, there is a comparative analysis of the existing legislation on the modern policies and regulations in relation to emerging cyber threats in four countries: Iraq, the UAE, France (European Union framework), and the USA. The results indicate the legislative lacunas in the sphere of AI-induced crimes, automated corporate/algorithmic responsibility, and the collection of digital evidence across borders. In the paper, the author provides the standard chain of custody process for digital evidence and draws a distinction between the integrity of the digital evidence and its admissibility in court, and also the guarantees of human rights in the cloud search procedure. 标题: Conceptualising and operationalising kinship-based organised crime: a scoping review
摘要: Abstract Kinship-based organised crime (KBOC) has attracted growing media attention in Northern Europe but remains under-researched in the academic literature. To address this gap, a scoping review was conducted to systematically map how KBOC has been conceptualised and operationalised across diverse geographical, cultural, and research contexts, thereby identifying commonalities, variations, and limitations in existing approaches to the study of KBOC. The analysis identified eight recurring themes through which KBOC is conceptualised and operationalised in the existing literature: intergenerational transmission of crime, concentration of criminal activity, overlap between familial and criminal structures, intermarriage between criminally involved families, marginalisation, governance-related crime, organised criminal activity, and the use of violence. Although these themes vary in their prominence and operationalisation across studies, together they illustrate the different ways in which kinship is understood as relevant to the structure and organisation of criminal activity. The review thus provides a conceptual synthesis of recurring dimensions in the literature, without suggesting that these dimensions are exhaustive or necessarily present in every KBOC network.

标题: Image Rights Infringements: Is the Common Law of Delict Sufficient or is It Time for Legislative Intervention?
摘要: In modern commerce one could argue that the image of an individual constitutes an asset with a substantial intrinsic commercial value that may be used by third parties to generate profit, because the image of individuals is highly exploitable for commercial purposes (specifically in the context of the endorsement, marketing and advertising of brands, products and services). It is common practice for celebrities (and social media influencers alike) to engage in the marketing, merchandising and commercial exploitation of their own image for commercial gain, especially on various social media channels. Since the introduction of these channels it has become a business tool for individuals to generate an income by exploiting their image online. Despite this development and evolution of the use of social media channels, image rights and the protection thereof have not gained much attention in South Africa over the last few years. This raises the question, when an image rights infringement occurs, for example on social media, and an individual cannot rely on contractual remedies to rectify the breach (since there is no valid contract in place to regulate the use), what remedies are available to the individual, who has suffered patrimonial harm for the unauthorised use of their image. Case law has identified the common law of delict as an area of law that may provide plaintiffs in image rights infringement matters with possible relief for the financial loss they suffered due to the unauthorised use of their image. Thus, this article will investigate the common law of delict to determine whether it provides the most appropriate remedy to address image rights infringements outside a contractual agreement, by analysing South Africa case law in this regard.
