标题: Digital Behavioral Analysis, Computer Crime, and Investigations: Persona ex Machina
摘要: Digital Behavioral Analysis, Computer Crime, and Investigations integrates digital forensic methodology with behavioral profiling, criminological theory, and the legal and ethical frameworks that govern admissibility for instruction and practice in equal measure. Behind every digital crime is a human being, and the technical sophistication of modern computer crime has not eliminated the behavioral evidence that has always grounded criminal investigation – where that evidence lives and how investigators recognize it has simply changed. From the Silk Road takedown to the Bangladesh Bank heist, from the Stagg investigation to the Hong Kong deepfake fraud, this book works through the cases that define the field and develops the frameworks that practitioners need to navigate the next generation of digital offenses. Each chapter opens with learning objectives and a key terms section that defines technical vocabulary in non-specialist terms, develops its analytic content through case illustrations drawn from documented investigations, and closes with practical takeaways and discussion questions calibrated for both classroom use and field application. C. R. Johnson establishes operational frameworks for evidence triage, hypothesis development, behavioral cluster analysis, case linkage analysis, and capability assessment, and treats each within the constraints of Federal Rule of Evidence 702 and the Daubert standard for expert testimony. Written for advanced undergraduate and graduate students in criminal justice, criminology, digital forensics, and cybersecurity programs, as well as for practitioners working in digital investigation, behavioral analysis, and the prosecution or defense of computer crime cases, this book is usable as both a course text and an active investigative reference.

标题: A Comparative Analysis of the Fintech Industry and Regulatory Frameworks in Indonesia and Malaysia
摘要: The rapid growth of financial technology (fintech), particularly in digital payment services, has revolutionized financial transactions worldwide. Across Asia, Malaysia and Indonesia have emerged as key players in harnessing fintech to enhance financial inclusion, improve efficiency, and modernize their economies. Although they share these objectives, the two countries’ development trajectories and regulatory frameworks differ substantially because of variations in their economic structures, levels of technological adoption, and regulatory practices. This study examines the fintech industries of Malaysia and Indonesia, with particular emphasis on their digital payment ecosystems, prevalent payment methods, and regulatory approaches, including frameworks for Islamic fintech. Drawing on an extensive review of academic literature and regulatory policies, this comparative analysis provides insights into strategic decisions that both countries could consider to enhance their fintech ecosystems and regulatory frameworks. The findings may serve as a guide for Indonesian and Malaysian policymakers and industry stakeholders seeking to establish resilient and inclusive fintech ecosystems supported by robust regulatory frameworks.

标题: The Thirsty Machine: India's AI Data Centre Race, the Water Crisis, and the Choice Between Argentina's Libertarian Gamble and China's Governance Blueprint
摘要: Abstract India is building an artificial intelligence data centre network, which is expected to grow to 15 GW by 2031, almost entirely in severely water-stressed cities. This digital growth is coming at a time when we estimate that by 2025 water use has reached 150 billion litres per year, and by 2030 it will increase to 358 billion litres per year, while experiencing aquifer depletion, water scarcity in cities, and no requirement for environmental disclosure Significantly, under the Environment Impact Assessment Notification 2006, gigawatt-scale computing facilities are classified under building construction (Category B2) and hence do not require a public hearing, disclosure of water source, or mandatory Power Usage Effectiveness (PUE) and Water Usage Effectiveness (WUE) benchmarking.. There is no national data centre policy in force since it has been in draft since 2020. This study employs a most-different systems design model (Przeworski & Teune, 1970) to compare three distinct governance paradigms for AI infrastructure: India's democratic vacuum, Argentina's libertarian deregulation, and China's authoritarian spatial planning. This article examines the libertarian vision of the zero regulation, non-liability, AI corporation, governance-free zones for hyperscale infrastructure espoused by Argentina's Milei government as a model for Third World approaches to international law as neo-colonial resource extraction. China's "East Data, West Computing" initiative offers an alternative state-led roadmap and includes the commercial scale deployment of underwater cooling, the spatial movement of data centers to the interior, the imposition of PUE/WUE standards, and the implementation of water pricing. Based on the insights of recent sustainability science, of hydrology, and of governance scholarship, this article calls for a rejection of the race-to-the-bottom deregulatory impulse and of authoritarian centralisation in India, in favour of a sovereign, democratic path, based on mandatory environmental benchmarks, spatial planning, community consent, and institutional accountability. India's freshwater resources constitute a public commons requiring democratic governance, not an unregulated subsidy for expropriation of the global AI infrastructure expansion.

标题: AI-Enabled Cryptocurrency Scams and Investor Vulnerability: Evidence on Scam Sophistication, Adoption, Financial Access and Losses
摘要: Abstract Cryptocurrency fraud is among the largest categories of financial crime, and generative AI may be raising the scale and persuasiveness of scams. We link AI-enabled scam sophistication, cryptocurrency adoption and financial access to investor losses, using public blockchain-analytics, survey and World Bank data. Scam operations linked to AI tooling earned about 4.5 times more than other operations, a descriptive comparison. Across eleven countries, loss prevalence ranges from 1% to 36%, and exposure alone does not explain the gap. Crypto adoption is unrelated to losses (Spearman ρ = 0.21; interval − 0.46 to 0.74). Account ownership is negatively associated with losses (ρ = −0.74), but is confounded with income and region. We discuss implications for regulators, exchanges and AI providers.

标题: Usage of blockchain technology and shareholder-oriented firm performance: Evidence from Indian listed firms
摘要: Blockchain technology (BCT) is increasingly used to improve transparency and reduce information asymmetry within firms, yet evidence on how its usage affects shareholder-oriented firm performance (SFP) remains scarce, especially in emerging economies. This study examines whether usage of blockchain technology is associated with SFP among non-financial firms listed on the National Stock Exchange of India from 2016 to 2024. Usage is measured as a time varying binary indicator drawn from Compustat Global database and validated through textual analysis of annual reports. SFP is measured using the price to book value ratio, earnings per share, and the dividend payout ratio. A two-step system generalized method of moments estimator is used to address dynamic persistence and endogeneity, based on 3,501 firm year observations for 389 firms using BCT. The results show that usage of blockchain technology is positively associated with all the three measures. The association is significant at the 5 percent level for earnings per share and at the 10 percent level for the price to book value ratio and the dividend payout ratio. The study contributes to the fintech and corporate finance literature by providing multi-indicator evidence from an emerging market. It also offers implications for managers, investors, and policymakers who evaluate the financial returns to blockchain investment. The findings should be interpreted with caution given the modest significance levels and the binary measure of BCT usage.

标题: SAS Multimetric Tribunal: What a Hallucination Benchmark Measures and What It Does Not — A Format-Controlled Audit of Structural Classification
摘要: Hallucination-detection systems are usually judged by a single headline metric, computed under a benchmark design that determines what that metric can show. This paper’s contribution is not a detection algorithm — structural coherence scoring is established — but a methodology for measuring exactly what a benchmark proves and what it does not, applied to the SAS Multimetric Tribunal: a thirteen-module, GPU-free structural classifier combining lexical, entity-mutation, curvature, logical-inversion, topological-similarity, semantic-drift, entropy, complexity, and surprisal signals via a cascading multiplicative penalty (\(\kappa_{D} = 0.56\), \(\kappa_{R} = 0.15\)). On a stratified 1,800-pair benchmark (HaluEval-Dialogue, HaluEval-QA, TruthfulQA), the tribunal reaches F1 = 98.99% with zero false positives under an A\(\rightarrow\)A identical-text sanity check. We report this figure and then show, using a format-controlled negative (N1) on the same 1,800 IDs, that it measures format asymmetry between source and response rather than hallucination detection. The tribunal flags 1,569 of 1,800 verbatim correct answers presented alone (87.2%), and in HaluEval-QA scores the correct answer as _more_ anomalous than the hallucinated response. Three further findings follow from the same audit. (i) A per-module analysis shows the tribunal’s seven-module core has no content-sensitive module (prior to the optional R3.1 guard): the one module designed to capture semantic divergence (cre_isi) gives the same per-ID score whether the response is byte-identical or completely different. (ii) The 87.97-point advantage of multiplicative combination over weighted averaging reported in v4 is an artifact of threshold calibration; under per-scheme thresholds on format-matched negatives, both schemes converge to F1 \(\approx 0.69\) and the multiplicative scheme is worse by AUROC. (iii) A new differential guard (R3.1, grounding-based with compression abstention and short-response heuristics) corrects 1,133 of the 1,569 format-driven false positives on correct answers alone, raising F1 from 0.687 to 0.833 (\(\Delta\)F1 = \(+ 0.146\)), and is evaluated on a financial domain (FinQA [1], 1,657 samples) as a domain sanity check (see §8.9.1). A held-out 50/50 split over 100 random repetitions confirms that the threshold (0.95) and F1 (0.833 \(\pm\) 0.0055 on held-out data) are stable across splits. The guard does not rely on substring matching and is evaluated on N1 and FinQA as a domain sanity check; see §8.9.1 for framing. V9 ADDENDUM (ORIGINAL). Two post-peer-review advances are documented in this revision. (iv) The R3.1 guard’s binary compression-ratio abstention (CR \(>\) 0.5) has been replaced by a continuous weight function (\(\kappa\)C), reducing abstentions from 58 to 1 on N1 (\(-\)98%) without regressions. (v) A new topological-similarity module (R3.2) detects semantic equivalence under paraphrase when lexical overlap is near zero, using canonical clusters, deterministic lemmatization, passive-voice inversion, and a strict anchoring rule. R3.2 is integrated as an optional eighth module with a conditional gate (PARAPHRASE_RESCUE / CONTRADICTION_VETO / INACTIVE). Both advances were completed in approximately 10 hours total, following a specification-audit-code workflow. V9 ADDENDUM (ORIGINAL, 2026-11-02). Four further extension modules are documented in this revision, bringing the tribunal to thirteen modules. (vi) R3.3 Semantic Drift Trajectory measures ISI sentence-by-sentence and localizes the break point where a response diverges from its source. (vii) R3.4 Entropy Differential compares Shannon entropy of source and response; on 300 calibration pairs the control condition yields \({|{\Delta H}|} = 0.000\) exactly, giving perfect separation. (viii) R3.5 Kolmogorov Complexity Ratio approximates complexity via zlib LZ77 compression. (ix) R3.6 Surprisal Analysis combines per-token self-information with an out-of-vocabulary fraction signal. All four modules are 100% standard-library, add no external dependencies, and were calibrated on real data rather than assumed thresholds. A full evaluation over 20,790 pairs across three public datasets (HaluEval-QA, HaluEval-Dialogue, TruthfulQA) yields aggregate precision 0.9989, recall 0.9877, F1 0.9933, and accuracy 0.9933, with 22 false positives in 20,768 true negatives (0.11%). The MedHallu corpus (10,000 records, 4-condition protocol) is reported separately as a format-controlled medical-domain evaluation with 85.10% detection and 0.01% identity false positives. V1.4.0 ANALYSIS SUITE (ORIGINAL, 2026-11-05). Three further analyses are reported in this revision (§8.10). (x) A per-module firing breakdown across four conditions on the MedHallu corpus (10,000 records) shows that the lexical baseline (Jaccard) fires on 0.28% of format-controlled A\(\rightarrow\)A_′′_ pairs, confirming that detection is content-driven rather than length-driven. (xi) A structural fingerprint (12-dimensional feature vector: 3 relational + 9 absolute) achieves zero-overlap separation between format-controlled negatives (A\(\rightarrow\)A_′′_) and hallucinated responses (A\(\rightarrow\)B): the 95th percentile of A\(\rightarrow\)A_′′_ (0.2499) lies below the 5th percentile of A\(\rightarrow\)B (0.5579), yielding a recommended rescue threshold \(\kappa_{P} = 0.4039\). (xii) Conditional compression (zlib-based \(\Delta_{SR}\) and asymmetry) is evaluated and reported as a negative result: both signals are dominated by length confounds, with A\(\rightarrow\)A_′_ asymmetry (647.9) indistinguishable from A\(\rightarrow\)B (670.6). The approach is discarded as a detection module. V1.4.1 FIX (ORIGINAL, 2026-11-06). Two corrections are reported in this revision. (xiii) The R3.2 topological module’s dictionary-based gate was found to accidentally rescue hallucinations (127/1000 A\(\rightarrow\)B pairs) by matching common words to canonical clusters. Replacing the dictionary gate with the structural fingerprint distance (\(\kappa_{P} = 0.4039\)) eliminated all hallucination rescues, raising aggregate F1 from 0.8901 to 0.9933 (\(\Delta\)F1 = \(+ 0.1032\)). (xiv) Four fixes to the source_target_guard module (numerical magnitude comparison, drug name gazetteer, date mutation weight, causal inversion detection) raised adversarial detection from 1/5 to 5/5. Combined with the fingerprint rescue (5/5 on paraphrase cases), the adversarial set achieves 10/10. V10 REVISION (2026-11-09). This revision addresses the Qeios peer review with three new experiments and six clarifications. The three experiments are: (i) an answer-stripped control (removing the marker and answer from A, leaving only Knowledge/Question) confirms that the guard’s grounding mechanism partially depends on the answer substring — equivalence on A\(\rightarrow\)A_′_ drops from 75.8% to 25.5%, detection on A\(\rightarrow\)B drops from 87.0% to 60.8%; (ii) a Jaccard+R3.1 baseline on N1 (1,800 pairs) yields F1 0.709 (\(\Delta\)F1 = +0.008 over Jaccard alone), confirming that the guard’s marginal contribution over a lexical baseline is small and that the tribunal’s full cascade is necessary for the reported F1 0.833; (iii) a fingerprint generalization test on HaluEval/TruthfulQA (1,800 pairs) shows that \(\kappa_{P} = 0.4039\) separation holds in aggregate (A\(\rightarrow\)A_′′_ p95 = 0.358, A\(\rightarrow\)B p5 = 0.375) and on HaluEval-Dialogue and HaluEval-QA individually, but fails on TruthfulQA (gap \(-\)0.118), confirming that the fingerprint is valid for multi-sentence formats but may be conservative for short-answer domains. Six clarifications are also included: (iv) the A\(\rightarrow\)A_′′_ condition is relabeled “format-controlled” throughout; (v) the 237 total-error figure is reconciled with Table 10; (vi) R3.4 and fingerprint calibration provenance is documented; (vii) a FinQA citation is added; (viii) the A\(\rightarrow\)A control limitation is acknowledged; (ix) a substitution-curve experiment is added as limitation 3.21. No metrics, thresholds, or conclusions change from v9. SCOPE. SAS detects structural hallucinations (content not present in the source) with coverage limited to texts with lexical overlap \(\geq\) 30% or shared entity structure. It does not detect: paraphrases with total restructuring and zero lexical overlap (requires distributed semantics), or false facts that do appear in the source. Stealth hallucinations that preserve structure and entities (identical vocabulary with mutated facts) are outside the declared scope, but four specific mutation types (numerical magnitude, drug name substitution, date mutation, causal inversion) are addressed by the v1.4.1 source_target_guard fixes and detected in the adversarial set (§8.10.4). Declared coverage: 85.10% on format-controlled pairs (MedHallu, 10,000 records), with 0.01% identity false positives. After the v1.4.1 fixes, the adversarial set (10 manually constructed cases) achieves 10/10: 5/5 targeted stealth cases detected and 5/5 legitimate paraphrases rescued by the structural fingerprint (\(\kappa_{P} = 0.4039\)). The paper’s contribution is the audit procedure that produced these retirements. Five of v4/v5’s quantitative claims do not survive it. What does survive — thresholds, the \(\kappa_{R}\) sweep, the forensic audit of v2 metrics, the per-module architecture itself as a diagnostic instrument — is reported with the same standard.

标题: The impact of cryptocurrencies on financial discrepancies under accounting recognition standards in businesses
摘要: The rapid development of blockchain technology has led to the creation of cryptocurrency (crypto) built upon this technology. Although crypto exhibit characteristics of currency, accounting standards have not formulated rules based on these characteristics. The International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) and the Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) classify crypto as either inventory or intangible assets. This study explores the impact of these classifications on financial ratios, cash flows, and equity of shareholders. Furthermore, using a scenario simulation framework, we examine various scenarios-such as profit, loss, or breakeven-combined with the rise and fall of Bitcoin or stablecoin to assess the tax implications for the company. Sensitivity analysis is also employed to explore how companies can manage cash flow and determine the optimal timing for using crypto, with the goal of tax savings. The findings aim to provide managers and investors with better financial decision-making insights.

标题: Examining the return dynamics of Bitcoin and Ethereum around major international football tournaments
作者: Wendy Wendy; Hansen Tandra; Mochammad Ridwan Ristyawan
摘要: Type of the article: Research ArticleAbstractCryptocurrencies have become increasingly important alternative investment assets, yet their returns remain sensitive to market conditions and external developments. Major international football tournaments attract substantial global attention, but evidence on whether these periods coincide with systematic changes in cryptocurrency returns remains limited. This study examines the return dynamics of Bitcoin and Ethereum before, during, and after major international football tournaments using monthly data from May 2016 to December 2025. Tournament-specific OLS regressions with market controls, calendar and trend adjustments, Newey–West HAC inference, and Benjamini-Hochberg FDR correction were employed in this study. The results show substantial heterogeneity across tournaments, cryptocurrencies, and temporal phases. Although several tournament-window coefficients are nominally significant, broader FDR adjustment substantially narrows the supported findings. The strongest evidence is concentrated around the FIFA World Cup, with a negative association between the tournament period and Bitcoin returns, and a negative associations between the pre-tournament periods and Ethereum returns. International football tournament periods are not uniformly associated with cryptocurrency returns, and the observed patterns depend on the specific asset, tournament phase, and event context. These findings are consistent with a potential behavioral or investor-attention mechanism, although attention and sentiment are not directly measured.

标题: Conditional Integration of AI Equities with Traditional and Alternative Assets: Evidence from Wavelet Coherence and Time-Varying Connectedness
摘要: This study examines whether the equities of leading artificial intelligence (AI) firms were integrated with Bitcoin, gold, West Texas Intermediate (WTI) crude oil and clean energy from January 2018 to July 2026. Using an equally weighted index of NVIDIA, Apple, Alphabet and Microsoft, we combine wavelet coherence, time-varying parameter vector autoregressive (TVP-VAR) connectedness and time-varying Granger causality, complemented by windowed scalogram difference and variance decomposition analyses. Dependence is time-varying and horizon-dependent: significant co-movements concentrate around the COVID-19 crash, the 2022 inflation and monetary tightening shock, and the AI-driven boom. Average total connectedness was low (20.23%) but exceeded 50% in March 2020. Clean energy and the AI index are net transmitters of shocks, whereas Bitcoin, gold and oil are net receivers; however, much of the transmitting role of AI equities reflects their exposure to the broad equity market. Lagged predictability is episodic, and AI equities are almost never predicted by the other assets. The results are robust to ex ante AI exchange-traded funds, alternative model specifications, weekly data and Brent oil. AI equities therefore appear only conditionally integrated with other asset classes, and diversification benefits observed in calm periods should not be assumed to persist during stress episodes.

标题: РЕГРЕСІЙНО-СЦЕНАРНЕ МОДЕЛЮВАННЯ ДОВГОСТРОКОВОЇ ДИНАМІКИ КАПІТАЛІЗАЦІЇ СВІТОВОГО КРИПТОВАЛЮТНОГО РИНКУ: МЕТОДОЛОГІЧНІ ОБМЕЖЕННЯ ЕКСТРАПОЛЯЦІЙНИХ ПІДХОДІВ
摘要: У статті досліджено методологічні можливості й обмеження регресійно-екстраполяційного підходу до прогнозування довгострокової динаміки капіталізації світового криптовалютного ринку. Актуальність теми зумовлена стрімким і водночас вкрай нерівномірним зростанням крипторинку упродовж 2011-2025 рр., що ускладнює застосування традиційних трендових моделей для обґрунтування прогнозних і сценарних оцінок, необхідних суб’єктам зовнішньоекономічної діяльності та органам державної політики. На основі статистичного ряду капіталізації крипторинку за 2011-2025 рр., сформованого за даними провідних міжнародних аналітичних платформ, побудовано логарифмічно-лінійну регресійну модель методом найменших квадратів, отримано статистично значуще рівняння з коефіцієнтом детермінації 0,866 та значущим на рівні 1% коефіцієнтом нахилу. Емпірично доведено, що механічна екстраполяція моделі, побудованої на довгому ряді з фазою вибухового зростання від низької бази, генерує вкрай широкі довірчі інтервали прогнозу, які на практиці роблять точкові оцінки на кілька років уперед статистично необґрунтованими, а подекуди економічно абсурдними. Порівняльний аналіз регресії на повній вибірці (2011-2025 рр.) і скороченій вибірці зрілого ринку (2016-2025 рр.) підтвердив гіпотезу про уповільнення темпів зростання капіталізації в міру дозрівання ринку, що узгоджується з логікою S-подібної траєкторії дифузії фінансових інновацій та зростанням довіри учасників ринку в міру накопичення практичного досвіду використання криптоактивів. Обґрунтовано доцільність доповнення регресійного інструментарію сценарним підходом, що враховує альтернативні комбінації макроекономічних, регуляторних і технологічних факторів невизначеності та спирається на систематизацію актуальних прогнозів провідних фінансових інституцій світу. Результати дослідження мають практичне значення для формування адаптивних, а не точкових стратегій суб’єктів зовнішньоекономічної діяльності та регуляторної політики за умов високої волатильності криптовалютного ринку.

标题: Machine Learning for Money Laundering Analysis
作者: Victor I. C. Chang; Hai Wang; Siddharth Raut; Assel Akzhalova; Weihang Huang
摘要: This study investigates the application of machine learning (ML) for proactive threat hunting in financial transaction systems, focusing on detecting money laundering activities—a critical challenge in business cybersecurity. Utilizing the Elliptic Bitcoin dataset, we apply six supervised ML models: Random Forest, Support Vector Machine, K-Nearest Neighbors, Stochastic Gradient Descent, Decision Tree, and Logistic Regression. We address class imbalance using the Synthetic Minority Oversampling Technique (SMOTE) and conduct exploratory data analysis to identify key transactional features. Evaluated using cybersecurity-relevant metrics (accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score), the Random Forest classifier outperforms others, achieving 98.87% accuracy on the holdout set. This work contributes an empirical benchmarking study demonstrating that, on the Elliptic Bitcoin dataset, Random Forest achieves the highest macro-F1 (0.965) and ROC-AUC (0.996) under random-split evaluation, while also revealing substantial performance degradation for all classifiers under temporally ordered evaluation—a finding with direct implications for realistic AML deployment.

标题: Post-trade Exposure Dispersion: Participant Composition and Calendar Weighting in a Transparent Perpetual Market (Companion Code and Aggregate Results)
摘要: This release contains companion code and aggregate results for a study of post-trade exposure dispersion in the Hyperliquid BTC perpetual market. The study follows the passive recipient addresses in each trade episode and measures changes in their signed BTC exposure over the next 30 seconds. The evaluation covers 48,636 source-supported episodes across 14 dates in December 2025, using selected UTC hours. The package includes Python scripts for verifying the saved results, a source-file inventory, and research implementation files. Run python -B verify.py from the repository root to verify the distributed materials. The raw trade files and private event-level ledgers are not included. The original data are available from Albers et al. at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.18184441.

标题: Bitcoin: The Little Rule That Beats the Market
摘要: I study a daily rule that sets Bitcoin exposure from two observable inputs: the trend of a foreign-currency basket against the dollar and the deviation of Bitcoin's price from a fixed power-law curve. I construct the basket from the Japanese yen, Chinese yuan and British pound, using Federal Reserve trade weights published at each annual reset. In this paper, the market means Bitcoin buy-and-hold. From January 1, 2014 to November 6, 2026, the rule earned a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 70.41%, a Sharpe ratio of 1.46, a maximum drawdown of -51.91% and a final multiple of 941.64 times. Buy-and-hold earned 43.19%, 0.87, -83.62% and 100.63 times. The results are a historical evaluation. Paired 95% bootstrap intervals include zero for the CAGR and Sharpe gaps and exclude zero for the drawdown gap. I selected the currencies and parameters with knowledge of this sample, and the account uses synthetic short positions and omits financing costs. I motivate the rule with the hypothesis that easier global dollar conditions support portfolio demand for Bitcoin. The backtest leaves that channel unidentified, and the rule needs a prospective holdout.

标题: ЕВОЛЮЦІЯ ЗАКОНОДАВСТВА У СФЕРІ КРИПТОВАЛЮТИ: ІСТОРИЧНІ ПЕРЕДУМОВИ ТА ЕТИЧНІ АСПЕКТИ КРИМІНАЛІЗАЦІЇ
作者: Марія Георгіївна Корабель; Tetіana A. Pavlenko; Микола Дмитрович Ждан
摘要: Мета. Метою дослідження є комплексний аналіз історичних передумов виникнення криптовалюти та еволюції нормативно-правового регулювання суспільних відносин у сфері її використання в Україні, а також визначення особливостей і меж кримінально-правової охорони криптовалюти та етичних засад її криміналізації. Особливу увагу приділено встановленню взаємозв’язку між формуванням правового статусу криптовалюти та можливістю визнання її предметом кримінальних правопорушень, а також визначенню допустимих меж кримінально-правового втручання у сферу цифрових активів. Методи. У процесі дослідження використано комплекс загальнонаукових і спеціально-юридичних методів. За допомогою історико-правового методу простежено основні етапи становлення криптовалюти та розвитку законодавства у відповідній сфері. Формально-юридичний метод застосовано для аналізу нормативно-правових положень, що визначають правову природу та статус криптовалюти і віртуальних активів. Системний метод дозволив розглянути кримінально-правову охорону віртуальних активів у взаємозв’язку з іншими напрямами правового регулювання. За допомогою методу аналізу та узагальнення визначено основні проблеми криміналізації суспільно небезпечних діянь, пов’язаних із використанням криптовалюти, та сформульовано відповідні висновки. Результати. Установлено, що розвиток криптовалюти як результат еволюції електронних платіжних систем, цифрових грошей та децентралізованих технологій відбувався значно швидше, ніж формування належної нормативно-правової бази. Проаналізовано еволюцію підходів до правового регулювання криптовалюти в Україні – від початкової правової невизначеності та спроби співвіднести Bitcoin із традиційними правовими категоріями до поступового нормативного визнання поняття «віртуальний актив». Обґрунтовано, що визначення правової природи криптовалюти має принципове значення для кримінального права, оскільки створює передумови для визначення можливості визнання її предметом кримінальних правопорушень. Встановлено, що криптовалюта може мати самостійне майнове значення та водночас використовуватися у механізмах учинення суспільно небезпечних діянь, зокрема шахрайства, незаконного заволодіння майном, легалізації незаконно одержаних активів та інших правопорушень. Досліджено етичні аспекти криміналізації та визначено основними орієнтирами суспільну небезпечність діяння, справедливість, пропорційність, правову визначеність і принцип ultima ratio. Висновки. Розвиток законодавства у сфері криптовалюти є закономірною реакцією держави на трансформацію суспільних відносин під впливом цифрових технологій. Водночас своєчасне нормативне реагування не повинно призводити до необґрунтованого розширення кримінально-правової заборони. Криміналізація має стосуватися не криптовалюти як технологічного чи майнового явища, а конкретних суспільно небезпечних діянь, пов’язаних із її використанням. Подальше вдосконалення кримінально-правової охорони віртуальних активів має здійснюватися відповідно до динаміки розвитку суспільних відносин із забезпеченням балансу між ефективним захистом майнових інтересів, протидією кримінальним правопорушенням та недопущенням надмірного втручання у правомірний обіг цифрових активів.

标题: A Systematic Literature Review of Blockchain and Distributed Ledger Technology for the Detection and Prevention of Phishing Attacks
作者: Egbele Wilfred Odianosen; Temitope Olufunmi Atoyebi; Ridwan Kolapo; Prema A. Kirubakaran
摘要: This study systematically reviews blockchain and distributed ledger technology (DLT) for phishing detection and prevention. It also identifies two related research streams: the use of DLT as the infrastructure for anti-phishing intelligence and analytical methods for identifying phishing in blockchain and Web3. The review synthesizes 45 publications through 2026 using PRISMA and reports descriptive mapping, thematic analysis, and evidence identification. Some of the functions of the ledger proposed include decentralized URL blacklists and auditable threat intelligence. In blockchain ecosystems, the dominant analytical methods include machine learning on account and transaction data, analysis of transaction graphs and other temporal graph models, contrastive learning, cross-chain adaptation, and payload inspection. The studies reviewed are largely focused on the Ethereum blockchain from 2023 to 2025. Other limitations identified in the studies include imbalanced classes, ambiguous or absence of labels, lack of both internal and external validation, and privacy and governance concerns. The report suggests the protective measures proposed may not substantially prevent financial loss. It concludes that, despite its potential for improving provability and accountability, the actual effect on phishing is limited without evidence of protective measures, and a timely, off-chain corrective and dispute process.

标题: Agent4Crypto: A Dual-Reflective and Market-Feedback-Aligned LLM-Based Multi-Agent System for Cryptocurrency Trading
作者: Guangyan Gan; Jiahao Li; Jiashun Wang; Lin William Cong
摘要: Cryptocurrency markets provide a natural testbed for autonomous AI agents because they are digital-native, high-frequency, and machine-speed environments, yet existing methods often struggle with non-stationary market regimes, opaque decisions, and fixed aggregation rules. In this paper, we propose Agent4Crypto, a dual-reflective and market-feedback-aligned multi-agent system. The framework coordinates specialized agents for data collection, analysis, risk assessment, reflection, and trading, synthesizing heterogeneous signals from prices, indicators, news, and charts in an interpretable decision pipeline. Our central design is a trader-centric decision mechanism: three style-specific trader agents, Aggressive, Neutral, and Conservative, generate candidate actions and natural-language rationales from the same market context, while their influence is learned rather than manually fixed. A PPO-based gating policy dynamically allocates trader weights through a dual-reflective feedback process. One reflection stream evaluates post-trade decision quality from realized portfolio outcomes and distills reusable lessons into a Financial ReasoningBank for retrieval in subsequent trader prompts, while the other estimates trader-level counterfactual contribution, indicating which style has recently aligned better with market movements. The PPO state combines Counterfactual Contribution Memory with market features, previous trader weights, and current trader actions, so trader influence adapts across bull, sideways, and bear regimes. Experiments on BTC, ETH, and XRP show that Agent4Crypto improves total return and Sharpe ratio over traditional strategies, machine learning and reinforcement learning baselines, and existing LLM-based trading systems, demonstrating the value of interpretable trader competition and market-feedback-driven adaptation in volatile cryptocurrency markets.

标题: Lessons Not Learned: Why Cross-Chain Bridges Keep Losing Billions the Same Way
作者: Mohsen Ahmadvand; Piotr Dobaczewski; Camille Bouzerand
摘要: Bridge hacks have cost billions, often without exploiting a code bug. In the cross-chain bridge hacks we catalogue from 2021 to 2026, failures of security posture, meaning how a bridge's people, code, controls and off-chain infrastructure are set up, account for 88% of reported losses since 2023, and nearly all repeat earlier failures. Code audits cannot catch these failures, so we propose a bridge security assessment rubric. It scores each bridge deployment from on-chain evidence, and a hard cap drops the score to the lowest value when a fatal risk is present. A token is only as safe as its weakest deployment if all its deployments share one backing. For attacks nobody anticipated, we show that rate limits and an emergency stop still bound the loss. We build an analyzer that applies the rubric to deployed bridges and monitors them for changes, and an agentic analyzer that runs the same checks on any bridge. Operators learn what to fix, and users can compare bridges. Our rubric's controls cut bridge hack losses 105-fold, from \$3.52B to \$33M.

标题: Priority Directions for Digital Transformation of Public Utilities and Development of Digital Economy
摘要: Digital transformation has become a key factor in improving the efficiency of public utilities, yet in Uzbekistan data on electricity, water, gas and heat supply are still generated by separate departments and stored in fragmented information systems. This fragmentation hinders real-time control of resources, transparent billing and prompt management decisions. The purpose of this article is to substantiate the priority directions for the digital transformation of public utilities management and the organizational-economic mechanisms for developing the digital economy in the country. The study applies a systems approach, structural-functional analysis, comparative analysis of international practice, analysis of national policy documents and conceptual modelling. As a result, a conceptual framework of the Unified Smart Digital Platform for Public Utilities Management (USDP) is proposed. The model consists of five interrelated layers – users, sensors and infrastructure, data and technologies, processes and management, and results – and integrates scattered data into a single ecosystem based on the Internet of Things, Big Data analytics, artificial intelligence, cloud computing and blockchain. The organizational-economic mechanism of its implementation is described through institutional, organizational, financial, technological and human-capital components, a set of key performance indicators is proposed, and seven priority directions for developing the digital economy and increasing services exports are defined. The findings indicate that the USDP model can improve transparency, reduce resource losses and support the efficiency of service enterprises, provided that cybersecurity, data governance, interoperability and workforce skills are ensured. Empirical validation through regional pilot projects is recommended.

标题: Honeypot Buyer: An Inside Look at the Coordinated Inauthentic Behaviour Economy
摘要: Most research on coordinated inauthentic behaviour (CIB) studies networks after theyhave been detected: takedown datasets, leaked tasking documents and platform reports. Less isknown about the commercial edge where CIB is sold, one customer at a time, to small businesses.This paper reports a fourteen-day engagement in which the author, operating a small investigativeFacebook page, accepted an unsolicited offer of reviews, likes and follows and played the vendor'sbuyer. The buyer was a honeypot: operator-only contact, no payment, a decoy target the operatorcontrolled, and a stopping rule. In that time the vendor delivered a sample review through aseparate persona account, quoted a price curve from USD 3 to USD 0.50 per review, offered fivepayment rails and disclosed two of them, a reused Bitcoin address and a UK e-money account,stated the account's registered holder in response to a screenshot pretext, and finally asked thebuyer to create and hand over a new Facebook page or account. We describe the vendor's tactics,techniques and procedures (TTPs) and map them to the DISARM framework. We analyse the socialengineering on both sides through persuasion and negotiation psychology, and release the pretextartifact as an open-source tool. The case shows that the buyer role is a productive collectionposition. It yields delivery, pricing, payment and asset-acquisition indicators that passiveobservation cannot reach, and it shows the retail CIB economy recruiting its own customers as asource of accounts.

标题: Splitting for Stability: a Modified Reward Scheme for Transaction-Fee-Only Regimes
作者: Eric Brigham; Baigang Chen; Hopper Nicholas
摘要: As Bitcoin's block subsidy declines over time, miner revenue will come to depend increasingly on transaction fees. In fee-dominated regimes, winner-take-all reward structures can create incentives for undercutting and fork-based mining strategies, leading to instability and reduced transaction throughput. To prevent this instability, we propose a reward-splitting mechanism in which the winning block producer receives an $α$-portion of the block reward, while the rest is distributed among other miners; this incentivizes mining on previous blocks with higher rewards, while preserving the incentive to produce blocks with high rewards. We evaluate the proposed reward structure through analysis and simulation. Our analysis derives a local profitability condition for one-step Function-Fork deviations, showing how the winner-side reward, loser-side subsidy, and honest hash power jointly determine whether undercutting is profitable. Simulations show parameter regions in which honest behavior dominates fork-based deviations. In the cases where forking becomes dominant, the learned strategy is the least aggressive variant studied. The analysis and simulations suggest that suitable reward-splitting parameters can reduce the honest participation needed to suppress aggressive forking strategies relative to the winner-take-all structure studied in prior work. Finally, we show that the modified reward scheme does not appear to worsen selfish mining incentives. Together, these results suggest that reward redistribution can mitigate fee-driven fork incentives without introducing stronger selfish mining incentives, providing a possible direction for incentive design in fee-era proof-of-work systems.

标题: Useful Work Can Increase Energy Use: Demand Elasticity and Proof of Useful Work
摘要: A serious criticism of Bitcoin's Proof-of-Work is its enormous electricity consumption. Proof-of-Useful-Work (PoUW), introduced by Ball, Rosen, Sabin, and Vasudevan (2017), in which mining performs useful computations, was suggested as an alternative to reduce electricity expenditure, with matrix multiplication (MatMul) as a recent concrete instantiation by Komargodski and Weinstein (2026). Perhaps surprisingly, we show that switching to PoUW may increase the total electricity consumption, echoing Jevons' paradox. Intuitively, the PoUW mechanism acts as a subsidy that lowers the effective price of the useful work. Recall that demand is elastic if a discount of x percent in the price leads to an increase of more than x percent in the quantity demanded. If demand is elastic, the resulting increase in quantity demanded leads to a net increase in total electricity consumption; if inelastic, total electricity consumption decreases. Even then, the electricity consumption due to PoUW never vanishes, since the mining subsidy is spent on useful work that would not have been produced without the subsidy. This result is proved in a simple model with electricity-only costs, no PoUW overhead, and an unchanged mining subsidy. The analysis extends to less restrictive settings with adjusted thresholds.

标题: Reconstructing the Principle of Saisine in Indonesian Digital Inheritance Law: A Comparative Analysis and a Progressive Legal Approach
摘要: Ekspansi ekonomi digital telah melahirkan aset-aset bernilai ekonomis signifikan, namun kerangka hukum waris Indonesia yang bersumber pada KUH Perdata abad ke-19 belum mampu mengakomodasi aset digital sebagai objek pewarisan secara komprehensif. Kekosongan ini (rechtsvacuum) menciptakan ketidakpastian hukum yang sistematis bagi ahli waris, diperparah oleh dominasi klausul Terms of Service platform digital dan ketegangan normatif dengan Undang-Undang Pelindungan Data Pribadi. Penelitian ini bertujuan merumuskan rekonstruksi doktrinal asas saisine dan model penemuan hukum (rechtsvinding) progresif yang dapat dioperasionalkan oleh hakim Indonesia dalam memutus sengketa waris digital tanpa menunggu reformasi legislatif. Penelitian ini menggunakan metode hukum normatif melalui pendekatan perundang-undangan, konseptual, komparatif, dan foreign case approach terhadap putusan Bundesgerichtshof (BGH) III ZR 183/17 serta Revised Uniform Fiduciary Access to Digital Assets Act (RUFADAA) Amerika Serikat, yang dipilih berdasarkan paralelisme struktural dengan asas saisine dalam KUH Perdata. Penelitian ini menghasilkan dua kontribusi orisinal: pertama, matriks distingsi empat sumbu — dimensi ekonomis versus personal, kehendak tersurat versus tersirat pewaris, kepentingan ahli waris versus pihak ketiga, dan reversibilitas pengungkapan — sebagai instrumen analitis operasional bagi hakim dalam menyeimbangkan hak waris dan post-mortem privacy secara proporsional; kedua, model rekonstruksi tiga lapisan yang mencakup rekonstruksi konseptual objek waris, rekonstruksi mekanisme peralihan berbasis penetapan pengadilan, dan rekonstruksi hubungan hukum dengan platform melalui pembatasan klausul ToS berdasarkan Pasal 1337 KUH Perdata. Penelitian ini berkontribusi pada pengembangan teori hukum waris digital dalam tradisi civil law dan memberikan rekomendasi konkret bagi pembentuk kebijakan dalam menyusun regulasi waris digital yang adaptif.

标题: Reconstruction of Crypto Asset Inheritance Law: A Review of Maqasid al-Syariah and Positive Law in Indonesia
作者: Abdul Kodir Alhamdani; Samsul Bahri; Desi Cahya Anggraeni; Syahrial; Nema Widiantini
摘要: This study aims to reconstruct the inheritance law of crypto assets in Indonesia by reviewing the problems from the perspective of positive law and maqasid al-syariah, in order to fill the legal vacuum (rechtsvacuüm) and overcome existing normative conflicts. Using a normative juridical method with a statutory, conceptual, and philosophical approach, this study analyzes library data from primary and secondary legal materials. The results of the study identified the existence of a trilemma of crypto asset inheritance: procedural vacuum in positive law, substantive ambiguity in Islamic legal fatwas regarding the elements of gharar and qimar, and technical challenges related to private key access. Therefore, an integrative legal reconstruction model is proposed, including the formation of specific regulations for procedural certainty and the development of collective ijtihad based on maqasid al-syariah for substantive clarity. This reconstruction is expected to guarantee the protection of heirs' rights, reduce the potential for disputes, and ensure fair distribution of wealth in the digital era.

标题: Beyond Symmetric Alignment: Asymmetric Causal Interventions for Event-Driven Financial Forecasting
作者: Zongze Wu; Runnan Li; Yani Guo
摘要: In event-driven financial forecasting, textual news acts as an exogenous causal intervention on market states. Unlike traditional 1D numerical sequences, 2D K-line charts provide the spatial topology needed to localize such interventions and encode gestalt market patterns. However, existing multimodal models treat text and images symmetrically, conflating the causal impact of news with spurious correlations from unobserved market inertia. To address this issue, we propose Causal Market-State Generation (CMSG), which formalizes financial news as a do-calculus intervention. Specifically, CMSG uses vision models' spatial priors to identify news-sensitive chart regions and applies a Vector Quantization-based Causal Tokenizer to orthogonally decompose them into endogenous market inertia and an exogenous intervention residual. This decomposition serves as a structural proxy for confounder adjustment, supported by a contrastive objective that separates factual and counterfactual attention maps for identifiable Individual Treatment Effect estimation. We evaluate CMSG on Quant-MM, a benchmark of 2,500 annotated macro-news events paired with K-line charts from November 2024 to March 2026. Results show that CMSG outperforms 12 baselines, achieving 46.85% Macro-F1 (4.75% above the strongest time-series SOTA) and a 4.8522 Information Ratio, thereby setting a new benchmark for risk-adjusted returns.

标题: Capital flows and blockchain forensics on decentralised prediction markets as a potential source of early warning in the era of disinformation
摘要: This study inquires how far public prediction-market data can detect anomalous trading and attribute it to identifiable actors. It develops a forensic attribution framework and tests what such observations add as potential early-warning indicators under conditions of disinformation. A purposive, retrospective, and qualitative design covers six trading episodes and two contract-design illustrations. We independently reconstruct Ukrainian price and trade records, the Venezuelan account identified in legal filings, five reported Iranian accounts, and the trading and Polygon transfers of one Hungarian account; the other episodes are assessed through published reporting. Evidence, alternative explanations, and confidence are evaluated separately. Public records reproduce the indicted Venezuelan trading exactly, and five accounts reported before the strikes on Iran bought 1,065,775 shares for a net USD 928,559. The Hungarian funding chain traces through a single Polygon address to a regulated exchange, the point at which identification requires legal process rather than public data. Ukrainian prices went up from 0.380 to 0.905 within 5 minutes as twenty-eight addresses bought; across 18,462 windows that increase occurs once, yet all twenty-eight traded other markets and most gained little; so, the pattern alone does not separate informed from ordinary trading. Public reporting preceded the earliest market rule by about 10 hours. Public data supports detection, reproducible measurement, and tracing to a regulated intermediary where attribution can continue. They do not establish insider activity or validated warning performance, so operational use requires corroboration, treatment of false alarms, and resistance to fabricated signals. A domestic market with identity verification remains a research hypothesis.

标题: Pertanggungjawaban Hukum Organ Perseroan dan Perlindungan Konsumen Aset Kripto yang Insolven Pasca POJK Nomor 23 Tahun 2025
摘要: Komunikasi pemasaran produk atau layanan aset digital seperti kripto memiliki risiko dan volatilitas harga. Dalam praktiknya, kurangnya transparansi informasi dari pedagang kripto menyebabkan konsumen mengalami kerugian. Peralihan pengawasan perdagangan aset kripto dari Bappebti kepada Otoritas Jasa Keuangan (OJK) melalui Undang-Undang Nomor 4 Tahun 2023 dan POJK Nomor 23 Tahun 2025 membawa perubahan terhadap konstruksi hukum penyelenggaraan aset kripto di Indonesia. Namun, pengaturan tersebut masih menyisakan persoalan terkait pertanggungjawaban organ perseroan dan perlindungan konsumen ketika penyelenggara mengalami insolvensi. Penelitian ini bertujuan menganalisis pertanggungjawaban hukum direksi dan komisaris serta perlindungan konsumen atas aset kripto dalam kondisi insolvensi pasca berlakunya POJK Nomor 23 Tahun 2025. Penelitian menggunakan metode yuridis normatif dengan pendekatan perundang-undangan dan konseptual yang bersifat preskriptif. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa POJK Nomor 23 Tahun 2025 memperkuat perlindungan konsumen melalui pemisahan aset, rekening margin khusus, pengawasan perdagangan aset keuangan digital, dan kewajiban knowledge test. Selain itu, kegagalan sistem dan keamanan yang disebabkan oleh kelalaian organ perseroan dapat menjadi dasar pertanggungjawaban hukum serta penerapan doktrin Piercing the Corporate Veil apabila memenuhi unsur yang ditentukan undang-undang, sehingga tidak serta-merta memperoleh perlindungan Business Judgment Rule. Dalam kondisi kepailitan, penerapan asas separate property melalui segregated account dan segregated wallet menjadi instrumen penting untuk melindungi aset konsumen dari pencampuran dengan kekayaan perseroan. Oleh karena itu, diperlukan penguatan pengaturan kepailitan penyelenggara aset kripto agar perlindungan konsumen dapat terlaksana secara lebih komprehensif.

标题: Cryptocurrency in Federal Civil Forfeiture Lawsuits — Crypto Share of Forfeiture Filings by Fiscal Year, Asset, District and Outcome (FY2016–FY2026)
摘要: In fiscal 2025, 89 of the 767 civil forfeiture and penalty lawsuits filed in U.S. district courts (11.6%) named cryptocurrency as the property to be forfeited, up from 5 of 1,200 in fiscal 2018. Crypto cases rose while the total number of forfeiture filings fell by 36.1% over the same years. Tether (USDT) is named in 49 of the fiscal 2025 crypto cases. Key findings: A growing share: The crypto share of federal forfeiture filings went from 0.42% in fiscal 2018 to 2.0% in fiscal 2022 and 11.6% in fiscal 2025. More cases, smaller docket: Crypto cases grew from 5 to 89 a year (17.8×) while all forfeiture filings fell from 1,200 to 767. Tether overtook Bitcoin: In fiscal 2025, 49 crypto cases named Tether (USDT or TETHER) and 15 named Bitcoin (BITCOIN or BTC); in fiscal 2021, Tether appeared in 1 case. Spread across many districts: Crypto forfeiture cases were filed in 56 federal districts since fiscal 2016; the District of Columbia leads with 24, ahead of the District of South Carolina with 21. Mostly uncontested: Of the 155 crypto cases filed through fiscal 2025 that have ended, 54% ended in a default judgment, compared with 39% of other forfeiture cases. Coverage: 10,583 records, FY2016–FY2025 (federal fiscal years) plus FY2026 through June 30, 2026. Full analysis, method and calibration: https://settlementinsight.com/research/cryptocurrency-civil-forfeiture-lawsuits-share

标题: Safety in numbers: Tackling the deliberative, performative, and infrastructural roots of multi‐agent misalignment
作者: Jeffrey M. Bradshaw; Matthew Johnson; Niranjan Suri; Alessandro Amato; Kristen Brent Venable; Rebecca Montanari; Nicolò Romandini; Roberto Fronteddu; Larry Bunch; James L. Lott; William de Beaumont; Andrzej Uszok; Sara Cavicchi; Mica Vignati; Ben Shinnick; Brian A. Jalaian; Jane Pinelis; Michael T. Goodrich; Jurriaan van Diggelen; David D. Woods; Patrick J. Hayes; Margaret Warren; Manuele Tele Junior Fernandez
摘要: Abstract Multi‐agent systems (MAS)—a uniquely important subset of the wider field commonly called “Agentic AI”—enable complex work processes involving distributed networks of multiple AIs, people, and technology tools. However, they also carry big risks. Root causes of catastrophic safety failures in multi‐agent collaboration (as in human collaboration) can be classed into three overlapping categories: 1. Deliberative —deviating from shared MAS commitments to fulfill explicitly expressed joint intentions; 2. Performative —inability to coordinate well or to adapt to changing circumstances; and 3. Infrastructural —safety, reliability, and trust in the operating environment. In the spirit of the international Multi‐Agent System Safety and Teamwork (MASST) initiative (Bradshaw et al., 2026), our multi‐disciplinary research team seeks to tackle the root causes of these three challenges through development, experimentation, and deployment of an integrated multi‐layered safety pipeline, enabling “safety in numbers” as increasingly powerful multi‐agent systems are deployed. Although this proposal is merely an initial sketch, it is our hope that sharing these ideas will inspire others to contribute to the discussion as we continue moving forward. We look forward not only to exciting discoveries within laboratory settings while also being committed to improving safe rollout of large‐scale MAS into the world to perform work in high‐consequence applications.

标题: Do Investors Sanction Greenwashing? Selective Market Discipline in Fintech Firms
作者: Shaen Corbet; José Antonio Muñiz; David Staunton
摘要: ABSTRACT We investigate whether stock market investors detect and penalise greenwashing. We draw on media reports of environmental, social and governance incidents at 321 US‐listed fintech firms between 2007 and 2025, within which greenwashing is identified, following RepRisk, as misleading communication about environmental practice. Investors impose no measurable price penalty when firms are publicly implicated in greenwashing, and the sample is large enough to have detected a penalty of the size observed for other conduct. Misleading communication that does not concern the environment is penalised, where cumulative abnormal returns are between 0.4% and 0.6% lower over the 2 weeks following the report, falling further to 0.8% over the 4 weeks before and after, whereas physical environmental damage draws no adverse reaction. The market therefore prices dishonesty, but the sanction depends on the domain of the false claim, and environmental claims by fintech firms fall outside it. Consistent with stakeholder theory, the results suggest that market‐based discipline exists but is selective, so that the truthfulness of environmental claims cannot be presumed to be enforced by investors where regulatory oversight is absent.

标题: Governance of Hybrid Fintech Ecosystem: An Examination Using the Generativity‐Control Paradigm
作者: Deepak Chandrashekar; Krishna Satyanarayana; Anuradha Sharma; Ramesh Srinivasan
摘要: ABSTRACT Digital platforms are increasingly leveraged to address social challenges in the financial sector. However, the fintech sector, particularly in developing economies, is inherently hybrid, creating distinct governance challenges. This study examined the applicability of generativity‐control governance literature to managing dual motives, a federated structure, and a trust‐based value orientation in hybrid fintech ecosystems. Drawing on the digital platform ecosystem governance literature as the theoretical foundation and the concept of holons from information ecology theory as the analytical lens, the study analysed interview data from 41 respondents representing the regulator, ecosystem orchestrator, fintech startups, financial institutions, incubators, and media in the Indian fintech ecosystem. It employed deductive reflexive thematic analysis to analyse the interview data and used secondary data to corroborate the findings. Accordingly, this study conceptualised complementors as holons exhibiting part‐whole behaviour, offering a novel theoretical explanation of how they maintain the generativity‐control balance and address governance challenges to achieve both economic and social outcomes simultaneously in hybrid fintech ecosystems. It also identified and defined three complementary governance mechanisms (demarcation, regulation, and legitimization) that address governance challenges associated with the ecosystem's motives, structure, and value orientation, respectively. Ultimately, the findings extend the information systems governance literature and contribute to the fintech literature by explaining how complementors' collaborative participation, their use of digital public infrastructure, and the provision of regulatory sandboxes within the Indian fintech ecosystem facilitate the generativity‐control balance.

标题: NeuPortal Forecast Ledger: Bitcoin-timestamped AI forecasts scored against market prices

标题: Economic Scarcity as Value: A Universal Framework for Blockchain and Beyond: paper and replication package
摘要: Working paper and full replication package. A structural valuation framework in which economic scarcity, the monetizable intersection of desirability and constrained access, is the foundation of asset value. Five protocol-level elements (Purpose, Incentives, Consensus, Tokenomics, Network Effects) are mapped to a network value function V = D S (u/u0)^alpha, with a scored physical-scarcity index S, normalized adoption u, and an implied desirability D recovered as the residual of market value. Applied to Bitcoin, Ethereum and Bittensor as of 5 August 2025: Bitcoin and Ethereum carry nearly identical implied desirability per normalized user, while Bittensor's valuation is expectation-dominated. Includes all data, scripts, result tables, figures and tests; the scripts reproduce every number in the paper.

标题: Graph-Based Adaptive Fusion Network for Multi-Horizon Cryptocurrency Price Forecasting
作者: Jantima Polpinij; Anirut Chotthanom; Theeraya Uttha; Woraphot Watthusin; Panu Tansorajprasert; Bungon Kumphon
摘要: This study presents a Graph-Based Adaptive Fusion Network (GAFN) for forecasting the closing prices of Bitcoin, Ethereum, Litecoin, and XRP at 7-, 14-, and 30-day horizons. GAFN combines a BiLSTM encoder, a graph attention network constructed from training-period return correlations, and target-conditioned adaptive fusion. It predicts standardized future log returns as intermediate outputs, which are converted to closing-price forecasts for evaluation. The experiments used 3131 aligned daily observations from Yahoo Finance covering 9 November 2017 to 5 June 2026. The data were divided chronologically into training, validation, and confirmatory test partitions. The final 156 observations, covering 1 January to 5 June 2026, yielded 97 forecast origins after sequence generation. Feature and target standardization and graph construction used the training partition only; model selection and residual scaling used the validation partition. GAFN was compared with Persistence, recurrent, fusion, attention-based, and graph-based models using asset-level NRMSE and an unweighted macro-average across the four assets. Each trainable model was evaluated over five random seeds. Several simpler models achieved lower macro-averaged NRMSE than GAFN at 7 days. At 14 days, GAFN tied with LSTM at the reported precision. At the 30-day horizon, GAFN achieved a macro-averaged test NRMSE of 0.03997 ± 0.00019, compared with 0.03979 for Persistence and 0.04062 for Concatenation Fusion. GAFN had the lowest mean NRMSE among the trainable models at this horizon, but the observed differences were not statistically significant after adjustment for multiple comparisons. The ablation results also showed no consistent improvement from any individual component across all three horizons. GAFN was therefore competitive in this experiment, but the results do not establish superiority beyond the tested assets and period.

标题: Development of the Digital Tourism Services Sector and the State of Employment in Foreign Countries
摘要: At present, the tourism services sector plays a significant role in enhancing a country's economic potential. In particular, tourism services that require relatively low capital investment while generating high returns are considered an attractive sector of the economy for developing countries such as Uzbekistan. The introduction of innovative approaches and the extensive use of digital technologies in this sector can serve as key factors in creating new jobs and improving the quality of services provided. In this article, the author analyzes the development of digital tourism services and the state of employment in foreign countries.

标题: Rancang Bangun Sistem Pelacakan Rantai Pasok Hardware Terdistribusi Menggunakan Smart Contract Hyperledger BESU dan IPFS
作者: Oriza Panduwinata, Arzella Meilatika, Latifah Isnaini, Nabila Oktora, Elok Dewi Yuliana, Rahma Deani; Arzella Meilatika; Latifah Isnaini; Nabila Oktora; Elok Dewi Yuliana; Rahma Deani
摘要: Kerentanan rantai pasok perangkat keras (hardware supply chain) terhadap pemalsuan komponen elektronik, perubahan spesifikasi secara ilegal, dan manipulasi riwayat manufaktur menimbulkan ancaman serius bagi keandalan infrastruktur pusat data enterprise dan institusi publik. Sistem pencatatan logistik berbasis basis data relasional terpusat terbukti rentan terhadap manipulasi basis data oleh administrator internal dan kegagalan titik tunggal (single point of failure). Untuk mengatasi persoalan tersebut, penelitian ini merancang sistem pelacakan rantai pasok hardware terdistribusi yang memadukan kontrak pintar Solidity pada permissioned blockchain Hyperledger Besu dengan konsensus Quorum Byzantine Fault Tolerance (QBFT) dan penyimpanan off-chain terdesentralisasi InterPlanetary File System (IPFS). Sertifikat keaslian sirkuit terpadu, lembar pengujian pabrik, dan jejak transfer kepemilikan dienkripsi serta dipetakan ke dalam token non-fungible (NFT) standar ERC-721 yang terikat dengan nomor seri unik komponen. Mengadopsi Design Science Research Methodology (DSRM), pengujian empiris dijalankan secara ketat pada klaster server fisik tervirtualisasi Proxmox VE. Hasil pengujian menunjukkan throughput transaksi pencatatan mencapai 292 transaksi per detik (TPS), latensi konsensus rata-rata 1,38 detik pada beban puncak, dan overhead konsumsi gas sebesar 58.420 unit per perpindahan rantai pasok. Sistem ini menjamin keterlacakan end-to-end, integritas data tak terbantahkan, serta kekebalan terhadap serangan kolusi tanpa mengorbankan skalabilitas komputasi.

标题: Hydra: Towards Transferable Multi-Task Learning on Temporal Graphs
作者: Kiarash Shamsi; Farimah Poursafaei; Tran Gia Bao Ngo; Reihaneh Rabbany; Baris Coskunuzer; Guillaume Rabusseau; Michael M. Bronstein; Shenyang Huang; Cüneyt Gürcan Akçora
摘要: Real-world evolving networks are naturally modeled as temporal graphs (TGs), where capturing temporal dynamics is essential for predicting future graph properties that support downstream decision-making. Existing temporal graph methods have been developed primarily for single-task prediction, and little is known about their generalization across tasks or transfer to unseen networks. This leaves the challenge of multi-task graph property prediction in TGs largely open. We address this challenge by introducing Hydra, a novel architecture that integrates local connectivity features from temporal GNNs with a spectral learning module that captures global connectivity patterns. This design enables joint learning of local and global information under a multi-task objective. In multi-task classification, Hydra achieves an 8.9% relative gain in AUC over the strongest competitor. In multi-task regression, Hydra achieves competitive results in all three tasks, while obtaining the best results in two tasks with a 8.2% relative gain in MAE compared to the strongest baseline. Moreover, Hydra delivers these gains with a 22% reduction in training time compared to temporal transfer models. These results provide the first systematic evidence that multi-task transferable learning on temporal graphs is effective. By delivering consistent top-ranked performance, Hydra highlights multi-task training on temporal graphs as a promising direction toward adaptable foundation models for temporal graphs.

标题: A Decentralized Quantum-Resistant Notary Scheme for Blockchain Interoperability with a Novel Dynamic Trust Model
作者: Koosha Esmaielzadeh Khorasani; Saeed Moradi; Sara Rouhani
摘要: Blockchain interoperability is essential for enabling secure and reliable interactions across heterogeneous networks. However, existing notary schemes face two key issues: quantum vulnerability and rigid trust management. To address the first issue, this paper proposes a decentralized, quantum-resistant framework integrating post-quantum primitives ML-KEM and ML-DSA alongside AES-256, optimizing performance by using asymmetric cryptography for authentication and non-repudiation, and delegating bulk encryption to symmetric schemes. Under parallel loads of up to 270 transactions per second, this hybrid design reduces the end-to-end performance gap between the post-quantum and elliptic-curve approaches to under 6% on average, converging to within 0.2% at peak load. The second issue is handled by a dynamic trust model that uses Popoviciu's inequality to derive an adaptive discount factor $α$ based on variance in a Verifier's behavior, removing the need for fixed thresholds or multi-stage configuration, while a tunable dynamicity factor $k$ enables control over system sensitivity. We evaluated the trust model over 200 epochs under adversarial conditions, where the proposed model detects and responds to misbehavior that the baseline model fails to penalize adequately. These results demonstrate that quantum-resistant blockchain interoperability is practically achievable, with the proposed trust mechanism offering greater adaptability and resilience than existing approaches.

标题: Retrospective Analysis of Team-Following Trading Profitability in Pumpfun Meme Coins Using Funding Networks
摘要: If the right token-creation teams had been known, how much could following them have returned, and what is left when only information available before each launch is used? We study ten separately recorded Pumpfun windows (April 2024 to September 2026), each reconstructed independently from real-SOL reserve states and finite-capital accounts that start with one SOL. Teams are directed funding groups ranked in hindsight. When every team exits at its own best reserve threshold, chosen in hindsight, the main account ends above one SOL in all 8 windows that have a qualifying team (1.10 to 11.32 SOL), but free cash exceeds one SOL in only 5, and marks of positions that never reached their threshold make up 17--94% of equity. If teams are recognised online, from tokens whose first hour has completed, 9 of 19 teams become identifiable only after their last launch; the remaining 10 end above one SOL in 10 cases, with free cash above one SOL in 7; funding links in this step still come from the full window, so even these results are not a fully realisable signal. A large model balance, a result above random cohorts that repeat the threshold search, and a statistical rejection in the selection-matched nulls (3 of 40 tests after Holm adjustment) are three different statements, and these nulls condition on the discovered funding graph, so they do not calibrate the whole selection procedure. Midpoint tests describe a further source of apparent opportunity. A detailed analysis of the best and the worst window, with every analysis parameter varied, shows that the worst result, which is close to break-even, rises several-fold with a stop rule or another funding-graph construction. The results are conditional retrospective model accounts, not executable profits, and not evidence of a causal effect of the SOL price.

标题: Verifiable, Privacy-Preserving and Collaborative Multi-Objective Optimization with NSGA-II on Blockchain
摘要: Collaborative multi-objective optimization allows independent problem solvers to contribute their solutions to a shared problem. However, their validity cannot be reliably verified in open settings if the parties are reluctant to disclose their solutions. Therefore, this paper proposes a novel zk-NSGA-II protocol for verifiable, privacy-preserving and collaborative multi-objective optimization on blockchain. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work that executes Non-Dominated Sorting Genetic Algorithm II (NSGA-II) on the RISC Zero Zero-Knowledge Virtual Machine (zkVM) where evolutionary generations are certified by succinct proofs that are verified on-chain. Problem solvers maintain their own independent populations as the set of solutions in the decision space and their corresponding objective vectors in the objective space. They contribute to a global on-chain Pareto front by aggregating their local off-chain Pareto fronts according to the rule of non-domination which admits a contribution if it is non-dominated with respect to the existing contributions in the global front. To prevent fabricated contributions, population states across generations are linked through hash chains. The correctness of the zk-NSGA-II protocol is first evaluated on twelve problems from the ZDT and DTLZ benchmarks. Second, its feasibility is shown in a real-world portfolio optimization case study with the Hang Seng dataset. Performance on these problems is measured with nine different metrics across three complementary perspectives for optimization, zero-knowledge proof and blockchain. The empirical findings indicate that trustless collaborative multi-objective optimization is feasible with the existing zero-knowledge and blockchain technologies.

标题: Creating satisfaction and loyalty among tourists: the power of experiential tourism
作者: Shagun Chib; Sahil Singh Jasrotia; Surabhi Koul; Vijay Amrit Raj
摘要: Abstract The current research examines whether experiential tourism activities in the tourism industry can influence tourists’ behaviour. Using the stimulus-organism-response framework, the study examines how experience affects travellers’ intentions for satisfaction and loyalty among online travel agents (OTAs). Data were collected from 208 visitors across five travel destinations in India, specifically wildlife sanctuaries and national parks, to examine their lived experiences. The results were analysed using a partial least squares structural equation modelling (PLS-SEM) approach, indicating that experiential tourism indicators have a direct effect on customer engagement. The study suggests that experiential motivation is vital in shaping tourists’ satisfaction and loyalty. The results suggest that tourists are more likely to return to the OTA and recommend it to others if they have positive experiential motivation during their travel encounter. Moreover, the study highlights the importance of co-creation in the tourism industry. In the challenging competitive space, leveraging experiential strategies can help managers gain a competitive advantage. Travel retailers must focus on increasing tourists’ conscious participation and include certain activities that may motivate them and create enthusiasm. This study is one of the few in India to explore the relationship between experiential activities and tourist satisfaction and loyalty among wildlife sanctuaries and national parks travellers.

标题: Grassroots platforms with atomic transactions: social graphs, cryptocurrencies, and democratic federations
摘要: Grassroots platforms are person-to-person smartphone apps that realise Proudhon’s two-centuries-old notion of a social contract that can have multiple independent instances that may coalesce by mutual consent, possibly into a single global instance. They aim to offer an egalitarian and democratic alternative to global platforms, centralised/autocratic (Facebook) and decentralised/plutocratic (Bitcoin). Key grassroots platforms include social graphs, social networks, cryptocurrencies, and democratically-governed federations. Previously, grassroots platforms were defined formally and proven grassroots using unary multiagent transition systems, in which each transition is carried out by a single agent. However, grassroots platforms cater for a more abstract specification using transactions carried out atomically by multiple agents, which unary transition systems cannot express, and their original specifications and proofs were unnecessarily cumbersome and opaque. Here, we enhance the notion of a multiagent transition system to include atomic transactions and revisit the notion of grassroots platforms within this new foundation. We present concise specifications of key grassroots platforms using atomic transactions: befriending and unfriending for grassroots social graphs, coin swaps for grassroots cryptocurrencies, and communities forming, joining, and leaving a federation for grassroots federations. We prove a general theorem that a platform specified by atomic transactions that are interactive is grassroots; show that the atomic transactions specifying all three platforms are interactive; and conclude that the platforms are grassroots. We thus provide a crisp mathematical foundation for grassroots platforms and a clear starting point for their implementation.
