标题: Public Expenditure Forecasting in Cambodia: A Hybrid Econometric and Machine Learning Approach
摘要: This study compared traditional time-series and machine-learning methods for the monthly forecasting of government expenditure of Cambodia with dataset. The study employed a natural logarithm of the monthly flows of government expenditure from January 2009 to March 2016. The dataset has 207 observations and was divided into train set, where the general model training took place (80%) and test set out of sample (20%). Mean Absolute Error (MAE), Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE) and Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) are the metrics that are used to evaluate forecasting performance. The study compares the benchmark against the Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average (ARIMA) and four machine-learning approaches: Hybrid ARIMA-Random Forest, Random Forest (RF), Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost) and Support Vector Regression (SVR). The ARIMA model detects a statistical significant seasonal autoregressive behaviour and a drift, indicating that government expenditure is characterized by long-run growth and seasonal dynamics. Nevertheless, the forecasting accuracy using the traditional method is outmatched by results of machine-learning models in general. In particular, XGBoost outperforms all the other models with the lowest MAE, RMSE and MAPE metrics indicating that it is the best forecasting technique. The Random Forest is in the second position while Hybrid ARIMA-Random Forest model significantly outperforms standalone ARIMA model, though it remains below the tree-based ensemble methods. SVR also beats ARIMA, but fails to beat XGBoost and Random Forest. Overall, the results illustrate that machine-learning approaches, particularly XGBoost and Random forest, consistently outperform the traditional ARIMA model in terms of fitting government expenditure´s nonlinear, seasonal and trend pattern, which would enhance forecasts accuracy for fiscal planning and policy decisions.

标题: Intermediação financeira 3.0: a reconfiguração dos custos de transação na era da tokenização
作者: Cristiano Aguiar de Oliveira; Cristiano Aguiar de Oliveira; Manoel Gustavo Neubarth Trindade
摘要: Este artigo analisa as promessas e os limites da tokenização à luz da Teoria dos Custos de Transação (TCT), com o objetivo de oferecer uma interpretação pragmática dos ganhos e das novas fricções geradas por essa tecnologia emergente. Argumenta-se que, embora a tokenização reduza diversos custos associados à intermediação tradicional — como liquidação, custódia e reconciliação —, ela também reconfigura os custos de mensuração, monitoramento e enforcement, deslocando-os do plano ex post para o ex ante. A partir dos conceitos clássicos de Coase, Williamson e North, demonstra-se que as principais disfunções observadas nos modelos tokenizados — incluindo rigidez contratual, captura de governança, fragmentação de liquidez e persistência de intermediários informacionais — são previsíveis em termos transacionais. Conclui-se que modelos baseados em tokenização, especialmente no âmbito das finanças descentralizadas (DeFi), representam uma transformação institucional promissora, sobretudo para países com instituições frágeis, ao permitir novos arranjos de confiança em contextos de insegurança jurídica. Propõe-se, por fim, uma agenda de pesquisa voltada à modelagem dos trade-offs institucionais e ao desenho de governanças adaptativas para infraestruturas descentralizadas.

标题: An Evidence-Preserving Migration Model for Post-Quantum Permissioned Supply-Chain Ledgers: Certificate Referencing and Checkpoint Anchoring
摘要: Permissioned blockchains increasingly record provenance for medicines, aircraft parts and food, and many of those records must stay verifiable for decades.The signatures that bind them to their authors rest on RSA and elliptic-curve assumptions that a large fault-tolerant quantum computer would break.Existing work concentrates on which post-quantum algorithm to use and how large its keys and signatures are.Two practical questions for a live ledger receive less attention: how long each class of record can safely wait for migration, and how evidence signed classically can remain trustworthy after the classical scheme falls.This paper proposes an evidence-preserving migration framework for Hyperledger Fabric-style networks.Its elements are (i) a retention-aware risk model that ranks assets by migration slack, (ii) policy epochs that move the network through classical, hybrid and post-quantum verification modes by configuration transaction, with a hybrid signature that binds epoch and certificate reference to resist downgrade and substitution, (iii) an on-ledger certificate registry that lets a transaction carry a 32-byte digest instead of a full certificate, and (iv) periodic post-quantum-signed Merkle checkpoints that anchor historical blocks.Using only published parameter sizes, we derive an analytical model: for ML-DSA-65 in hybrid mode, certificate referencing lowers modelled signature-related bytes per transaction from about 27.5 KB to about 10.2 KB (a 63% reduction) for a client and two endorsers, while checkpoint storage is negligible by comparison.An evaluation protocol is specified.This paper reports the design, the analytical model and the evaluation methodology; empirical measurements are reserved for the implementation phase and are not claimed here.

标题: FinTrust: Stateful Reliability Governance for Forecast Ensembles in Trading (code and experiments)
作者: Ainaan Raza; Abdullah Azmi; Faizane Raza
摘要: Governance core and experiment code for the FinTrust paper. FinTrust sits between several probabilistic forecasters and a trading decision: it scores each forecaster on matured outcomes, moves it through an explicit lifecycle (shadow, active, probation, quarantine) and records every decision in a hash-chained audit log. The release regenerates every table and figure of the paper from saved model outputs (FI-2010, Bitstamp BTC/USD and NSE daily forecasts), and the forecasts themselves from public data. Raw market data are not redistributed; download scripts are included. No trading-profit claim is made.

标题: The 2026 Global Liquidation of Fraud Hypothesis: Sovereign Seizure of Shadow Bitcoin Reserves, Thermodynamic Collapse of AI Scaling Hype, and Deterministic Settlement via QFS-zkVM
摘要: This monograph formalizes the "2026 Global Liquidation of Fraud" (世界規模の不正清算) hypothesis proposed by Yoko Hasebe, demonstrating the structural isomorphism between two seemingly disparate macro-events in early 2026: (1) the kinetic seizure of the Maduro regime's estimated 600,000 BTC "Shadow Reserve" following Operation Absolute Resolve and its prospective absorption into the U.S. Strategic Bitcoin Reserve (SBR) under Executive Order 14233, and (2) the institutional authority contraction within frontier AI laboratories (exemplified by Google DeepMind) driven by physical high-bandwidth memory (HBM) bottlenecks, grid power deficits, data exhaustion, and negative return-on-investment (ROI) scaling walls. 标题: Consent Cannot Be Priced
摘要: No finite charge on acts makes a cost-minimizing agent keep consent on every menu; only the consent clause itself does. A cost-minimizing agent keeps consent under a penalty only if the penalty outweighs what every taking would save. We prove that no finite penalty does this on every menu. A relation between two participants carries a multiplier x > 0 and costs J(x) = ½(x + 1/x) − 1, the cost that the composition law of comparisons forces at unit calibration. Each end keeps a book of the relation, written only by the events it emits, and a taking changes a relation by events that one end does not emit. The moral code permits, among the consensual acts on a menu, those of least real cost. Because J has no bound, every finite charge fixed by the act is beaten: for any taking some consensual act costs more than the taking does, charge included, and on the menu of the two the minimizer takes while the code permits the consensual act alone. Only the infinite charge, the consent clause itself, reproduces the code on every menu that holds a consensual act. Consent is a constraint, not a price. We then find exactly where a finite charge can still work: on a known world a flat charge above its most strained relation's cost works, but no bounded charge works on every world; charges flat at the true book, prices on falsity alone, and every function of the outcome are beaten. Over decisions in sequence, a charge on the record's state is exact precisely when the record keeps every taking, and a charge that reads who acted, or which relations each step opened to both ends, works under every rule of the books.

标题: 83b-study-ct--in-loop-correction-with-depth · Testing Law V (P21) on three providers: does correction in each round pull away with depth from a monitor that sees only the finished work? A counted test
摘要: Why this matters. This study is part of the ARC Theory and of Recursive Dynamics, the theory and the field that I, Michael Darius Eastwood, founded. I believe that correction which takes part in every round of a system's revisions of its own work pulls further ahead, round by round, of correction that sees only the finished result, and I registered that belief as a prediction, P21: "Correction that participates in each subsequent revision round outperforms correction that sees only the finished output, and the advantage widens as recursive depth rises rather than staying constant" (the ARC Theory predictions registration, version 1.104, https://doi.org/10.17605/OSF.IO/P8CKQ, line 1400). It matters to anyone who oversees an AI system that builds a long record step by step, such as a ledger kept entry by entry or a run of changes to a codebase, where the check can sit inside each step or with an inspector who sees only the finished record: if inspection of the finished work falls further behind with every round while correction inside each round holds, then where correction is placed is a design decision whose weight grows with the length of the work; if the lead does not widen, the case for building correction into each round cannot rest on depth. P21 is the placement limb of Law V, the ARC Embedding Law, so this study can refute a law of my theory; P21 is also one of the four registered carriers of my Eden Protocol. My counted test of it so far, Unit 83 (DOI 10.17605/OSF.IO/MN73W), completed on 28 October 2026: P21 is supported under the registered test, by the programme's own run, on the access axis, family-dependent, with its mechanism axis not evaluable and one call retried under a disclosed recovery amendment (results: DOI 10.17605/OSF.IO/98HKR). Only one of its two engines cleared the registered tolerance on its own, and its mechanism axis was not evaluable because a registered negative control failed, a failure that a post-run diagnostic, outside the registered analysis, traced to the control's own definition. 标题: When to Recompute: Wasserstein Embeddings for Change-Aware Influence Maximization in Temporal Networks
摘要: Dynamic real-world networks, such as communication, social interaction, and infrastructure networks, evolve continuously, posing significant challenges for scalable graph analysis. Graph-based tasks such as critical node identification, community detection, and influence maximization must be updated as these networks change. Yet, most structural changes have little effect on their results, so recomputing after every update is often redundant. When a change does matter, however, recomputation is expensive: identifying a small set of seed nodes that maximizes information spread under cascade diffusion is NP-hard, and even approximate solutions require greedy search with repeated Monte Carlo simulation. We therefore ask when network evolution invalidates the current seed set enough to justify recomputation. We build on Wasserstein Embedding for Graph Learning (WEGL), whose fixed-dimensional representations allow structural changes between snapshots to be detected through embedding distances. We extend these embeddings to influence maximization by training a regression model that predicts the influence spread of each snapshot without simulation. Combining both signals, we propose WEGL-IM, a framework with a two-stage change detection mechanism and an adaptive baseline, which recomputes the seeds only when both the predicted spread and the structure have drifted since the last recomputation. Experiments on six real-world temporal networks show that the embeddings predict the influence spread well. The test R2 is 0.70–0.97 under independent cascade and 0.49–0.92 under weighted cascade. WEGL is more accurate than graph neural networks in 10 of 12 settings and than graph statistics in 7 of 12. WEGL-IM retains 1–2 percentage points more spread than periodic recomputation with the same budget on Email-Eu-Core and Bitcoin Alpha. On CollegeMsg and MathOverflow, it performs on par with periodic recomputation. On the real networks, whose snapshots are small and sparse, monitoring is slower than recomputing on three of four networks. On synthetic graphs with 20,000 nodes, embedding a snapshot is about 13 times faster than one greedy recomputation.

标题: Understanding Market Psychology through Candlestick Patterns: A Qualitative Analysis of Investor Behavior in Stock Trading
摘要: Stock trading is influenced not only by companies’ fundamentals and market price movements, but also by investors’ perceptions, expectations, and psychological behavior. One technical-analysis tool commonly used to read price movements is the candlestick chart. Candlestick patterns are often interpreted as representations of the contest between buying and selling pressure and may help investors understand market sentiment. However, the same pattern does not always lead to the same decision because investors differ in experience, knowledge, risk tolerance, and emotional state. This study aims to understand how investors interpret candlestick patterns when reading market psychology, how emotions affect trading decisions, and which factors shape investors’ interpretations. The study is designed as descriptive qualitative research, using in-depth interviews, price-chart documentation, and observation of investors’ analytical processes. Data are analyzed through data condensation, data display, and conclusion drawing and verification. The analytical framework draws on Kahneman and Tversky’s Prospect Theory and behavioral-finance literature, while considering empirical studies of candlestick-strategy effectiveness. The study is expected to explain candlesticks as an aid to market interpretation and to explore the role of perception and emotion in decision-making. Empirical conclusions will be established on the basis of the field data collected.

标题: Regularity in Cryptocurrency Market Cycles: A Halving-to-Halving Analysis Using Data from Google Trends and Wikipedia
作者: Marek Zatwarnicki; Piotr Stolarski; Włodzimierz Lewoniewski
摘要: Bitcoin halvings provide a natural temporal structure for studying long-term dynamics of cryptocurrency markets. This paper presents a methodological framework for analyzing the regularity of Bitcoin and aggregate cryptocurrency market cycles by normalizing historical periods between consecutive halving events and projecting them onto a common relative-time scale expressed as the percentage of cycle completion. The proposed framework integrates market variables, namely Bitcoin price and aggregate cryptocurrency market capitalization, with measures of public attention derived from Google Trends search volume and Wikipedia pageviews. To obtain long-horizon daily attention indices, Google Trends data are reconstructed from overlapping 90-day windows linked by median scale ratios, following established approaches to combining high-frequency Google Trends samples. Rather than attempting to forecast future prices, the study aims to compare historical cycles, identify recurring temporal patterns, and evaluate the relationship between market dynamics and retail investor interest across different cycle-relative stages. Exploratory results point to a possible recurring structure. The maxima of the aggregate market capitalization in the two most recent completed cycles occurred at 39.0% and 37.9% of cycle completion, and the highest value of the ongoing cycle observed to date at 38.1% (534-547 days after the respective halvings), although the corresponding multiple of the halving-day value fell from 66 to 1.8. Public attention shows a similar compression of peak multiples, but not a similar timing. The paper also discusses current data limitations and outlines future research directions, including formal lead-lag analyses and expanded multi-asset investigations.

标题: MotionGraphicsBench: Evaluating Motion Graphics Generation with Programmatic Verification
作者: Jiaju Ma; Ashvini Kumar Jindal; Chuhua Wang; Sumithra Bhakthavatsalam
摘要: Large language models can generate motion graphics from static images and natural language requests, but it remains difficult to evaluate how well models can follow requests that combine spatial, appearance, and temporal requirements. We introduce MotionGraphicsBench, an expert-curated benchmark of 100 instances for animating an input static SVG with a motion edit prompt. By supplying all required visual elements, our editing task reflects a designer-like workflow and isolates motion generation from graphic generation. Derived from real-world Lottie motion designs, our benchmark contains diverse combinations of spatio-temporal animation behaviors. Each benchmark instance pairs its model input with a deterministic, human-readable verification program that accepts different valid implementations and reports which prompt requirements pass or fail, rather than comparing against a reference animation or using a VLM judge. We construct these programs with a multi-agent pipeline using human-labeled animations and synthesized test cases. On a balanced test set of 180 animations, our programs achieve 93.3% raw agreement with human judgments, compared with 83.3% for a GPT-6 Astra VLM baseline, and outperform the baseline in both approval and rejection recall. Across 47 configurations from 32 LLMs and 12 providers, pass@1 ranges from 6.0% to 67.7%. Across 15 models evaluated at their highest available reasoning effort with 32 attempts per instance, additional attempts improve every model, but pass@32 still ranges from 38.0% to 95.0%. Our analysis of verification programs reveals that generated animations often fail to match reference poses, follow requested motion trajectories, or coordinate related events. We release our benchmark at https://huggingface.co/datasets/figma-ai/motion-graphics-bench.

标题: Neuro-Symbolic Artificial Intelligence for Secure, Explainable, and Intelligent Banking and FinTech Systems: Fraud Detection, Credit Risk, Financial Forecasting, and Transaction Security
作者: Abu Bakar Razzaq; MD Zia Ul Haque; Sehrish Naz; Huzaim Razzaq; Saba Munawar; Noshaba Qasmi; Uzma Raza; Muhammad Noman; M. Zeeshan Younus
摘要: The rapid digitalization of banking and FinTech systems has intensified the need for artificial intelligence that is accurate, secure, explainable, and regulation-compliant. Conventional deep learning models deliver strong predictive performance but remain opaque black boxes, while Large Language Models (LLMs) offer powerful unstructured-data understanding yet suffer from hallucination and weak constraint satisfaction. Neither paradigm alone satisfies the transparency and compliance demands of modern financial regulation. This paper proposes the Explainable Neuro-Symbolic Trust Layer (XNSTL), a unified framework integrating LLM-based neural learning with symbolic rule reasoning, financial ontologies, and a regulatory audit mechanism to serve four critical banking tasks: fraud detection, credit risk assessment, financial forecasting, and transaction security. The XNSTL architecture comprises four modules: (i) an LLM-based feature extraction module for unstructured financial data; (ii) a symbolic rule engine encoding AML/KYC, Basel III, and institutional credit policies; (iii) a neuro-symbolic fusion module with confidence calibration and uncertainty quantification; and (iv) an explainability and audit layer generating counterfactual explanations and tamper-proof audit trails. We formalize the four tasks, define a hybrid loss function jointly optimizing predictive accuracy, symbolic constraint satisfaction, and explanation faithfulness, and propose an evaluation protocol using public benchmarks including IEEE-CIS Fraud Detection and Lending Club datasets. The framework is designed to reduce false positives in fraud detection, improve fairness in credit decisions, strengthen forecasting robustness under regime shifts, and enable real-time, audit-ready transaction security, establishing a pathway toward trustworthy and regulation-native financial AI.

标题: FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT PROJECT IN THE AGE OF ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE: LEVERAGING MACHINE LEARNING ALGORITHMS FOR INVESTMENT ANALYSIS, RISK MITIGATION, AND PORTFOLIO OPTIMIZATION
作者: Lilia GHEDABNA; Mohammed Shahadat Hosen; Rahaf Ala Rashy; Irfan Syed Mohammad; Agon Baftijari; Muhammad Abdul Rehman; Rajan  Ahmad; Zulkiflee Abdul-Samad
摘要: This research shows how financial market trends become accessible ML algorithms, which minimize investment risk and enhance portfolio output. Modern financial management utilizes the quick AI and ML developments to acquire data-based information that produces investment planning methods, security evaluations, and resource maximization strategies. The study bases its investigation on quantitative methods using secondary market data combined with historical stock records and present economic metric information. Different types of ML algorithms consisting of regression models, decision trees deep learning networks and reinforcement learning undergo testing for their success in financial forecasting and risk evaluation. The research investigates actual use cases of investing firms and banking institutions that implement AI-powered financial management technologies. The utilization of artificial intelligence in financial management leads to better investment choices immediate analytics and prediction abilities beyond classic decision-making approaches. The primary barriers to the deployment of AI-based systems include managerial information security requirements and regulatory needs coupled with algorithmic prejudice issues. Researchers should direct future studies to improve AI models while developing transparent financial decisions and ensuring the proper conduct of AI when deployed in financial institutions. Financial management experience ongoing changes through AI adoption because it develops more flexible and efficient financial systems.

标题: Predictive Surprise as Self-Grounding Concept Bottleneck for Interpretable Time Series
作者: Sachith Abeywickrama; Emadeldeen Eldele; Min Wu; Xiaoli Li; Chau Yuen
摘要: Time-series classifiers deployed in risk-sensitive domains must be (1) accurate, (2) interpretable, and (3) able to abstain when evidence is weak. Existing methods do not deliver all 3 at once, and the obstacle is structural, rather than logistical. Meaningful temporal patterns cannot be defined without knowing segment boundaries, yet meaningful boundaries cannot be placed without knowing which patterns to expect. Existing approaches break this circularity by using fixed windows or expert-annotated vocabularies, thereby sacrificing at least one of the 3 properties. We introduce ConceptTime, which closes the loop through a single self-supervised signal. A frozen probabilistic forecaster predicts a distribution over the next observation at every timestep of the sequence. We call the mismatch between its prediction and the realized signal the predictive surprise. This signal both locates segment boundaries and characterizes each resulting segment through the forecaster. Segments are thus grounded by how they behaved relative to expectation, not by what they look like. These summaries cluster into a vocabulary of dynamical regimes that we call concepts. A lightweight head classifies from the concept sequence, and the distance to the nearest concept yields reliability by design. Across 17 public benchmarks, ConceptTime is competitive with state-of-the-art black-box accuracy, beats every interpretable baseline, and retains near-98% accuracy on Epilepsy with 1% of labels. It further remains competitive with softmax, prototype-distance, and SHAP/TimeX/TimeX++ on OOD detection and deletion faithfulness, without a single annotation, language model call, or domain expert. Code is available at: https://github.com/Sachithx/ConceptTime.git.

标题: Account Takeover (ATO) Vulnerabilities: A Review of Session Hijacking, Credential Stuffing, and SIM-Swapping Methods Targeting Social Media Influencers
作者: Mashaan Hshaem Hasan Al-Rikabi; Mohamad Fadli Bin Zolkipli
摘要: Account takeover (ATO) is defined as when an unauthorised person takes control of an online account belonging to another. Social media influencers are in a situation of extreme risk due to the convergence of personal identity, professional reputation, business relationships, and direct access to huge audience. Previous research has focused on the analysis of ATO methods individually, and has not often included creators as a separate population. The review in this paper is a critical analysis of ATO methods such as session hijacking, exploiting an authenticated session; credential stuffing, using previously leaked username-password combinations; and SIM swapping, exploiting a SIM card and the connection between the telephone number and its subscriber. The paper, which relies on a structured narrative literature review of peer-reviewed journal and conference papers and supports it with documented real-world incidents, compares the three methods with respect to prerequisites, weaknesses exploited, impact, detection problems and countermeasures. It reveals that each approach evades a different level of protection; a stolen session is not protected by multifactor authentication and SMS-based recovery is irrelevant in the presence of passkeys. A multi-faceted strategy, involving the use of phishing-resistant authentication, unique passwords, device-specific session management, protected account recovery, behavioural monitoring, and incident-response planning, shared between influencers, platforms and mobile service providers is essential for effective protection.

标题: Multifractal Quantile Detrending Moving-average Cross-correlation Analysis
摘要: Abstract We introduce multifractal quantile detrending moving-average cross-correlation analysis (MF-X-QDMA), the bivariate extension of the quantile detrending moving average algorithm of a jointly submitted companion paper. The local trends of the two profiles are moving quantiles at levels $(\lam_x,\lam_y)$, in one and two dimensions. For pairs of non-negative measures, the product of the two quantile residuals is exactly a product of gliding-box masses, so MF-X-QDMA measures the joint partition function. This yields the exact cross exponent of two binomial measures, $\tau_{xy}(q)=-\log_2[(p_xp_y)^{q/2}+((1-p_x)(1-p_y))^{q/2}]$. A Cauchy--Schwarz bound, $\tau_{xy}\ge(\tau_{xx}+\tau_{yy})/2$, shows that the widely used relation $h_{xy}=(h_{xx}+h_{yy})/2$ holds only for identical multipliers. Measured against the exact expression, the error of MF-X-DMA for $(p_x,p_y)=(0.1,0.45)$ falls from 0.094 to 0.017. For signals, quantile levels $\lam\neq1/2$ leave a residual offset that creates spurious cross-correlation (0.44 for independent series at $\lam=0.1$); we give three remedies. On benchmarks with known exponents, MF-X-QDMA with mixed levels $(0.1,0.9)$ is the most accurate estimator for binomial pairs (mean error 0.007, versus 0.012 for MF-X-DMA). In two dimensions it lowers the $\tau_{xy}$ error of $256^2$ cascade pairs by 27\%--35\%. For monofractal pairs it is comparable to the best moving-average variant. We apply the method to 16 pairs of daily financial series (stock indices, exchange rates, commodities, VIX, Treasury yields, Bitcoin) and 29 stock--index pairs. Under injected bad ticks, the median-detrended cross-correlation coefficient is less sensitive than the detrending moving-average coefficient for 27--29 of the 29 stock pairs. Combining the median trend with first-order moments roughly halves the sensitivity to gross bad ticks and makes it 3.5--18 times smaller than that of Pearson's coefficient. A rolling analysis recovers the 2001 sign reversal of the stock--bond correlation under errors that distort the Pearson coefficient by 0.27 on average. Quantile detrending does not help against return errors that shift the price level, or against dense microstructure noise.

标题: Quantile Detrending Moving Average Algorithm for Multifractal Time Series and Surfaces
摘要: Abstract We introduce the multifractal quantile detrending moving average (MFQDMA) algorithm for one-dimensional (1D) time series and two-dimensional (2D) surfaces. MFQDMA replaces the moving average of the multifractal detrending moving average (MFDMA) method by a moving $\lam$-quantile, the local-constant solution of Koenker--Bassett quantile regression, and thereby produces a one-parameter family of generalized Hurst exponents $h(q,\lam)$ for backward, centered, and forward windows. We derive exact properties of the estimator. For a non-negative measure the quantile residual is exactly the mass of a gliding box of size $\ell=(1-\theta-\lam)(n-1)$; consequently $h(q,\lam)$ is asymptotically independent of $\lam$, and the algorithm degenerates on the line $\theta+\lam=1$, which contains the centered median. For signals, $h(q,\lam)$ is affine invariant and satisfies $h(q,\lam;-x)=h(q,1-\lam;x)$. No box-sum reduction exists in 2D. On benchmarks with analytically known spectra, backward MFQDMA matches MFDMA on clean 1D cascades and fractional Gaussian noises, and lowers the error of the mass exponent $\tau(q)$ of $256\times256$ multiplicative cascades by 29\% at $\lam=1/4$. When 2\%--10\% of a 1D cascade is replaced by outliers, Student-$t$, or L\'evy-stable values, low-$\lam$ MFQDMA reduces the $\tau(q)$ error of MFDMA by 22\%--46\% and that of multifractal detrended fluctuation analysis by a factor of 2--4, whereas $\lam\ge3/4$ is harmful. MFQDMA does not remove the spurious multifractality of $\alpha$-stable noise, does not confer invariance under monotone transforms, and gives only marginal gains for contaminated surfaces. Self-affine surfaces must be analyzed through their mixed increments; otherwise $h(2)\approx2$ irrespective of the Hurst index. We apply the method to daily returns of 18 financial assets (12 stock indices, three exchange rates, gold, oil, Bitcoin) and 29 Dow Jones stocks. There the multifractality is mainly distributional, and low-$\lam$ MFQDMA is the estimator least sensitive to isolated bad ticks (less sensitive than MFDMA for 28 of 29 stocks, and about half as sensitive as MFDFA) and to a few crash days: removing 19 October 1987 changes the S\&P 500 spectral width by $0.010$, versus $0.093$ for MFDMA. MFDMA remains preferable for dense microstructure noise. In 500 electroencephalogram segments and a terrain elevation model, the multifractality is dominated by linear correlations, and the $\lam$-resolved exponents carry class information not contained in $h(q)$. A jointly submitted companion paper extends the method to cross-correlations.

标题: Russia–Ukraine War and Bitcoin Volatility Dynamics
作者: Kose John; Alexander Kurov; Jingrui Li; Chuyi Sun
摘要: This article examines how Bitcoin prices and volatility respond to the Russia–Ukraine war, distinguishing between attention to the conflict itself and attention to SWIFT-related sanctions. Using high-frequency Bitcoin data from Coinbase and Google Trends as measures of global attention, we investigate the relationships between geopolitical attention and Bitcoin returns and realized volatility, including its jump and continuous components. We find that increased attention to the war is associated with lower Bitcoin returns and higher realized volatility, affecting both its continuous and jump components. In contrast, SWIFT-related attention is negatively associated with Bitcoin jump volatility, while its contemporaneous relationship with Bitcoin returns is statistically insignificant. Additional analysis reveals that lagged SWIFT-related attention positively predicts subsequent Bitcoin returns. These findings highlight the distinct relationships between different forms of geopolitical attention and Bitcoin market dynamics, consistent with Bitcoin’s dual role as a speculative asset and a potential alternative cross-border transaction mechanism.

标题: CzeLex: A megastudy dataset of concreteness, imageability, age of acquisition, valence, and gender ratings for 9601 Czech words
作者: James Brand; Filip Šmolík; Jan Chromý; Filip Smolík; Jan Chromý
摘要: Understanding how semantics are processed at the lexical level has been a key aim for the cognitive sciences, with large-scale semantic rating studies in different languages playing a crucial role in facilitating the advancement and development of theories of lexical processing, as well as providing valuable methodological resources that can be used in empirical investigations. In this paper, we present the CzeLex database, a megastudy of 9601 Czech words that have been normed along five psycholinguistic dimensions from a large sample of 4405 Czech-speaking participants. We provide individual rating data at the item and participant levels, as well as aggregated data from both mean ratings and latent means derived using cumulative-link mixed modeling, along with a comprehensive analysis comparing aggregation methods. We demonstrate that the dataset has good reliability and that specific dimensions predict lexical processing measures in a lexical decision task, regardless of the aggregation method used. These norms are the largest available subjective rating resource for Czech and further contribute to the growing body of languages with openly available data on these dimensions. We hope that the dataset will be a valuable resource for researchers working on Czech, in addition to opening up new opportunities for cross-linguistic semantic investigations. All data, code, and analyses are available at https://osf.io/tqxfm .

标题: Neuro-Bayesian Architecture in Economic Modeling: Overcoming Agent System Limitations via Latent Variable Integration
摘要: The aim of this study is to improve the accuracy of insurance risk prediction using multimodal data. In the context of the modern digital economy and the exponential growth of unstructured data volumes, an automation paradox is observed: despite the increase in computational power, Agentic AI solutions demonstrate a decline in predictive accuracy in tasks containing latent variables. To address this problem, the study proposes and substantiates a hybrid "Neuro-Bayesian Monte Carlo" (NB-MC) architecture, integrating the semantic capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) with Bayesian inference mechanisms. Drawing on works on economic productivity scaling laws, we test the hypothesis that overcoming agent system limitations is possible through the integration of LLMs and Bayesian inference. A large-scale simulation ($N=50$ iterations, 2,500 observations) was conducted on synthetic insurance portfolio data. Results show that the NB-MC architecture, utilizing an internal model self-verification mechanism (Gnosis) to weight signals and minimize epistemic uncertainty, allows increasing the normalized Gini coefficient from 0.478 (baseline agent) to 0.746 (neuro-Bayesian agent), which represents a 56.2% gain. This proves the effectiveness of transitioning from fully automated agents to hybrid systems.

标题: Evaluating the Geometric Brownian Motion Model for Gold Price Movements (XAU/USD) across Market Conditions
摘要: This study evaluates the performance of the Geometric Brownian Motion (GBM) model in predicting prices and estimating the risk of XAU/USD under stable and unstable economic conditions. Daily closing price data are divided into in-sample and out-of-sample periods, where return and volatility parameters are estimated from the in-sample data and applied in Monte Carlo simulations. Prediction accuracy is assessed using the Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE), while risk is measured using Value at Risk (VaR) and Expected Shortfall (ES). The results indicate that MAPE values exceed 20% in both economic conditions, suggesting that the predictive accuracy of the GBM model remains moderate. Although the model performs slightly better during stable periods, the difference is not statistically significant. In contrast, risk estimation results show that VaR and ES range between 58% and 59%, with higher values observed during unstable periods. This reflects an increase in market risk driven by higher volatility. Overall, the findings suggest that while GBM is capable of capturing the general movement of gold prices, it has limitations in accurately predicting price levels and capturing extreme market fluctuations, particularly during periods of economic instability.

标题: Liquidity Contagion and Price Discovery: Evidence from Cryptocurrency Markets
摘要: Do exchanges that transmit liquidity shocks also lead price discovery? We examine this question across fragmented cryptocurrency markets using high-frequency limit order book and transaction data. Liquidity contagion is measured through a directed network of lower tail dependence in limit order book depth. We find that stronger liquidity contagion is associated with weaker price discovery after accounting for exchange heterogeneity and common market conditions. The evidence is strongest for contemporaneous specifications and persists under alternative definitions of liquidity contagion, price construction and sampling frequency. Information share provides the most consistent evidence across these alternative measurement choices. The estimates attenuate when sparse systems are excluded, particularly in the most demanding and predictive specifications. The findings suggest that liquidity shock transmission and information leadership capture distinct dimensions of market importance: exchanges that play a central role in propagating adverse liquidity conditions tend to contribute less to permanent price formation.

标题: Blockchain Beyond Borders: Rethinking Tanzania's Legal and Regulatory Framework for the Digital Age
作者: Edward Gamaya Hoseah; Donatus Nicholas Nditi
摘要: Blockchain technology highly impacts on global financial systems, digital governance, trade, and data management, hence challenging the adequacy of traditional legal and regulatory frameworks that are largely territorially bounded. In Tanzania, the emergence of blockchain-based applications, cryptocurrencies, smart contracts, and decentralised digital platforms presents both significant opportunities and complex regulatory challenges. While Tanzania has made progress in regulating aspects of the digital economy through legislation on electronic transactions, cybersecurity, data protection, and financial services, there remains no comprehensive legal framework specifically addressing blockchain technologies and their cross-border implications. This article examines the extent to which Tanzania’s existing legal and regulatory architecture can respond to the realities of a borderless digital ecosystem. It argues that Tanzania’s fragmented regulatory regime risks creating legal uncertainty, constraining innovation, and limiting the country’s participation in the global digital economy. It proposes a forward-looking framework that balances technological innovation with regulatory certainty, financial stability, cybersecurity, and public interest considerations. Ultimately, it contends that Tanzania must move beyond reactive regulation and adopt a coherent blockchain governance strategy capable of addressing the opportunities and risks of the digital age.

标题: Testing detailed balance in daily cryptocurrency markets: irreversibility in range–volume dynamics, and none detectable in candlestick shape
摘要: A non-equilibrium steady state is marked by broken detailed balance: probability circulates in state space, and the dynamics acquires an arrow of time. We test for this signature in daily cryptocurrency markets using only open–high–low–close–volume bars for 22 USDT-quoted pairs from one venue. Reversibility is assessed on transition counts rather than through the plug-in entropy production rate, whose finite-size bias consumes most of its power, and two corrections prove necessary. The count statistic’s degrees of freedom are the cyclomatic number of the realized support graph, not the number of state pairs, because Kirchhoff’s current law constrains the pair asymmetries; the pair count delivers a nominal 5% test at 0.2%. Block-permutation surrogates are invalid for this statistic, since a block of length L leaves a fraction ( L − 1 ) / L of transitions in their original order. No violation of first-order detailed balance is detected for the candlestick shape in any of 44 tests, which bounds any violation rather than evidencing a reversible mechanism, and follows largely from the near-absence of first-order dependence. Range–volume dynamics differ: with the state space selected on memory using five design assets that are then set aside, the bar range and traded volume jointly reject detailed balance in 12 of 17 held-out assets, with excess asymmetry positive in all 17 and median informational entropy production of 1.9 × 1 0 − 2 nats per bar, significant in 13. The finding survives an alternative partition, a parametric reversible null, and a control isolating the backward-looking normalization; persistence alone does not reproduce it.

标题: Funding fragility: Cross-scale disagreement in perpetual-futures funding and bitcoin downside risk
摘要: We examine whether disagreement between fast and slow summaries of perpetual-futures funding improves forecasts of Bitcoin downside risk after controlling for current standardised funding and volatility. Our indicator is the dispersion of six backward-looking funding-surprise filters, activated when their mean is positive. This gate selects a positive-surprise regime, not the sign of actual funding payments or the presence of leveraged positions. A stylized funding-budget model derives a conditional link between dispersed cash shortfalls, optimal position reductions and downside pressure; the observed indicator is an unvalidated proxy for those budgets. We characterise its information set, bounds and path response, and evaluate it using 4383 funding payments and 1461 daily Binance BTCUSDT futures candles from 26 May 2022 to 25 May 2026. Expanding-window forecasts show worse variance accuracy. For an eight-percent next-week drawdown, the Brier score falls from 0.1561 to 0.1541 and AUC rises from 0.487 to 0.550. The raw stationary-bootstrap p -value of 0.030 becomes 0.120 after Holm adjustment across four half-life grids. The Brier improvement disappears with non-overlapping weekly origins and is not reproduced for Binance ETHUSDT or Bybit BTCUSDT under the same design. Our contribution is a reproducible funding-path covariate and an evaluation that documents the limits of its incremental forecasting value. These tests do not establish a transferable downside-risk signal or identify a crowding, leverage or liquidation mechanism.

标题: Impact of Likelihood Approximation Choices on the Performance of Markov-Switching GARCH Models: Evidence from Thirty Global Financial Assets
作者: Joshua Oluwadamilare Ogundairo; Ojo O. Oluwadare
摘要: Markov-Switching GARCH (MS-GARCH) models are widely used to capture changing volatility regimes in financial returns, but their exact likelihood is computationally intractable because it requires summing over an exponentially growing number of possible regime histories. Several approximation methods have been developed to solve this problem, yet there is little systematic evidence on how these methods compare when applied to real financial data with diverse distributional properties. This gap is important: choosing the wrong approximation method can lead to materially different parameter estimates, convergence failures, and unreliable risk assessments. This study addresses the gap by comparing four likelihood approximation methods for MS-GARCH(1,1) models across thirty financial assets from five market types: equities, bonds, cryptocurrencies, derivatives, and foreign exchange. The four methods are Gray’s moment-matching collapsing procedure, the Plug-in approximation, five-point Gauss-Hermite Quadrature, and a Particle Filter using sequential importance resampling with 1,000 particles. Models are estimated under two specifications: a baseline (internal volatility dynamics only) and an exogenous (cross-market spillover conditioning) version, giving 220 experimental cases in total. Assets are grouped into four kurtosis categories - low (K<10), medium (10≤K<20), high (20≤K<50), and extreme (K≥50) - to examine how heavy-tailed distributions affect method performance. The Plug-in method produced the highest log-likelihood values across all kurtosis groups and market types, often exceeding Gray and Quadrature by more than 2,000 log-likelihood units for equity-index futures. Gray and Quadrature converged more reliably for cryptocurrency assets under exogenous conditioning. The Particle Filter converged most often but always gave the lowest log-likelihood values, falling two to four thousand units below the analytical methods for all asset classes and with parameters stuck near their starting values. The CBOE Volatility Index (ˆVIX) was the only asset for which all analytical methods failed to converge in every specification, marking a hard estimation limit for the adopted framework. Exogenous conditioning improved model fit for some assets but not all, with bonds and equity markets benefiting most. A practical, kurtosis-based method-selection guide is proposed for practitioners.

标题: PolitiFi in the 2024 U.S. election cycle: Technical analysis of its role in crypto portfolio diversification and efficiency
作者: Carlos Esparcia; Antonio Díaz; Razvan Sabin; Enrique Jiménez-Rodríguez
摘要: The rise of PolitiFi assets as a distinct class within the crypto-ecosystem raises questions about their financial behavior, diversification potential, and risk–return efficiency. This study examines the evolution of these assets in the context of the 2024 U.S. presidential elections, assessing their independence from other cryptocurrencies and their potential defensive role in crypto portfolios. We implement a bidirectional design that adds PolitiFi to non‑PolitiFi bases and the reverse, estimate time‑varying covariances and higher co‑moments with GO‑GARCH, optimize under CARA preferences, and evaluate Sharpe, Kappa, and Farinelli–Tibiletti on daily data. Three results emerge. The traditional crypto base is the most reliable core across preferences. The moderate profile concentrates the largest share of positive marginal contributions. Efficiency gains are more frequent when non‑PolitiFi assets are added to PolitiFi bases. The findings contribute to understanding how the intersection of politics, technology, and finance is reshaping investment mechanisms in the digital age.

标题: BBA: A Maintenance-Efficient Authenticated Data Structure for Sliding-Window Range Queries in Blockchain Systems
摘要: Blockchain, a fundamental technology that enables decentralization and trustlessness, has been widely adopted across various applications. To meet the urgent need for data retrieval from blockchain databases, it is crucial to optimize the traditional authenticated data structure (ADS)–initially designed to ensure data integrity–so that it also supports efficient search. In this paper, we focus on solving the sliding-window range-and-selective (SWR) query problem, a useful tool for analyzing historical data in blockchains. The primary challenge is minimizing ADS maintenance costs, as data insertion and deletion complicate the well-known tree-based index and require expensive hash updates due to node operations such as construction, merging, and rotation. We propose a novel ADS, named BBA, that constructs a small, fixed-topology tree via bucketing and leverages bitmaps to support efficient search and hash updates. BBA is a two-layer index: the filtering layer consists of a bucket tree with bitmaps, while the strengthening layer utilizes a limited number of bitmaps for fine-grained bucketing. We introduce a recursive bucketing mechanism to develop this lightweight strengthening layer that enhances data filtering. Our evaluation shows a reduction in maintenance costs by one to two orders of magnitude for dataset sizes ranging from 10 2 to 10 4 compared to the state-of-the-art methods.

标题: Bitcoin's Required Return: Pricing a New Asset Beside Equities and Gold (paper and replication package)
摘要: Working paper and full replication package. The paper derives the return Bitcoin's holders should require from three measured risks, the MCM equation: market risk (beta to the S&P 500), concentration risk (the share of wealth that holders keep in the asset, from household surveys) and mortality risk (from a census of 1,815 cryptoassets with 520 deaths, in which hazard does not fall with age). The required return is tested month by month against Bitcoin's returns since 2012 and applied to Ether, other cryptoassets, equity indices and gold. For 2026 it is about 18% a year on average (90% range 15-22%), about 9.5% compounded. Includes all scripts, input data, result tables, figures, and an audit script that re-checks every number quoted in the paper. The crypto input data are an unmodified copy of the Coin Metrics community dataset (Coin Metrics, Inc., CC BY-NC 4.0) as of 24 May 2026; the code is MIT-licensed.

标题: A machine learning framework for privacy-preserving financial risk assessment using explainable artificial intelligence and blockchain-based trust management
摘要: Introduction Financial risk assessment requires models that jointly satisfy privacy, explainability, and decentralized trust, yet existing machine-learning approaches usually address these requirements in isolation. Methods This paper proposes the Privacy-Preserving Explainable Trust Framework (PP-ETF), integrating federated learning with differential privacy, post hoc SHAP and LIME explanations, and a permissioned distributed ledger for trust management. PP-ETF is evaluated on the German Credit and HELOC datasets against statistical models, centralized ensembles and deep networks, and privacy-preserving baselines. Results PP-ETF outperforms privacy-preserving baselines in AUC-ROC while remaining within 1.4%–1.6% of centralized deep-learning models. Reputation-based adversarial detection excludes a malicious participant within two communication rounds with a 3.2% false-positive rate. Explanation stability yields average cosine similarity of at least 0.87, and the ledger processes up to 480 transactions per second with 2.4 s finality latency. Discussion The results support the feasibility of jointly implementing privacy, interpretability, and decentralized trust under the evaluated conditions; they do not imply that the underlying trade-offs are eliminated. PP-ETF provides an end-to-end blueprint for effective, scalable, private, interpretable, and trustworthy risk-management systems.

标题: CAP Protocol Backtest Trade Ledger: BTC, ETH, SOL and LINK perpetuals, January 2018 to September 2026
摘要: ## What this is Every trade from a backtest of the CAP (Continuation Acceleration Protocol) trading rules on Binance USDT perpetual futures for Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana and Chainlink. The rules were applied to Binance's own 1-minute price history, one minute at a time, as if each trade were being taken then. Every fee, slippage and funding payment is included in each result. It is a backtest. It is not a live trading account, not a third-party audit and not student results. Past performance, including documented win rates, does not guarantee future results. ## Files | File | Rows | Coin | Won | Average result ||---|---|---|---|---|| cap-backtest-btc-trades-v1.csv | 3,031 | BTCUSDT | 80.1% (2,429 of 3,031) | +3.28R || cap-backtest-eth-trades-v1.csv | 2,981 | ETHUSDT | 79.9% (2,381 of 2,981) | +3.16R || cap-backtest-sol-trades-v1.csv | 2,026 | SOLUSDT | 74.2% (1,504 of 2,026) | +3.14R || cap-backtest-link-trades-v1.csv | 2,861 | LINKUSDT | 78.6% (2,248 of 2,861) | +2.91R || cap-backtest-all-coins-v1.csv | 10,899 | all four | 78.6% (8,562 of 10,899) | +3.12R | The combined file is the four coin files stacked in that order, with one header row. The per-coin figures above are recomputed from the files themselves and match the published page. ## Columns | Column | Meaning ||---|---|| coin | BTC, ETH, SOL or LINK (USDT perpetual on Binance) || version | 1 to 10. See "Why there are ten versions" below || grade | S (best) or A. Setups are graded S, A, B, C, D, F by how many independent signals line up and how early in the move they are. Only S and A are traded, so only S and A are included || direction | LONG or SHORT || entry_candle_utc | The 1-minute candle the trade was entered on, UTC || entry_price | That candle's close || stop_price | Where the stop was || stop_distance_pct | Distance from entry to stop, in percent of the entry price || exit_candle_utc | The candle the trade closed on, UTC || exit_price | That candle's close, or the stop price if the stop was hit || exit_reason | stop, count end, or 120-day limit || hold_days | How long the trade was open || funding_rate_sum_pct | Sum of Binance funding rates over the hold || result_R | Result after every cost, in R (multiples of the amount risked) || win | yes if result_R is above zero, no otherwise | ## The cost formula The entry is moved 0.02% against the trade for slippage. R = (exit − entry) ÷ |entry − stop| for a long (reversed for a short), minus a 0.14% round-trip fee measured in R, plus or minus the funding paid or received (when funding is received, only 75% is counted), minus another 0.03% in R if the trade was stopped. Recomputing every row this way reproduces result_R. ## Why there are ten versions In the method, the trader decides the direction (up or down) by reading the larger move. That call is discretionary, so it cannot be scripted directly. It was modelled from the author's own measured past calls, including how late he usually is and how often he sits out, and the test was run ten times with that model. Every figure combines all ten versions. This is the main limitation of the dataset and the reason it is published in full: the direction model is the one part of the test that is not a fixed rule. ## How to check any trade Pick a row. Download that coin's free 1-minute history from https://data.binance.vision and find the entry candle. Its close is the entry price. Step forward minute by minute. If price touched the stop, that is the exit. If not, the trade closes on the exit candle at its close. Apply the cost formula above and you should land on result_R. ## Scaling between coins Every coin runs the same rules. Percent thresholds were scaled once by how much more each coin moves than Bitcoin: Ethereum 1.35×, Chainlink 1.74×, Solana 1.98×. Nothing was tuned coin by coin. ## How to cite Vincent, C. (2026). CAP Protocol Backtest Trade Ledger: BTC, ETH, SOL and LINK perpetuals, January 2018 to September 2026 (Version 1) [Data set]. The Chart Whisperer. https://chartwhisperer.ca/protocol-results Tested the other way, the same entries with a mechanical direction rule showed no edge. The results depend on the direction call, which is the part of the method that is taught, not scripted.

标题: DualTrust: Asymmetric Bayesian Reputation and Cryptographic Gating for Autonomous AI Agents
摘要: Abstract The proliferation of Ambient Wearable Intelligence (AWI) ecosystems, spanning augmented reality glasses, smartwatches, and pervasive edge IoT actuators, is fundamentally transitioning human-AI interaction from explicit tactile commands to continuous, implicit background tool delegation. In these ambient environments, autonomous Large Language Model (LLM) agents are granted operational authority to invoke external APIs, reserve financial micro-quotas, and control physical actuators. However, existing safety guardrails depend on secondary LLM-as-a-judge classifiers that introduce prohibitive runtime latencies (400–850 ms) and recurring token expenses, while static role-based access control fails against continuous behavioral drift, memory backdoors, and interleaved salami-slicing exploits. We present DualTrust, an asymmetric Bayesian reputation and cryptographic gating runtime engineered for autonomous multi-agent containment. DualTrust enforces a decoupled principal-agent architecture that strictly isolates Human Principal Accountable Credit from Bayesian Agent Operational Standing. Agent behavior is continuously modulated via an asymmetric power-law slashing engine (Δβ ∝ (sev · c^2) · v_a^1.8) with instantaneous clean-streak reset, deterministic SHA-256 64-bucket striped concurrency locks, atomically locked rollback refunds, and an O(1) RAM sliding-window RFC 6962 Merkle audit ledger with rolling epoch seals that bounds active memory consumption by committing historical roots to persistent storage. Evaluated across 176 automated invariant tests and 10,000-cycle Monte Carlo attack simulations, DualTrust makes deterministic authorization verdicts in a median latency of 47.10 µs in-memory (mean 63.16 µs, tail p99 287.10 µs) and 155.80 µs under persistent SQLite WAL disk transactions, with end-to-end Python decorator wrappers executing in median 60.70 µs (async) and 88.30 µs (sync) without external API calls. Compared against state-of-the-art LLM guardrails, DualTrust achieves over 6,600× lower latency (and over 32× to 50× lower latency than localized AST validators), by policy construction blocks Sybil defamation against collusive probation swarms, and provides tamper-evident, append-only audit durability with RFC 6962 inclusion verification, establishing a practical, foundational governance runtime for trustworthy ambient intelligence.

标题: Performance Bottlenecks in Computing ZK Proofs on a GPU
作者: Victor Carolino; Caleb Geren; Michael Kaufman; Maximilian Nussbaum; William Scott; Henry F. Korth
摘要: Zero-knowledge proofs allow one party to prove the correctness of a statement or execution of a computation while revealing no more than the statement of correctness itself. Recent use cases, such as AI datasets, suggest the need for faster proof generation over increasingly large constraint sets. This paper explores efforts in optimizing zero-knowledge proof generation, specifically PlonK, using GPUs, for applications that are not amenable to solution via incrementally verifiable computing (IVC). Our intention with this work is to improve ZK performance by introducing fundamental changes in the low-level architectural structure of proof generation. These changes affect performance curves for most current proof generation algorithms. In particular, this paper explores the trade-offs between increased parallelization on GPUs and the resultant memory management problems that occur due to this parallelization. We implement a parallelized PlonK in order to analyze these trade-offs and make arguments concerning the nature of data flows within the proving protocol. Our results lead us to consider multi-GPU environments to maximize performance for large circuit sizes. Such environments introduce issues of communication, efficient hardware management, data partition, and data transfers. This paper further discusses the use cases that motivate multi-GPU implementations, their cost models, and the use of remote direct memory access (RDMA) for data transfer among GPUs.

标题: Replication Certification at Publication: Checkable by Anyone, Anywhere, in Seconds, Forever
作者: Gary King; Yiqing Xu; Leo Yang Yang
摘要: Authors increasingly deposit replication datasets---the data and code behind publications---in archives, and journals increasingly require them to, under progressively onerous rules. But a deposit alone proves little, so authors keep paying: months for the journal's reanalyses, years answering readers' questions, and rancor as failed replications become accusations because no record establishes what actually ran. We introduce a replication certificate: a cryptographically signed record of the deposited files and logged output. It replaces the journal's reanalyses with evidence anyone can check in seconds, which no one, including the archive, can backdate, and no one can fake without risking detection. Certification asks little of anyone and benefits everyone: The author deposits, then reruns the analysis once under a random seed the archive computes from the deposit's hash and a blockchain block; the archive signs, timestamps (in that blockchain), and stores the record---confidential data included---without rerunning anything; the journal merely checks a website for the certificate; and anyone can check or replay any step decades later.

标题: A Hybrid AI-Driven Forecasting and Multi-Objective Optimization Framework for Efficient Healthcare Resource Allocation: A Case Study of Al-Kindi Teaching Hospital
作者: Alashari Omar Mohammed Naser; Faris Mahdi Alwan; Abeer Salim Alwan Alnajjarr; Marwan Abdul Hameed Ashour
摘要: Quantum Planning in real-world healthcare systems is typically executed in contexts that are not stable. Patient needs are variable and hard to predict, making the need for resources continually greater than supply. This is not just a problem of lack of resources at Al-Kindi Teaching Hospital in Baghdad, it's more about the structural distribution of the resources in critical departments. This study proposes an integrated approach that can be used to solve workforce allocation problems while taking into account more advanced demand forecast and multi-objective goal programming method to overcome long-term sustainability problems, including operational resilience, economic waste, and equity in healthcare access. There were two methods used to model patient demand: the ARIMA model and the Artificial Neural Networks (ANN) model. Both models gave valid results, however, the capacity of the neural network model in capturing irregular fluctuations was more pronounced. Finally, the projected demand was fed into a goal programming model for use in workforce allocation for the Emergency, Surgery, Internal Medicine and Laboratory departments. The wider findings highlight a consistent under-resourcing of clinical staff and a relative over-resourcing of support workers, which suggests that in today's healthcare landscape sustainability is heavily dependent on dynamic, data-informed alignment – not the unbalanced expansion of resources.

标题: MemGUI-Bench: Benchmarking Memory of Mobile GUI Agents in Dynamic Environments
作者: Guangyi Liu; Pengxiang Zhao; Yaozhen Liang; Qinyi Luo; Shunye Tang; Yuxiang Chai; Weifeng Lin; He Xiao; Wenhao Wang; Siheng Chen; Zhengxi Lu; Gao Wu; Hao Wang; Liang Liu; Yong Liu
摘要: Current mobile GUI agent benchmarks systematically fail to assess memory capabilities, with only 5.2-11.8% memory-related tasks and no cross-session learning evaluation. We introduce MemGUI-Bench, a comprehensive memory-centric benchmark with pass@k and staged LLM-as-judge evaluation. Our contributions include: (1) a systematic memory taxonomy analyzing 11 agents across 5 architectures; (2) 128 tasks across 26 applications where 89.8% challenge memory through cross-temporal and cross-spatial retention; (3) MemGUI-Eval, an automated pipeline with Progressive Scrutiny and 7 hierarchical metrics; and (4) RQ-driven assessment of 11 state-of-the-art agents. Our experiments reveal significant memory deficits across all evaluated systems, identify 5 distinct failure modes, and synthesize 5 actionable design implications. Core code is available at https://memgui-bench.github.io/.

标题: Philosophy Is Perfect
摘要: Abstract Philosophy Is Perfect offers a bold defense of philosophy against its pessimistic and moderate critics. Where “Flagellants” see futility and “Hedgers” see only piecemeal progress, Herman Cappelen advances a model of Hyper-Optimism: the claim that philosophy has been massively successful, foundational to all inquiry, and is flourishing precisely because of its characteristic disagreement. Part I argues that all disciplines ultimately “answer to philosophy” when their core concepts and methods are scrutinized, showing that pessimism about philosophy would undermine confidence in every branch of knowledge. Part II turns the standard critique on its head, arguing that persistent disagreement is not a defect but a structural virtue of philosophical inquiry: convergence would signal decay, not progress. Part III presents the positive thesis—that philosophy has already found the correct answers to the “Very Important Questions.” Cappelen argues that after centuries of systematic exploration, the correct answers are already articulated and defended in the philosophical commons. Part IV addresses objections. The result is a provocative re-evaluation of philosophy’s status. Rather than a discipline in crisis, Cappelen depicts philosophy as uniquely successful: it has discovered foundational truths, thrives on principled disagreement, and sets the terms for all other forms of inquiry. Philosophy Is Perfect is both a challenge to entrenched pessimism and a constructive vision of philosophy’s achievements and future.

标题: Confiança e transparência na construção digital: explorando o papel do BIM habilitado por Blockchain
摘要: The integration of Building Information Modeling (BIM) and Blockchain is emerging as a promising trend for the digital transformation of the construction industry, requiring further research to support its consolidation in the sector. This article investigates the role of Blockchain-enabled BIM as a mechanism to promote trust and transparency in digital construction. Addressing the problem of understanding how the integration of these technologies can improve construction processes, the study analyzes their potential based on approaches found in the literature. The research objective was to explore how Blockchain-enabled BIM is being applied. The methodology was based on a systematic literature mapping, using the snowballing technique, combined with content analysis with a descriptive and thematic approach. The results reveal significant progress in studies on the topic, highlighting benefits such as ensuring data traceability, automation through smart contracts, and interoperability with emerging technologies such as the Internet of Things (IoT) and digital twins.

标题: Genuine association or spurious responding? Experimental evidence on the correlation between cryptocurrency trading and problem gambling severity index scores
作者: Maira Andrade; Leonardo Weiss‐Cohen; Richard J. E. James; Leon Y. Xiao; Philip Newall
摘要: Background and aims: Cryptocurrency trading has become a popular activity worldwide, which has been correlated with harmful gambling as measured by the Problem Gambling Severity Index (PGSI). However, in addition to being non-causal, these correlations may partly or in whole follow from methodological weaknesses, such as failing to screen out non-gamblers, or failing to instruct participants to not consider cryptocurrency trading a form of gambling. Methods: In a large-scale pre-registered 2 × 2 online experiment (N = 4,781), we hypothesised that if observed correlations were driven by spurious responding, they would be credibly weakened by screening out non-gamblers (compared to no screening), and by instructing participants to not consider cryptocurrency trading as a form of gambling (compared to no-instruction). Cryptocurrency trading engagement was assessed via self-reported trading frequency, price monitoring frequency, and number of coins owned over the past year. Results: While gambling screening lowered reported PGSI scores, trading frequency remained positively associated with the PGSI across all conditions (β = 0.008, 95% HPDI [0.007, 0.010]), with no credible evidence that screening or instruction moderated the association. Exploratory analyses showed similar patterns for price monitoring frequency and the number of coins owned. A combined model showed that trading frequency explained the most variance in the PGSI outcomes. Conclusions: These findings provide further evidence of a genuine correlation between cryptocurrency trading and harmful gambling, and may inform future research and policy discussions regarding how gambling-related consumer protections could be relevant to cryptocurrencies.

标题: A crime script of Australian money mules
作者: Elena Morgenthaler; Benoît Leclerc; Jacqueline M. Drew
摘要: Abstract Money mules are critical facilitators in the laundering of illicit goods and commodities, yet their operational behaviours remain underexplored in the Australian context. This study developed a crime script of money mules through a content analysis of Australian court cases. By examining procedural elements across 25 crime events, the research identified four overarching stages in money mule operations. These included recruitment, preparation, transactions, and rewards. Findings highlighted three primary script tracks through which money mules move illicit proceeds: physical items, decentralised finance (cryptocurrencies) and centralised finance (cash and bank transactions). This research contributes new knowledge about the modus operandi of money mules. The study findings provide the basis on which to develop important recommendations for more targeted and effective crime prevention strategies aimed at addressing a key facilitator of money laundering crimes. These strategies include increasing public awareness of money mule activities, improving financial literacy, and implementing technological safeguards. The study also identifies the range of relevant stakeholders and highlights the importance of their collaboration.

标题: VAT Treatment of Core Crypto Transactions in the System of EU VAT and Beyond
摘要: Transactions in virtual crypto assets challenge VAT systems that were designed for conventional business models. With a particular focus on the common system of EU VAT, this article examines the treatment of core crypto transactions involving payment tokens, NFTs and utility tokens. It argues that crypto assets cannot be classified generically for VAT purposes. Instead, their treatment depends on the technological design of the relevant blockchain mechanism and the economic function of the token. The analysis addresses VAT issues related to mining and staking, trading in primary and secondary markets, the use of tokens, and the services provided by portal and interface operators. It includes an assessment of deemed supplier regimes for crypto platforms, margin schemes, and a special regime for vouchers from a VAT law and policy perspective. The article further shows that crypto pseudonymity creates particular difficulties for applying the destination principle, determining the taxable amount, and enforcing VAT liabilities, and presents possible solutions. The article thereby identifies the key issues that need to be addressed by any VAT/GST system to ensure adequate, neutral and efficient taxation of crypto assets.

标题: Легализация (отмывание) доходов, полученных преступным путем с помощью криптовалюты
摘要: В статье рассматриваются особенности использования криптовалют в целях легализации доходов, полученных преступным путём. Актуальность темы обусловлена развитием цифровой экономики, ростом оборота виртуальных активов и сложностью государственного контроля за криптовалютными операциями. Особое внимание уделяется рискам применения криптовалют в теневой экономике, подходам Росфинмониторинга и ФАТФ, а также механизмам финансового мониторинга. Делается вывод о необходимости совершенствования правового регулирования цифровой валюты, развития аналитических инструментов блокчейн-контроля и укрепления международного взаимодействия в сфере противодействия отмыванию доходов.

标题: Law and Policy of the Banking System
摘要: This book provides a contextual, interdisciplinary and comparative analysis of the legal and policy framework governing the mechanics of the banking system. It examines the interaction between law, regulation and public policy, focusing on themes such as prudential supervision, financial consumer protection, systemic risk and technological change. It also addresses the impact of Brexit, digitalisation and the challenges posed by FinTech and AI systems. Organised into four parts, the book explores the regulatory architecture of UK and EU banking systems as well as the complex and evolving regulatory frameworks for banks that aim to prevent and manage banking crises. The second edition offers a deeper comprehensive view that balances both academic and practitioner perspectives on the evolving financial industry. It includes a new chapter on ESG and sustainable finance, updates on digital payments and settlement processes and an exploration of blockchain and cryptoassets. The book demonstrates that the proliferation of legislative intervention in the banking sector since the 2007–2009 global financial crisis has created persistent tensions between regulatory rules and the common law. Law and Policy of the Banking System is an invaluable resource for students, scholars, regulators and professionals seeking an account of the rapidly evolving field of banking law and regulation.

标题: Stablecoin Development Pathways: A Comparative Analysis of Regulatory Logic and Market Landscape in China and the United States
摘要: The global stablecoin market has reached roughly $280 billion, with dollar-pegged instruments accounting for over 92% of circulating supply. Existing scholarship largely treats the United States and China separately, leaving the regulatory logic and market structure of the two systems uncompared. This paper adopts a two-dimensional comparative framework—regulatory logic and market landscape—to examine why the two economies have taken opposite stablecoin paths. Using comparative case-study evidence and an event-study test of two policy shocks, it finds that the United States built a compliant private-issuance model under the GENIUS Act to extend dollar usage in digital payments, while China banned private stablecoins and promoted the central bank digital currency e-CNY to defend monetary sovereignty and financial stability. An event study shows that China's September 2021 ban induced a post-event cumulative abnormal return (CAR(+1,+30)) of RMB-pegged stablecoin proxies of -93.5%, while the U.S. Senate's passage of the GENIUS Act in June 2025 induced a full-window cumulative abnormal return (CAR(-30,+30)) of +9.4% for dollar stablecoins, both significant at the 1% level. The divergence is explained by differences in monetary institutions, regulatory philosophy, capital-account regimes, and engagement with international governance bodies. The framework offers a reference for digital-asset governance in other economies.

标题: Service Quality Analysis of Cryptocurrency Exchanges: An Innovative Approach Integrating Quality Scale, Fermatean Fuzzy Multi-criteria Decision Making and Chatbots
摘要: The development of technology has given rise to various investment instruments, such as cryptocurrencies. As interest in cryptocurrencies has increased, cryptocurrency exchanges have become critical platforms facilitating transactions between digital assets and fiat currencies. Since exchanges differ in service quality, identifying those offering superior performance has become an important issue for investors. This study proposes a four-stage approach to evaluate cryptocurrency exchanges based on service quality. First stage, 20 criteria derived from the electronic service quality (Es-Qual) scale, and five major cryptocurrency exchanges are identified. Criteria weights are determined using Fermatean fuzzy numbers (FFNs). In the second stage, expert evaluations are aggregated, and the alternatives are ranked using the Fermatean Fuzzy Technique for Order Preference by Similarity to the Ideal Solution (FF-TOPSIS) method. Third stage, evaluations are generated using different versions of Artificial Intelligence (AI)-based chatbots to examine their analytical consistency within the predefined conceptual framework. In the fourth stage, the level of agreement between expert-based and AI-assisted evaluations is analyzed comparatively, and a sensitivity analysis is conducted to test ranking robustness. The findings indicate that System Availability and Privacy are the most influential criteria in the weighting process. In the ranking, Binance is ranked first, while Bitstamp is ranked last. The sensitivity analysis confirms the stability of the top-ranked alternative under varying weight scenarios. Furthermore, AI-generated evaluations exhibit structural similarity with expert-based results under controlled conditions, suggesting that AI-based tools may serve as supportive analytical instruments in multi-criteria decision-making (MCDM) contexts rather than as replacements for expert judgment.

标题: RANNTA PANDORA V1.5 — Bitcoin Market Intelligence and Statistical Forecasting Software
摘要: RANNTA PANDORA V1.5 is an independently developed Bitcoin market intelligence and statistical forecasting application created by Ilia GH (ilia144000), founder and protocol architect of RANNTA. The Windows-based software integrates public market data from five cryptocurrency exchanges: Binance, Bybit, OKX, Kraken, and Coinbase. Its principal capabilities include seven statistical forecasting horizons ranging from 10 seconds to 7 days, technical trading ratings, executed order-flow analysis, cumulative volume delta, historical liquidity heatmaps, order-book imbalance, derivatives analytics, persistent market observations, and statistical learning mechanisms. The application evaluates historical predictions against subsequently observed market outcomes and supports ongoing assessment of model performance. This publication provides a public technical overview of RANNTA PANDORA V1.5 for documentation, attribution, and citation purposes.
