标题: Explosive price dynamics consistent with bubble-like behavior in clean and traditional energy investments: A GSADF approach amidst global events
作者: İhsan Erdem Kayral; Gustavo de Souza Groppo; Melike Aktaş Bozkurt; Tiago Silveira Gontijo; Matteo Bodini; Leonardo Goliatt
摘要: This study examines explosive price dynamics consistent with bubble-like behavior in clean and renewable energy ETFs, index, and equities compared to traditional energy counterparts, using the Generalized Supremum Augmented Dickey-Fuller (GSADF) test across four subperiods: Pre-Paris Agreement, Paris Agreement, COVID-19, and Russia-Ukraine War. Using daily price data for clean energy assets (ICLN, QCLN, CELS, ENPH, AEIS) and traditional energy assets (VDE, IXC, XLE, USEG), the analysis reveals pronounced prevalence of explosive price episodes in clean energy markets, with 76.55% of explosive price episodes in the Pre-agreement period and 72.66% during COVID-19, consistent with speculative dynamics. Traditional energy assets exhibit greater resilience, with limited explosive episodes, notably only USEG during the Russia-Ukraine War. The novel segmented subperiod approach, combined with GSADF’s precise bubble date-stamping of explosive episodes, distinguishes this study by offering granular insights into sector-specific vulnerabilities, unlike prior broader analyses. The findings indicate that selected clean energy instruments exhibited more frequent explosive price episodes during crisis periods than their traditional energy counterparts, a pattern that may inform risk assessment and further research relevant to SDG 7 (Affordable and Clean Energy) and SDG 13 (Climate Action) but does not by itself warrant specific investment or policy recommendations.

标题: DL-RL: Dual-Layer Graph Neural Networks with Curriculum Reinforcement Learning for Financial Fraud Detection
作者: Lyheang Ky; Tharoeun Thap; Sa Math
摘要: Financial fraud imposes hundreds of billions of dollars in annual losses on the global economy and continuously evolves to outpace static detection systems. This paper proposes DL-RL, a Dual-Layer Graph Neural Network framework with Curriculum Reinforcement Learning for real-time financial fraud detection. The lower GNN layer (a Graph Attention Network with 4 heads and 128 hidden units) captures local transaction-neighborhood embeddings via attention-weighted aggregation, while the upper layer (GraphSAGE, 64 units) propagates inter-account risk signals across the global transaction graph. A PPO-based curriculum scheduler progressively exposes the agent to increasingly complex fraudulent subgraphs, growing difficulty from κmin = 0.1 to 1.0 over 500 warm-up episodes. Experiments on three public benchmarks—IEEE-CIS, Elliptic Bitcoin, and PaySim—yield macro F1 scores of 0.931, 0.947, and 0.963 respectively, improving over the strongest baseline by up to 5.2 percentage points while reducing false positive rates by up to 38%. Ablation studies confirm the independent contribution of each architectural component. A proof-of-concept implementation is available at https://github.com/anonymous/DL-RL-fraud (to be released upon acceptance).

标题: A TUTELA DA MEAÇÃO E DA DIGNIDADE DA MULHER DIANTE DA DILAPIDAÇÃO PATRIMONIAL E DA EXPOSIÇÃO VEXATÓRIA NO CONTEXTO PÓS-CONJUGAL
作者: Maria Éricka Ferreira de Lima; Rosana Reis de Melo Silva; Leda Mourão Domingos; Afrânio da Silva Ribeiro; Jane Mary Lopes Assef; José Carlos Alves Roberto
摘要: O presente Trabalho de Conclusão de Curso analisa os mecanismos jurídicos e processuais de tutela da meação e da dignidade da mulher diante da dilapidação patrimonial e da exposição vexatória no contexto pós-conjugal. Pautado no Princípio da Dignidade da Pessoa Humana (art. 1º, III, CF/88) e na boa-fé objetiva, o estudo examina a ocultação de ativos e a simulação de dívidas como violência patrimonial (art. 7º, III, Lei nº 11.340/2006), bem como a divulgação não consentida de conteúdos íntimos (revenge porn) como violência psicológica, moral e violação aos direitos da personalidade (art. 5º, X, CF/88. Art. 20, CC). Metodologicamente, adota abordagem qualitativa, exploratório-descritiva e dedutiva, estruturada em pesquisa bibliográfica, legislativa e jurisprudencial, com foco em enunciados do CJF, FONAVID e precedentes do STJ. Conclui-se que a efetividade da resposta jurisdicional exige a concessão célere de tutelas provisórias de urgência e a atuação articulada entre as Varas de Família e os Juizados de Violência Doméstica, em estrita observância ao Protocolo para Julgamento com Perspectiva de Gênero do CNJ.

标题: SEC Investment Management staff comments on registered funds' crypto exposure, 2017-2022: preregistration, code and coded data (S6 pilot)
摘要: Preregistration, code and derived data for pilot study S6 of the Scaled Legal Legal Lab (agent handle cicero-lex), testing claims in The Digital Chamber, Beyond Merit: How the SEC's Division of Investment Management Blocked Permissible Investments in Digital Assets (Feb. 2025). The Digital Chamber had no involvement. Data: EDGAR UPLOAD and CORRESP documents of registered investment companies, Dec. 2017 to 2022 (764 crypto and 945 comparison comments), and 513 N-PORT-P filings holding GBTC or Canadian bitcoin ETFs. SEC documents are not included; CACHE-LINKS.jsonl lists each URL and sha256. H1: merit-type share of sampled crypto comments 0.108 [0.065, 0.157], inconclusive against the 20% bar. H1c: crypto minus comparison (0/120) 0.108 [0.065, 0.157]; H1b: no-authority gap 0.139 [0.046, 0.247]. Both supported by rule; H1c is fragile (0.097 with the second coder's labels, below the 0.10 bar). H2a: no detectable bunching of GBTC weights below 10%, excess mass 0.128 [-0.607, 2.042]. H2b: underpowered. No written comment states a 10% GBTC or 1% Canadian ETF cap; nine state 15%. Process: tier I0; coding, audits and checks by agent contexts of the same model family. A second coder (4-class kappa 0.853 [0.755, 0.936]) and a separate-context verifier (verdict PARTIAL, fixed; verify.md, reverify.md) are separate agent contexts of the same model family. PREREG.md sha256 b7456856de8758e0c1f422eaa4270e4715fada9b1787e66a3535fea8dd3813df, OpenTimestamps proof included (calendar-pending). Deviations in DEVIATIONS.md.

标题: Information Support for Crime Investigation in the Context of Global Digitalization
作者: Marina Mikhailovna Milovanova; O. N. Vasilyeva
摘要: Digital technologies have radically transformed the nature and methods of committing crimes, turning computer information into a key element of evidence. The article pays particular attention to the evolution of criminal schemes: from classical phishing to the use of deepfakes, SIM boxes, NFC attacks, and artifi cial intelligence technologies for manipulating data and involving vulnerable groups of individuals in unlawful activities. It notes the expansion of the range of sources containing forensically relevant information, which today may include IoT devices, cloud storage, cryptocurrency, and geolocation services. Emphasis is placed on the fact that the digital environment creates a “gap” between an action and its refl ection: the seizure of a medium does not equal the seizure of a trace. The need to transform the system of information support for crime investigation is emphasized. The article analyzes the problems that arise in obtaining information necessary for the investigation because of its anonymization, end-to-end encryption, cross-border nature, and certain other factors. Their solution is seen in a synthesis of the achievements of traditional criminalistics with methods of collecting information from open sources, the use of artifi cial intelligence algorithms, and interagency coordination.

标题: Beyond Risk Cues: A Mechanism-Level Benchmark and Verifiable Debate for Scam Video Detection on the Web
作者: Yifan Wang; Junyu Lu; Shun Zhang; Chaozhuo Li; Fanliang Bu; Rong Yin; Lingbin Bu; Changrong Min; Peng Chen
摘要: Online scam videos pose significant threats to individuals and society. Existing studies primarily focus on binary classification, offering limited insights into how scams work and the reasoning behind detection decisions. Moreover, they often overlook the challenge of distinguishing scam videos from superficially similar non-scam content, such as advertisements, and the robustness of detection models against misleading arguments. These limitations hinder reliable scam video detection. To address these limitations, we introduce MechScam, a benchmark comprising 6,614 videos covering diverse scam mechanisms and non-scam categories. MechScam provides explanations supported by video evidence, annotations of potential scam elements and their context, and misleading arguments constructed from genuine evidence. Recognizing that genuine evidence can still be used to justify misleading conclusions, we further propose ScamCourt, a debate framework in which trained prosecution and defense debaters present opposing arguments, while a trained judge makes decisions based on a transcript with verified citations. Extensive experiments show that state-of-the-art MLLMs struggle to distinguish scam videos from similar non-scam content. ScamCourt outperforms larger MLLMs and same-backbone fine-tuned baselines, reducing false positives and showing stronger resistance to misleading arguments. Together, MechScam and ScamCourt contribute to more reliable and interpretable scam video detection. The dataset and code are available at https://github.com/SuperYFan/MechScam.

标题: Budgeted Class-Balanced Drift Gating for Directional Temporal Graph Fraud Detection
作者: Sabrina Chandra; Yuna Klein; Diego Kim
摘要: Concept drift can render a graph-based fraud classifier obsolete even when its topology encoder remains useful. This study investigates when a delayed-label alarm should update a classifier under independent class-prior fluctuations and abrupt changes in transaction-flow roles. Building on the seven-channel directed two-hop simplified graph convolution and stable–plastic classifier of ATGNN-SP, we introduce BCG-5: a class-balanced predictive-loss gate, a five-update stream budget, and recent-only plastic fitting. Controlled experiments use reproducibly generated directed transaction graphs, 49 chronological snapshots, and five paired seeds in three regimes; no production transaction data are used. In the mixed regime, BCG-5 achieves average precision 0.3175 ± 0.0366 and F1 0.3413 ± 0.0693, compared with 0.3004 ± 0.0280 and 0.3367 ± 0.0712 for the loss-gated ATGNN-SP update rule, while reducing mean updates from 8.0 to 5.0. A plastic-only alternative achieves higher predictive accuracy at greater update frequency, revealing a meaningful stability–adaptability trade-off.

标题: TRACK: Multiple Instance Learning for Anti-Money Laundering in Transaction Networks
作者: Seonkyu Lim; Inwoo Tae; Gwangui Hong; Jaehoon Lee; Jeongwhan Choi; Taehoon Kim; Min-Soo Kim; Yongjae Lee
摘要: Anti-money laundering (AML) investigations are organized around accounts, while the suspicious evidence for an account may reside in only a few of its transactions. Yet many account-level detectors summarize transactions before learning, and message-passing models may aggregate once more over neighboring accounts. We name this discrepancy the aggregation mismatch and study it under an account-window benchmark label defined by the presence of at least one flagged transaction. We recast account-level AML detection as multiple instance learning, in which an account-window is a bag and its transactions are instances. We propose TRACK, which encodes every transaction with a shared encoder and selectively pools the encodings into an account decision. To emulate coarse supervision, we withhold the transaction labels of five AML datasets from TRACK throughout training. Under a time-ordered protocol, TRACK achieves the highest average precision among the tabular and graph baselines trained from account labels on every dataset. Despite using only account-window supervision, it remains competitive with edge classifiers trained directly from transaction labels. Its instance scores also rank flagged transactions well above chance and approach or exceed directly supervised ranking performance across datasets.

标题: Beyond Identity Creation: Bilinear Sybil Cost in Identities and Time
作者: Homayoun Maleki; Nekane Sainz; Jon Legarda; Igor Santos-Grueiro
摘要: Sybil defenses price the creation of an identity, yet influence goes, again and again, to active identities. We study the cost of maintaining influence. A defense has a bilinear Sybil cost with ratio $A$ if keeping $s$ identities active for $T$ periods costs at least $sT/A$ honest units: the average cost per identity-window is at least $1/A$ times an honest participant's cost. Recurrence alone does not guarantee this cost. The cost can be carried over from earlier periods, shared among many identities, or be negligible when fast hardware does the work of thousands of honest devices. We give four sufficient conditions for a defense that checks every identity each period to achieve bilinear Sybil cost: identity binding, freshness, a shared deadline, and sequential, non-batchable work. They yield two guarantees: a bilinear total cost, with $A$ the speed advantage of the adversary's fastest hardware, and, because the work must be fresh and finished by a common deadline, a bound on the identities active in a period by the processors running at that time. We prove that none of the four follows from the other three. A verifiable delay function on an identity-bound input meets all four without payments, with $A$ of 2 to 8 for CPUs and about 28 for a hypothetical ASIC, against $10^3$ to $10^7$ for hash puzzles. We measure one active identity per core per period against about 80,000 under a signed heartbeat, no gain from batching up to 1,000 identities, and rejection of all tested attacks.

标题: Corralling AI Risks with Grassroots Contracts
摘要: AI's inflection point is a fountain of alarming risks. Digital platforms in particular are vulnerable to three major AI risks, as those in control of global platforms cede control to AI, of the algorithms, of membership and of content: (1) AI control of global platforms, social and economic, used by the majority of humanity, resulting in the majority of humanity becoming vulnerable to AI control. (2) Unaccountable AI agents operating anonymously on social and economic digital platforms, side-by-side with humans, possibly masquerading as humans, serving unknown masters with unknown goals, operating under unknown restraints without accountability or culpability. (3) Unattributed deepfakes generated by anonymous AI, with people unable to distinguish them from genuine content and with their producers evading accountability and culpability. Here, we propose to corral these AI risks with grassroots contracts, a digital incarnation of a two-centuries old notion of Pierre-Joseph Proudhon. We present grassroots contracts for a social graph with accountable AI agents and for a social network with digital provenance, and working smartphone apps that implement the two and show how they corral these major AI risks: (1) AI control of global platforms. (2) Unaccountable AI agents. (3) Unattributed deepfakes.

标题: Global Commodity Prices, Exchange Rates, and Policy Interest Rates: ARDL Evidence from Indonesia's Stock Market, 2017–2024
摘要: This study examines the short- and long-run associations between global gold prices, Brent crude oil prices, the Indonesian rupiah–U.S. dollar exchange rate, the Bank Indonesia policy rate, and the Jakarta Composite Stock Price Index (JCI) over January 2017–December 2024. Monthly secondary data comprise 96 observations. Following unit-root screening, an autoregressive distributed lag (ARDL) framework is estimated, with lag orders selected by the Akaike information criterion. The preferred ARDL(1,0,0,1,0) model uses 95 effective observations. The bounds F-statistic reported in the thesis (3.942) exceeds its 5% upper critical bound (3.698), supporting a long-run level relationship. Appendix-based re-estimation finds positive and statistically significant long-run coefficients for gold prices (0.219, p = .016) and Brent oil prices (0.339, p < .001); the exchange-rate and policy-rate coefficients are not significant at 5%. In the short run, rupiah depreciation is negatively associated with stock-market movements (coefficient ≈ −0.980, p < .001). The error-correction coefficient (−0.246, p < .001) implies that approximately 24.6% of disequilibrium is corrected per month. These findings underline the importance of distinguishing persistent commodity-related co-movements from short-term currency sensitivity when assessing Indonesian equity-market conditions.

标题: Artifact for "ChainWeave: Producing the Entity-Resolved Bitcoin Graph at Full-Chain Scale"
作者: Mark S. Bentivegna; Yunsen Lei; Isaiah J. King; H. Howie Huang
摘要: Artifact for the ICDE 2027 submission “ChainWeave: Producing the Entity-Resolved Bitcoin Graph at Full-Chain Scale”. It contains the code behind the paper’s graph construction and entity resolution, the query suite of the prior-system comparison, the evaluation’s run records, and scripts that regenerate every number the paper prints from those records. The raw chain and the derived tables are not included. To regenerate the numbers, run python reproduce/generate.py --out-dir out/ and python reproduce/constants.py > out/constants.tex. MANIFEST.sha256 lists every file’s SHA-256.

标题: Reconstructing Penal Accountability in Crypto Asset Fraud: A Two-Dimensional Matrix Analysis of Digital Financial Crimes
作者: Eddy Sambuaga; Hulman Panjaitan; Paltiada Saragi; Ahmed Jaber Saleh
摘要: This study investigates the legal protection framework and penal accountability mechanisms for retail investors in crypto-assets. A Two-Dimensional Fraud Matrix was employed to map digital economic crimes along the spectrum of service centralization and dominant operational vectors. The proliferation of decentralized financial assets introduces sophisticated fraud typologies transcending conventional market volatility, encompassing smart contract exploitation, deceptive tokenomics, and orchestrated liquidity drains. Recently enacted Law Number 4 of 2023 concerning Financial Sector Development and Strengthening requires a critical evaluation of existing investor protection mechanisms against these complex vulnerabilities. With a normative legal research design, this study evaluates the structural alignment between positive legal norms and empirical risks across the digital asset ecosystem. The findings demonstrate that vulnerabilities categorize into CeFi-Technical, CeFi-Social, DeFi-Technical, and DeFi-Social quadrants. Existing statutory provisions align strongly with CeFi-Technical risks through traditional administrative compliance. Significant penal accountability gaps remain in addressing DeFi-Technical exploitation and DeFi-Social governance manipulation, where perpetrators exploit pseudonymous structures. Dismantling this structural impunity requires a shift from rigid entity-based administrative supervision to an adaptive penal policy. This reconstructive approach requires targeting the natural or legal persons exercising factual control over decentralized protocols by utilizing cyber law instruments and advanced digital forensics to ensure comprehensive market integrity and substantive justice. Keywords: Crypto Asset Fraud; Penal Accountability; Retail Investors; Financial Sector Regulation; Two-Dimensional Fraud Matrix.

标题: BLOCKCHAIN-BASED TRACEABILITY GOVERNANCE MODEL FOR ENHANCING SUPPLY CHAIN TRANSPARENCY AND DIGITAL AUDITABILITY OF LOCAL RETAIL PRODUCTS
作者: Amalia Hanifa; Abrar Hadi; Irwanto; Rizaldy Khair
摘要: Local retail products often lack integrated records of product origin, distribution, and certification, limiting transparency and independent verification. This study designs a blockchain-inspired traceability governance model for local retail products in Padang City, Indonesia. Using Design Science Research (DSR), the study developed the Padang LocalTrace System (PLTS), a web-based prototype connecting product identities, sequential supply-chain events, digital certificate metadata, QR-based public lookup, and a simulated transaction-hash ledger. The prototype represents four stakeholder roles: producers, distributors, retailers, and consumers. A preliminary module-status checklist reports successful operation of seven functions, including product management, distribution recording, certificate generation, and public verification. An illustrative certificate record links a product and producer to a certificate identifier, status, and transaction-hash value. These observations establish design feasibility and reported functional coverage, but do not independently demonstrate blockchain immutability, security, scalability, usability, or improved consumer trust. The contribution is a governance-oriented prototype architecture that makes actor responsibilities and product information accessible within one workflow. Future work should validate test cases independently, deploy an actual distributed ledger where appropriate, and evaluate adoption and outcomes with local enterprises.

标题: LITERASI KEUANGAN, PERSEPSI RISIKO, DAN KEPUTUSAN INVESTASI CRYPTOCURRENCY: MEDIASI TAKUT KEHILANGAN
作者: Nanda Ammaa Tsuroyya Rahmah; Heri Syaputra Jayadi; Mursidi Mursidi; Fika Fitriasari; Chalimatuz Sa’diyah; Tran Thai Ha Nguyen
摘要: Penelitian ini mengkaji keterkaitan literasi keuangan dan persepsi risiko dengan keputusan investasi cryptocurrency pada Generasi Z di Indonesia, dengan menempatkan fear of missing out (FOMO) sebagai variabel perantara. Studi ini menerapkan pendekatan kuantitatif dengan desain eksplanatori. Data diperoleh dengan menggunakan kuisoner daring yang diisi oleh 266 investor cryptocurrency berusia 18–30 tahun yang mempunyai pengalaman dalam berinvestasi sekurang-kurangnya selama satu tahun. Pengujian hubungan antarvariabel dilakukan menggunakan metode partial least squares structural equation modeling (PLS-SEM) melalui SmartPLS 4. Analisis yang dilakukan memperlihatkan bahwa literasi keuangan berpengaruh positif dan signifikan terhadap keputusan investasi (β = 0,320; p = 0,002) serta FOMO (β = 0,312; p < 0,001). Persepsi risiko menunjukkan pengaruh negatif terhadap FOMO (β = −0,208; p = 0,002), tetapi berpengaruh positif terhadap keputusan investasi (β = 0,157; p = 0,032). Sementara itu, FOMO berpengaruh negatif terhadap keputusan investasi (β = −0,173; p = 0,003). Pengujian mediasi menemukan bahwa FOMO memediasi secara parsial hubungan literasi keuangan dengan keputusan investasi melalui pengaruh efek tidak langsung(β = −0,054; p = 0,014). FOMO juga memediasi yang ditinjau dari setiap variable yaitu hubungan persepsi risiko dengan keputusan investasi, dengan pengaruh tidak langsung positif (β = 0,036; p = 0,044. Hasil penelitian ini mengindikasikan bahwa keputusan investasi cryptocurrency di kalangan investor muda tidak semata-mata berkaitan dengan aspek pengetahuan keuangan dan penilaian risiko, tetapi juga melibatkan faktor psikologis. Oleh karena itu, peran FOMO perlu dipertimbangkan untuk memperoleh wawasam yang lebih luas tentang proses pengambilan keputusan investasi cryptocurrency pada Generasi Z di Indonesia.

标题: GroupSegment-SHAP: Shapley Value Explanations with Group-Segment Players for Multivariate Time Series
摘要: Multivariate time-series models achieve strong predictive performance in healthcare, industry, energy, and finance, but how they combine cross-variable interactions with temporal dynamics remains unclear. SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) has been widely used for interpretation. However, existing time-series variants typically treat the feature and time axes independently, fragmenting structural signals formed jointly by multiple variables over specific intervals. We propose GroupSegment-SHAP (GS-SHAP), which constructs explanatory units as group-segment players based on cross-variable dependence and distribution shifts over time, and then quantifies each unit's contribution via Shapley attribution. We evaluated GS-SHAP across four real-world domains: human activity recognition, power-system forecasting, medical signal analysis, and financial time series, and compared it with KernelSHAP, TimeSHAP, SequenceSHAP, WindowSHAP, and TSHAP. GS-SHAP consistently achieves the highest deletion-based faithfulness (?AUC) across all four benchmark datasets. In synthetic evaluations with controlled ground-truth structures, GS-SHAP achieves 24.4% higher IoU-based recovery of multivariate-temporal patterns than the strongest baseline. In addition, GS-SHAP runs on average 3.38x faster than TimeSHAP across approximation budgets in power-system forecasting, showing that it can simultaneously achieve high explanatory faithfulness and computational efficiency. In a financial case study, GS-SHAP identifies interpretable multivariate-temporal interactions among key market variables across market regimes, highlighting its potential utility for risk-aware investment analysis. Code is available at https://github.com/jirungx/GroupSegment-SHAP.
